To address these limitations, we propose SemiGDA, a novel Generative Dual-distribution Alignment framework for semi-supervised medical image segmentation. Our SemiGDA overcomes the reliance of discriminative methods on large labeled datasets by aligning feature and semantic distributions to boost semantic learning and scene adaptability. Specifically, we propose a Dual-distribution Alignment Module (DAM), which employs two structurally distinct encoders to model image and mask feature distributions. It enforces their alignment in the latent space via distributional constraints, establishing structured feature consistency. Moreover, we design a Consistency-Driven Skip Adapter (CDSA) strategy, which introduces dual skip adapters (Image and Mask) to fuse multi-scale features via skip connections. Using a consistency loss, CDSA enhances cross-branch semantic alignment and reinforces fine-grained semantic consistency. Experimental results on diverse medical datasets show that our method outperforms other state-of-the-art semi-supervised segmentation methods. Code is released at: https://github.com/taozh2017/SemiGDA.

item.title: Contrastive Learning for Multimodal Human Activity Recognition with Limited Labeled Data
item.author: Long Jing, Zhixiong Yang, Yajun Zhang, Xinlong Feng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CLMM是一个用于人类活动识别的通用对比学习框架，旨在解决多模态数据异质性和标签稀缺问题。

背景: 研究人员利用多源传感器的协作感知来捕捉复杂动态的人类活动，但现有解决方案与实际需求之间存在应用差距。

目的: 提出CLMM框架，以有限的标注数据实现有效的多模态人类活动识别。

方法: 采用两阶段训练策略：第一阶段使用CNN-DiffTransformer编码器捕获跨模态共享信息，并利用硬正样本加权算法增强梯度传播；第二阶段结合质量引导注意力和双向门控单元的dual-branch架构捕获模态特定信息，并采用主-辅协作训练策略融合共享和模态特定信息。

主要发现: 在三个公共数据集上的实验结果表明，CLMM显著提高了最先进基线的识别准确性和收敛性能。

结论: CLMM框架在有限标注数据下实现了有效的多模态人类活动识别，优于现有方法。

翻译: CLMM是一个用于人类活动识别的通用对比学习框架，旨在解决多模态数据异质性和标签稀缺问题。

Abstract

Human activity recognition serves as the foundation for various emerging applications. In recent years, researchers have used collaborative sensing of multi-source sensors to capture complex and dynamic human activities. However, multimodal human activity sensing typically encounters highly heterogeneous data across modalities and label scarcity, resulting in an application gap between existing solutions and real-world needs. In this paper, we propose CLMM, a general contrastive learning framework for human activity recognition that achieves effective multimodal recognition with limited labeled data. CLMM employs a novel two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, CLMM employs a CNN-DiffTransformer encoder to capture cross-modal shared information by extracting local and global features. Meanwhile, a hard-positive samples weighting algorithm enhances gradient propagation to reinforce shared learning. In the second stage, a dual-branch architecture combining quality-guided attention and bidirectional gated units captures modality-specific information, while a primary-auxiliary collaborative training strategy fuses both shared and modality-specific information. Experimental results on three public datasets demonstrate that CLMM significantly improves state-of-the-art baselines in both recognition accuracy and convergence performance.

item.title: RadTwin: Generalizable Wireless Digital Twin for Dynamic Environments
item.author: Yuru Zhang, Ming Zhao, Qiang Liu, Ahmed Alkhateeb, Abhishek K. Agrawal, Qi Qu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出RadTwin框架以实现动态无线环境的可泛化数字孪生建模

背景: 传统射线追踪方法依赖精确的3D模型和详细环境参数，而神经辐射场方法学习特定静态场景的表示，环境变化时需要重新训练

目的: 构建一个能够适应动态环境变化且无需重新训练的通用无线数字孪生框架

方法: RadTwin包含三个关键组件：场景表示网络、电磁射线追踪模块和神经传播解码器

主要发现: 在室内场景数据集上，RadTwin相比NeRF2实现了更高的SSIM（0.846）和更低的LPIPS（0.023），并表现出优越的跨尺度性能、高泛化能力和数据效率

结论: RadTwin代表了向动态无线环境实用数字网络孪生的重要进展

翻译: 在动态无线环境中精确建模无线电传播是实现无线数字孪生的基础。传统射线追踪方法依赖于具有详细环境参数的精确3D模型，而最近的神经辐射场方法学习与特定静态场景相关的表示，当环境变化时需要重新训练。在本文中，我们提出了RadTwin，一个可泛化的无线数字孪生框架，它明确以场景几何为条件，能够在不重新训练的情况下适应动态环境。RadTwin包含三个关键组件：1）从点云中提取高层潜在场景特征的场景表示网络；2）计算物理信息稀疏注意力掩码的电磁射线追踪模块，识别在物理上向每个查询方向贡献信号的体素；3）神经传播解码器，通过掩码交叉注意力聚合相关场景特征，以学习无线电传播在给定场景几何内如何表现。我们在具有不同家具布置的室内场景定制数据集上评估了RadTwin。实验结果表明，与NeRF2相比，RadTwin实现了更高的SSIM（0.846对比0.643）和更低的LPIPS（0.023对比0.286）。RadTwin进一步展示了优越的跨尺度性能和高的泛化能力及数据效率，代表了向动态无线环境实用数字网络孪生的重要进展。

Abstract

Precisely modeling radio propagation in dynamic wireless environments is fundamental to the realization of wireless digital twins. Traditional ray tracing methods rely on accurate 3D models with detailed environment parameters, while recent neural radiance field approaches learn representations tied to specific static scenes, requiring retraining when environments change. In this paper, we propose RadTwin, a generalizable wireless digital twin framework that explicitly conditions on scene geometry, enabling adaptation to dynamic environments without retraining. RadTwin comprises three key components: 1) a scenario representation network that extracts high-level latent scene features from point clouds, 2) an electromagnetic ray tracing module that computes physics-informed sparse attention masks identifying voxels that physically contribute signals toward each query direction, and 3) a neural propagation decoder that aggregates relevant scene features through masked cross-attention to learn how radio propagation behaves within the given scene geometry. We evaluate RadTwin on a customized dataset of indoor scenes with varying furniture arrangements. Experimental results show that RadTwin achieves 31.6% higher SSIM (0.846 vs. 0.643) and 91.96% lower LPIPS (0.023 vs. 0.286) compared to NeRF2. RadTwin further demonstrates superior cross-scale performance and high generalization and data efficiency, representing a significant advancement toward practical digital network twins for dynamic wireless environments.

item.title: MMEB-V3: Measuring the Performance Gaps of Omni-Modality Embedding Models
item.author: Haohang Huang, Xuan Lu, Mingyi Su, Xuan Zhang, Ziyan Jiang, Ping Nie, Kai Zou, Tomas Pfister, Wenhu Chen, Wei Zhang, Xiaoyu Shen, Rui Meng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了MMEB-V3基准测试和OmniSET数据集，旨在评估跨文本、图像、视频、音频及智能体场景的嵌入模型，并识别了当前多模态嵌入模型在模态约束和检索行为方面的关键问题。

背景: 现有的多模态嵌入模型和基准测试主要局限于部分模态覆盖，难以系统评估全模态表示学习。

目的: 迈向全模态设置，构建全面的基准测试和细粒度诊断工具，以分析全模态嵌入模型。

方法: 引入MMEB-V3基准测试，涵盖文本、图像、视频、音频及智能体场景；构建OmniSET数据集，通过跨模态表示语义等价实例来分离语义相似度和模态效应。

主要发现: 模型经常无法检索到预期的目标模态；跨模态检索高度不对称且受查询模态偏差主导；指令诱导的偏移要么不足要么与目标模态不匹配，无法可靠地提高检索性能。

结论: 当前多模态嵌入模型尚不具备可靠地执行指令指定的模态约束的能力，因此无法表现出一致的模态感知检索行为。

翻译: 多模态嵌入模型旨在将文本、图像、视频和音频等异构输入映射到共享的语义空间中。然而，现有的方法和基准测试主要局限于部分模态覆盖，使得难以系统评估全模态表示学习。在这项工作中，我们迈向全模态设置。我们介绍了MMEB-V3，这是一个全面的基准测试，用于评估文本、图像、视频、音频以及智能体场景中的嵌入。为了进行更细粒度的诊断，我们进一步构建了OmniSET，其中跨模态表示的语义等价实例，使我们能够分离语义相似度和模态效应。通过MMEB-V3上的实验，我们对全模态嵌入进行了系统分析，并确定了三个关键发现：（1）模型经常无法检索到预期的目标模态；（2）跨模态检索高度不对称且受查询模态偏差主导；（3）指令诱导的偏移要么不足要么与目标模态不匹配，因此不能可靠地提高检索。这些结果表明，当前的多模态嵌入模型还不足以可靠地执行指令指定的模态约束，因此无法表现出一致的模态感知检索行为。我们希望MMEB-V3能为理解和诊断这些局限性以及指导全模态嵌入的未来的研究提供有用的基准。

Abstract

Multimodal embedding models aim to map heterogeneous inputs, such as text, images, videos, and audio, into a shared semantic space. However, existing methods and benchmarks remain largely limited to partial modality coverage, making it difficult to systematically evaluate full-modality representation learning. In this work, we take a step toward the full-modality setting. We introduce MMEB-V3, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates embeddings across text, image, video, audio, as well as agent-centric scenarios. To enable more fine-grained diagnosis, we further construct OmniSET (Omni-modality Semantic Equivalence Tuples), where semantically equivalent instances are represented across modalities, allowing us to disentangle semantic similarity from modality effects. Through experiments on MMEB-V3, we conduct a systematic analysis of full-modality embeddings and identify three key findings: (1) models often fail to retrieve the intended target modality; (2) cross-modal retrieval is highly asymmetric and dominated by query-modality bias; and (3) instruction-induced shifts are either insufficient or misaligned with the target modality, and therefore do not reliably improve retrieval. These results indicate that current multimodal embeddings are not yet capable of reliably enforcing modality constraints specified by instructions, and consequently fail to exhibit consistent modality-aware retrieval behavior. We hope MMEB-V3 provides a useful benchmark for understanding and diagnosing these limitations, and for guiding future research on full-modality embeddings.

item.title: Robust Audio-Text Retrieval via Cross-Modal Attention and Hybrid Loss
item.author: Meizhu Liu, Matthew Rowe, Amit Agarwal, Michael Avendi, Yassi Abbasi, Hitesh Laxmichand Patel, Paul Li, Kyu J. Han, Tao Sheng, Sujith Ravi, Dan Roth
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种新的多模态检索框架，用于改进音频文本检索

背景: 当前最先进的方法在处理长、嘈杂和弱标签音频时面临困难，因为它们依赖于对比学习和大批量训练

目的: 为了解决现有方法在长、嘈杂和弱标签音频上的局限性

方法: 提出了一种新的多模态检索框架，该框架使用跨模态嵌入细化模块来细化音频和文本嵌入，该模块结合了基于变换器的投影、线性映射和双向注意力。此外，引入了一种混合损失函数，结合余弦相似度、L1和对比目标，以在批量约束下实现稳定训练。该方法通过静音感知的分块和基于注意力的池化来高效处理长音频和嘈杂音频（SNR 5到15）。

主要发现: 在基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于先前的方法

结论: 该方法能够有效处理长音频和嘈杂音频，并在检索性能上优于现有方法

翻译: 音频文本检索实现了音频内容和自然语言查询之间的语义对齐，支持多媒体搜索、无障碍访问和监控等应用。然而，当前最先进的方法在处理长、嘈杂和弱标签音频时面临困难，因为它们依赖于对比学习和大批量训练。我们提出了一种新颖的多模态检索框架，该框架使用跨模态嵌入细化模块来细化音频和文本嵌入，该模块结合了基于变换器的投影、线性映射和双向注意力。为了进一步提高鲁棒性，我们引入了一种混合损失函数，结合余弦相似度、L1和对比目标，以在批量约束下实现稳定训练。我们的方法通过静音感知的分块和基于注意力的池化来高效处理长音频和嘈杂音频（SNR 5到15）。在基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于先前的方法。

Abstract

Audio-text retrieval enables semantic alignment between audio content and natural language queries, supporting applications in multimedia search, accessibility, and surveillance. However, current state-of-the-art approaches struggle with long, noisy, and weakly labeled audio due to their reliance on contrastive learning and large-batch training. We propose a novel multimodal retrieval framework that refines audio and text embeddings using a cross-modal embedding refinement module combining transformer-based projection, linear mapping, and bidirectional attention. To further improve robustness, we introduce a hybrid loss function blending cosine similarity, $\mathcal{L}_{1}$, and contrastive objectives, enabling stable training even under small-batch constraints. Our approach efficiently handles long-form and noisy audio (SNR 5 to 15) via silence-aware chunking and attention-based pooling. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate improvements over prior methods.

item.title: H-SemiS: Hierarchical Fusion of Semi and Self-Supervised Learning for Knee Osteoarthritis Severity Grading
item.author: Chandravardhan Singh Raghaw, Anushka Parwal, Shahid Shafi Dar, Prajakta Darade, Nagendra Kumar
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种分层融合半监督与自监督框架H-SemiS用于膝关节骨关节炎严重程度分级。

背景: 膝关节骨关节炎是一种可能导致慢性疼痛、活动能力下降和长期残疾的退行性关节疾病。

目的: 为了解决当前方法严重依赖大型标注数据集、对类别不平衡、噪声样本和临床注释变异性敏感的问题，提出了一种利用有限标注数据的半监督框架。

方法: H-SemiS将严重程度分级任务分解为半监督教师-学生架构内的二进制子任务序列，以直接缓解类别不平衡的影响。框架集成了对抗性自监督重建模块以从无标签数据中增强特征学习，并采用受量子启发的特征混合的教师-学生设计来改善相邻等级间的判别边界。

主要发现: 在两个具有挑战性的多类数据集上进行了全面评估，并在两个二类数据集上评估了其泛化能力。实验结果表明，H-SemiS框架在多个评估指标上优于几种竞争基线和最先进的方法。

结论: H-SemiS框架在处理膝关节X光样本的严重程度分级任务中表现出优越性。

翻译: 摘要：膝关节骨关节炎是一种退行性关节疾病，可导致慢性疼痛、活动能力下降和长期残疾。从膝关节X光片进行自动严重程度分级可以支持早期评估，但当前方法严重依赖大型标注数据集，并且对类别不平衡、噪声样本和临床注释的变异性敏感。为了缓解这些局限性，我们提出了一种分层融合半监督与自监督框架H-SemiS，用于利用有限标注数据对膝关节X光样本进行严重程度分级。H-SemiS不将严重程度分级视为扁平的多类问题，而是在半监督教师-学生架构内将任务分解为一系列二进制子任务，直接缓解了类别不平衡的影响。为了进一步从无标签数据中增强特征学习，该框架集成了对抗性自监督重建模块，鼓励网络捕获稳健的解剖结构。同时，具有量子启发的特征混合的教师-学生设计在伪标签噪声时改善了相邻等级间的判别边界。我们在两个具有挑战性的多类数据集上全面评估了H-SemiS，并在两个二类数据集上评估了其泛化能力。我们的实验结果表明，所提出的H-SemiS框架在多个评估指标上始终优于几种竞争基线和最先进的方法。代码可在https://github.com/chandravardhan-singh-raghaw/H-SemiS公开获取。

Abstract

Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is a degenerative joint disease that can lead to chronic pain, reduced mobility, and long-term disability. Automated severity grading from knee radiographs can support early assessment, but current methods heavily depend on large labeled datasets and remain sensitive to class imbalance, noisy samples, and variability in clinical annotations. To alleviate these limitations, we propose a Hierarchical fusion of Semi-Supervised framework with Self-Supervision (H-SemiS) for KOA severity grading in knee X-ray samples using limited annotated data. Rather than treating severity grading as a flat multi-class problem, H-SemiS decomposes the task into a sequence of binary sub-tasks within a semi-supervised teacher-student architecture, directly mitigating the impact of class imbalance. To further enhance feature learning from unlabeled data, the framework integrates an adversarial self-supervised reconstruction module that encourages the network to capture robust anatomical structures. In parallel, a teacher-student design with quantum-inspired feature mixing improves discrimination boundaries between adjacent grades when pseudo-labels are noisy. We comprehensively evaluate H-SemiS on two challenging multi-class datasets and assess its generalizability on two binary-class datasets. Our experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed H-SemiS framework across multiple evaluation metrics, consistently outperforming several competing baselines and state-of-the-art methods. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/chandravardhan-singh-raghaw/H-SemiS.

item.title: Explainable AI in Speaker Recognition -- Making Latent Representations Understandable
item.author: Yanze Xu, Wenwu Wang, Mark D. Plumbley
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了可解释人工智能领域中关于网络表示中未知组织模式的发现，特别是针对说话人识别网络。

背景: 以往的研究利用算法分析网络表示中的独立聚类现象，但未深入探讨层级聚类关系。

目的: 研究说话人识别网络表示中是否存在层级聚类现象，并设计算法进行语义类别的匹配。

方法: 应用单链接聚类和层次密度聚类算法分析层级聚类关系，设计层级聚类-类别匹配算法进行语义匹配，并提出Liebig评分量化匹配性能。

主要发现: 网络表示空间中存在层级聚类现象，部分层级聚类与单一语义类别匹配，部分与语义类别组合匹配。

结论: 通过Liebig评分量化匹配行为，能够诊断限制匹配性能的主要因素。

翻译: 神经网络可以从数据中学习任务相关的表示。理解这些网络如何做出决策属于可解释人工智能领域。本文提出研究一个可解释人工智能主题：揭示网络表示中未知的组织模式，特别是由识别语音说话人身份的说话人识别网络学习的表示。以往的研究采用算法（如t分布随机邻域嵌入和K均值）来分析和可视化网络表示如何形成独立聚类，表明在这些表示定义的空间内存在平坦聚类现象。相反，这项工作应用了两种算法——单链接聚类和层次密度空间应用聚类——来分析表示如何形成具有层级关系的聚类，而不是独立的，从而证明了网络表示空间中存在层级聚类现象。为了语义理解上述层级聚类现象，设计了一种新的算法，称为层级聚类-类别匹配，用于在预定义的语义类别和层级表示聚类之间执行一对一匹配。一些层级聚类成功匹配到单个语义类别（例如男性、英国），而其他匹配到语义类别的组合（例如男性且英国、女性且爱尔兰）。提出了一种新的指标Liebig评分，用于量化每种匹配行为的性能，使我们能够诊断限制匹配性能的最强因素。

Abstract

Neural networks can be trained to learn task-relevant representations from data. Understanding how these networks make decisions falls within the Explainable AI (XAI) domain. This paper proposes to study an XAI topic: uncovering unknown organisational patterns in network representations, particularly those representations learned by the speaker recognition network that recognises the speaker identity of utterances. Past studies employed algorithms (e.g. t-distributed Stochastic Neighbour Embedding and K-means) to analyse and visualise how network representations form independent clusters, indicating the presence of flat clustering phenomena within the space defined by these representations. In contrast, this work applies two algorithms -- Single-Linkage Clustering (SLINK) and Hierarchical Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (HDBSCAN) -- to analyse how representations form clusters with hierarchical relationships rather than being independent, thereby demonstrating the existence of hierarchical clustering phenomena within the network representation space. To semantically understand the above hierarchical clustering phenomena, a new algorithm, termed Hierarchical Cluster-Class Matching (HCCM), is designed to perform one-to-one matching between predefined semantic classes and hierarchical representation clusters (i.e. those produced by SLINK or HDBSCAN). Some hierarchical clusters are successfully matched to individual semantic classes (e.g. male, UK), while others to conjunctions of semantic classes (e.g. male and UK, female and Ireland). A new metric, Liebig's score, is proposed to quantify the performance of each matching behaviour, allowing us to diagnose the factor that most strongly limits matching performance.

item.title: PushupBench: Your VLM is not good at counting pushups
item.author: Shengzhi Li, Jiarun Chen, Karun Sharma, Jiaqi Su, Shichao Pei
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了PushupBench数据集用于评估视频重复计数能力，发现当前模型在计数任务上表现不佳，但通过微调计数任务可以提升通用视频理解能力。

背景: 大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够识别视频中的内容，但在计数重复次数方面存在困难。

目的: 介绍PushupBench数据集以评估模型在重复计数任务上的表现，并探究计数任务与通用视频理解能力之间的关系。

方法: 构建了包含446个长视频片段的数据集，平均长度为36.7秒，并在该数据集上评估了当前最先进的模型和开源模型的表现。

主要发现: 当前最佳前沿模型在精确计数准确率上仅为42.1%，开源4B模型得分约为6%，与监督基线模型相当；模型往往利用模态计数而非进行时间推理；在计数任务上进行微调可以提升模型在MVBench、PerceptionTest和TVBench等通用视频理解任务上的表现。

结论: 仅凭准确率会误导评估，因为较弱的模型往往利用模态计数而非进行时间推理；计数任务可以作为更广泛时间推理能力的代理指标。

翻译: 大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够识别视频中的内容，但在计数重复次数方面存在困难。我们介绍了PushupBench，这是一个包含446个长视频片段（平均长度36.7秒）的数据集，用于评估重复计数能力。最佳前沿模型在精确计数准确率上达到42.1%；开源4B模型得分约为6%，与监督基线模型相当。我们发现仅凭准确率会误导评估，因为较弱的模型往往利用模态计数而非进行时间推理。在计数任务上进行微调可以提升通用视频理解能力：MVBench提升2.15，PerceptionTest提升1.88，TVBench提升4.54，表明计数任务可以作为更广泛时间推理能力的代理指标。PushupBench已集成到lmms-eval中，并托管在pushupbench.com上。

Abstract

Large vision-language models (VLMs) can recognize \textit{what} happens in video but fail to count \textit{how many} times. We introduce \textbf{PushupBench}, 446 long-form clips (avg. 36.7s) for evaluating repetition counting. The best frontier model achieves 42.1\% exact accuracy; open-source 4B models score $\sim$6\%, matching supervised baselines. We show that accuracy alone misleads -- weaker models exploit the modal count rather than reason temporally. Fine-tuning on counting with 1k samples transfers to general video understanding: MVBench (+2.15), PerceptionTest (+1.88), TVBench (+4.54), suggesting counting is a proxy for broader temporal reasoning.PushupBench incorporated in \texttt{lmms-eval} (https://github.com/EvolvingLMMs-Lab/lmms-eval/pull/1262) and hosted on (pushupbench.com/)

item.title: Sphere-Depth: A Benchmark for Depth Estimation Methods with Varying Spherical Camera Orientations
item.author: Soulayma Gazzeh, Giuseppe Mazzola, Liliana Lo Presti, Marco La Cascia
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 介绍了一个名为 Sphere-Depth 的公开基准测试，用于评估全景图像单目深度估计模型的鲁棒性。

背景: 在机器人和沉浸式场景理解中，从球面图像进行可靠的深度估计至关重要。然而，在现实世界的机器人平台上， onboard 球面相机可能会经历意外的姿态变化，结合等距圆柱投影中固有的几何畸变，会显著影响深度估计的有效性。

目的: 系统地评估全景图像单目深度估计模型在等距圆柱投影图像中的鲁棒性，并确保跨模型的有意义的评估。

方法: 引入了 Sphere-Depth 基准测试，模拟相机姿态扰动来评估模型性能；提出了基于深度校准的错误协议，利用监督学习的缩放因子将预测的相对深度值转换为度量深度值。

主要发现: 即使是专门设计用于处理全景图像的模型，在观察到相对于标准姿态的相机姿态变化时，也会表现出显著的性能下降。

结论: Sphere-Depth 基准测试、评估协议和数据集划分已公开发布，以促进对全景深度估计鲁棒性的研究。

翻译: 从球面图像进行可靠的深度估计对于机器人和沉浸式场景理解中的360°视觉至关重要。然而，在现实世界的机器人平台上， onboard 球面相机可能会经历意外的姿态变化，结合等距圆柱投影中固有的几何畸变，会显著影响深度估计的有效性。为了研究这个问题，引入了一个名为 Sphere-Depth 的新颖公开基准，用于以可重现的方式系统地评估全景图像单目深度估计模型在等距圆柱投影图像中的鲁棒性。相机姿态扰动被模拟并用于评估一个流行的基于透视的模型 Depth Anything 以及球形感知模型 Depth Anywhere、ACDNet、Bifuse++ 和 SliceNet 的性能。此外，为了确保跨模型的有意义的评估，提出了一种基于深度校准的错误协议，利用监督学习的缩放因子将每个模型的预测相对深度值转换为度量深度值。实验表明，即使是专门设计用于处理全景图像的模型，在观察到相对于标准姿态的相机姿态变化时，也会表现出显著的性能下降。完整的基准、评估协议和数据集划分已公开发布。

Abstract

Reliable depth estimation from spherical images is crucial for 360° vision in robotic navigation and immersive scene understanding. However, the onboard spherical camera can experience unintentional pose variations in real-world robotic platforms that, along with the geometric distortions inherent in equirectangular projections, significantly impact the effectiveness of depth estimation. To study this issue, a novel public benchmark, called Sphere-Depth, is introduced to systematically evaluate the robustness of monocular depth estimation models from equirectangular images in a reproducible way. Camera pose perturbations are simulated and used to assess the performance of a popular perspective-based model, Depth Anything, and of spherical-aware models such as Depth Anywhere, ACDNet, Bifuse++, and SliceNet. Furthermore, to ensure meaningful evaluation across models, a depth calibration-based error protocol is proposed to convert predicted relative depth values into metric depth values using supervised learned scaling factors for each model. Experiments show that even models explicitly designed to process spherical images exhibit substantial performance degradation when variations in the camera pose are observed with respect to the canonical pose. The full benchmark, evaluation protocol, and dataset splits are made publicly available at: https://github.com/sgazzeh/Sphere_depth

item.title: From Edges to Depth: Probing the Spatial Hierarchy in Vision Transformers
item.author: Jainum Sanghavi
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究探讨了仅通过图像分类训练的视觉Transformer在空间理解任务中的迁移能力，以及其空间结构是如何被编码的。

背景: Vision Transformers 仅在图像分类任务上训练，但在需要空间理解的任务中表现良好，且在预训练期间未接受空间监督。

目的: 探究 Vision Transformer 中空间结构编码的位置和稳健性。

方法: 对冻结的 ViT-B/16 模型逐层进行探测，评估局部补丁边界和每个补丁的深度属性，并进行因果干预和 targeted activation patching。

主要发现: 边界结构在层5-6线性可解码，深度属性在层8达到峰值，两者在最终分类层均消失；深度信号在中间层被主动重新推导而非被动携带。

结论: 分类训练的 Vision Transformer 发展出了一种主动维护的空间层级结构，类似于灵长类视觉皮层的早期到晚期进展。

翻译: Vision Transformers 仅在图像分类任务上训练，通常能迁移到需要空间理解的任务上，然而它们在预训练期间并未接受空间监督。我们询问这种结构是在哪里以及如何稳健地编码的。通过探测冻结的 ViT-B/16 模型的逐层，以评估两个互补属性：局部补丁边界和每个补丁的深度，揭示了明显的层级：边界结构在层5-6线性可解码，而需要整合全局线索的深度属性则在层8达到峰值。这两个信号在最终分类层均崩溃，随机权重控制证实这些编码是学习到的而非架构固有的。因果干预增加了特异性：消除线性深度探测读取的单一方向会使深度解码退化高达165%，而消除任何其他方向则变化不到1%。沿该方向进行 targeted activation patching 表明深度信号在每一层都是部分重新推导的，而不是被动地携带在残差流中，中间层的干预在下游最强。结果是，分类训练的 Vision Transformer 发展出了一种主动维护的空间层级，反映了灵长类视觉皮层中观察到的早期到晚期进展。

Abstract

Vision Transformers trained only on image classification routinely transfer to tasks that demand spatial understanding, yet they receive no spatial supervision during pretraining. We ask where and how robustly such structure is encoded. Probing a frozen ViT-B/16 layerwise for two complementary properties, local patch boundaries (BSDS500) and per-patch depth (NYU Depth V2), reveals a clear hierarchy: boundary structure becomes linearly decodable at layers 5-6 (AP = 0.833), while depth, which requires integrating global cues, peaks two to three layers later at layer 8 (MAE = 0.0875). Both signals collapse at the final classification layer, and random-weight controls confirm the encodings are learned rather than architectural. Causal interventions add specificity: ablating the single direction a linear depth probe reads degrades depth decoding by up to 165%, while ablating any other direction changes it by less than 1%. Targeted activation patching along that direction shows the depth signal is partially re-derived at each layer rather than passively carried in the residual stream, with mid-layer interventions persisting most strongly downstream. The result is that a classification-trained ViT develops an actively maintained spatial hierarchy that mirrors the early-to-late progression observed in the primate visual cortex.

item.title: K-SENSE: A Knowledge-Guided Self-Augmented Encoder for Neuro-Semantic Evaluation of Mental Health Conditions on Social Media
item.author: Vijay Yadav
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种名为K-SENSE的框架，旨在通过结合外部常识知识和内部表示的鲁棒性，从社交媒体文本中早期检测心理健康状况，如压力和抑郁。

背景: 从社交媒体文本中早期检测心理健康状况（特别是压力和抑郁）是计算精神病学和自然语言处理领域的一个具有挑战性的开放问题。现有的方法要么利用外部常识知识来显式建模心理状态，要么应用自增强和对比训练来提高泛化能力，但很少在原则性的统一框架中同时做到这两点。

目的: 提出K-SENSE（知识引导的自增强编码器），用于从社交媒体文本中早期检测心理健康状况。

方法: K-SENSE采用三阶段编码管道：(1)从COMET模型中提取五个心理状态维度的推断性常识知识；(2)通过结合两个并行编码流的隐藏表示构建语义锚点，将其投影到共享空间后进行融合；(3)使用监督对比学习目标对齐同类表示，并鼓励注意力机制抑制无关知识噪声。

主要发现: 在Dreaddit（压力检测）和Depression_Mixed（抑郁检测）数据集上，K-SENSE分别实现了86.1和94.3的平均F1分数，比最强的先前基线分别提高了约2.6和1.5个百分点。

结论: 消融实验证实了每个架构组件的贡献，包括时间知识集成策略以及在微调期间保持知识编码器冻结的选择。

翻译: 从社交媒体文本中早期检测心理健康状况，特别是压力和抑郁，仍然是计算精神病学和自然语言处理中一个具有挑战性的开放问题。自动化系统必须应对隐喻语言、隐含的情感表达以及用户生成内容固有的高噪声。现有的方法要么利用外部常识知识来显式建模心理状态，要么应用自增强和对比训练来提高泛化能力，但很少在原则性的统一框架中同时做到这两点。我们提出了K-SENSE（知识引导的自增强编码器，用于心理健康状况的神经语义评估），该框架联合利用外部心理推理和内部表示鲁棒性。K-SENSE采用三阶段编码管道：(1)从COMET模型中提取五个心理状态维度的推断性常识知识；(2)通过结合两个并行编码流的隐藏表示构建语义锚点，将其投影到共享空间后进行融合；(3)使用监督对比学习目标对齐同类表示，并鼓励注意力机制抑制无关知识噪声。我们在Dreaddit（压力检测）和Depression_Mixed（抑郁检测）上评估了K-SENSE，分别实现了86.1和94.3的平均F1分数，在五次独立运行中。这些结果比最强的先前基线分别提高了约2.6和1.5个百分点。消融实验证实了每个架构组件的贡献，包括时间知识集成策略以及在微调期间保持知识编码器冻结的选择。

Abstract

Early detection of mental health conditions, particularly stress and depression, from social media text remains a challenging open problem in computational psychiatry and natural language processing. Automated systems must contend with figurative language, implicit emotional expression, and the high noise inherent in user-generated content. Existing approaches either leverage external commonsense knowledge to model mental states explicitly, or apply self-augmentation and contrastive training to improve generalization, but seldom do both in a principled, unified framework. We propose K-SENSE (Knowledge-guided Self-augmented Encoder for Neuro-Semantic Evaluation of Mental Health), a framework that jointly exploits external psychological reasoning and internal representation robustness. K-SENSE adopts a three-stage encoding pipeline: (1) inferential commonsense knowledge is extracted from the COMET model across five mental state dimensions; (2) a semantic anchor is constructed by combining hidden representations from two parallel encoding streams, projected into a shared space before fusion; and (3) a supervised contrastive learning objective aligns same-class representations while encouraging the attention mechanism to suppress irrelevant knowledge noise. We evaluate K-SENSE on Dreaddit (stress detection) and Depression_Mixed (depression detection), achieving mean F1-scores of 86.1 (0.6%) and 94.3 (0.8%), respectively, over five independent runs. These represent improvements of approximately 2.6 and 1.5 percentage points over the strongest prior baselines. Ablation experiments confirm the contribution of each architectural component, including the temporal knowledge integration strategy and the choice to keep the knowledge encoder frozen during fine-tuning.

item.title: BurstGP: Enhancing Raw Burst Image Super Resolution with Generative Priors
item.author: Dong Huo, Tristan Aumentado-Armstrong, Samrudhdhi B. Rangrej, Maitreya Suin, Angela Ning Ye, Zhiming Hu, Amanpreet Walia, Amirhossein Kazerouni, Konstantinos G. Derpanis, Iqbal Mohomed, Alex Levinshtein
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 BurstGP 的新方法，用于解决复杂纹理和过度平滑问题，通过利用生成模型先验来提升图像质量。

背景: 现有的 Burst 图像超分辨率方法在处理复杂纹理时存在困难，且现有的扩散模型方法通常需要从头训练且仅处理单帧重建。

目的: 利用生成模型先验来克服现有方法的局限性，构建一个多帧感知的扩散模型，以提升图像质量并保持保真度。

方法: 构建了一个多帧感知的扩散模型，引入了新的退化感知条件机制和鲁棒的 sRGB 到 lRGB 反转器，以利用生成式多帧先验。

主要发现: BurstGP 在定量和定性指标上均优于现有最先进的方法，特别是在恢复丰富纹理和更精细的结构细节方面表现出色。

结论: 视频先验在 Burst 图像超分辨率任务中具有巨大潜力，优于传统方法。

翻译: Burst 图像超分辨率旨在通过聚合多个低分辨率帧的信息来构建单张高分辨率图像，依赖于爆发期间的时间冗余和空间连贯性。虽然传统方法取得了令人印象深刻的结果，但它们往往难以处理复杂纹理和过度平滑。扩散模型，特别是那些在高质量数据上预训练的模型，在图像和视频超分辨率的生成逼真细节方面显示出显著能力。然而，它们在 Burst 图像超分辨率中的潜力在很大程度上仍未被探索，现有的方法通常依赖于从头训练的任务特定扩散模型，并在单帧重建上运行。在这项工作中，我们提出了 BurstGP，一种用于 Burst 图像超分辨率的 novel 扩散解决方案，它利用了最近基础模型的生成先验来克服这些问题。特别是，我们在传统 Burst 图像超分辨率方法的基础上构建了一个多帧感知的扩散模型，该模型以最小的保真度损失提升了图像质量。此外，我们引入了 (i) 一种新的退化感知条件机制，它根据输入中估计的退化来控制细节的合成，以及 (ii) 一种鲁棒的 sRGB 到 lRGB 反转器，使我们能够利用生成式多帧视频 sRGB 先验，同时使用原始输入和 lRGB 输出图像。经验上，我们证明了 BurstGP 在定量（特别是关于感知指标，包括 MUSIQ 和 LPIPS）和定性方面都优于现有的最先进方法。特别是，我们的方法在恢复丰富纹理和更精细的结构细节方面表现出色，突出了视频先验在 Burst 图像超分辨率任务中相对于传统方法的潜力。

Abstract

Burst image super resolution (BISR) aims to construct a single high-resolution (HR) image by aggregating information from multiple low-resolution (LR) frames, relying on temporal redundancy and spatial coherence across the burst. While conventional methods achieve impressive results, they often struggle with complex textures and oversmoothing. Diffusion models, particularly those pretrained on high-quality data, have shown remarkable capability in generating realistic details for image and video super-resolution. However, their potential remains largely under-explored in BISR, where existing approaches typically rely on task-specific diffusion models trained from scratch and operate on single-frame reconstructions. In this work, we propose BurstGP, a novel diffusion-based solution for BISR, which leverages generative priors of recent foundation models to overcome these issues. In particular, we build a multiframe-aware diffusion model on top of a conventional BISR approach, which boosts image quality with minimal loss to fidelity. Further, we introduce (i) a novel degradation-aware conditioning mechanism, which controls synthesis of fine details based on the estimated degradation in the input, and (ii) a robust sRGB-to-lRGB inverter, enabling us to utilize generative multiframe (video) sRGB priors, while operating with raw input and lRGB output images. Empirically, we demonstrate that BurstGP outperforms the existing state of the art, both quantitatively (especially with respect to perceptual metrics, including MUSIQ and LPIPS) and qualitatively. In particular, our proposed method excels at recovering richer textures and finer structural details, highlighting the potential of video priors for BISR over traditional methods.

item.title: Large Language Model based Interactive Decision-Making for Autonomous Driving
item.author: Xinwei Dong, Jiyang Li, Jiabin Xie, Yang Yi, Tianshang Jia, Shiyu Fang, Ye Tian, Peng Hang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于大语言模型的交互式决策框架，通过场景理解和意图感知来提升自动驾驶的安全性和效率。

背景: 在涉及人类驾驶车辆和自动驾驶车辆的高冲突混合交通场景中，现有的自动驾驶系统通常表现出过于保守的行为，缺乏主动交互，导致公众接受度有限。

目的: 为了减少意图误解和决策失败，该研究旨在通过增强场景理解和意图感知的交互式决策制定来同时提高安全性和效率。

方法: 该方法使用对象-过程方法论对复杂多车辆场景进行语义建模，将低级感知数据抽象为对象、过程和关系。在此基础上，大语言模型解析周围代理的显式和隐式意图，并在安全性和效率约束下选择候选机动动作。通过蒙特卡洛采样生成扰动轨迹候选并评估以获得优化的可执行轨迹。最后，将最终决策翻译成简洁的自然语言消息并通过外部人机界面广播。

主要发现: 在集群驾驶模拟器中的实验表明，该方法在安全性、舒适性和效率指标上均优于传统基线。图灵测试风格的评估显示决策具有高度的人类相似性。

结论: 将语义场景抽象与大语言模型中介的意图推理和基于语言的eHMI通信相结合，为在密集混合交通中实现交互式、可信的自动驾驶提供了一条实用路径。

翻译: 在涉及人类驾驶车辆和自动驾驶车辆的高冲突混合交通场景中，大多数现有的自动驾驶系统默认采取过于保守的行为，缺乏主动交互，因此导致公众接受度有限。为了减轻意图误解和决策失败，我们提出了一种基于大语言模型的交互式决策制定框架，该框架增强了场景理解和意图感知交互，以同时提高安全性和效率。该方法使用对象-过程方法论对复杂多车辆场景进行语义建模，将低级感知数据抽象为对象、过程和关系，从而简化对潜在因果结构的推理。在此基础上，大语言模型解析周围代理的显式和隐式意图，并在共同强制执行的安全性和效率约束下选择候选机动动作。我们进一步通过蒙特卡洛采样生成扰动轨迹候选并对其进行评估以获得优化的可执行轨迹。为了促进与附近道路使用者的透明度和协调，最终决策由大语言模型翻译成简洁的自然语言消息并通过外部人机界面广播，从而完成从场景理解到行动再到语言的闭环。在集群驾驶模拟器中的实验表明，所提出的方法在安全性、舒适性和效率指标上均优于传统基线，而图灵测试风格的评估显示决策具有高度的人类相似性。此外，这些结果表明，将语义场景抽象与大语言模型中介的意图推理和基于语言的eHMI通信相结合，为在密集混合交通中实现交互式、可信的自动驾驶提供了一条实用路径。

Abstract

In high-conflict mixed-traffic scenarios involving human-driven and autonomous vehicles, most existing autonomous driving systems default to overly conservative behaviors, lack proactive interaction, and consequently suffer from limited public acceptance. To mitigate intent misunderstandings and decision failures, we present a Large Language Model based interactive decision-making framework that augments scene understanding and intent-aware interaction to jointly improve safety and efficiency. The approach uses Object-Process Methodology to semantically model complex multi-vehicle scenes, abstracting low-level perceptual data into objects, processes, and relations, thereby streamlining reasoning over latent causal structure. Building on this representation, the Large Language Model parses both explicit and implicit intents of surrounding agents and, under jointly enforced safety and efficiency constraints, selects candidate maneuvers. We further generate perturbed trajectory candidates via Monte Carlo sampling and evaluate them to obtain an optimized executable trajectory. To foster transparency and coordination with nearby road users, the final decision is translated by the Large Language Model into concise natural-language messages and broadcast through an external Human-Machine Interface, completing a closed loop from scene understanding to action to language. Experiments in a cluster driving simulator demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms traditional baselines across safety, comfort, and efficiency metrics, while a Turing-test-style evaluation indicates a high degree of human-likeness in decision making. Besides, these results suggest that coupling semantic scene abstraction with Large Language Model mediated intent reasoning and language-based eHMI communication offers a practical pathway toward interactive, trustworthy autonomous driving in dense mixed traffic.

item.title: Unsupervised Learning for AC Optimal Power Flow with Fast Physics-Aware Layer
item.author: Jiebao Zhang, Haoyu Yan, Haoyu Wang, Ye Shi, Zhichao Sheng, Hongwen Yu, Shuang Ye, Zhifang Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为FPL-OPF的新型无监督学习框架，用于解决交流最优潮流(AC-OPF)问题。

背景: 现有的神经网络方法通过嵌入功率流(PF)求解器来确保物理可行性，但隐式微分需要手动推导雅可比矩阵并求解线性系统，计算成本高昂，阻碍了与现代自动微分(AD)框架的集成。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在计算效率上的挑战，提出一种新的无监督学习框架FPL-OPF。

方法: FPL-OPF在神经网络中嵌入了一个快速的PF迭代求解器，仅将最后几次甚至最终迭代纳入自动微分图中，从而确保了前向和反向传播的高计算效率，并避免了复杂的自定义反向实现。

主要发现: 理论上证明了该设计的梯度在温和条件下是真实隐式梯度的忠实代理；实验表明FPL-OPF相比最先进的无监督学习方法实现了显著的速度提升，同时保持了接近零的约束违反率和具有竞争力的最优性。

结论: FPL-OPF是一种高效且有效的AC-OPF解决方案。

翻译: 通过神经网络学习解决交流最优潮流(AC-OPF)问题在实时应用中是一种有前景的方法。现有的确保神经网络输出物理可行性的方法是在网络中嵌入功率流(PF)求解器。然而，通过PF求解器的梯度，即隐式微分，需要手动雅可比推导和线性系统的求解，这在计算上是禁止的，阻碍了与现代自动微分(AD)框架的集成。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了FPL-OPF，一种新颖的无监督学习框架，它为AC-OPF问题结合了一个快速的物理感知层。FPL-OPF在NN中嵌入了一个快速的PF迭代求解器，仅将最后几次甚至最终迭代纳入AD图。这种设计确保了前向和反向传播的高计算效率，绕过了复杂的自定义反向实现。理论上，我们严格证明了该设计的梯度在温和条件下是真实隐式梯度的忠实代理。大量实验表明，FPL-OPF相比最先进的无监督学习方法实现了显著的速度提升，同时保持了接近零的约束违反率和具有竞争力的最优性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/wowotou1998/fpl-opf获取

Abstract

Learning to solve the Alternating Current Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) problem by neural networks (NNs) is a promising approach in real-time applications. Existing methods to ensure the physical feasibility of NN outputs embed a power flow (PF) solver within networks. However, the gradient through the PF solver, namely, implicit differentiation, needs manual Jacobian derivation and the solution of linear systems, which is computationally prohibitive and hinders integration with modern automatic differentiation (AD) frameworks. To address these challenges, we propose FPL-OPF, a novel unsupervised learning framework that incorporates a Fast Physics-aware Layer for AC-OPF problems. FPL-OPF embeds a fast PF iterative solver within the NN and takes solely the last few or even the final iterations into the AD graph. This design ensures high computational efficiency for both the forward and backward passes, circumventing complex custom backward implementations. Theoretically, we rigorously prove that the gradient from this design serves as a high-fidelity surrogate of the true implicit gradient under mild conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FPL-OPF achieves significant speedups over state-of-the-art unsupervised learning approaches, while maintaining near-zero constraint violations and competitive optimality. Our code is available at https://github.com/wowotou1998/fpl-opf

item.title: PhysLayer: Language-Guided Layered Animation with Depth-Aware Physics
item.author: Tianyidan Xie, Zhentao Huang, Mingjie Wang, Xin Huang, Jun Zhou, Minglun Gong, Zili Yi
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PhysLayer是一个新的框架，用于通过语言引导和深度感知的分层动画将静态图像转换为视频。

背景: 现有的图像到视频生成方法往往产生物理上不合理的运动，缺乏对物体动态的精确控制。虽然之前的方法已经结合了物理模拟器，但它们仍然局限于二维平面运动，无法捕捉深度感知的空间相互作用。

目的: 介绍PhysLayer框架，实现语言引导的、深度感知的静态图像分层动画。

方法: PhysLayer包含三个关键组件：1. 语言引导的场景理解模块，利用视觉基础模型将场景分解为基于深度的分层；2. 深度感知的分层物理模拟，扩展二维刚体动力学以包含深度运动和透视一致的缩放；3. 物理引导的视频合成模块，将模拟轨迹与场景感知的重光照集成。

主要发现: 实验结果显示CLIP相似度提高了2.2%，FID分数提高了9.3%，运动FID提高了3%。人类评估显示物理合理性提高了24%，文本视频对齐提高了35%。

结论: PhysLayer在物理真实性和计算效率之间提供了实用的平衡，实现了可控的图像动画。

翻译: PhysLayer是一个新的框架，用于通过语言引导和深度感知的分层动画将静态图像转换为视频。现有的图像到视频生成方法往往产生物理上不合理的运动，缺乏对物体动态的精确控制。虽然之前的方法已经结合了物理模拟器，但它们仍然局限于二维平面运动，无法捕捉深度感知的空间相互作用。PhysLayer包含三个关键组件：语言引导的场景理解模块，利用视觉基础模型将场景分解为基于深度的分层；深度感知的分层物理模拟，扩展二维刚体动力学以包含深度运动和透视一致的缩放；物理引导的视频合成模块，将模拟轨迹与场景感知的重光照集成。实验结果显示CLIP相似度提高了2.2%，FID分数提高了9.3%，运动FID提高了3%。人类评估显示物理合理性提高了24%，文本视频对齐提高了35%。PhysLayer在物理真实性和计算效率之间提供了实用的平衡，实现了可控的图像动画。

Abstract

Existing image-to-video generation methods often produce physically implausible motions and lack precise control over object dynamics. While prior approaches have incorporated physics simulators, they remain confined to 2D planar motions and fail to capture depth-aware spatial interactions. We introduce PhysLayer, a novel framework enabling language-guided, depth-aware layered animation of static images. PhysLayer consists of three key components: First, a language-guided scene understanding module that utilizes vision foundation models to decompose scenes into depth-based layers by analyzing object composition, material properties, and physical parameters. Second, a depth-aware layered physics simulation that extends 2D rigid-body dynamics with depth motion and perspective-consistent scaling, enabling more realistic object interactions without requiring full 3D reconstruction. Third, a physics-guided video synthesis module that integrates simulated trajectories with scene-aware relighting for temporally coherent results. Experimental results demonstrate improvements in CLIP-Similarity (+2.2\%), FID score (+9.3\%), and Motion-FID (+3\%), with human evaluation showing enhanced physical plausibility (+24\%) and text-video alignment (+35\%). Our approach provides a practical balance between physical realism and computational efficiency for controllable image animation.

item.title: LLMs Reading the Rhythms of Daily Life: Aligned Understanding for Behavior Prediction and Generation
item.author: Fanjin Meng, Jingtao Ding, Nian Li, Yizhou Sun, Yong Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为行为理解对齐（BUA）的新框架，通过结构化课程学习过程将大语言模型（LLM）集成到人类行为建模中，以解决现有方法在处理长尾行为、增强可解释性以及支持多任务统一框架方面的挑战。

背景: 人类日常行为由意图、偏好和上下文塑造的复杂序列组成。虽然深度学习和行为预训练的进步提高了行为预测，但在处理长尾行为、增强可解释性以及支持多任务统一框架方面仍存在关键挑战。大语言模型（LLM）因其语义丰富性、强可解释性和生成能力而成为一个有前景的方向，但行为数据与自然语言之间的结构和模态差异限制了其直接应用。

目的: 为了解决行为数据与自然语言之间的结构和模态差异，提出行为理解对齐（BUA）框架，将LLM集成到人类行为建模中。

方法: BUA框架通过结构化课程学习过程将LLM集成到人类行为建模中。它使用预训练行为模型的序列嵌入作为对齐锚点，引导LLM通过三阶段课程学习，并在多轮对话设置中引入预测和生成能力。

主要发现: 在两个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，BUA在两个任务中显著优于现有方法，突显了其在将LLM应用于复杂人类行为建模方面的有效性和灵活性。

结论: BUA框架有效地解决了行为建模中的关键挑战，证明了将LLM应用于复杂人类行为建模的可行性和优越性。

翻译: 人类日常行为展开为由意图、偏好和上下文塑造的复杂序列。有效地建模这些行为对于智能系统（如个人助理和推荐引擎）至关重要。虽然深度学习和行为预训练的进步提高了行为预测，但关键挑战仍然存在——特别是在处理长尾行为、增强可解释性以及在统一框架内支持多任务方面。大语言模型（LLM）提供了一个有前景的方向，因为它们具有丰富的语义、强大的可解释性和生成能力。然而，行为数据与自然语言之间的结构和模态差异限制了LLM的直接应用。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了行为理解对齐（BUA），这是一个新颖的框架，通过结构化课程学习过程将LLM集成到人类行为建模中。BUA使用预训练行为模型的序列嵌入作为对齐锚点，引导LLM通过三阶段课程学习，而多轮对话设置引入了预测和生成能力。在两个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，BUA在两个任务中显著优于现有方法，突显了其在将LLM应用于复杂人类行为建模方面的有效性和灵活性。

Abstract

Human daily behavior unfolds as complex sequences shaped by intentions, preferences, and context. Effectively modeling these behaviors is crucial for intelligent systems such as personal assistants and recommendation engines. While recent advances in deep learning and behavior pre-training have improved behavior prediction, key challenges remain--particularly in handling long-tail behaviors, enhancing interpretability, and supporting multiple tasks within a unified framework. Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising direction due to their semantic richness, strong interpretability, and generative capabilities. However, the structural and modal differences between behavioral data and natural language limit the direct applicability of LLMs. To address this gap, we propose Behavior Understanding Alignment (BUA), a novel framework that integrates LLMs into human behavior modeling through a structured curriculum learning process. BUA employs sequence embeddings from pretrained behavior models as alignment anchors and guides the LLM through a three-stage curriculum, while a multi-round dialogue setting introduces prediction and generation capabilities. Experiments on two real-world datasets demonstrate that BUA significantly outperforms existing methods in both tasks, highlighting its effectiveness and flexibility in applying LLMs to complex human behavior modeling.

item.title: HAC: Parameter-Efficient Hyperbolic Adaptation of CLIP for Zero-Shot VQA
item.author: Francesco Dibitonto, Cigdem Beyan, Vittorio Murino
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种参数高效的框架HAC，通过轻量级微调将预训练的CLIP模型迁移到双曲空间，并在视觉问答任务中展示了优于欧几里得基线的性能。

背景: 表示学习中的最新进展表明，双曲几何可以提供比CLIP模型中使用的欧几里得嵌入更具表现力的替代方案，能够捕获层次结构并产生更好的组织表示。

目的: 提出HAC框架，使预训练的CLIP模型能够通过轻量级微调过渡到双曲空间，以解决当前双曲CLIP变体从头训练计算昂贵和资源密集的问题。

方法: HAC是一个参数高效的框架，通过轻量级微调使预训练的CLIP模型能够过渡到双曲空间。训练在没有任何VQA基准重叠的数据集上进行，实现了严格的零样本评估范式。

主要发现: HAC-S和HAC-B在多个VQA基准测试中均超过欧几里得基线和先前双曲方法。HAC-B在推理密集型任务上比CLIP-B平均提升高达1.9点。

结论: HAC框架展示了任务无关的适应性，在视觉问答任务中取得了优异的性能，证明了双曲空间表示的有效性。

翻译: 本文提出了一种参数高效的框架HAC，通过轻量级微调将预训练的CLIP模型迁移到双曲空间，并在视觉问答任务中展示了优于欧几里得基线的性能。

Abstract

Recent advances in representation learning have shown that hyperbolic geometry can offer a more expressive alternative to the Euclidean embeddings used in CLIP models, capturing hierarchical structures and leading to better-organized representations. However, current hyperbolic CLIP variants are trained entirely from scratch, which is computationally expensive and resource-intensive. In this work, we propose HAC (Hyperbolic Adaptation of CLIP), a parameter-efficient framework that enables pretrained CLIP models to transition into hyperbolic space via lightweight fine-tuning. We apply HAC to Visual Question Answering (VQA), where models must interpret visual elements and align them with textual queries. Notably, HAC's training is performed on a dataset with no overlap with any VQA benchmark, resulting in a strict zero-shot evaluation paradigm that underscores HAC's task-agnostic adaptability. We evaluate HAC across a diverse suite of VQA benchmarks spanning General, Reasoning, and OCR categories. Both HAC-S (small) and HAC-B (medium) consistently surpass Euclidean baselines and prior hyperbolic approaches, with HAC-B delivering up to a +1.9 point average improvement over CLIP-B on reasoning-intensive tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/fdibiton/HAC

item.title: Weakly Supervised Multicenter Nancy Index Scoring in Ulcerative Colitis Using Foundation Models
item.author: Adam Kukučka, Ondřej Fabián, Vít Musil, Tomáš Brázdil
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于弱监督多实例学习的计算病理方法，用于自动评估溃疡性结肠炎的组织学活动性，旨在解决人工评分耗时且易受观察者差异影响的问题。

背景: 溃疡性结肠炎的组织学活动性评估是临床试验和常规护理中的重要终点，但人工评分如Nancy组织学指数耗时且易受观察者差异影响。许多计算病理方法依赖密集的区域级标注，这在异质性和多中心队列中获取成本高昂。

目的: 提出一种弱监督多实例学习方法，利用基础模型从病例和幻灯片级别的Nancy指数标签中学习，以预测包括中性粒细胞活性和派生的Nancy低/高分组在内的临床相关终点，实现完整的五级Nancy指数预测。

方法: 在来自三家医院（2019-2025年）的多中心数据集上，评估了多种基础模型编码器和聚合策略。研究发现基础模型的选择和分辨率显著影响性能，其中Virchow2提供了最一致的增益，且简单的集成规则相比分层门控基线提高了五级Nancy指数预测。

主要发现: 基础模型的选择和分辨率显著影响性能，Virchow2提供了最一致的增益；简单的集成规则相比分层门控基线提高了五级Nancy指数预测。

结论: 在现代基础模型表示的弱监督多实例学习下，能够在现实的多中心环境中提供稳健、可解释的溃疡性结肠炎组织学活动性评估。

翻译: Histologic assessment of ulcerative colitis (UC) activity is an important endpoint in clinical trials and routine care, but manual grading with indices such as the Nancy histological index (NHI) is time-consuming and prone to observer variability. While computational pathology methods can automate scoring, many approaches depend on dense region-level annotations, which are costly to obtain, particularly in heterogeneous, multicenter cohorts. We propose a weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) approach for whole-slide images that learns from case- and slide-level NHI labels, leveraging foundation models. Our method targets clinically relevant endpoints, including neutrophilic activity and derived Nancy-low/high groupings, enabling full five-grade NHI prediction. On a multicenter dataset of H&E-stained colon biopsies from three hospitals (2019-2025), we evaluate multiple foundation model encoders and aggregation strategies. We find that foundation model choice and resolution substantially affect performance, with Virchow2 providing the most consistent gains, and that a simple ensembling rule improves five-grade NHI prediction compared to a hierarchical gating baseline. Overall, our results demonstrate that weakly supervised MIL with modern foundation-model representations can provide robust, interpretable UC histology activity assessment in realistic multicenter settings.

Abstract

Histologic assessment of ulcerative colitis (UC) activity is an important endpoint in clinical trials and routine care, but manual grading with indices such as the Nancy histological index (NHI) is time-consuming and prone to observer variability. While computational pathology methods can automate scoring, many approaches depend on dense region-level annotations, which are costly to obtain, particularly in heterogeneous, multicenter cohorts. We propose a weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) approach for whole-slide images that learns from case- and slide-level NHI labels, leveraging foundation models. Our method targets clinically relevant endpoints, including neutrophilic activity and derived Nancy-low/high groupings, enabling full five-grade NHI prediction. On a multicenter dataset of H&E-stained colon biopsies from three hospitals (2019-2025), we evaluate multiple foundation model encoders and aggregation strategies. We find that foundation model choice and resolution substantially affect performance, with Virchow2 providing the most consistent gains, and that a simple ensembling rule improves five-grade NHI prediction compared to a hierarchical gating baseline. Overall, our results demonstrate that weakly supervised MIL with modern foundation-model representations can provide robust, interpretable UC histology activity assessment in realistic multicenter settings.

item.title: Information-Theoretic Measures in AI: A Practical Decision Guide
item.author: Nikolaos Al. Papadopoulos, Konstantinos E. Psannis
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提供了一套实用的决策框架，用于选择和评估七种信息论度量方法，并涵盖了AI和决策代理的应用场景。

背景: 信息论度量在人工智能中广泛应用，但度量选择往往与估计器假设、失效模式和推断声明脱节。

目的: 为所有七种度量提供实用的决策框架，并围绕三个问题组织：度量回答的问题及AI背景、适合的数据类型和维度的估计器、以及最危险的误用。

方法: 通过流程图和主决策表将框架操作化，并使用标准化桥接框将信息论量与认知结构联系起来。

主要发现: 框架涵盖了AI/ML和决策代理应用领域，并通过三个具体示例展示了在表示学习、时间影响分析和进化代理复杂性方面的应用。

结论: 该框架有助于解决度量选择与估计器假设、失效模式和推断声明脱节的问题，为实践者提供了明确的指导。

翻译: 信息论度量在人工智能中无处不在：熵驱动决策树分割和不确定性量化，交叉熵是默认的分类损失，互信息是表示学习和特征选择的基础，转移熵揭示动态系统中的 directed 影响。第二类较少统一的度量，包括集成信息、有效信息和自主性，已出现用于表征代理复杂性。尽管广泛采用，度量选择往往与估计器假设、失效模式和安全的推断声明脱节。本文为所有七种度量提供实用的决策框架，围绕每个度量三个规定性问题组织：(i) 度量回答的问题及在哪个AI背景下；(ii) 哪种估计器适合数据类型和维度；(iii) 最危险的误用是什么。框架通过两个互补的制品操作化：度量选择流程图和主决策表。我们涵盖每个度量的AI/ML和决策代理应用领域，并使用标准化的桥接框将IT量与认知结构联系起来。三个工作示例展示了框架在表示学习、时间影响分析和进化代理复杂性方面的具体实践者场景。

Abstract

Information-theoretic (IT) measures are ubiquitous in artificial intelligence: entropy drives decision-tree splits and uncertainty quantification, cross-entropy is the default classification loss, mutual information underpins representation learning and feature selection, and transfer entropy reveals directed influence in dynamical systems. A second, less consolidated family of measures, integrated information (Phi), effective information (EI), and autonomy, has emerged for characterizing agent complexity. Despite wide adoption, measure selection is often decoupled from estimator assumptions, failure modes, and safe inferential claims. This paper provides a practical decision framework for all seven measures, organized around three prescriptive questions for each: (i) what question does the measure answer and in which AI context; (ii) which estimator is appropriate for the data type and dimensionality; and (iii) what is the most dangerous misuse. The framework is operationalized in two complementary artifacts: a measure-selection flowchart and a master decision table. We cover both AI/ML and decision-making agent application domains per measure, with standardized Bridge Boxes linking IT quantities to cognitive constructs. Three worked examples illustrate the framework on concrete practitioner scenarios spanning representation learning, temporal influence analysis, and evolved agent complexity.

item.title: ESIA: An Energy-Based Spatiotemporal Interaction-Aware Framework for Pedestrian Intention Prediction
item.author: Yanping Wu, Meiting Dang, Lin Wu, Edmond S. L. Ho, Zhenghua Chen, Chongfeng Wei
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于条件随机场的行人意图预测框架 ESIA，通过统一图表示和能量函数确保场景一致性，并引入结构一致性约束和无监督优化。

背景: 自动驾驶的进步推动了行人意图预测研究，但现有方法受限于简化的多智能体交互模式、不透明的推理逻辑和行为预测缺乏全局一致性，影响了鲁棒性和可解释性。

目的: 为了解决现有研究的局限性，提出一种新的框架来改进行人意图预测的鲁棒性和可解释性。

方法: 提出 ESIA 框架，将意图预测任务视为基于统一图表示的结构化预测问题，将行人和环境视为时空节点，通过节点上的单势能捕获个体意图，边上的双势能编码社会和环境交互，并集成到全局能量函数中以保持场景一致性；引入结构一致性项约束推理；通过新颖的 U-SSA 算法高效求解。

主要发现: 在标准基准上的广泛实验表明，ESIA 实现了最先进的性能，并比现有方法具有更好的可解释性。

结论: ESIA 框架通过统一图表示、全局能量函数和结构一致性约束，有效提升了行人意图预测的准确性和可解释性。

翻译: Recent advances in autonomous driving have motivated research on pedestrian intention prediction, which aims to infer future crossing decisions and actions by modeling temporal dynamics, social interactions, and environmental context. However, existing studies remain constrained by oversimplified multi-agent interaction patterns, opaque reasoning logic, and a lack of global consistency in behavioral predictions, which compromise both robustness and interpretability. In this work, we propose ESIA (Energy-based Spatiotemporal Interaction-Aware framework), a novel Conditional Random Field (CRF)-based paradigm. We cast the intention prediction task as a structured prediction problem over a unified graph-based representation, treating pedestrians and the environment as spatiotemporal nodes. To characterize their distinct roles, we assign unary potentials to nodes to capture individual intentions, and pairwise potentials to edges to encode social and environmental interactions. These potentials are integrated into a unified global energy function to ensure scene-level consistency across behavioral predictions. To further constrain inference without ground-truth supervision, we introduce structural consistency terms to penalize logical contradictions. This optimization is efficiently solved via a novel Unary-Seeded Simulated Annealing (U-SSA) algorithm, which leverages high-confidence unary priors to rapidly converge to a high-quality solution. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that ESIA achieves state-of-the-art performance with improved interpretability over existing methods.

Abstract

Recent advances in autonomous driving have motivated research on pedestrian intention prediction, which aims to infer future crossing decisions and actions by modeling temporal dynamics, social interactions, and environmental context. However, existing studies remain constrained by oversimplified multi-agent interaction patterns, opaque reasoning logic, and a lack of global consistency in behavioral predictions, which compromise both robustness and interpretability. In this work, we propose ESIA (Energy-based Spatiotemporal Interaction-Aware framework), a novel Conditional Random Field (CRF)-based paradigm. We cast the intention prediction task as a structured prediction problem over a unified graph-based representation, treating pedestrians and the environment as spatiotemporal nodes. To characterize their distinct roles, we assign unary potentials to nodes to capture individual intentions, and pairwise potentials to edges to encode social and environmental interactions. These potentials are integrated into a unified global energy function to ensure scene-level consistency across behavioral predictions. To further constrain inference without ground-truth supervision, we introduce structural consistency terms to penalize logical contradictions. This optimization is efficiently solved via a novel Unary-Seeded Simulated Annealing (U-SSA) algorithm, which leverages high-confidence unary priors to rapidly converge to a high-quality solution. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that ESIA achieves state-of-the-art performance with improved interpretability over existing methods.

item.title: Impact of Age Specialized Models for Hypoglycemia Classification
item.author: Beyza Cinar, Maria Maleshkova
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了基于连续葡萄糖监测数据的糖尿病低血糖预测模型，通过分析不同年龄段患者的数据，评估了基于人群的模型、按年龄分段的模型以及通过迁移学习实现个体化模型的性能。

背景: 疾病进展随年龄变化，受遗传、生化及激素病因影响，特别是在1型糖尿病（T1D）患者中，由于依赖外源性胰岛素，药物治疗剂量和生命体征反映的生理反应存在差异。胰岛素治疗可能导致低血糖，这是一种危险的状况，可通过改进的数据分析支持的管理来缓解。

目的: 本文旨在利用DiaData数据集，对低血糖发作前0、5-15、20-45和50-120分钟进行分类。具体研究内容包括：1）包含所有年龄组的人群模型的泛化能力；2）按年龄分段训练的模型的性能影响；3）通过迁移学习实现模型个体化的效果。

方法: 研究使用了DiaData数据集，这是一个包含从儿童到老年人T1D患者的连续葡萄糖监测数据集。通过比较基于人群的模型、按年龄分段的模型以及个体化模型，对低血糖发作前的时间段进行分类。

主要发现: 结果显示，基于人群的模型在性能上与按年龄分段的模型相似或更优。这表明儿童、青少年和成人的数据可以结合用于训练低血糖分类模型。虽然不同年龄组的血糖变化不同，但短期低血糖模式相似。然而，儿童数据在使用年龄专业化模型时获得了最佳召回率。

结论: 基于人群的模型在低血糖分类任务中表现良好，证明了将不同年龄段患者数据结合训练的可行性。尽管血糖变化因年龄而异，但短期低血糖模式具有相似性，这为开发通用的低血糖预测模型提供了依据。

翻译: 摘要：疾病进展随年龄变化，受遗传、生化及激素病因影响，提示需要在标准临床指南之外进行量身定制的监测、护理和药物治疗。具体而言，在1型糖尿病（T1D）等自身免疫疾病中，患者依赖外源性胰岛素来补偿胰岛素缺乏，药物治疗剂量和反映在生命体征中的生理反应可能有所不同。胰岛素治疗可能导致低血糖，这是一种危险的状况，其特征是血糖水平降低（≤70）。这种风险可以通过支持数据分析的改进糖尿病管理来缓解。值得注意的是，利用来自连续葡萄糖监测（CGM）设备的数据，可以预测低血糖的发作。然而，虽然血糖变异性、自身抗体水平和低血糖发生情况在不同年龄组之间存在差异，但低血糖分类通常仅依赖于针对特定年龄范围的专业人群模型。在这项工作中，我们使用DiaData——一个包含从儿童到老年人T1D患者的CGM大型数据集——对低血糖发作前0、5-15、20-45和50-120分钟进行分类。具体而言，我们调查了：1）包含所有年龄组的人群模型的泛化能力；2）按年龄分段训练的模型的性能影响；3）通过迁移学习实现模型个体化的效果。结果显示，基于人群的模型在性能上与按年龄分段的模型相似或更优。这些发现表明，来自儿童、青少年和成人的数据可以结合用于训练低血糖分类模型。虽然不同年龄组的血糖变化不同，但短期低血糖模式相似。然而，儿童数据在使用年龄专业化模型时获得了最佳召回率。

Abstract

Disease progression varies with age and is influenced by underlying genetic, biochemical, and hormonal etiologies, suggesting the need for tailored monitoring, care, and medication beyond standard clinical guidelines. Specifically, in autoimmune diseases like type 1 diabetes (T1D), where patients depend on exogenous insulin to compensate for insulin deficiency, medication dosing and the physiological response reflected in vital signs can differ. Insulin therapy can lead to hypoglycemia, a dangerous condition characterized by decreased blood glucose levels ($\leq$70). This risk can be mitigated through improved diabetes management supported by data analytics. Notably, leveraging data from continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) devices, hypoglycemia onset can be predicted. However, while glucose variability, auto-antibody levels, and hypoglycemia occurrence differ across age groups, hypoglycemia classification most often only relies on population-based models specialized in specific age ranges. In this work, we classify hypoglycemia 0, 5-15, 20-45, and 50-120 minutes before onset using DiaData, a large CGM dataset of patients with T1D ranging from children to seniors. In particular, we investigate: 1) the generalizability of a population-based model including all age groups, 2) the impact of age-segmented models trained separately per age group, and 3) the effect of model individualization through transfer learning. The results show that a global population-based model yields similar or superior performance compared to age-segmented models. These findings suggest that data from children, teenagers, and adults can be combined for training models on hypoglycemia classification. While glucose variation differs across age groups, short-term hypoglycemic patterns are similar. However, data of children obtain their best recall with age specialized model.

item.title: Transformer as an Euler Discretization of Score-based Variational Flow
item.author: Huadong Liao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 论文介绍了基于分数的变分流（SVFlow），这是一种用于表示学习的连续时间动力系统，通过变分后验加权平均的条件对数似然分数来演化状态，并为通过变分一致性进行正则化提供了原则性基础。

背景: 尽管Transformer在机器学习领域占据主导地位，但其架构在很大程度上仍属于启发式方法，缺乏统一的理论基础。

目的: 引入SVFlow，为表示学习提供统一的理论基础，并解释Transformer架构的稳定性与正则化需求。

方法: SVFlow是一种连续时间动力系统，其状态演化遵循变分后验加权平均的条件对数似然分数。通过前向欧拉离散化，球面SVFlow精确恢复了Transformer架构。多头注意力机制通过vMF核平滑后验近似SVFlow向量场，MoE/FFN通过松弛网络方式近似，残差归一化块实现了保持球面几何的松弛重排。

主要发现: 在带有前缀打乱预训练语言模型上的实验表明，SVFlow诱导的指标与任务性能相关，揭示了深度依赖的敏感性，并反映了注意力的内在动力学。

结论: SVFlow为Transformer提供了统一的理论基础，解释了为什么注意力机制无需显式正则化即可稳定训练，而MoE需要辅助平衡损失。

翻译: 尽管Transformer在机器学习领域占据主导地位，但其架构在很大程度上仍属于启发式方法，缺乏统一的理论基础。我们引入了基于分数的变分流（SVFlow），这是一种用于表示学习的连续时间动力系统，其状态根据条件对数似然分数的变分后验加权平均进行演化，并为通过变分一致性进行正则化提供了原则性基础。我们表明，球面SVFlow的前向欧拉离散化精确地恢复了Transformer架构。多头注意力机制通过vMF核平滑后验近似SVFlow向量场，而MoE/FFN通过松弛网络方式近似，残差归一化块实现了保持球面几何的松弛重排。这种统一解释了为什么注意力机制无需显式正则化即可稳定训练，而MoE需要辅助平衡损失。在带有前缀打乱的预训练语言模型上的实验表明，SVFlow诱导的指标与任务性能相关，揭示了深度依赖的敏感性，并反映了注意力的内在动力学。

Abstract

Despite the Transformer's dominance across machine learning, its architecture remains largely heuristic and lacks a unified theoretical foundation. We introduce Score-based Variational Flow (SVFlow), a continuous-time dynamical system for representation learning in which the state evolves according to a variational posterior-weighted average of conditional log-likelihood scores, and provide a principled basis for regularization through variational consistency. We show that forward Euler discretization of spherical SVFlow exactly recovers the Transformer architecture. Multi-head attention approximates SVFlow vector field via a vMF kernel-smoothed posterior, while MoE/FFN approximates it in a relaxed network-based way, and the residual-normalization block implements a relaxed retraction that maintains spherical geometry. This unification explains why attention trains stably without explicit regularization while MoE requires auxiliary balancing losses. Experiments on pre-trained language models with prefix shuffling show that SVFlow-induced metrics correlate with task performance, reveal depth-dependent sensitivity, and reflect the intrinsic dynamics of attention.

item.title: WISE-FM:Operation-Aware, Engineering-Informed Foundation Model for Multi-Task Well Design
item.author: Carine de Menezes Rebello, Anderson Rapello dos Santos, Idelfonso B. R. Nogueira
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: WISE是一个设计感知的物理信息多任务模型，用于虚拟流量计和井底条件预测，通过特征调制、跨模态注意力和物理约束机制提高预测准确性和可靠性。

背景: 在多样化的井群中部署机器学习模型需要对设计参数超出训练分布的井进行泛化，当前的数据驱动方法通常独立处理每口井或忽略井设计对操作行为的影响。

目的: 提出WISE模型，旨在通过设计感知和物理信息机制，同时预测流量、井底条件和流动状态分类，并优化井设计。

方法: WISE模型集成了特征调制和跨模态注意力以条件化操作嵌入，多任务学习用于同时预测，以及基于工程原理的结构质量守恒和软物理约束。

主要发现: 在ManyWells基准测试中，设计感知模型将VFM预测误差降低了13倍，物理约束减少了65%的负流量预测；流动状态分类达到97.7%的井底准确度；在Equinor Volve生产者数据上实现了高R2值；模型作为快速代理在24维设计空间中比漂移-通量模拟快1000倍以上。

结论: 设计感知、物理强制和多任务学习是跨大型井群运行的基础模型所必需且互补的要素。

翻译: 在多样化的井群中部署机器学习模型需要对设计参数超出训练分布的井进行泛化，当前的数据驱动方法通常独立处理每口井或忽略井设计对操作行为的影响。我们提出WISE（井智能和系统工程基础模型），这是一个设计感知的物理信息多任务模型，集成了三种互补机制：特征调制和跨模态注意力以条件化操作嵌入在井设计参数上；多任务学习用于同时预测流量、井底条件和流动状态分类；以及基于井工程原理的结构质量守恒和软物理约束。在ManyWells基准测试（2000个模拟井，100万数据点）上的评估表明，设计感知模型将VFM预测误差降低了13倍，物理约束减少了65%的负流量预测。流动状态分类达到97.7%的井底准确度，提供连续的井完整性监测而无需额外传感器。该方法适用于五个Equinor Volve生产者的真实操作数据（油流量R2=0.89，井底压力R2=0.98，水流量R2=0.97）。训练后的模型还作为完整性感知井设计优化的快速代理，在24维设计空间中比漂移-通量模拟快1000倍以上。这些结果表明，设计感知、物理强制和多任务学习是跨大型井群运行的基础模型所必需且互补的要素。

Abstract

Deploying machine learning models across diverse well portfolios requires generalisation to wells with design parameters outside the training distribution. Current data-driven approaches to virtual flow metering (VFM) and bottomhole estimation typically treat each well independently or ignore the influence of well design on operational behaviour. We present WISE (Well Intelligence and Systems Engineering Foundation Model), a design-aware, physics-informed multi-task model that integrates three complementary mechanisms: Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) and cross-modal attention to condition operational embeddings on well design parameters; multi-task learning for simultaneous prediction of flow rates, bottomhole conditions, and flow regime classification; and structural mass conservation with soft physics constraints derived from well engineering principles. Evaluation on the ManyWells benchmark (2000 simulated wells, $10^6$ data points) demonstrates that design-aware models reduce VFM prediction error by up to $13\times$ compared to design-unaware baselines, and that physics constraints reduce negative flow predictions by 65%. Flow regime classification achieves 97.7% bottomhole accuracy, providing continuous well integrity monitoring without additional sensors. The methodology transfers to real operational data from five Equinor Volve producers (oil rate $R^2 = 0.89$, bottomhole pressure $R^2 = 0.98$, water rate $R^2 = 0.97$). The trained model additionally serves as a fast surrogate for integrity-aware well design optimisation over a 24-dimensional design space, with more than $1000\times$ speedup over drift-flux simulations. These results demonstrate that design awareness, physics enforcement, and multi-task learning are essential and complementary ingredients for foundation models intended to operate across large well portfolios.

item.title: FAIR_XAI: Improving Multimodal Foundation Model Fairness via Explainability for Wellbeing Assessment
item.author: Sophie Chiang, Tom Brennan, Fethiye Irmak Dogan, Jiaee Cheong, Hatice Gunes
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究探讨了多模态机器学习在心理健康评估中的公平性与可解释性问题，分析了不同模型在实验室和自然场景下的表现及偏见。

背景: 多模态机器学习在心理健康监测方面具有变革潜力，但视觉语言模型（VLMs）在临床部署中因缺乏透明度和潜在偏见而引发担忧。

目的: 调查VLM在实验室和自然场景数据集上的诊断可靠性和人口统计学公平性，并评估可解释人工智能（XAI）干预框架的效果。

方法: 在AFAR-BSFT和E-DAIC数据集上评估VLM性能，分析诊断准确率和人口统计学偏见，并测试公平性提示和可解释性干预。

主要发现: Phi3.5-Vision在E-DAIC上达到80.4%准确率，Qwen2-VL仅33.9%；两者在AFAR-BSFT上均倾向于过度预测抑郁；Qwen2-VL表现出更高的性别差异，Phi-3.5-Vision表现出更多种族偏见；XAI干预框架效果不一，公平性提示在E-DAIC上以严重牺牲准确率为代价实现了完美的机会均等。

结论: 程序透明度与公平结果之间存在持续差距，未来公平干预必须同时优化预测准确性、人口统计学均等性和跨领域泛化能力。

翻译: 近年来，多模态机器学习在福祉评估中的整合为心理健康监测提供了变革性潜力。然而，随着视觉语言模型（VLMs）的快速发展，其在临床环境中的部署因缺乏透明度和潜在偏见而引发担忧。虽然先前的研究探讨了公平性与可解释人工智能（XAI）的交集，但其在福祉评估和抑郁症预测中的VLM应用仍探索不足。本研究调查了VLM在实验室（AFAR-BSFT）和自然场景（E-DAIC）数据集上的表现，重点关注诊断可靠性和人口统计学公平性。性能在不同环境和架构间差异显著；Phi3.5-Vision在E-DAIC上达到80.4%的准确率，而Qwen2-VL仅33.9%。此外，两个模型均表现出在AFAR-BSFT上过度预测抑郁的倾向。尽管两个架构中均存在偏见，但Qwen2-VL显示出更高的性别差异，而Phi-3.5-Vision表现出更多种族偏见。我们的XAI干预框架结果不一；公平性提示在E-DAIC上以严重牺牲准确率为代价实现了Qwen2-VL的完美机会均等。在AFAR-BSFT上，基于可解释性的干预改善了程序一致性，但并未保证结果公平性，有时甚至加剧了种族偏见。这些结果突显了程序透明度与公平结果之间的持续差距。我们分析了这些发现并总结了解决这些问题的具体建议，强调未来的公平干预必须同时优化预测准确性、人口统计学均等性和跨领域泛化能力。

Abstract

In recent years, the integration of multimodal machine learning in wellbeing assessment has offered transformative potential for monitoring mental health. However, with the rapid advancement of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), their deployment in clinical settings has raised concerns due to their lack of transparency and potential for bias. While previous research has explored the intersection of fairness and Explainable AI (XAI), its application to VLMs for wellbeing assessment and depression prediction remains under-explored. This work investigates VLM performance across laboratory (AFAR-BSFT) and naturalistic (E-DAIC) datasets, focusing on diagnostic reliability and demographic fairness. Performance varied substantially across environments and architectures; Phi3.5-Vision achieved 80.4% accuracy on E-DAIC, while Qwen2-VL struggled at 33.9%. Additionally, both models demonstrated a tendency to over-predict depression on AFAR-BSFT. Although bias existed across both architectures, Qwen2-VL showed higher gender disparities, while Phi-3.5-Vision exhibited more racial bias. Our XAI intervention framework yielded mixed results; fairness prompting achieved perfect equal opportunity for Qwen2-VL at a severe accuracy cost on E-DAIC. On AFAR-BSFT, explainability-based interventions improved procedural consistency but did not guarantee outcome fairness, sometimes amplifying racial bias. These results highlight a persistent gap between procedural transparency and equitable outcomes. We analyse these findings and consolidate concrete recommendations for addressing them, emphasising that future fairness interventions must jointly optimise predictive accuracy, demographic parity, and cross-domain generalisation.

item.title: MuSS: A Large-Scale Dataset and Cinematic Narrative Benchmark for Multi-Shot Subject-to-Video Generation
item.author: Haojie Zhang, Di Wu, Bingyan Liu, Linjie Zhong, Yuancheng Wei, Xingsong Ye, Nanqing Liu, Yaling Liang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者介绍了MuSS数据集和Cinematic Narrative Benchmark，旨在解决视频生成中多镜头叙事和主体到视频生成的挑战。

背景: 现有视频基础模型擅长单镜头生成，但现实电影叙事依赖复杂的多镜头序列。现有数据集缺乏对真实叙事逻辑、时空文本视频对齐冲突以及S2V生成中普遍存在的“复制粘贴”问题的解决。

目的: 构建一个大规模的双轨数据集MuSS，以支持多镜头视频和S2V生成，并引入Cinematic Narrative Benchmark来评估连续叙事和3D结构一致性。

方法: 1. 数据集构建：从3000多部电影中获取，支持复杂蒙太奇过渡和以主体为中心的叙事。采用渐进式描述流程，先确保局部镜头级准确性，再强制全局叙事连贯性。2. 机制实现：实施跨镜头匹配机制以消除S2V复制粘贴捷径。3. 评估方法：提出视觉逻辑驱动范式和新的Anti-Copy-Paste Variance (ACP-Var)指标。

主要发现: 在MuSS增强的模型上实现了最先进的叙事效果和跨镜头身份保持。相比之下，当前基线模型在连续叙事逻辑上挣扎，或退化为简单的2D贴纸生成器。

结论: MuSS数据集和Cinematic Narrative Benchmark能够有效提升视频生成模型在多镜头叙事和主体保持方面的性能。

翻译: While video foundation models excel at single-shot generation, real-world cinematic storytelling inherently relies on complex multi-shot sequencing. Further progress is constrained by the absence of datasets that address three core challenges: authentic narrative logic, spatiotemporal text-video alignment conflicts, and the

Abstract

While video foundation models excel at single-shot generation, real-world cinematic storytelling inherently relies on complex multi-shot sequencing. Further progress is constrained by the absence of datasets that address three core challenges: authentic narrative logic, spatiotemporal text-video alignment conflicts, and the "copy-paste" dilemma prevalent in Subject-to-Video (S2V) generation. To bridge this gap, we introduce MuSS, a large-scale, dual-track dataset tailored for multi-shot video and S2V generation. Sourced from over 3,000 movies, MuSS explicitly supports both complex montage transitions and subject-centric narratives. To construct this dataset, we pioneer a progressive captioning pipeline that eliminates contextual conflicts by ensuring local shot-level accuracy before enforcing global narrative coherence. Crucially, we implement a cross-shot matching mechanism to fundamentally eradicate the S2V copy-paste shortcut. Alongside the dataset, we propose the Cinematic Narrative Benchmark, featuring a visual-logic-driven paradigm and a novel Anti-Copy-Paste Variance (ACP-Var) metric to rigorously assess continuous storytelling and 3D structural consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while current baselines struggle with continuous narrative logic or degenerate into trivial 2D sticker generators, our MuSS-augmented model achieves state-of-the-art narrative effectiveness and cross-shot identity preservation.

item.title: Causal Representation Learning from General Environments under Nonparametric Mixing
item.author: Ignavier Ng, Shaoan Xie, Xinshuai Dong, Peter Spirtes, Kun Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了在一般环境下的因果表示学习问题，旨在从低级观测中恢复潜在因果变量及其因果关系。

背景: 现有的因果表示学习方法通常依赖于特定假设，如多环境、单节点干预、耦合干预或参数约束（如线性），但这些假设在真实问题中往往被违反。

目的: 为了将因果表示学习的适用范围扩展到更广泛的环境类别，即一般环境，本文形式化了一套新的期望条件。

方法: 通过利用因果机制在第三阶导数上的充分变化条件，结合非参数混合函数和非线性潜在因果模型（如加性高斯噪声模型或异方差噪声模型）。

主要发现: 在非参数混合函数和非线性潜在因果模型下，可以完全恢复潜在DAG并识别潜在变量，仅存在微小的不确定性。

结论: 本文的结果在已知工作中是首次在一般环境下通过非参数混合完全恢复潜在DAG，且相比许多现有工作具有更少的限制性假设。

翻译: 因果表示学习旨在从图像像素等低级观测中恢复潜在因果变量及其因果关系，通常用有向无环图表示。现有研究通常利用多环境，假设数据分布如何变化，包括单节点干预、耦合干预或硬干预，或对混合函数或潜在因果模型施加参数约束，如线性。尽管结果新颖且优雅，但在真实问题中往往被违反。因此，我们形式化了一套适用于更广泛环境类别的因果表示学习的期望条件，称为一般环境。有趣的是，我们表明通过适当利用因果机制在第三阶导数上的充分变化条件，可以在非参数混合函数和非线性潜在因果模型（如加性高斯噪声模型或异方差噪声模型）下完全恢复潜在DAG并识别潜在变量，仅存在微小的不确定性。据我们所知，这些是在一般环境下通过非参数混合完全恢复潜在DAG的首次结果。值得注意的是，我们的结果与许多现有工作相匹配或有所改进，但对环境变化的假设限制更少。

Abstract

Causal representation learning aims to recover the latent causal variables and their causal relations, typically represented by directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), from low-level observations such as image pixels. A prevailing line of research exploits multiple environments, which assume how data distributions change, including single-node interventions, coupled interventions, or hard interventions, or parametric constraints on the mixing function or the latent causal model, such as linearity. Despite the novelty and elegance of the results, they are often violated in real problems. Accordingly, we formalize a set of desiderata for causal representation learning that applies to a broader class of environments, referred to as general environments. Interestingly, we show that one can fully recover the latent DAG and identify the latent variables up to minor indeterminacies under a nonparametric mixing function and nonlinear latent causal models, such as additive (Gaussian) noise models or heteroscedastic noise models, by properly leveraging sufficient change conditions on the causal mechanisms up to third-order derivatives. These represent, to our knowledge, the first results to fully recover the latent DAG from general environments under nonparametric mixing. Notably, our results match or improve upon many existing works, but require less restrictive assumptions about changing environments.

item.title: EndoGov: A knowledge-governed multi-agent expert system for endometrial cancer risk stratification
item.author: Weiye Dai, Liyun Shi, Zanxiang He, Yuling Ma, Mengyuan Lin, Dianxiang Sun, Liming Nie
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: EndoGov是一个两级多代理专家系统，用于子宫内膜癌风险分层，通过将决策过程分解为证据提取和规则应用，实现了高准确率并确保指南合规性。

背景: 现有的多模态人工智能模型在子宫内膜癌风险分层中虽然优化了整体预测性能，但在强制执行指南覆盖（如将POLE突变肿瘤分配到低风险组）方面存在机制有限的问题。

目的: 提出EndoGov系统，旨在通过明确的临床规则治理提供符合指南、可审计的子宫内膜癌风险分配，同时保持竞争力的鉴别能力。

方法: EndoGov是一个两级多代理专家系统，决策过程分解为D(x) = G(P(x), R)，其中P提取结构化证据，G应用可执行规则集R。Tier 1包含病理、分子和临床代理，Tier 2查询证据级加权的指南知识图谱，使用确定性硬路径规则和高优先级覆盖以及约束软路径推理处理模糊病例。

主要发现: 在TCGA-UCEC数据集（n=541）中，EndoGov达到0.943准确率和0.973宏观AUC，条件逻辑违规率（C-LVR）为0.93%；在CPTAC-UCEC数据集（n=95）中，准确率为0.842，显著优于锁定转移神经基线（<0.31）；端到端安全分解显示残余失败主要位于上游分子检测；后端交换实验表明硬路径合规性对LLM后端不变。

结论: 明确的临床规则治理能够提供符合指南、可审计的子宫内膜癌风险分配，同时保留竞争力的鉴别能力，支持在分布偏移下的治理路径转移。

翻译: 用于子宫内膜癌风险分层的多模态人工智能模型通常优化整体预测性能，但在强制执行指南覆盖方面机制有限，例如尽管形态学为高级别，仍将POLE突变肿瘤分配到低风险组。我们提出了EndoGov，一个两级多代理专家系统，将决策过程分解为D(x) = G(P(x), R)，其中专家代理P提取结构化证据，治理代理G应用可执行规则集R。第一级包括病理、分子和临床代理，它们从冻结的基模型特征或结构化记录中独立生成符合架构的报告。第二级查询证据级加权的指南知识图谱，对高优先级覆盖使用确定性硬路径规则，对模糊病例使用约束软路径推理。在TCGA-UCEC（n=541）中，EndoGov实现了0.943准确率、0.973宏观AUC和0.93%的条件逻辑违规率（C-LVR）。在CPTAC-UCEC（n=95）中，参考标签由指南衍生，EndoGov达到0.842准确率，而锁定转移神经基线低于0.31，支持在分布偏移下的治理路径转移，而非与独立临床真理验证。端到端安全分解将残余失败主要定位在上游分子检测而非下游治理。后端交换实验进一步表明硬路径合规性对LLM后端不变。这些发现表明，明确的临床规则治理可以提供符合指南、可审计的子宫内膜癌风险分配，同时保持竞争力的鉴别能力。

Abstract

Multimodal artificial intelligence models for endometrial cancer (EC) risk stratification typically optimize aggregate predictive performance but provide limited mechanisms for enforcing mandatory guideline overrides, such as assigning POLE-mutated tumors to the low-risk group despite high-grade morphology. We present EndoGov, a two-tier multi-agent expert system that factorizes the decision process as D(x) = G(P(x), R), where specialist agents P extract structured evidence and a governance agent G applies an executable rule set R. Tier 1 comprises pathology, molecular, and clinical agents that independently generate schema-constrained reports from frozen foundation-model features or structured records. Tier 2 queries an evidence-level-weighted Guideline Knowledge Graph, using deterministic hard-path rules for high-priority overrides and constrained soft-path reasoning for ambiguous cases. In TCGA-UCEC (n=541), EndoGov achieved 0.943 accuracy, 0.973 macro AUC, and a conditional logic-violation rate (C-LVR) of 0.93% among trigger-exposed cases. In CPTAC-UCEC (n=95), where reference labels are guideline-derived, EndoGov reached 0.842 accuracy compared with < 0.31 for locked-transfer neural baselines, supporting governance-pathway transfer under distribution shift rather than validation against independent clinical truth. End-to-end safety decomposition localized residual failures primarily to upstream molecular detection rather than downstream governance. Backend-swap experiments further showed that hard-path compliance is invariant to the LLM backend. These findings indicate that explicit clinical-rule governance can provide guideline-compliant, auditable EC risk assignment while preserving competitive discrimination.

item.title: Mapping License Plate Recoverability Under Extreme Viewing Angles for Oppor-tunistic Urban Sensing
item.author: Igor Adamenko, Orpaz Ben Aharon, Yehudit Aperstein, Alexander Apartsin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为 recoverability maps 的方法，用于量化图像恢复的边界，以确定哪些失真参数允许可靠恢复，哪些会导致推理失败。该方法结合了密集的合成失真参数扫描和两个总结指标：边界面积下曲线和可靠性评分。研究在车牌识别任务上进行了演示，并评估了多种恢复架构。

背景: 城市环境中存在许多用于特定目的的成像传感器（如 ATM、身体佩戴、CCTV 和仪表盘摄像头），在机会感知范式下，这些传感器可以被重新用于车牌识别等次要推断任务。然而，图像中的目标对象通常存在噪声、低分辨率和极端视角等问题。

目的: 确定哪些失真参数允许可靠恢复，哪些会导致推断失败，并量化这一边界。

方法: 引入了 recoverability maps，一种任务无关的方法。该方法结合了密集的合成失真参数扫描和两个总结指标：边界面积下曲线（估计参数空间中可恢复部分的分数）和可靠性评分（捕捉该区域内失败频率和严重程度）。

主要发现: 在车牌识别任务上，最佳模型恢复了约 93% 的参数空间。不同模型之间相似的结果表明，感知几何而非架构决定了恢复的上限。

结论: 感知几何而非架构决定了恢复的上限。

翻译: 城市环境中包含许多为特定目的而构建的成像传感器，包括 ATM、身体佩戴、CCTV 和仪表盘摄像头。在机会感知范式下，这些传感器可以被重新用于车牌识别等次要推断任务。然而，此类图像中的目标对象通常存在噪声、低分辨率和极端视角等问题。基于 AI 的恢复的最新进展可以从严重退化的图像中恢复有用的信息。一个主要的挑战是确定哪些失真参数允许可靠恢复，哪些会导致推断失败。本文介绍了 recoverability maps，一种用于量化这一边界的任务无关方法。该方法结合了密集的合成失真参数扫描和两个总结指标：边界面积下曲线，它估计参数空间中可恢复部分的分数，以及可靠性评分，它捕捉该区域内失败的频率和严重程度。我们在从具有真实相机伪影的极端角度视图中进行车牌识别的任务上演示了该方法。训练和评估了几种恢复架构，包括 U-Net、Restormer、Pix2Pix 和 SR3 扩散。最佳模型恢复了约 93% 的参数空间。不同模型之间相似的结果表明，感知几何而非架构决定了恢复的上限。

Abstract

Urban environments contain many imaging sensors built for specific purposes, including ATM, body-worn, CCTV, and dashboard cameras. Under the opportunistic sensing paradigm, these sensors can be repurposed for secondary inference tasks such as license plate recognition. Yet objects of interest in such imagery are often noisy, low-resolution, and captured from extreme viewpoints. Recent advances in AI-based restoration can recover use-ful information even from severely degraded images. A central challenge is determining which distortion parame-ters allow reliable recovery and which lead to inference failure. This paper introduces recoverability maps, a task-agnostic method for quantifying this boundary. The method combines a dense synthetic sweep of degrada-tion parameters with two summary measures: boundary area-under-curve, which estimates the recoverable frac-tion of the parameter space, and a reliability score, which captures the frequency and severity of failures within that region. We demonstrate the method on license plate recognition from highly angled views under realistic camera artifacts. Several restoration architectures are trained and evaluated, including U-Net, Restormer, Pix2Pix, and SR3 diffusion. The best model recovers about 93% of the parameter space. Similar results across models sug-gest that sensing geometry, rather than architecture, sets the limit of recovery.

item.title: Focus on What Matters: Two-Stage ROI-Aware Refinement for Anatomy-Preserving Fetal Ultrasound Reconstruction
item.author: Ines Abbes, Mahmood Alzubaidi, Mowafa Househ, Khalid Alyafei, Marco Agus, Samir Brahim Belhaouari
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种针对测量关键超声任务的区域感知表示学习框架，并在多医院域偏移下的早期NT筛查中进行了实例化。该方法通过两阶段卷积自编码器学习全局忠实潜码，并利用梯度校准自动调整损失权重以优化特定区域。实验表明，该方法在严格医院评估下显著提升了重建质量和测量精度，并增强了模型在未见医院上的泛化能力。

背景: 测量关键超声任务往往依赖于小解剖区域，使得全局重建指标作为临床保真度的可靠代理不可靠。

目的: 提出一种区域感知表示学习框架，并在多医院域偏移下的早期NT筛查中进行实例化。

方法: 采用两阶段卷积自编码器，第一阶段通过MS-SSIM学习全局忠实潜码，第二阶段利用强度和归一化Sobel边缘约束细化NT区域。通过基于梯度的校准方法自动初始化损失权重以结合异质目标。

主要发现: 在严格医院评估下，区域细化在标准验证集上提高了PSNR，在未见测试集上提高了PSNR，并显著降低了ROI的MAE和边缘MAE。冻结潜码探针显示模型在未见医院上的泛化能力增强，且异常检测保持强劲。

结论: 该区域感知细化原则具有解剖学普适性，可应用于其他胎儿生物测量目标（如CRL、NB）以及小ROI主导临床决策的更广泛医学成像设置。

翻译: 测量关键超声任务通常依赖于小解剖区域，使得全局重建指标作为临床保真度的可靠代理不可靠。我们提出了一种区域感知表示学习框架，并在多医院域偏移下的早期NT筛查中对其进行了实例化。两阶段卷积自编码器首先通过MS-SSIM学习全局忠实的潜码，然后利用强度和归一化Sobel边缘约束细化NT区域。为了结合这些异质目标而不需要手动调优，我们通过基于梯度的校准从逐项梯度幅度初始化损失权重。在严格的医院级评估下，区域细化提高了全局和测量相关的质量：在标准验证集上，它将PSNR提高了+0.27 dB（验证）和+0.29 dB（保留测试），将ROI MAE降低了8.87%（验证）和6.43%（保留测试），并将ROI边缘MAE在源医院上降低了11.10%，在未见医院上降低了4.90%。除了重建之外，冻结潜码探针提供了泛化的额外证据：医院来源在未见站点上变得不那么自信可预测（0.556到0.541最大softmax；0.684到0.688熵），而OOD检测在站点保留协议下保持强劲（马氏距离AUROC高达0.9956，在具有挑战性的分割中KNN增益适中）。相同的区域感知细化原则是解剖学无关的，可以用于其他胎儿生物测量目标（如头臀长、鼻骨）以及小ROI主导临床决策的更广泛医学成像设置。

Abstract

Measurement-critical ultrasound tasks often depend on a small anatomical region, making global reconstruction metrics an unreliable proxy for clinical fidelity. We propose an ROI-aware representation learning framework and instantiate it for first-trimester nuchal translucency (NT) screening under multi-hospital domain shift. A two-phase convolutional autoencoder (CAE) first learns a globally faithful 128-D latent code via MS-SSIM, then refines the NT ROI using intensity (L1) and normalized Sobel-edge constraints. To combine these heterogeneous objectives without manual tuning, we initialize loss weights via gradient-based calibration from per-term gradient magnitudes. Under strict hospital-wise evaluation with one hospital held out, ROI refinement improves both global and measurement-relevant quality: on the standard dev split it increases PSNR by +0.27 dB (val) and +0.29 dB (held-out test), reduces ROI MAE by 8.87% (val) and 6.43% (held-out test), and reduces ROI Edge-MAE by 11.10% on source hospitals and 4.90% on the unseen hospital. Beyond reconstruction, frozen-latent probes provide additional evidence of generalization: hospital provenance becomes less confidently predictable on the unseen site (0.556 to 0.541 max-softmax; 0.684 to 0.688 entropy) while OOD detection remains strong across site-held-out protocols (Mahalanobis AUROC up to 0.9956, with modest KNN gains in challenging splits). The same ROI-aware refinement principle is anatomy-agnostic and can be adopted for other fetal biometry targets (e.g., crown-rump length (CRL), nasal bone (NB)) and broader medical imaging settings where small ROIs dominate clinical decisions.

item.title: Exploring Audio Hallucination in Egocentric Video Understanding
item.author: Ashish Seth, Xinhao Mei, Changsheng Zhao, Varun Nagaraja, Ernie Chang, Gregory P. Meyer, Gael Le Lan, Yunyang Xiong, Vikas Chandra, Yangyang Shi, Dinesh Manocha, Zhipeng Cai
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究egocentric视频中音频幻觉问题并提出评估框架

背景: Egocentric视频中声音是理解用户活动和周围环境的关键线索，特别是在视觉信息不稳定或被遮挡时。现有的先进音频-视觉语言模型虽然能生成多模态描述，但容易出现音频幻觉，即从视觉线索推断出实际未听到的声音。

目的: 提出一个系统且自动的评估框架来分析egocentric视频中的音频幻觉，通过针对性的问答协议进行评估。

方法: 构建了包含300个egocentric视频的数据集，设计了1000个专注于声音的问答问题。提出了一个基于分类学的评估方法，将幻觉区分为用户活动的前景动作声音和环境背景声音。

主要发现: 先进的AV-LLMs表现出高幻觉率，例如Qwen2.5 Omni在前景声音和背景声音的问答准确率分别仅为27.3%和39.5%。

结论: 强调了测量多模态响应可靠性的必要性，指出开发可靠的AV-LLMs需要可靠的幻觉评估。

翻译: Egocentric视频提供了一种独特的设置，其中声音作为理解用户活动和周围环境的关键线索，特别是当由于连续相机运动导致视觉信息不稳定或被遮挡时。最先进的音频-视觉语言模型可以生成多模态描述。然而，我们在这项工作中表明，它们容易出现音频幻觉，经常从可见但未听到的视觉线索推断声音。我们提出了一种系统且自动的评估框架，通过针对性的问答协议来分析egocentric视频中的音频幻觉。我们策划了300个egocentric视频的数据集，并设计了1000个专注于声音的问题来探测模型输出。为了对幻觉进行分类，我们提出了一个基于分类学的方法，将用户活动的前景动作声音与环境背景声音区分开来。我们的评估表明，先进的AV-LLMs，如Qwen2.5 Omni，表现出高幻觉率，在前景和背景声音相关的问答中分别实现了27.3%和39.5%的准确率。通过这项工作，我们强调了测量多模态响应可靠性的必要性，强调可靠的幻觉评估对于开发可靠的AV-LLMs至关重要。

Abstract

Egocentric videos provide a distinctive setting in which sound serves as crucial cues to understand user activities and surroundings, particularly when visual information is unstable or occluded due to continuous camera movement. State-of-the-art large audio-visual language models (AV-LLMs) can generate multimodal descriptions. However, we show in this work that they are prone to audio hallucinations, often inferring sounds from visual cues that are visible but not heard. We present a systematic and automatic evaluation framework for analyzing audio hallucinations in egocentric video through a targeted question-answering (Q/A) protocol. We curate a dataset of 300 egocentric videos and design 1,000 sound-focused questions to probe model outputs. To characterize hallucinations, we propose a grounded taxonomy that distinguishes between foreground action sounds from the user activities and background ambient sounds. Our evaluation shows that advanced AV-LLMs, such as Qwen2.5 Omni, exhibit high hallucination rates, achieving only 27.3% and 39.5% accuracy on Q/As related to foreground and background sounds, respectively. With this work, we highlight the need to measure the reliability of multimodal responses, emphasizing that robust evaluation of hallucinations is essential to develop reliable AV-LLMs.

item.title: Inverting Foundation Models of Brain Function with Simulation-Based Inference
item.author: Niels Bracher, Xavier Intes, Stefan T. Radev
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究基础模型在逆向任务中的潜力，通过模拟大脑活动来恢复刺激参数。

背景: 基础模型在模拟神经反应方面展现出前景，下一步是探索其在逆向任务中的应用。

目的: 探究基础模型能否从合成的大脑活动中恢复刺激或其属性。

方法: 使用TRIBEv2作为概念验证工具，将大脑模拟器与生成新闻标题的大型语言模型配对，利用基于模拟的推断学习从大脑图谱到潜在刺激参数的概率映射。

主要发现: 这些参数可以从预测的大脑图谱中恢复，验证了神经编码的质量；大型语言模型可作为可控的刺激生成器用于模拟实验。

结论: 这些发现为利用基础大脑模型进行解码和逆向设计迈出了重要一步。

翻译: 基础大脑模型在模拟神经反应方面展现出前景，能够跨任务和模态模拟神经对复杂刺激的反应。自然的下一步是询问这些模型是否也能用于逆向。我们能否从合成的大脑活动中恢复刺激或其属性？我们在概念验证设置中利用TRIBEv2研究了这个问题。我们将大脑模拟器与生成新闻标题的大型语言模型配对，这些标题由情感、唤醒度和支配度等语言参数生成。然后我们使用基于模拟的推断来学习从大脑图谱到潜在刺激参数的概率映射。我们的结果表明，这些参数可以从预测的大脑图谱中恢复，验证了神经编码的质量。它们还表明，大型语言模型可以作为可控的刺激生成器用于模拟实验。这些发现共同为利用基础大脑模型进行解码和逆向设计提供了重要一步。

Abstract

Foundation models of brain activity promise a new frontier for in silico neuroscience by emulating neural responses to complex stimuli across tasks and modalities.
