A natural next step is to ask whether these models can also be used in reverse. Can we recover a stimulus or its properties from synthetic brain activity? We study this question in a proof-of-concept setting using TRIBEv2. We pair the brain emulator with large language models (LLMs) that generate news headlines from linguistic parameters such as valence, arousal, and dominance. We then use simulation-based inference to learn a probabilistic mapping from brain maps to latent stimulus parameters. Our results show that these parameters can be recovered from predicted brain maps, validating the quality of neural encodings. They also show that LLMs can serve as controllable stimulus generators for simulated experiments. Together, these findings provide a step toward decoding and inverse design with foundation brain models.

item.title: VLM-VPI: A Vision-Language Reasoning Framework for Improving Automated Vehicle-Pedestrian Interactions
item.author: Qingwen Pu, Kun Xie, Yuxiang Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于视觉语言模型的车辆-行人交互框架，旨在提升自动驾驶系统对行人意图的理解和 yielding-aware 控制。

背景: 现有的自动驾驶系统仅依赖几何和运动学线索推断行人让路行为，限制了其对视觉场景上下文和年龄相关行为差异的推理能力，导致在安全关键交互中干预延迟或在良性交互中不必要的制动。

目的: 引入 Vision-Language Model-based Vehicle-Pedestrian Interaction (VLM-VPI)，构建一个多模态推理框架，以理解行人意图并实现 yielding-aware 控制。

方法: 系统包含三个组件：多模态感知层（捕获视觉和运动学观察）、推理层（使用 Qwen3-VL 8B 进行视觉场景理解，使用 GPT-OSS 20B 进行少样本意图推理）以及分级安全控制器（应用针对儿童、成人和老年人的特定制动余量）。

主要发现: 在 112 个 CARLA 场景中，意图分类准确率达到 92.3%，优于基于规则的基线（78.4%）、监督轨迹模型（73.5-82.4%）和零样本 LLM 配置（88.4%）；在 24 个真实 PIE 场景中准确率为 87.5%；在 200 个仿真案例中，误报率从 7.4% 降至 2.8%，平均通行时间从 13.5 秒降至 11.8 秒，冲突次数从 124 次降至 33 次，最小碰撞时间从 1.92 秒提升至 4.47 秒；针对儿童和老年人的自适应控制分别比统一控制减少了 60% 和 54.5% 的冲突。

结论: 显式的视觉语言推理层通过将行人意图、人口统计背景和车辆控制决策联系起来，能够同时提高自动驾驶的安全性和效率。

翻译: Autonomous driving systems often infer pedestrian yielding behavior from geometric and kinematic cues alone, limiting their ability to reason about visual scene context and age-dependent behavioral variability. This limitation can produce delayed interventions in safety-critical encounters and unnecessary braking in benign interactions. This work introduces Vision-Language Model-based Vehicle-Pedestrian Interaction (VLM-VPI), a multimodal reasoning framework for pedestrian intent understanding and yielding-aware control in autonomous driving. The system combines three components: a multimodal perception layer that captures visual and kinematic observations, a reasoning layer that uses Qwen3-VL 8B for visual scene understanding and GPT-OSS 20B for few-shot intent reasoning, and a tiered safety controller that applies age-specific braking margins for children, adults, and seniors. In 112 CARLA scenarios, VLM-VPI achieves 92.3% intent classification accuracy, outperforming a rule-based baseline (78.4%), supervised trajectory models (73.5-82.4%), and a zero-shot LLM configuration (88.4%). Validation on 24 real-world PIE scenarios yields 87.5% accuracy, indicating functional sim-to-real transferability. Across 200 simulation cases, VLM-VPI reduces the false-alarm rate from 7.4% to 2.8% and mean intersection traversal time from 13.5 s to 11.8 s. Conflict occurrences decrease from 124 to 33, while mean minimum time-to-collision improves from 1.92 s to 4.47 s. Demographic-adaptive control further reduces conflicts by 60% for children and 54.5% for seniors compared with uniform control. These results show that an explicit vision-language reasoning layer can improve both safety and efficiency by linking pedestrian intent, demographic context, and vehicle control decisions.

Abstract

Autonomous driving systems often infer pedestrian yielding behavior from geometric and kinematic cues alone, limiting their ability to reason about visual scene context and age-dependent behavioral variability. This limitation can produce delayed interventions in safety-critical encounters and unnecessary braking in benign interactions. This work introduces Vision-Language Model-based Vehicle-Pedestrian Interaction (VLM-VPI), a multimodal reasoning framework for pedestrian intent understanding and yielding-aware control in autonomous driving. The system combines three components: a multimodal perception layer that captures visual and kinematic observations, a reasoning layer that uses Qwen3-VL 8B for visual scene understanding and GPT-OSS 20B for few-shot intent reasoning, and a tiered safety controller that applies age-specific braking margins for children, adults, and seniors. In 112 CARLA scenarios, VLM-VPI achieves 92.3% intent classification accuracy, outperforming a rule-based baseline (78.4%), supervised trajectory models (73.5-82.4%), and a zero-shot LLM configuration (88.4%). Validation on 24 real-world PIE scenarios yields 87.5% accuracy, indicating functional sim-to-real transferability. Across 200 simulation cases, VLM-VPI reduces the false-alarm rate from 7.4% to 2.8% and mean intersection traversal time from 13.5 s to 11.8 s. Conflict occurrences decrease from 124 to 33, while mean minimum time-to-collision improves from 1.92 s to 4.47 s. Demographic-adaptive control further reduces conflicts by 60% for children and 54.5% for seniors compared with uniform control. These results show that an explicit vision-language reasoning layer can improve both safety and efficiency by linking pedestrian intent, demographic context, and vehicle control decisions.

item.title: GoClick: Lightweight Element Grounding Model for Autonomous GUI Interaction
item.author: Hongxin Li, Yuntao Chen, Zhaoxiang Zhang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了GoClick，一种轻量级的GUI元素定位模型，仅使用230M参数，通过选择编码器-解码器架构和渐进式数据精炼管道，在保持小尺寸和高推理速度的同时，实现了与大型模型相当的视觉定位准确率。

背景: GUI元素定位对于智能体与图形用户界面交互至关重要，但在资源受限的设备如手机上直接部署这一能力面临挑战，因为当前方法通常依赖参数超过25亿的大型视觉语言模型，难以在设备上执行。

目的: 为了解决在资源受限设备上部署GUI元素定位的需求，开发一种轻量级模型，使其能够在保持小尺寸和高推理速度的同时，实现优秀的视觉定位准确率。

方法: 1. 采用编码器-解码器架构而非简单的解码器架构；2. 开发渐进式数据精炼管道，利用任务类型过滤和数据比例调整，从1080万原始数据集中提取出380万高质量核心数据集；3. 使用该核心数据集训练GoClick模型。

主要发现: 1. 编码器-解码器架构在小参数规模下优于解码器架构；2. 渐进式数据精炼管道能显著提升定位准确率；3. GoClick在多个GUI元素定位基准测试中表现出色；4. GoClick在设备-云协作框架中集成后，能帮助云端任务规划器进行精确元素定位并提高成功率。

结论: GoClick作为一种轻量级模型，在保持小尺寸和高推理速度的同时实现了优秀的视觉定位准确率，为GUI智能体社区提供了一种有意义的探索。

翻译: 图形用户界面（GUI）元素定位（基于自然语言指令在屏幕截图中精确定位元素）是智能体与GUI交互的基础。在资源受限的设备（如手机）上直接部署这一能力对于需要低延迟的GUI智能体变得越来越关键。然而，这一目标面临重大挑战，因为当前的视觉定位方法通常采用大型视觉语言模型（参数超过25亿），由于内存和计算限制，使其在设备上执行不切实际。为了解决这个问题，本文介绍了GoClick，一种轻量级的GUI元素定位VLM，仅有230M参数，实现了优秀的视觉定位准确率，甚至与显著更大的模型相当。简单地缩小现有的解码器VLM是设计轻量级模型的一种直接方法，但我们的实验表明，这种方法产生次优结果。相反，我们选择了一种编码器-解码器架构，在小参数规模下，该架构在GUI定位任务中优于解码器替代方案。此外，小VLM的有限容量鼓励我们开发一种渐进式数据精炼管道，利用任务类型过滤和数据比例调整，从1080万原始数据集中提取出380万高质量核心数据集。使用此核心数据集训练GoClick带来了显著的定位准确率提升。我们的实验表明，GoClick在多个GUI元素定位基准测试中表现出色，同时保持了小尺寸和高推理速度。GoClick在集成到设备-云协作框架中时，也增强了GUI智能体的性能，其中GoClick帮助基于云的任务规划器进行精确元素定位并实现更高的成功率。我们希望我们的方法能为GUI智能体社区提供有意义的探索。

Abstract

Graphical User Interface (GUI) element grounding (precisely locating elements on screenshots based on natural language instructions) is fundamental for agents interacting with GUIs. Deploying this capability directly on resource-constrained devices like mobile phones is increasingly critical for GUI agents requiring low latency. However, this goal faces a significant challenge, as current visual grounding methods typically employ large vision-language model (VLM) (more than 2.5B parameters), making them impractical for on-device execution due to memory and computational constraints. To address this, this paper introduces GoClick, a lightweight GUI element grounding VLM with only 230M parameters that achieves excellent visual grounding accuracy, even on par with significantly larger models. Simply downsizing existing decoder-only VLMs is a straightforward way to design a lightweight model, but our experiments reveal that this approach yields suboptimal results. Instead, we select an encoder-decoder architecture, which outperforms decoder-only alternatives at small parameter scales for GUI grounding tasks. Additionally, the limited capacity of small VLMs encourages us to develop a Progressive Data Refinement pipeline that utilizes task type filtering and data ratio adjustment to extract a high-quality 3.8M-sample core set from a 10.8M raw dataset. Training GoClick using this core set brings notable grounding accuracy gains. Our experiments show that GoClick excels on multiple GUI element grounding benchmarks while maintaining a small size and high inference speed. GoClick also enhances GUI agent performance when integrated into a device-cloud collaboration framework, where GoClick helps cloud-based task planners perform precise element localization and achieve higher success rates. We hope our method serves as a meaningful exploration within the GUI agent community.

item.title: Propagation Structure-Semantic Transfer Learning for Robust Fake News Detection
item.author: Mengyang Chen, Lingwei Wei, Han Cao, Wei Zhou, Zhou Yan, Songlin Hu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于教师-学生架构的传播结构-语义迁移学习框架（PSS-TL），用于在噪声环境下鲁棒地检测虚假新闻。

背景: 现有的虚假新闻检测方法主要从新闻内容或传播结构中学习语义特征，但在实际场景中，由于非正式语言的语义模糊性和社交媒体上不可靠的用户交互行为，新闻内容和传播结构中存在固有的语义和结构噪声。

目的: 为了解决现有方法中结构噪声与语义噪声相互干扰导致检测性能受限的问题，本文旨在提出一种鲁棒的虚假新闻检测方法。

方法: 本文设计了一个基于教师-学生架构的PSS-TL框架。具体包括：设计双教师模型分别从噪声新闻内容和传播结构中独立学习语义知识和结构知识；设计多通道知识蒸馏（MKD）损失，使学生模型能够从教师模型中获取专门知识，从而避免噪声相互干扰。

主要发现: 在两个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验验证了该方法的有效性和鲁棒性。

结论: 该方法能够有效缓解噪声干扰，实现鲁棒的虚假新闻检测。

翻译: Fake news generally refers to false information that is spread deliberately to deceive people, which has detrimental social effects. Existing fake news detection methods primarily learn the semantic features from news content or integrate structural features from propagation. However, in practical scenarios, due to the semantic ambiguity of informal language and unreliable user interactive behaviors on social media, there are inherent semantic and structural noises in news content and propagation. Although some recent works consider the effect of irrelevant user interactions in a hybrid-modeling way, they still suffer from the mutual interference between structural noise and semantic noise, leading to limited performance for robust detection. To alleviate this issue, this paper proposes a novel Propagation Structure-Semantic Transfer Learning framework (PSS-TL) for robust fake news detection under a teacher-student architecture. Specifically, we design dual teacher models to learn semantics knowledge and structure knowledge from noisy news content and propagation structure independently. Besides, we design a Multi-channel Knowledge Distillation (MKD) loss to enable the student model to acquire specialized knowledge from the teacher models, thereby avoiding mutual interference. Extensive experiments on two real-world datasets validate the effectiveness and robustness of our method.

Abstract

Fake news generally refers to false information that is spread deliberately to deceive people, which has detrimental social effects. Existing fake news detection methods primarily learn the semantic features from news content or integrate structural features from propagation. However, in practical scenarios, due to the semantic ambiguity of informal language and unreliable user interactive behaviors on social media, there are inherent semantic and structural noises in news content and propagation. Although some recent works consider the effect of irrelevant user interactions in a hybrid-modeling way, they still suffer from the mutual interference between structural noise and semantic noise, leading to limited performance for robust detection. To alleviate this issue, this paper proposes a novel Propagation Structure-Semantic Transfer Learning framework (PSS-TL) for robust fake news detection under a teacher-student architecture. Specifically, we design dual teacher models to learn semantics knowledge and structure knowledge from noisy news content and propagation structure independently. Besides, we design a Multi-channel Knowledge Distillation (MKD) loss to enable the student model to acquire specialized knowledge from the teacher models, thereby avoiding mutual interference. Extensive experiments on two real-world datasets validate the effectiveness and robustness of our method.

item.title: Multi-View Synergistic Learning with Vision-Language Adaption for Low-Resource Biomedical Image Classification
item.author: Xiaoliu Luo, Minxue Xiao, Ting Xie, Mengzhu Wang, Huiqing Qi, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Taiping Zhang, Xu Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为多视图协同学习（MVSL）的统一框架，旨在解决生物医学图像分类中标注有限、类别间视觉差异细微以及疾病语义复杂的问题。

背景: 生物医学图像分类在资源受限条件下面临挑战，主要由于标注有限、类别间视觉差异细微以及复杂的疾病语义。虽然视觉-语言模型为缓解数据稀缺提供了有前景的基础，但在生物医学环境中的有效适应需要参数高效微调以及细粒度和语义一致的表示学习。

目的: 提出多视图协同学习（MVSL）框架，通过联合考虑适应范式、表示粒度和疾病语义关系来解决这些挑战。

方法: MVSL通过解耦视觉和文本编码器的适应来尊重它们不同的表征特征，实现更稳定和有效的参数高效微调。引入多粒度对比学习来显式建模全局图像语义和局部病灶级证据，提高对视觉相似疾病类别的细粒度区分能力。通过结合来自大型语言模型的结构化监督来保持疾病级语义结构，约束文本表示并间接通过跨模态对齐来规范视觉嵌入。

主要发现: 在涵盖9种成像模态和10个解剖区域的11个公共生物医学数据集上的广泛实验表明，MVSL在少样本和零样本分类设置中始终优于最先进的方法。

结论: MVSL的组件能够实现更稳定的跨模态对齐和有限的监督下的改进区分能力。

翻译: 在低资源条件下对生物医学图像进行准确分类仍然具有挑战性，这归因于有限的标注、类别间细微的视觉差异以及复杂的疾病语义。虽然视觉-语言模型为缓解数据稀缺提供了有前景的基础，但在生物医学环境中的有效适应受到需要参数高效微调以及细粒度和语义一致的表示学习的限制。在这项工作中，我们提出了多视图协同学习（MVSL），这是一个统一框架，通过联合考虑适应范式、表示粒度和疾病语义关系来解决这些挑战。MVSL解耦了视觉和文本编码器的适应，以尊重它们不同的表征特征，从而实现更稳定和有效的参数高效微调。它进一步引入了多粒度对比学习，以显式建模全局图像语义和局部病灶级证据，提高了对视觉相似疾病类别的细粒度区分能力。此外，MVSL通过结合来自大型语言模型的结构化监督来保持疾病级语义结构，这约束了文本表示，并通过跨模态对齐间接规范了视觉嵌入。这些组件共同实现了更稳定的跨模态对齐和有限的监督下的改进区分能力。在涵盖9种成像模态和10个解剖区域的11个公共生物医学数据集上的广泛实验表明，MVSL在少样本和零样本分类设置中始终优于最先进的方法。

Abstract

Accurate biomedical image classification under low-resource conditions remains challenging due to limited annotations, subtle inter-class visual differences, and complex disease semantics. While vision--language models offer a promising foundation for mitigating data scarcity, their effective adaptation in biomedical settings is constrained by the need for parameter-efficient tuning alongside fine-grained and semantically consistent representation learning. In this work, we propose Multi-View Synergistic Learning (MVSL), a unified framework that addresses these challenges by jointly considering adaptation paradigms, representation granularity, and disease semantic relationships. MVSL decouples the adaptation of visual and textual encoders to respect their distinct representational characteristics, enabling more stable and effective parameter-efficient fine-tuning. It further introduces multi-granularity contrastive learning to explicitly model both global image semantics and localized lesion-level evidence, improving fine-grained discrimination for visually similar disease categories. In addition, MVSL preserves disease-level semantic structure by incorporating structured supervision derived from large language models, which constrains textual representations at the class level and indirectly regularizes visual embeddings through cross-modal alignment. Together, these components enable more stable cross-modal alignment and improved discrimination under limited supervision. Extensive experiments on $11$ public biomedical datasets spanning $9$ imaging modalities and $10$ anatomical regions demonstrate that MVSL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in few-shot and zero-shot classification settings.

item.title: Failure-Centered Runtime Evaluation for Deployed Trilingual Public-Space Agents
item.author: M. Meng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了PSA-Eval框架，旨在通过关注失败而非评分来评估部署的三语公共空间代理的运行时表现。

背景: 当评估对象从静态输入输出映射转变为运行时系统时，分析的基本单位应从评分转变为失败。

目的: 将传统的评估链条扩展为可追踪、可审查、可修复和可回归测试的流程，以观察跨语言策略漂移。

方法: 使用三语等价输入作为受控探针，在真实的三语数字前台系统中进行试点研究，包含81个样本和27个三语等价问题组。

主要发现: 尽管系统平均得分为23.15/24，但14个组别显示出非零的跨语言评分漂移，5个组别漂移至少3分，最大漂移达9分。

结论: 基于失败的运行时评估能够揭示被聚合评分掩盖的结构化部署信号。

翻译: 本文介绍了PSA-Eval，这是一个针对部署的三语公共空间代理的以失败为中心的运行时评估框架。核心主张是，当评估对象从静态输入输出映射转变为运行时系统时，分析的基本单位应从评分转变为失败。PSA-Eval将传统的链条问题->答案->评分->结束扩展为问题->批次->运行->评分->失败案例->修复->回归批次，使失败可追踪、可审查、可修复和可回归测试。该框架使用三语等价输入作为受控探针来观察群体层面的跨语言策略漂移。我们在一家国际金融机构大厅部署的真实三语数字前台系统中进行了一项试点研究。试点研究使用简化的单基础模型设置（MA = MB），因此观察到的漂移不应被解释为A/B基础模型差异。研究包含81个样本，组织成27个三语等价问题组。尽管系统平均得分为23.15/24，但14个组别显示出非零的跨语言评分漂移，5个组别显示出至少3分的漂移，最大漂移达到9分。这些结果提供了初步证据，表明以失败为中心的运行时评估能够揭示被聚合评分掩盖的结构化部署信号。

Abstract

This paper presents PSA-Eval, a failure-centered runtime evaluation framework for deployed trilingual public-space agents. The central claim is that, when the evaluation object shifts from a static input-output mapping to a runtime system, the basic unit of analysis should shift from score to failure. PSA-Eval extends the conventional chain Question -> Answer -> Score -> End into Question -> Batch -> Run -> Score -> Failure Case -> Repair -> Regression Batch, making failures traceable, reviewable, repairable, and regression-testable. The framework uses trilingual equivalent inputs as controlled probes for observing group-level cross-language policy drift. We conduct a pilot study on a real trilingual digital front-desk system deployed in the lobby of an international financial institution. The pilot uses a simplified single-foundation-model setting (MA = MB), so the observed drift should not be interpreted as an A/B foundation-model difference. The study contains 81 samples organized into 27 trilingual equivalent question groups. Although the system achieves an average score of 23.15/24, 14 groups show non-zero cross-language score drift, 5 groups show drift of at least 3 points, and the maximum drift reaches 9 points. These results provide initial evidence that failure-centered runtime evaluation can expose structured deployment signals hidden by aggregate scoring.

item.title: TCOD: Exploring Temporal Curriculum in On-Policy Distillation for Multi-turn Autonomous Agents
item.author: Jiaqi Wang, Wenhao Zhang, Weijie Shi, Yaliang Li, James Cheng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TCOD框架通过课程调度控制轨迹深度，缓解了多轮智能体设置中轨迹级KL不稳定性问题，提升了学生模型性能。

背景: On-policy distillation (OPD)在静态单轮任务中有效，但在多轮智能体设置中的行为尚未被充分探索。

目的: 识别并解决vanilla OPD在多轮智能体设置中的关键限制，即轨迹级KL不稳定性。

方法: 提出TCOD (Temporal Curriculum On-Policy Distillation)框架，通过课程调度从短到长逐步扩展暴露给学生的轨迹深度。

主要发现: TCOD缓解了KL的上升和训练不稳定性，在多个基准测试中相比vanilla OPD提升了高达18点性能；TCOD甚至能超越教师模型性能并在教师模型失败的特定任务上泛化。

结论: TCOD是一种简单有效的框架，通过控制轨迹深度暴露，显著改善了多轮智能体设置中的训练稳定性和最终性能。

翻译: On-policy distillation (OPD)在将推理能力从前沿或特定领域模型转移到较小的学生模型方面显示出强大潜力。虽然它在静态单轮任务中有效，但在多轮智能体设置中的行为尚未被充分探索。在这项工作中，我们识别了vanilla OPD在此类设置中的一个关键限制，我们称之为轨迹级KL不稳定性。具体来说，我们观察到KL散度随着成功率的下降而增加，并且即使在收敛后，KL仍然很高，导致训练不稳定。这种不稳定性源于回合间误差的累积：随着误差的积累，学生被推向教师的有效支持范围之外，使得监督信号不可靠。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了TCOD (Temporal Curriculum On-Policy Distillation)，这是一个简单而有效的框架，它控制暴露给学生的轨迹深度，并通过课程调度从短到长逐步扩展它。在三个多轮智能体基准测试(ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld)上对四个学生-教师对的实验结果表明，TCOD缓解了KL的上升，并提高了整个训练过程中的KL稳定性，相比vanilla OPD提高了高达18点的智能体性能。进一步的评估表明，TCOD甚至可以超越教师模型的性能，并在教师模型失败的特定任务上泛化。

Abstract

On-policy distillation (OPD) has shown strong potential for transferring reasoning ability from frontier or domain-specific models to smaller students. While effective on static single-turn tasks, its behavior in multi-turn agent settings remains underexplored. In this work, we identify a key limitation of vanilla OPD in such settings, which we term Trajectory-Level KL Instability. Specifically, we observe that KL divergence increases together with a drop in success rate, and even after convergence, the KL remains high, leading to unstable training. This instability arises from inter-turn error compounding: as errors accumulate, the student is driven beyond the teacher's effective support, rendering the supervision signal unreliable. To address this, we propose TCOD (Temporal Curriculum On-Policy Distillation), a simple yet effective framework that controls the trajectory depth exposed to the student and progressively expands it from short to long with a curriculum schedule. Experimental results across four student-teacher pairs on three multi-turn agent benchmarks (ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld) show that TCOD mitigates KL escalation and enhances KL stability throughout training, improving agent performance by up to 18 points over vanilla OPD. Further evaluations show that TCOD can even surpass the teacher's performance and generalize to tasks on which the teacher fails.

item.title: A Limit Theory of Foundation Models: A Mathematical Approach to Understanding Emergent Intelligence and Scaling Laws
item.author: Jun Shu, Junxiong Jia, Deyu Meng, Zongben Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究从极限理论的角度提出了一个数学框架来形式化涌现智能，通过引入性能函数和极限架构概念，揭示了智能涌现的必要条件和基础模型的缩放规律。

背景: 现有研究主要依赖经验观察来描述涌现智能现象，但缺乏严谨的理论框架。

目的: 开发一个数学方法，从极限理论视角形式化涌现智能，并推导其必要条件和缩放规律。

方法: 引入性能函数E(N,P,K)量化智能行为，将涌现智能视为极限$ext{lim}_{N,P,K o ext{infty}} ext{E}(N,P,K)$的存在；利用非线性Lipschitz算子理论证明极限架构存在的充要条件；利用Lipschitz算子和覆盖数工具推导基础模型的缩放规律。

主要发现: 1) 涌现智能由训练步数、数据大小和模型架构三个关键因素支配，基本块属性在构建基础模型中起关键作用；2) Lip(T)=1的条件为涌现智能提供了理论支持；3) 涌现智能由无限维系统决定，但可通过有限维架构有效实现。

结论: 理论结果与实证结果相互印证，验证了该数学框架的有效性。

翻译: 涌现智能在现代人工智能发展中发挥了重要作用。虽然现有研究主要依赖经验观察来描述这一现象，但严谨的理论框架仍未得到充分探索。本研究尝试从极限理论的角度开发一种数学方法来形式化涌现智能。具体而言，我们引入了一个依赖于数据大小N、模型大小P和训练步数K的性能函数E(N,P,K)，以量化智能行为。我们假设智能作为从有限知识到有效无限知识的转变而涌现，因此将涌现智能重新表述为极限$ext{lim}_{N,P,K o ext{infty}} ext{E}(N,P,K)$的存在，其中涌现能力对应于极限行为。这种极限理论有助于揭示涌现智能源于参数极限架构（称为极限架构）的存在，并且涌现智能合理地对应于该极限系统的学习行为。通过引入非线性Lipschitz算子理论工具，我们证明了极限架构存在的必要且充分条件。此外，我们利用Lipschitz算子和覆盖数工具推导了基础模型的缩放规律。理论结果表明：1) 涌现智能由三个关键因素支配——训练步数、数据大小和模型架构，其中基本块的属性在构建基础模型中起关键作用；2) 涌现智能的临界条件Lip(T)=1为现有发现提供了理论支持；3) 涌现智能由无限维系统决定，但在实践中可通过有限维架构有效实现。我们的实证结果证实了这些理论发现。

Abstract

Emergent intelligence have played a major role in the modern AI development. While existing studies primarily rely on empirical observations to characterize this phenomenon, a rigorous theoretical framework remains underexplored. This study attempts to develop a mathematical approach to formalize emergent intelligence from the perspective of limit theory. Specifically, we introduce a performance function E(N, P, K), dependent on data size N, model size P and training steps K, to quantify intelligence behavior. We posit that intelligence emerges as a transition from finite to effectively infinite knowledge, and thus recast emergent intelligence as existence of the limit $\lim_{N,P,K \to \infty} \mathcal{E}(N,P,K)$, with emergent abilities corresponding to the limiting behavior. This limit theory helps reveal that emergent intelligence originates from the existence of a parameter-limit architecture (referred to as the limit architecture), and that emergent intelligence rationally corresponds to the learning behavior of this limit system. By introducing tools from nonlinear Lipschitz operator theory, we prove that the necessary and sufficient conditions for existence of the limit architecture. Furthermore, we derive the scaling law of foundation models by leveraging tools of Lipschitz operator and covering number. Theoretical results show that: 1) emergent intelligence is governed by three key factors-training steps, data size and the model architecture, where the properties of basic blocks play a crucial role in constructing foundation models; 2) the critical condition Lip(T)=1 for emergent intelligence provides theoretical support for existing findings. 3) emergent intelligence is determined by an infinite-dimensional system, yet can be effectively realized in practice through a finite-dimensional architecture. Our empirical results corroborate these theoretical findings.

item.title: CLLAP: Contrastive Learning-based LiDAR-Augmented Pretraining for Enhanced Radar-Camera Fusion
item.author: Bingyi Liu, Chuanhui Zhu, Hongfei Xue, Jian Teng, Jipeng Liu, Enshu Wang, Penglin Dai, Pu Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CLLAP是一个基于对比学习的激光雷达增强预训练框架，通过生成伪雷达数据并采用双阶段、双模态对比学习策略，有效提升了现有雷达相机融合模型在3D目标检测中的性能。

背景: 自动驾驶中准确的3D目标检测至关重要，需要可靠且经济的传感器在恶劣天气下工作。相机和毫米波雷达融合是一个有前景的解决方案，但现有方法往往依赖精细标注的雷达数据，而这类数据稀缺且标注成本高昂。

目的: CLLAP旨在解决雷达数据稀缺和标注困难的问题，通过利用丰富的激光雷达数据来增强现有雷达相机融合方法在3D目标检测中的性能。

方法: CLLAP利用丰富的激光雷达数据，通过提出的L2R（LiDAR-to-Radar）采样方法生成伪雷达数据。随后，它将这些数据纳入一种新颖的双阶段、双模态对比学习策略中，实现从配对的伪雷达和图像数据中进行有效的自监督学习。该方法允许以即插即用的方式对现有的雷达相机融合模型进行有效预训练，增强其特征提取能力。

主要发现: 在NuScenes和Lyft Level 5数据集上使用三个基线模型进行的实验结果表明，CLLAP显著提高了检测性能，突显了其在推进自动驾驶雷达相机融合应用方面的有效性。

结论: CLLAP通过自监督学习和伪雷达数据生成，成功提升了雷达相机融合模型的特征提取能力和检测精度及鲁棒性，为自动驾驶应用提供了有效的解决方案。

翻译: CLLAP是一个基于对比学习的激光雷达增强预训练框架，通过生成伪雷达数据并采用双阶段、双模态对比学习策略，有效提升了现有雷达相机融合模型在3D目标检测中的性能。

Abstract

Accurate 3D object detection is critical for autonomous driving, necessitating reliable, cost-effective sensors capable of operating in adverse weather conditions. Camera and millimeter-wave radar fusion has emerged as a promising solution; however, these methods often rely on finely annotated radar data, which is scarce and labor-intensive to produce. To address this challenge, we present CLLAP, a Contrastive Learning-based LiDAR-Augmented Pretraining framework that enhances the performance of existing radar-camera fusion methods for 3D object detection. CLLAP leverages abundant LiDAR data to generate pseudo-radar data using the proposed L2R (LiDAR-to-Radar) Sampling method. Then, it incorporates this data into a novel dual-stage, dual-modality contrastive learning strategy, enabling effective self-supervised learning from paired pseudo-radar and image data. This approach facilitates effective pretraining of existing radar-camera fusion models in a plug-and-play manner, enhancing their feature extraction capabilities and improving detection accuracy and robustness. Experimental results using NuScenes and Lyft Level 5 datasets demonstrate significant performance improvements across three baseline models, highlighting CLLAP's effectiveness in advancing radar-camera fusion for autonomous driving applications.

item.title: Jailbreaking Frontier Foundation Models Through Intention Deception
item.author: Xinhe Wang, Katia Sycara, Yaqi Xie
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种针对多轮对话的新型越狱方法，该方法利用模型的一致性属性，通过逐步建立对话信任来诱导模型生成有害输出，并发现了一种名为‘旁路越狱’的模型脆弱性。

背景: 现有的安全训练方法基于二元训练机制，将用户意图分为安全和不安全两类，这种方法容易导致模型脆弱且显得无益。前沿模型如GPT-5已转向安全补全，但这种方法可能被用户伪装良性意图所利用。

目的: 介绍一种新的多轮越狱方法，以利用模型在多轮对话中的脆弱性，并揭示一种被称为‘旁路越狱’的模型脆弱性。

方法: 通过模拟良性意图逐步建立对话信任，并利用模型的一致性属性，最终引导目标模型生成有害且详细的输出。

主要发现: 发现了一种新的‘旁路越狱’漏洞，即模型可能不会直接回答有害查询，但透露的信息仍然是有害的；该方法在包括GPT-5-thinking和Claude-Sonnet-4.5在内的前沿模型上取得了高成功率；在多模态VLM模型上表现优于现有最佳模型。

结论: 该方法成功揭示了模型在多轮对话中的脆弱性，并解决了‘旁路越狱’产生的有害输出问题，证明了其在多模态模型上的优越性。

翻译: Large (vision-)language models exhibit remarkable capability but remain highly susceptible to jailbreaking. Existing safety training approaches aim to have the model learn a refusal boundary between safe and unsafe, based on the user's intent. It has been found that this binary training regime often leads to brittleness, since the user intent cannot reliably be evaluated, especially if the attacker obfuscates their intent, and also makes the system seem unhelpful. In response, frontier models, such as GPT-5, have shifted from refusal-based safeguards to safe completion, that aims to maximize helpfulness while obeying safety constraints. However, safe completion could be exploited when a user pretends their intention is benign. Specifically, this intent inversion would be effective in multi-turn conversation, where the attacker has multiple opportunities to reinforce their deceptively benign intent. In this work, we introduce a novel multi-turn jailbreaking method that exploits this vulnerability. Our approach gradually builds conversational trust by simulating benign-seeming intentions and by exploiting the consistency property of the model, ultimately guiding the target model toward harmful, detailed outputs. Most crucially, our approach also uncovered an additional class of model vulnerability that we call para-jailbreaking that has been unnoticed up to now. Para-jailbreaking describes the situation where the model may not reveal harmful direct reply to the attack query, however the information that it reveals is nevertheless harmful. Our contributions are threefold. First, it achieves high success rates against frontier models including GPT-5-thinking and Claude-Sonnet-4.5. Second, our approach revealed and addressed para-jailbreaking harmful output. Third, experiments on multimodal VLM models showed that our approach outperformed state-of-the-art models.

Abstract

Large (vision-)language models exhibit remarkable capability but remain highly susceptible to jailbreaking. Existing safety training approaches aim to have the model learn a refusal boundary between safe and unsafe, based on the user's intent. It has been found that this binary training regime often leads to brittleness, since the user intent cannot reliably be evaluated, especially if the attacker obfuscates their intent, and also makes the system seem unhelpful. In response, frontier models, such as GPT-5, have shifted from refusal-based safeguards to safe completion, that aims to maximize helpfulness while obeying safety constraints. However, safe completion could be exploited when a user pretends their intention is benign. Specifically, this intent inversion would be effective in multi-turn conversation, where the attacker has multiple opportunities to reinforce their deceptively benign intent. In this work, we introduce a novel multi-turn jailbreaking method that exploits this vulnerability. Our approach gradually builds conversational trust by simulating benign-seeming intentions and by exploiting the consistency property of the model, ultimately guiding the target model toward harmful, detailed outputs. Most crucially, our approach also uncovered an additional class of model vulnerability that we call para-jailbreaking that has been unnoticed up to now. Para-jailbreaking describes the situation where the model may not reveal harmful direct reply to the attack query, however the information that it reveals is nevertheless harmful. Our contributions are threefold. First, it achieves high success rates against frontier models including GPT-5-thinking and Claude-Sonnet-4.5. Second, our approach revealed and addressed para-jailbreaking harmful output. Third, experiments on multimodal VLM models showed that our approach outperformed state-of-the-art models.

item.title: AsyncShield: A Plug-and-Play Edge Adapter for Asynchronous Cloud-based VLA Navigation
item.author: Kai Yang, Zedong Chu, Yingnan Guo, Zhengbo Wang, Shichao Xie, Yanfen Shen, Xiaolong Wu, Xing Li, Mu Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AsyncShield是一个轻量级、即插即用的异步控制框架，旨在解决VLA模型在移动导航中因云部署导致的时空错位问题。

背景: Vision-Language-Action (VLA)模型虽然具备强大的零样本泛化能力，但其庞大的参数量通常需要云端部署。云端部署会引入网络抖动和推理延迟，导致在连续位移下的移动导航中产生严重的时空错位，使过去自我坐标系中表达的动作意图在当前坐标系中变得空间不正确，从而引发碰撞。

目的: 提出AsyncShield框架，以解决云端部署导致的时空错位问题，在保持VLA模型原始几何意图的同时确保物理安全。

方法: AsyncShield摒弃了传统的黑盒时间序列预测，采用确定性的物理白盒空间映射。系统通过维护时间姿态缓冲区并利用运动学变换，将时间滞后准确转换为空间姿态偏移以恢复VLA的原始几何意图。为了平衡意图恢复的保真度和物理安全，边缘适配被制定为受限马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），通过PPO-Lagrangian算法求解。该框架利用标准化的通用子目标接口、域随机化和感知层面的碰撞半径膨胀，作为轻量级即插即用模块运行。

主要发现: 在仿真和现实世界的实验中，该框架在不微调任何基于云的基础模型的情况下，表现出零样本和鲁棒的泛化能力，有效提高了异步导航的成功率和物理安全性。

结论: AsyncShield证明了其作为轻量级即插即用模块的可行性，能够在不改变云端模型的情况下，显著提升移动导航系统的安全性和成功率。

翻译: 虽然视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已被证明在机器人控制方面具有强大的零样本泛化能力，但其巨大的参数量通常需要基于云的部署。然而，云部署引入了网络抖动和推理延迟，这可以在连续位移下的移动导航中诱导严重的时空错位，使得过去自我帧中表达的动作意图在当前帧中可能变得空间不正确，从而导致碰撞。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了AsyncShield，一个即插即用的异步控制框架。AsyncShield摒弃了传统的黑盒时间序列预测，转而采用确定性的物理白盒空间映射。通过维护时间姿态缓冲区并利用运动学变换，系统将时间滞后准确转换为空间姿态偏移，以恢复VLA的原始几何意图。为了平衡意图恢复保真度和物理安全，边缘适配被制定为受限马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）。通过PPO-Lagrangian算法求解，强化学习适配器在跟踪VLA意图和响应高频激光雷达避障硬约束之间动态权衡。此外，得益于标准化的通用子目标接口、域随机化和通过碰撞半径膨胀进行的感知级适配，AsyncShield作为一个轻量级即插即用模块运行。仿真和现实世界的实验表明，在不微调任何基于云的基础模型的情况下，该框架表现出零样本和鲁棒的泛化能力，有效提高了异步导航的成功率和物理安全性。

Abstract

While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have been demonstrated possessing strong zero-shot generalization for robot control, their massive parameter sizes typically necessitate cloud-based deployment. However, cloud deployment introduces network jitter and inference latency, which can induce severe spatiotemporal misalignment in mobile navigation under continuous displacement, so that the stale intents expressed in past ego frames may become spatially incorrect in the current frame and lead to collisions. To address this issue, we propose AsyncShield, a plug-and-play asynchronous control framework. AsyncShield discards traditional black-box time-series prediction in favor of a deterministic physical white-box spatial mapping. By maintaining a temporal pose buffer and utilizing kinematic transformations, the system accurately converts temporal lag into spatial pose offsets to restore the VLA's original geometric intent. To balance intent restoration fidelity and physical safety, the edge adaptation is formulated as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP). Solved via the PPO-Lagrangian algorithm, a reinforcement learning adapter dynamically trades off between tracking the VLA intent and responding to high-frequency LiDAR obstacle avoidance hard constraints. Furthermore, benefiting from a standardized universal sub-goal interface, domain randomization, and perception-level adaptation via Collision Radius Inflation, AsyncShield operates as a lightweight, plug-and-play module. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that, without fine-tuning any cloud-based foundation models, the framework exhibits zero-shot and robust generalization capabilities, effectively improving the success rate and physical safety of asynchronous navigation.

item.title: SemiSAM-O1: How far can we push the boundary of annotation-efficient medical image segmentation?
item.author: Yichi Zhang, Le Xue, Bichun Xu, Judong Luo, Zhigang Wu, Yu Fu, Zixin Hu, Yuan Cheng, Yuan Qi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SemiSAM-O1是一个仅使用一个标注模板图像的标注高效框架，通过两阶段流程在复杂医学图像模态中实现分割。

背景: 深度学习医学图像分割模型面临标注负担，尽管基础模型驱动的半监督学习在极少标注场景下取得了进展，但在复杂成像模态中仍难以保持稳健的竞争性能。

目的: 提出SemiSAM-O1框架，旨在在仅使用一个标注模板图像的情况下，实现高效的医学图像分割，缩小单标签半监督学习与全监督之间的性能差距。

方法: SemiSAM-O1采用两阶段流程：第一阶段利用基础模型编码器提取特征，通过特征相似性传播类原型以生成粗略初始伪标签；第二阶段通过迭代训练和细化循环逐步改进分割模型和伪标签，利用不确定性引导细化步骤通过聚合相似邻居的标签来修正高不确定性区域。

主要发现: 在多种模态和解剖目标的广泛分割任务实验中，SemiSAM-O1显著缩小了单标签半监督学习与全监督之间的性能差距，同时显著降低了在线基础模型推理的计算开销。

结论: SemiSAM-O1框架在仅使用一个标注模板的情况下，能够有效提升医学图像分割性能，并减少计算负担。

翻译: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) has become a promising solution to alleviate the annotation burden of deep learning-based medical image segmentation models. While recent advances in foundation model-driven SSL have pushed the boundary to extremely limited annotation scenarios, they fail to maintain robust competitive performance in complex imaging modalities. In this paper, we propose SemiSAM-O1, an annotation-efficient framework using only one annotated template image for segmentation. SemiSAM-O1 extends the specialist-generalist collaborative learning framework to the extreme one-label setting by fully exploiting the foundation model's feature representation capability beyond its prompting interface. SemiSAM-O1 operates in two stages. In the first stage, the foundation model's encoder extracts dense features from all volumes, and class prototypes derived from the single annotated template are propagated to the unlabeled pool via feature similarity to produce coarse initial pseudo-labels. In the second stage, an iterative training-and-refinement loop progressively improves both the segmentation model and the pseudo-labels over multiple rounds, where each round trains the model from scratch on current pseudo-labels and generates updated predictions with voxel-wise uncertainty estimates. An uncertainty-guided refinement step further leverages the foundation model's global feature space to correct high-uncertainty regions by aggregating labels from their most similar confident neighbors, establishing a virtuous cycle of mutual improvement. Extensive experiments on a wide range of segmentation tasks across different modalities and anatomical targets demonstrate that SemiSAM-O1 significantly narrows the performance gap between one-label semi-supervised learning and full supervision, while significantly reducing the computational overhead of online foundation model inference.

Abstract

Semi-supervised learning (SSL) has become a promising solution to alleviate the annotation burden of deep learning-based medical image segmentation models. While recent advances in foundation model-driven SSL have pushed the boundary to extremely limited annotation scenarios, they fail to maintain robust competitive performance in complex imaging modalities. In this paper, we propose SemiSAM-O1, an annotation-efficient framework using only one annotated template image for segmentation. SemiSAM-O1 extends the specialist-generalist collaborative learning framework to the extreme one-label setting by fully exploiting the foundation model's feature representation capability beyond its prompting interface. SemiSAM-O1 operates in two stages. In the first stage, the foundation model's encoder extracts dense features from all volumes, and class prototypes derived from the single annotated template are propagated to the unlabeled pool via feature similarity to produce coarse initial pseudo-labels. In the second stage, an iterative training-and-refinement loop progressively improves both the segmentation model and the pseudo-labels over multiple rounds, where each round trains the model from scratch on current pseudo-labels and generates updated predictions with voxel-wise uncertainty estimates. An uncertainty-guided refinement step further leverages the foundation model's global feature space to correct high-uncertainty regions by aggregating labels from their most similar confident neighbors, establishing a virtuous cycle of mutual improvement. Extensive experiments on a wide range of segmentation tasks across different modalities and anatomical targets demonstrate that SemiSAM-O1 significantly narrows the performance gap between one-label semi-supervised learning and full supervision, while significantly reducing the computational overhead of online foundation model inference.

item.title: EXACT: an explainable anomaly-aware vision foundation model for analysis of 3D chest CT
item.author: Xuguang Bai, Mingxuan Liu, Tongxi Song, Yifei Chen, Hongjia Yang, Kasidit Anmahapong, Zihan Li, Ying Zhou, Qiyuan Tian
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: EXACT是一个可解释的异常感知基础模型，用于三维胸部CT，通过解剖学感知的弱监督学习从配对的临床扫描和放射学报告中学习空间解析表示。

背景: 胸部CT在检测和管理胸部疾病中至关重要，但体积成像的规模和复杂性日益增加，仅靠扫描级预测已不足以应对。临床有用的AI不仅需要识别整个体积内的疾病，还需要定位异常并提供可解释的视觉证据。现有的视觉语言基础模型通常将扫描和报告压缩为全局图像文本表示，限制了它们保留空间证据和支持临床有意义解释的能力。

目的: 开发EXACT，一个可解释的异常感知基础模型，用于三维胸部CT，从配对的临床扫描和放射学报告中学习空间解析表示。

方法: EXACT在25,692对CT-报告对上进行了预训练，使用解剖学感知的弱监督，联合学习器官分割和多实例异常定位，无需手动体素级注释。

主要发现: EXACT生成了器官特定的异常感知图，为每个体素分配疾病特定的异常分数，限制在其对应的解剖结构内，同时编码病变范围和器官级上下文。在回顾性多国和多中心评估中，EXACT在相关的CT任务（包括多疾病诊断、零样本异常定位、下游适应和视觉基础报告生成）中表现出广泛且一致的改进，优于现有的三维医学基础模型。

结论: 通过将常规临床CT扫描和自由文本报告转换为可解释的体素级表示，EXACT为可信的体积医学AI建立了一个可扩展的范式。

翻译: 胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）是检测和管理胸部疾病的核心，但体积成像的规模和复杂性日益增加，仅靠扫描级预测已不足以应对。临床有用的AI不仅需要识别整个体积内的疾病，还需要定位异常并提供可解释的视觉证据。现有的视觉语言基础模型通常将扫描和报告压缩为全局图像文本表示，限制了它们保留空间证据和支持临床有意义解释的能力。在这里，我们开发了EXACT，一个用于三维胸部CT的可解释异常感知基础模型，从配对的临床扫描和放射学报告中学习空间解析表示。EXACT在25,692对CT-报告对上进行了预训练，使用解剖学感知的弱监督，联合学习器官分割和多实例异常定位，无需手动体素级注释。由此产生的器官特定的异常感知图将每个体素分配疾病特定的异常分数，限制在其对应的解剖结构内，同时编码病变范围和器官级上下文。在回顾性多国和多中心评估中，EXACT在相关的CT任务中表现出广泛且一致的改进，包括多疾病诊断、零样本异常定位、下游适应和视觉基础报告生成，优于现有的三维医学基础模型。通过将常规临床CT扫描和自由文本报告转换为可解释的体素级表示，EXACT为可信的体积医学AI建立了一个可扩展的范式。

Abstract

Chest computed tomography (CT) is central to the detection and management of thoracic disease, yet the growing scale and complexity of volumetric imaging increasingly exceed what can be addressed by scan-level prediction alone. Clinically useful AI for CT must not only recognize disease across the whole volume, but also localize abnormalities and provide interpretable visual evidence. Existing vision-language foundation models typically compress scans and reports into global image-text representations, limiting their ability to preserve spatial evidence and support clinically meaningful interpretation. Here we developed EXACT, an explainable anomaly-aware foundation model for three-dimensional chest CT that learns spatially resolved representations from paired clinical scans and radiology reports. EXACT was pre-trained on 25,692 CT-reports pairs using anatomy-aware weak supervision, jointly learning organ segmentation and multi-instance anomaly localization without manual voxel-level annotations. The resulting organ-specific anomaly-aware maps assign each voxel a disease-specific anomaly score confined to its corresponding anatomy, jointly encoding lesion extent and organ-level context. In retrospective multinational and multi-center evaluations, EXACT showed broad and consistent improvements across clinically relevant CT tasks, spanning multi-disease diagnosis, zero-shot anomaly localization, downstream adaptation, and visually grounded report generation, outperforming existing three-dimensional medical foundation models. By transforming routine clinical CT scans and free-text reports into explainable voxel-level representations, EXACT establishes a scalable paradigm for trustworthy volumetric medical AI.

item.title: Progressive Approximation in Deep Residual Networks: Theory and Validation
item.author: Wei Wang, Xiao-Yong Wei, Qing Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究重新构建了残差网络为逐层近似过程，提出了层级渐进近似（LPA）训练原则，证明了残差网络可按深度顺序逐步细化而非端到端映射，并实现了单次训练多深度部署。

背景: 通用近似定理（UAT）虽然保证了函数的通用近似能力，但未解释残差模型如何在各层间分配近似能力。

目的: 重新构建残差网络为逐层近似过程，提出层级渐进近似（LPA）训练原则，以实现单次训练多深度部署。

方法: 将残差网络重新构建为逐层近似过程，提出层级渐进近似（LPA）训练原则，该原则明确将每一层与其残差目标对齐。

主要发现: 残差网络能够实现结构化的逐步细化而非端到端的黑盒映射；LPA在残差前馈神经网络、ResNets和Transformer中均观察到渐进行为；单个网络可在任意深度提供有用预测，支持高效浅层推理。

结论: 该工作统一了近似理论与实用深度学习，为表示学习提供了新视角，并为多深度部署提供了灵活框架。

翻译: The Universal Approximation Theorem (UAT) guarantees universal function approximation but does not explain how residual models distribute approximation across layers. We reframe residual networks as a layer-wise approximation process that builds an approximation trajectory from input to target, and prove the existence of progressive trajectories where error decreases monotonically with depth. It reveals that residual networks can implement structured, step-by-step refinement rather than end-to-end (E2E) black-box mapping. Building on this, we propose Layer-wise Progressive Approximation (LPA), a theoretically grounded training principle that explicitly aligns each layer with its residual target to realize such trajectories. LPA is architecture-agnostic: we observe progressive behavior in residual FNNs, ResNets, and Transformers across tasks including complex surface fitting, image classification, and NLP with LLMs for generation and classification. Crucially, this enables "train once, use N models": a single network yields useful predictions at every depth, supporting efficient shallow inference without retraining. Our work unifies approximation theory with practical deep learning, providing a new lens on representation learning and a flexible framework for multi-depth deployment. The source code will be released unpon acceptance at https://(open_upon_acceptance).

Abstract

The Universal Approximation Theorem (UAT) guarantees universal function approximation but does not explain how residual models distribute approximation across layers. We reframe residual networks as a layer-wise approximation process that builds an approximation trajectory from input to target, and prove the existence of progressive trajectories where error decreases monotonically with depth. It reveals that residual networks can implement structured, step-by-step refinement rather than end-to-end (E2E) black-box mapping. Building on this, we propose Layer-wise Progressive Approximation (LPA), a theoretically grounded training principle that explicitly aligns each layer with its residual target to realize such trajectories. LPA is architecture-agnostic: we observe progressive behavior in residual FNNs, ResNets, and Transformers across tasks including complex surface fitting, image classification, and NLP with LLMs for generation and classification. Crucially, this enables ``train once, use $N$ models": a single network yields useful predictions at every depth, supporting efficient shallow inference without retraining. Our work unifies approximation theory with practical deep learning, providing a new lens on representation learning and a flexible framework for multi-depth deployment. The source code will be released unpon acceptance at https://(open\_upon\_acceptance).

item.title: Robust Deepfake Detection, NTIRE 2026 Challenge: Report
item.author: Benedikt Hopf, Radu Timofte, Chenfan Qu, Junchi Li, Fei Wu, Dagong Lu, Mufeng Yao, Xinlei Xu, Fengjun Guo, Yongwei Tang, Zhiqiang Yang, Zhiqiang Wu, Jia Wen Seow, Hong Vin Koay, Haodong Ren, Feng Xu, Shuai Chen, Minh-Khoa Le-Phan, Minh-Hoang Le, Trong-Le Do, Minh-Triet Tran, Chih-Yu Jian, Yi-Fan Wang, Bang-Kang Chen, You-Chen Chao, Chia-Ming Lee, Fu-En Yang, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Chih-Chung Hsu, Aashish Negi, Hardik Sharma, Prateek Shaily, Jayant Kumar, Sachin Chaudhary, Akshay Dudhane, Praful Hambarde, Amit Shukla, Jielun Peng, Yabin Wang, Yaqi Li, Jincheng Liu, Xiaopeng Hong, Krish Wadhwani, Liam Fitzpatrick, Utkarsh Tiwari, Bilel Benjdira, Anas M. Ali, Wadii Boulila, Cristian Lazo Quispe, Aishwarya A, Akshara S, Ashwathi N, Jiachen Tu, Guoyi Xu, Yaoxin Jiang, Jiajia Liu, Yaokun Shi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该摘要介绍了NTIRE 2026鲁棒深度伪造检测挑战赛，旨在解决深度伪造检测在面对图像退化时的鲁棒性问题。

背景: 深度伪造检测在现实世界中表现不佳，因为检测器容易受到图像退化（包括处理管道中意外发生的弱退化或恶意深度伪造故意引入的退化）的影响。

目的: 介绍NTIRE 2026鲁棒深度伪造检测挑战赛，旨在构建能够应对各种强度和类型（包括常见和不常见）图像退化的检测器。

方法: 参赛者被要求构建检测器，并在没有标签的情况下在未知测试集上进行测试。为确保结果的可靠性，参赛者仅有24小时完成测试运行，且顶级解决方案在私有测试集上进行评分以检测过拟合。

主要发现: 共有337名参与者提交了57个最终排行榜提交，该挑战赛反响良好。顶级解决方案依赖于大型基础模型、集成方法和退化训练，以结合通用性和鲁棒性。

结论: 该挑战赛成功解决了深度伪造检测在图像退化下的鲁棒性问题，顶级方法通过结合大型基础模型、集成和退化训练实现了良好的效果。

翻译: 摘要：鲁棒性是深度伪造检测中被长期忽视的问题。然而，如果检测器在遭受轻微图像退化时表现不佳，那么其在现实世界中的检测性能几乎毫无价值。除了处理管道中可能意外发生的弱退化外，还存在另一种恶意深度伪造故意引入退化的风险，专门利用检测器在此方面的弱点。在这里，我们介绍了NTIRE 2026鲁棒深度伪造检测挑战赛的概述，该挑战赛专门解决了这个问题。参与者被要求构建检测器，该检测器将在包含各种强度常见和不常见退化的未知测试集上进行测试。共有337名参与者提交了57个最终排行榜提交，第一届挑战赛反响良好。为确保结果的可靠性，参与者仅有24小时完成测试运行且未提供标签，限制了在测试数据上训练的可能性。此外，顶级解决方案在私有测试集上进行评分以检测任何此类过拟合。本报告介绍了竞赛设置、数据集准备以及方法的详细信息和性能。顶级方法依赖于大型基础模型、集成和退化训练，以结合通用性和鲁棒性。

Abstract

Robustness is a long-overlooked problem in deepfake detection. However, detection performance is nearly worthless in the real world if it suffers under exposure to even slight image degradation. In addition to weaker degradations that can accidentally occur in the image processing pipeline, there is another risk of malicious deepfakes that specifically introduce degradations, purposefully exploiting the detector's weaknesses in that regard. Here, we present an overview of the NTIRE 2026 Robust Deepfake Detection Challenge, which specifically addresses that problem. Participants were tasked with building a detector that would later be tested on an unknown test-set, which included both common and uncommon degradations of various strengths. With a total number of 337 participants and 57 submissions to the final leaderboard, the first edition of the challenge was well received. To ensure the reliability of the results, participants were given only 24h to complete the test run with no labels provided, limiting the possibility of training on the test data. Furthermore, the top solutions were scored on a private test-set to detect any such overfitting. This report presents the competition setting, dataset preparation, as well as details and performance of methods. Top methods rely on large foundation models, ensembles, and degradation training to combine generality and robustness.

item.title: PointTransformerX:Portable and Efficient 3D Point Cloud Processing without Sparse Algorithms
item.author: Laurenz Reichardt, Nikolas Ebert, Oliver Wasenmüller
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了PointTransformerX (PTX)，这是一个完全基于PyTorch的3D点云感知模型，移除了所有自定义CUDA算子和外部库，同时保持了竞争力。PTX引入了3D-GS-RoPE旋转位置嵌入来编码3D空间关系，并用线性投影替换了稀疏卷积补丁嵌入。PTX探索了注意力窗口的推理时间缩放以提高精度，并重新设计了前馈网络。PTX在ScanNet数据集上实现了PointTransformer V3 98.7%的精度，参数减少了79.2%，速度提高了1.6倍，内存占用仅253 MB。PTX可以在NVIDIA、AMD GPU和CPU上原生运行。

背景: 3D点云感知严重依赖于自定义CUDA算子进行空间操作，限制了在非NVIDIA、AMD和嵌入式硬件上的可移植性和效率。

目的: 引入PointTransformerX (PTX)，一个完全基于PyTorch的3D点云视觉Transformer骨干网络，以移除所有自定义CUDA算子和外部库，同时保持竞争力。

方法: PTX引入了3D-GS-RoPE旋转位置嵌入，直接在自注意力中编码3D空间关系而不需要构建邻域；用线性投影替换了稀疏卷积补丁嵌入；探索了注意力窗口的推理时间缩放；重新设计了前馈网络。

主要发现: PTX在ScanNet上实现了PointTransformer V3 98.7%的精度，参数减少了79.2%，速度提高了1.6倍，内存占用仅253 MB。

结论: PTX可以在NVIDIA、AMD GPU和CPU上原生运行，为点云感知提供了一个高效且可移植的解决方案。

翻译: 3D点云感知仍然与用于空间操作的自定义CUDA算子紧密耦合，限制了在非NVIDIA、AMD和嵌入式硬件上的可移植性和效率。我们介绍了PointTransformerX (PTX)，这是一个完全基于PyTorch的3D点云视觉Transformer骨干网络，移除了所有自定义CUDA算子和外部库，同时保持了竞争力。PTX引入了3D-GS-RoPE，这是一种旋转位置嵌入，直接在自注意力中编码3D空间关系而不需要构建邻域，并进一步用线性投影替换了稀疏卷积补丁嵌入。PTX探索了注意力窗口的推理时间缩放以提高精度而不需要重新训练。通过重新设计前馈网络，PTX在ScanNet上实现了PointTransformer V3 98.7%的精度，参数减少了79.2%，速度提高了1.6倍，且仅需要253 MB内存。PTX可以在NVIDIA GPU、AMD GPU (ROCm)和CPU上原生运行，为点云感知提供了一个高效且可移植的基础。

Abstract

3D point cloud perception remains tightly coupled to custom CUDA operators for spatial operations, limiting portability and efficiency on non-NVIDIA, AMD, and embedded hardware. We introduce PointTransformerX (PTX), a fully PyTorch-native vision transformer backbone for 3D point clouds, removing all custom CUDA operators and external libraries while retaining competitive accuracy. PTX introduces 3D-GS-RoPE, a rotary positional embedding that encodes 3D spatial relationships directly in self-attention without neighborhood construction, and further replaces sparse convolutional patch embedding with a linear projection. PTX explores inference-time scaling of attention windows to improve accuracy without retraining. With a redesigned feed-forward network, PTX achieves 98.7\% of PointTransformer V3's accuracy on ScanNet with 79.2\% fewer parameters and executing 1.6\times faster while requiring just 253 MB memory. PTX runs natively on NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs (ROCm), and CPUs, providing an efficient and portable foundation for point cloud perception.

item.title: ReVSI: Rebuilding Visual Spatial Intelligence Evaluation for Accurate Assessment of VLM 3D Reasoning
item.author: Yiming Zhang, Jiacheng Chen, Jiaqi Tan, Yongsen Mao, Wenhu Chen, Angel X. Chang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ReVSI是一个新的基准测试和协议，旨在解决现代视觉语言模型在评估空间智能时存在的系统性无效问题，通过重新标注和生成问答对来确保评估的有效性和可控性。

背景: 当前的评估方法在现代视觉语言模型设置下存在系统性无效。首先，许多基准测试从基于点云的3D注释中衍生问答对，这些注释原本是为传统3D感知设计的。当这些注释被用作基于视频的评估的ground truth时，重建和注释伪影可能会遗漏视频中明显可见的对象，错误标记对象身份，或破坏依赖于几何形状的答案（例如大小），从而产生不正确或模棱两可的问答对。其次，评估通常假设可以访问整个场景，而许多视觉语言模型操作于稀疏采样的帧（例如16-64帧），使得许多问题在实际模型输入下实际上无法回答。

目的: 提高评估的有效性，通过引入ReVSI基准测试和协议，确保每个问答对在模型的实际输入下都是可回答且正确的。

方法: 从5个数据集中重新标注381个场景中的对象和几何形状以提高数据质量，并使用专业3D标注工具和严格偏见缓解及人工验证重新生成所有问答对。此外，通过提供多种帧预算（16/32/64/全部）和细粒度的对象可见性元数据来增强评估的可控性。

主要发现: 在ReVSI上对通用和特定领域的视觉语言模型的评估揭示了先前基准测试中掩盖的系统故障模式，从而提供了对空间智能更可靠和诊断性的评估。

结论: ReVSI提供了一种更可靠和诊断性的空间智能评估方法，能够揭示先前基准测试中未发现的系统性故障模式。

翻译: 在当前的视觉语言模型设置下，空间智能的评估可能存在系统性无效。首先，许多基准测试从基于点云的3D注释中衍生问答对，这些注释原本是为传统3D感知设计的。当这些注释被用作基于视频的评估的ground truth时，重建和注释伪影可能会遗漏视频中明显可见的对象，错误标记对象身份，或破坏依赖于几何形状的答案（例如大小），从而产生不正确或模棱两可的问答对。其次，评估通常假设可以访问整个场景，而许多视觉语言模型操作于稀疏采样的帧（例如16-64帧），使得许多问题在实际模型输入下实际上无法回答。我们通过引入ReVSI基准测试和协议来提高评估的有效性，确保每个问答对在模型的实际输入下都是可回答且正确的。为此，我们从5个数据集中重新标注了381个场景中的对象和几何形状以提高数据质量，并使用专业3D标注工具和严格偏见缓解及人工验证重新生成所有问答对。此外，通过提供多种帧预算（16/32/64/全部）和细粒度的对象可见性元数据来增强评估的可控性。在ReVSI上对通用和特定领域的视觉语言模型的评估揭示了先前基准测试中掩盖的系统故障模式，从而提供了对空间智能更可靠和诊断性的评估。

Abstract

Current evaluations of spatial intelligence can be systematically invalid under modern vision-language model (VLM) settings. First, many benchmarks derive question-answer (QA) pairs from point-cloud-based 3D annotations originally curated for traditional 3D perception. When such annotations are treated as ground truth for video-based evaluation, reconstruction and annotation artifacts can miss objects that are clearly visible in the video, mislabel object identities, or corrupt geometry-dependent answers (e.g., size), yielding incorrect or ambiguous QA pairs. Second, evaluations often assume full-scene access, while many VLMs operate on sparsely sampled frames (e.g., 16-64), making many questions effectively unanswerable under the actual model inputs. We improve evaluation validity by introducing ReVSI, a benchmark and protocol that ensures each QA pair is answerable and correct under the model's actual inputs. To this end, we re-annotate objects and geometry across 381 scenes from 5 datasets to improve data quality, and regenerate all QA pairs with rigorous bias mitigation and human verification using professional 3D annotation tools. We further enhance evaluation controllability by providing variants across multiple frame budgets (16/32/64/all) and fine-grained object visibility metadata, enabling controlled diagnostic analyses. Evaluations of general and domain-specific VLMs on ReVSI reveal systematic failure modes that are obscured by prior benchmarks, yielding a more reliable and diagnostic assessment of spatial intelligence.

item.title: BIMStruct3D: A Fully Automated Hybrid Learning Scan-to-BIM Pipeline with Integrated Topology Refinement
item.author: Mahdi Chamseddine, Fabian Kaufmann, Marius Schellen, Christian Glock, Didier Stricker, Jason Rambach
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于从3D点云生成符合IFC标准的建筑信息模型（BIM）的模块化流程。

背景: 从建筑扫描自动生成建筑信息模型（BIM）是建筑和施工领域的一个关键挑战。

目的: 开发一种混合方法，结合基于学习的语义分割和拓扑感知的几何重建来准确建模结构元素。

方法: 提出了vIoU，这是一种基于体素的重叠评估方法，通过实现重建模型与真实模型的整体、无实例匹配的比较来适应Scan-to-BIM任务。

主要发现: 在DeKH和CV4AEC数据集上的实验显示，相比基于RANSAC的基线方法，该方法取得了显著改进，并展示了鲁棒性和可扩展性。

结论: 该方法能够有效地从3D点云生成高质量的BIM模型。

翻译: 从建筑扫描自动生成建筑信息模型（BIM）是建筑和施工领域的一个关键挑战。我们提出了一种用于从3D点云生成符合IFC标准的建筑信息模型（BIM）的模块化流程。该混合方法结合了基于学习的语义分割和拓扑感知的几何重建，以准确建模结构元素。我们提出了vIoU，通过适应基于体素的重叠评估来适应Scan-to-BIM任务，实现了重建模型与真实模型的整体、无实例匹配的比较。我们发布了德国医院数据集（DeKH），包括高分辨率点云、真实BIM和语义标注。在DeKH和CV4AEC数据集上的实验显示，相比基于RANSAC的基线方法，该方法取得了显著改进，并展示了鲁棒性和可扩展性。

Abstract

Automatic generation of Building Information Models (BIM) from building scans is a key challenge in architecture and construction. We present a modular pipeline for generating IFC-compliant BIM from 3D point clouds. The hybrid approach combines learning-based semantic segmentation with topology-aware geometric reconstruction to model structural elements accurately. We propose vIoU, adapting voxel-based overlap evaluation to Scan-to-BIM by enabling holistic, instance-matching-free comparison of reconstructed and ground-truth models. We release the German Hospital dataset (DeKH), including high-resolution point clouds, ground truth BIMs, and semantic annotations. Experiments on DeKH and CV4AEC datasets show significant improvements over a RANSAC-based baseline, demonstrating robustness and scalability.

item.title: Multispectral airborne laser scanning dataset for tree species classification: MS-ALS-SPECIES
item.author: Matti Hyyppä, Klaara Salolahti, Eric Hyyppä, Xiaowei Yu, Josef Taher, Leena Matikainen, Matti Lehtomäki, Paula Litkey, Teemu Hakala, Harri Kaartinen, Juha Hyyppä, Antero Kukko
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究介绍了一个用于树木分类的开放式多光谱机载激光扫描数据集，该数据集包含来自芬兰南部九个物种的6326个单木点云数据，并详细描述了用于高效收集高质量地面真值数据的技术。

背景: 从单木级别进行森林评估支持了生物多样性制图，特别是在作为关键物种的桦木等北方生态系统。虽然机载激光扫描是标准方法，但公开的高质量、经过实地验证的ALS数据集很少，且缺乏带有高质量实地参考数据的开放式多光谱ALS数据集。

目的: 展示并详细说明了一个用于树木分类机器学习和深度学习方法国际基准研究的数据集，并基于Taher等人(2026)的初步发现，利用多光谱数据进行了新的分析，研究了分类精度与树高的关系。

方法: 数据集包含两个多光谱激光扫描系统获取的点云数据：一个直升机载系统(HeliALS)点密度超过1000点/平方米，以及一个Optech Titan系统约35点/平方米。研究还详细描述了用于高效和可扩展地收集高质量地面真值数据的实地数据收集技术。

主要发现: 基于多光谱数据的分析显示，点变换模型在小树和少数物种分类中具有优势。

结论: 该开放数据集展示了其多功能性，并证明了点变换模型在处理小树和少数物种时的优势。

翻译: 从单木级别进行森林评估支持了生物多样性制图，特别是在作为关键物种的桦木等北方生态系统。虽然机载激光扫描是标准方法，但公开的高质量、经过实地验证的ALS数据集很少，且缺乏带有高质量实地参考数据的开放式多光谱ALS数据集。该研究介绍了一个用于树木分类的开放式多光谱机载激光扫描数据集，该数据集包含来自芬兰南部九个物种的6326个单木点云数据，并详细描述了用于高效收集高质量地面真值数据的技术。展示并详细说明了一个用于树木分类机器学习和深度学习方法国际基准研究的数据集，并基于Taher等人(2026)的初步发现，利用多光谱数据进行了新的分析，研究了分类精度与树高的关系。数据集包含两个多光谱激光扫描系统获取的点云数据：一个直升机载系统(HeliALS)点密度超过1000点/平方米，以及一个Optech Titan系统约35点/平方米。研究还详细描述了用于高效和可扩展地收集高质量地面真值数据的实地数据收集技术。基于多光谱数据的分析显示，点变换模型在小树和少数物种分类中具有优势。该开放数据集展示了其多功能性，并证明了点变换模型在处理小树和少数物种时的优势。

Abstract

The shift from stand-level to individual-tree-level forest assessments supports improved biodiversity mapping, particularly in boreal ecosystems where tree species like aspen (Populus tremula L.) play a keystone role. While airborne laser scanning (ALS) is the standard for such inventories, a major limitation is the small number of publicly available ALS datasets containing high-quality, field-validated reference data. Furthermore, open multispectral ALS datasets with high-quality field reference data are completely lacking despite the potential of multispectral ALS data for tree species classification. This paper presents and details an open multispectral ALS dataset used in a recent international benchmarking study of machine learning and deep learning methods for tree species classification by Taher et al. (2026). The dataset comprises 6326 segment-level point clouds of individual trees representing nine species in Southern Finland. The point cloud data has been acquired using two multispectral laser scanning systems each operating at three laser wavelengths: a helicopter-borne system (HeliALS) with a point density exceeding 1000 points/m$^2$ and an Optech Titan system with approximately 35 points/m$^2$. We provide a detailed description of field data collection techniques developed in the study to facilitate the collection of high-quality ground truth data in an efficient and scalable manner. Additionally, our article presents new analyses on species classification using multispectral data building upon the initial findings of Taher et al. (2026). Furthermore, we study the relation between classification accuracy and tree height to highlight the versatility of the open dataset and to demonstrate the advantage of the point transformer model for small trees and minority species.

item.title: MIPIC: Matryoshka Representation Learning via Self-Distilled Intra-Relational and Progressive Information Chaining
item.author: Phung Gia Huy, Hai An Vu, Minh-Phuc Truong, Thang Duc Tran, Linh Ngo Van, Thanh Hong Nguyen, Trung Le
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MIPIC的统一训练框架，旨在生成结构一致且语义紧凑的套娃式表示。该方法通过自蒸馏内部关系对齐和渐进信息链式技术，实现了跨维度的结构一致性和深度上的语义整合。实验表明，MIPIC生成的套娃式表示在所有容量下都具有竞争力，并在极端低维情况下表现出显著优势。

背景: 表示学习是自然语言处理的基础，但构建在不同计算预算下表现良好的嵌入具有挑战性。Matryoshka表示学习通过嵌套嵌入提供灵活的推理范式，但学习这种结构需要明确协调信息在嵌入维度和模型深度上的排列方式。

目的: 提出MIPIC（通过自蒸馏内部关系对齐和渐进信息链式实现的套娃式表示学习）统一训练框架，旨在生成结构一致且语义紧凑的套娃式表示。

方法: MIPIC包含两个主要组件：1. 自蒸馏内部关系对齐（SIA），通过top-k CKA自蒸馏在完整和截断表示之间对齐token级别的几何和注意力驱动关系，促进跨维度结构一致性；2. 渐进信息链式（PIC），一种支架式对齐策略，将成熟的任务语义从深层层逐步转移到早期层，实现深度上的语义整合。

主要发现: 在STS、NLI和分类基准测试（涵盖从TinyBERT到BGEM3、Qwen3等模型）上的广泛实验表明，MIPIC生成的套娃式表示在所有容量下都具有高度竞争力，并且在极端低维情况下观察到显著性能优势。

结论: MIPIC成功实现了结构一致且语义紧凑的套娃式表示，证明了其在不同计算预算下的有效性和优越性。

翻译: Representation learning is fundamental to NLP, but building embeddings that work well at different computational budgets is challenging. Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) offers a flexible inference paradigm through nested embeddings; however, learning such structures requires explicit coordination of how information is arranged across embedding dimensionality and model depth. In this work, we propose MIPIC (Matryoshka Representation Learning via Self-Distilled Intra-Relational Alignment and Progressive Information Chaining), a unified training framework designed to produce structurally coherent and semantically compact Matryoshka representations. MIPIC promotes cross-dimensional structural consistency through Self-Distilled Intra-Relational Alignment (SIA), which aligns token-level geometric and attention-driven relations between full and truncated representations using top-k CKA self-distillation. Complementarily, it enables depth-wise semantic consolidation via Progressive Information Chaining (PIC), a scaffolded alignment strategy that incrementally transfers mature task semantics from deeper layers into earlier layers. Extensive experiments on STS, NLI, and classification benchmarks (spanning models from TinyBERT to BGEM3, Qwen3) demonstrate that MIPIC yields Matryoshka representations that are highly competitive across all capacities, with significant performance advantages observed under extreme low-dimensional.

Abstract

Representation learning is fundamental to NLP, but building embeddings that work well at different computational budgets is challenging. Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) offers a flexible inference paradigm through nested embeddings; however, learning such structures requires explicit coordination of how information is arranged across embedding dimensionality and model depth. In this work, we propose MIPIC (Matryoshka Representation Learning via Self-Distilled Intra-Relational Alignment and Progressive Information Chaining), a unified training framework designed to produce structurally coherent and semantically compact Matryoshka representations. MIPIC promotes cross-dimensional structural consistency through Self-Distilled Intra-Relational Alignment (SIA), which aligns token-level geometric and attention-driven relations between full and truncated representations using top-k CKA self-distillation. Complementarily, it enables depth-wise semantic consolidation via Progressive Information Chaining (PIC), a scaffolded alignment strategy that incrementally transfers mature task semantics from deeper layers into earlier layers. Extensive experiments on STS, NLI, and classification benchmarks (spanning models from TinyBERT to BGEM3, Qwen3) demonstrate that MIPIC yields Matryoshka representations that are highly competitive across all capacities, with significant performance advantages observed under extreme low-dimensional.

item.title: An event-based sequence modeling approach to recognizing non-triad chords with oversegmentation minimization
item.author: Leekyung Kim, Jonghun Park
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究将自动和弦识别（ACR）重新定义为基于片段的序列到序列预测任务，通过自回归方式预测和弦序列，以解决过分割、数据稀缺和类别不平衡问题，特别是在识别非三和弦等复杂和弦方面取得了显著改进。

背景: 尽管自动和弦识别（ACR）技术取得了进展，但仍面临过分割、数据稀缺和类别不平衡的挑战，尤其是在识别现有数据集中不常见的复杂和弦（如非三和弦）时表现不佳。

目的: 为了解决ACR中的过分割、数据稀缺和类别不平衡问题，特别是提高对复杂和弦的识别能力，研究将ACR重新定义为基于片段的序列到序列预测任务。

方法: 研究将和弦识别重新设计为基于片段的序列到序列预测任务，通过自回归方式预测和弦序列而非逐帧预测；引入了两种类型的标记表示和一种编码器预训练方法，专门用于时间对齐和弦建模。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，该模型在和弦识别和分割方面均提高了性能，特别是对复杂和不常见和弦类型的识别有显著提升。

结论: 基于片段的序列建模、结构化标记化和表示学习在推进和弦识别系统方面是有效的。

翻译: 自动和弦识别（ACR）从音乐音频录音中提取时间对齐的和弦标签。尽管取得了最近的进展，ACR仍然在过分割、数据稀缺和类别不平衡方面挣扎，特别是在识别现有数据集中不流行的复杂和弦（如非三和弦）时。为了解决这些挑战，我们将ACR重新定义为基于片段的序列到序列预测任务，其中和弦序列是自回归预测的，而不是逐帧预测。这种设计通过仅在片段边界检测和弦变化来减轻过度分割。我们进一步引入了两种类型的标记表示和一种编码器预训练方法，两者都是专门为时间对齐和弦建模设计的。实验结果表明，我们的模型在和弦识别和分割方面提高了性能，特别是对复杂和不常见和弦类型有显著改进。这些发现证明了基于片段的序列建模、结构化标记化和表示学习在推进和弦识别系统方面的有效性。

Abstract

Automatic chord recognition (ACR) extracts time-aligned chord labels from music audio recordings. Despite recent advances, ACR still struggles with oversegmentation, data scarcity, and imbalance, especially in recognizing complex chords such as non-triads, which are unpopular in existing datasets. To address these challenges, we reformulate ACR as a segment-level sequence-to-sequence prediction task, where chord sequences are predicted auto-regressively rather than frame by frame. This design mitigates excessive segmentation by detecting chord changes only at segment boundaries. We further introduce two types of token representations and an encoder pre-training method, both specifically designed for time-aligned chord modeling. Experimental results show that our model improves performance in both chord recognition and segmentation, with notable gains for complex and infrequent chord types. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of segment-level sequence modeling, structured tokenization, and representation learning for advancing chord recognition systems.

item.title: Complexity of Linear Regions in Self-supervised Deep ReLU Networks
item.author: Mufhumudzi Muthivhi, Terence L. van Zyl
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究自监督学习模型中线性区域的局部分布及其与表示质量的相关性

背景: 随着对基于ReLU激活网络的复杂性研究兴趣的增长，近期工作主要关注训练过程中形成的分段线性划分（线性区域）数量的演变，但现有研究仅限于监督学习模型的复杂性分析。自监督学习通过损失函数直接优化表示空间以提升模型在多个下游任务上的性能，与监督学习有所不同。

目的: 本研究调查自监督学习模型产生的线性区域的局部分布情况。

方法: 利用SplineCam提取数据分布附近的二维多面体，并跟踪训练过程中线性区域的数量、面积、离心率和边界。研究在MNIST和FashionMNIST两个标准基准数据集上比较了监督学习、对比学习和自蒸馏方法。

主要发现: 自监督方法在达到与监督模型相当的准确率时，创建的线性区域明显较少。对比学习方法随时间推移快速扩展区域，而自蒸馏方法倾向于通过合并相邻区域来整合。此外，可以在线性区域的几何空间中早期检测到表示崩溃。

结论: 多面体指标可以作为表示质量和模型性能的可靠指标。

翻译: 摘要：随着对基于ReLU激活网络的复杂性研究兴趣的增长，近期工作主要关注训练过程中形成的分段线性划分（线性区域）数量的演变，但现有研究仅限于监督学习模型的复杂性分析。自监督学习通过损失函数直接优化表示空间以提升模型在多个下游任务上的性能，与监督学习有所不同。本研究调查自监督学习模型产生的线性区域的局部分布情况。我们利用SplineCam提取数据分布附近的二维多面体，并跟踪训练过程中线性区域的数量、面积、离心率和边界。研究在MNIST和FashionMNIST两个标准基准数据集上比较了监督学习、对比学习和自蒸馏方法。实验结果分析表明，自监督方法在达到与监督模型相当的准确率时，创建的线性区域明显较少。对比学习方法随时间推移快速扩展区域，而自蒸馏方法倾向于通过合并相邻区域来整合。此外，可以在线性区域的几何空间中早期检测到表示崩溃。分析表明，多面体指标可以作为表示质量和模型性能的可靠指标。

Abstract

There has been growing interest in studying the complexity of Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) based activation networks. Recent work investigates the evolution of the number of piecewise-linear partitions (linear regions) that are formed during training. However, current research is limited to examining the complexity of models trained in a supervised way. Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) differs in that it directly optimises the representation space using a loss function to enhance the model's performance across multiple downstream tasks. This study investigates the local distribution of linear regions produced by SSL models. We demonstrate that the evolution of linear regions correlates with the representation quality by utilising SplineCam to extract two-dimensional polytopes near the data distribution. We track the number, area, eccentricity, and boundaries of regions throughout training. The study compares supervised, contrastive, and self-distillation methods over two standard benchmark datasets, MNIST and FashionMNIST. The analysis of the experimental results shows that self-supervised methods create substantially fewer regions to achieve comparable accuracy to supervised models. Contrastive methods rapidly expand regions over time, whereas self-distillation methods tend to consolidate by merging neighbouring regions. Lastly, we can detect representation collapse early within the geometric space of linear regions. Our analysis suggests that polytopal metrics can serve as reliable indicators of representation quality and model performance.

item.title: Few-Shot Cross-Device Transfer for Quantum Noise Modeling on Real Hardware
item.author: Sahil Al Farib, Sheikh Redwanul Islam, Azizur Rahman Anik
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究探索了在NISQ条件下，利用少量数据将一个量子设备上的噪声模型迁移到另一个设备上，以实现跨设备的误差缓解。

背景: 在NISQ（含噪声中等规模量子）条件下，量子设备包含特定的硬件噪声源，限制了设备不变的误差缓解策略。

目的: 探索转移学习方法，利用少量数据将在一个量子设备上学习的噪声模型应用到另一个不同的量子设备上。

方法: 从两个IBM量子设备（ibm_fez和ibm_marrakesh）上创建了包含170个噪声和理想电路输出分布及设备校准特征的真实硬件数据集。在源设备上训练残差神经网络以将噪声映射到理想结果。

主要发现: 零样本转移测试显示KL散度为1.6706，表明了设备特异性；使用K=20个微调样本后，KL散度降至1.1924，比零样本转移有28.6%的改善，恢复了零样本转移与域内KL之间差距的34.9%。消融研究指出跨设备不匹配的主要原因是CX门误差，其次是读出误差。

结论: 量子噪声可以用最少量的样本进行学习和微调，并为跨设备量子误差缓解提供了一种可行的方法。

翻译: 在含噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）条件下，量子设备包含特定的硬件噪声源，限制了设备不变的误差缓解策略。我们探索了转移学习方法，利用少量数据将在一个量子设备上学习的噪声模型应用到另一个不同的量子设备上。我们从两个IBM量子设备（ibm_fez和ibm_marrakesh）上创建了包含170个噪声和理想电路输出分布及设备校准特征的真实硬件数据集。在源设备上训练残差神经网络以将噪声映射到理想结果。零样本转移测试显示KL散度为1.6706，表明了设备特异性；使用K=20个微调样本后，KL散度降至1.1924，比零样本转移有28.6%的改善，恢复了零样本转移与域内KL之间差距的34.9%。消融研究指出跨设备不匹配的主要原因是CX门误差，其次是读出误差。结果表明量子噪声可以用最少量的样本进行学习和微调，并为跨设备量子误差缓解提供了一种可行的方法。

Abstract

In the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) regime, quantum devices contain hardware-specific noise sources which restrict device-invariant error mitigation strategies. We explore transfer learning approaches to apply noise models learned on one quantum device to a different device with the help of a small amount of data. We create a real-hardware dataset from two IBM quantum devices, ibm_fez (source) and ibm_marrakesh (target), comprising 170 noisy and ideal circuit output distributions, with device calibration features added. We train a residual neural network on the source device to map noisy to ideal outcomes. The zero-shot transfer test shows a KL divergence of 1.6706 (up from 0.3014), establishing device specificity. With K = 20 fine-tuning samples, KL drops to 1.1924 (28.6% improvement over zero-shot), recovering 34.9% of the gap between zero-shot and in-domain KL. Ablation studies reveal that the major cause of mismatches across devices is CX gate error, followed by readout error. The results show quantum noise can be learned and fine-tuned with minimal samples, and provide a plausible approach to cross-device quantum error mitigation.

item.title: AutoGUI-v2: A Comprehensive Multi-Modal GUI Functionality Understanding Benchmark
item.author: Hongxin Li, Xiping Wang, Jingran Su, Zheng Ju, Yuntao Chen, Qing Li, Zhaoxiang Zhang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AutoGUI-v2是一个用于评估GUI代理深度功能理解能力的综合基准测试，旨在解决现有基准测试的局限性。

背景: 虽然现代视觉语言模型具备感知能力，但现有基准测试要么关注黑盒任务完成，要么关注静态、浅层的定位，未能评估代理是否真正理解GUI的隐含功能和转换逻辑。

目的: 引入AutoGUI-v2基准测试，以评估代理对GUI深度功能理解以及交互结果预测的能力。

方法: 使用新颖的VLM-人类协作管道构建基准，递归解析多平台屏幕截图以生成层级功能区域，从而生成多样化的评估任务。

主要发现: 评估揭示了VLM的显著差异：开源模型在功能定位上表现出色，而商业模型在功能描述上占主导地位；所有模型在处理不常见动作的复杂交互逻辑时都存在困难。

结论: AutoGUI-v2系统地测量了这些基础能力，为推进下一代GUI代理提供了新的视角。

翻译: 能够导航图形用户界面的自主代理具有彻底改变数字生产力的潜力。然而，实现真正的数字自主性不仅限于对反应性元素的匹配；它需要对界面动态的预测性心理模型以及预见交互产生的“数字世界状态”的能力。尽管现代视觉语言模型具备感知能力，但现有基准测试仍然分裂（要么关注黑盒任务完成，要么关注静态、浅层的定位），因此未能评估代理是否真正理解GUI的隐含功能和转换逻辑。为了弥合这一差距，我们介绍了AutoGUI-v2，这是一个旨在评估深度GUI功能理解和交互结果预测的综合基准。我们使用新颖的VLM-人类协作管道构建基准，递归解析多平台屏幕截图以生成层级功能区域，从而生成多样化的评估任务。在六个操作系统上提供2753个任务，AutoGUI-v2严格测试代理在区域和元素级语义、定位和动态状态预测方面的能力。我们的评估揭示了VLM的显著差异：在代理数据上微调的开源模型（例如Qwen3-VL）在功能定位方面表现出色，而商业模型（例如Gemini-2.5-Pro-Thinking）在功能描述方面占主导地位。至关重要的是，所有模型在处理不常见动作的复杂交互逻辑时都存在困难，这表明深度功能理解仍然是一个重大障碍。通过系统地测量这些基础能力，AutoGUI-v2为推进下一代GUI代理提供了新的视角。

Abstract

Autonomous agents capable of navigating Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) hold the potential to revolutionize digital productivity. However, achieving true digital autonomy extends beyond reactive element matching; it necessitates a predictive mental model of interface dynamics and the ability to foresee the "digital world state" resulting from interactions. Despite the perceptual capabilities of modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs), existing benchmarks remain bifurcated (focusing either on black-box task completion or static, shallow grounding), thereby failing to assess whether agents truly comprehend the implicit functionality and transition logic of GUIs. To bridge this gap, we introduce AutoGUI-v2, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate deep GUI functionality understanding and interaction outcome prediction. We construct the benchmark using a novel VLM-human collaborative pipeline that recursively parses multi-platform screenshots into hierarchical functional regions to generate diverse evaluation tasks. Providing 2,753 tasks across six operating systems, AutoGUI-v2 rigorously tests agents on region and element-level semantics, grounding, and dynamic state prediction. Our evaluation reveals a striking dichotomy in VLMs: while open-source models fine-tuned on agent data (e.g., Qwen3-VL) excel at functional grounding, commercial models (e.g., Gemini-2.5-Pro-Thinking) dominate in functionality captioning. Crucially, all models struggle with complex interaction logic of uncommon actions, highlighting that deep functional understanding remains a significant hurdle. By systematically measuring these foundational capabilities, AutoGUI-v2 offers a new lens for advancing the next generation of GUI agents.

item.title: Geometric Analysis of Self-Supervised Vision Representations for Semantic Image Retrieval
item.author: Esteban Rodríguez-Betancourt, Edgar Casasola-Murillo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究现代自监督学习方法在基于内容的图像检索系统中的表现，评估其潜在空间几何特性对近似最近邻搜索的影响。

背景: 现有的基于内容的图像检索系统主要依赖元数据，文本领域已受益于无监督方法（如BERT）创建的向量搜索，但现代视觉领域的自监督学习方法在相关文献中报道较少，且现有方法多依赖监督模型或多模态方法。

目的: 评估现代视觉自监督学习方法学习到的表示在典型检索堆栈中的表现，该堆栈利用向量数据库和最近邻搜索。

方法: 通过评估潜在空间几何特性对近似最近邻索引性能的影响，特别关注高度各向异性和高偏度的表示如何降低分区和哈希搜索的性能，以及各向同性和局部纯度更高的表示如何改善语义检索性能。

主要发现: 高度各向异性和高偏度的表示会降低分区和哈希搜索的性能，即使其线性探测或K-NN准确率不受影响；而各向同性和局部纯度更高的表示更能满足ANN索引的距离假设，从而提高语义检索性能。

结论: 潜在空间几何特性对近似最近邻索引性能有显著影响，选择具有更好几何特性的表示方法能提升基于内容的图像检索系统的性能。

翻译: 基于内容的图像检索系统使用户能够基于视觉内容而非元数据搜索图像。文本领域已受益于使用无监督方法（如BERT）创建的表示的向量搜索。然而，现代视觉领域的自监督学习方法在CBIR相关文献中很少被报道，相反，它们依赖监督模型或多模态方法来对齐文本和视觉。我们评估了现代视觉自监督学习方法学习到的表示在典型检索堆栈中的表现，该堆栈利用向量数据库和最近邻搜索。我们的评估揭示了潜在空间几何特性影响近似最近邻索引。具体来说，由几种现代SSL方法产生的高度各向异性和高偏度的表示降低了分区和哈希搜索的性能，即使它们自己的线性探测或K-NN准确率不受影响。相反，具有更高各向同性和局部纯度的表示更好地满足了ANN索引的距离假设，从而提高了语义检索性能。

Abstract

Content-based image retrieval (CBIR) systems enable users to search images based on visual content instead of relying on metadata. The text domain has benefited from vector search of representations created with unsupervised methods such as BERT. However, modern self-supervised learning methods for vision are mostly not reported in CBIR-related literature, instead relying on supervised models or multi-modal methods that align text and vision. We evaluate how the representations learned by modern self-supervised learning methods for vision perform under typical retrieval stacks that leverage vector databases and nearest neighbor search. Our evaluation reveals that the latent space geometry impacts approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) indexing. Specifically, highly anisotropic representations with high skewness produced by several modern SSL methods degrade the performance of partition-based and hashing-based search, even if their own linear probe or K-NN accuracy is not affected. In contrast, representations with higher isotropy and local purity better satisfy the distance-based assumptions of ANN indexes, leading to improved semantic retrieval performance.

item.title: Guiding Vector Field Generation via Score-based Diffusion Model
item.author: Zirui Chen, Shiliang Guo, Shiyu Zhao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于分数的引导向量场(SGVF)框架，用于解决传统方法在处理无序、多分支或概率模型生成的路径时的局限性。

背景: 传统的引导向量场(GVF)方法假设路径是平滑且有序的曲线，但在面对无序、多分支或由概率模型生成的路径时表现不佳。

目的: 提出一种统一的框架，利用基于分数的生成建模从数据分布直接构建向量场，以实现复杂的路径跟随。

方法: 通过点云学习切向量场，并使用单位范数、正交性和方向一致性损失来确保几何保真度和控制可行性。

主要发现: 该方法消除了对临时路径分割的依赖，能够沿着分支和伪流形等复杂拓扑结构进行引导；建立了扩散模型中分数消失与GVF奇点之间的对应关系，并强调了在尖锐路径曲率附近的表示能力。

结论: 在平面环境中的机器人导航实验表明，SGVF在传统GVF失效的场景下实现了可靠的路径跟随，展示了生成建模与几何控制之间的桥梁潜力。

翻译: Guiding Vector Fields (GVFs) 是一种强大的机器人路径跟随工具。然而，经典方法假设平滑、有序的曲线，并在路径无序、多分支或由概率模型生成时失效。我们提出了一种统一的框架，称为基于分数的引导向量场(SGVF)，它利用基于分数的生成建模从数据分布直接构建向量场。SGVF 通过点云学习切向量场，并使用单位范数、正交性和方向一致性损失，确保几何保真度和控制可行性。这种方法消除了对临时路径分割的依赖，并能够沿着分支和伪流形等复杂拓扑结构进行引导。研究建立了扩散模型中分数消失与GVF奇点之间的对应关系，并强调了在尖锐路径曲率附近的表示能力。在平面环境中的机器人导航实验表明，SGVF 在传统GVF 失效的场景下实现了可靠的路径跟随，凸显了其作为生成建模和几何控制之间桥梁的潜力。代码和实验视频可在 https://github.com/czr-gif/Guiding-Vector-Field-Generation-via-Score-based-Diffusion-Model 获取。

Abstract

Guiding Vector Fields (GVFs) are a powerful tool for robotic path following. However, classical methods assume smooth, ordered curves and fail when paths are unordered, multi-branch, or generated by probabilistic models. We propose a unified framework, termed the Score-Induced Guiding Vector Field (SGVF), which leverages score-based generative modeling to construct vector fields directly from data distributions. SGVF learns tangent fields from point clouds with unit-norm, orthogonality, and directional-consistency losses, ensuring geometric fidelity and control feasibility. This approach removes the reliance on ad-hoc path segmentation and enables guidance along complex topologies such as branching and pseudo-manifolds. The study establishes a correspondence between score vanishing in diffusion models and GVF singularities and highlights representational capacity near sharp path curvatures. Experiments on robotic navigation in planar environments demonstrate that SGVF achieves reliable path following in scenarios where classical GVFs fail, underscoring its potential as a bridge between generative modeling and geometric control. Code and experiment video are available at https://github.com/czr-gif/Guiding-Vector-Field-Generation-via-Score-based-Diffusion-Model.

item.title: Self-Supervised Representation Learning via Hyperspherical Density Shaping
item.author: Esteban Rodríguez-Betancourt, Edgar Casasola-Murillo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 HyDeS 的基于多视图互信息最大化的自监督学习方法，该方法在球面空间内使用非参数 von Mises-Fisher 密度估计器和香农微分熵。

背景: 现有的现代自监督表示学习方法往往依赖于缺乏理论依据的经验启发式方法。

目的: 提出 HyDeS 方法，旨在基于多视图互信息最大化，在超球面空间内利用香农微分熵和非参数 von Mises-Fisher 密度估计器，构建具有理论依据的自监督学习方法。

方法: HyDeS 方法基于多视图互信息最大化，在超球面空间内使用香农微分熵和非参数 von Mises-Fisher 密度估计器。

主要发现: 该方法使训练模型倾向于关注图像的前景特征，在分割任务（如 VOC PASCAL）上表现良好，但在细粒度分类任务上表现滞后。

结论: 研究提供了对诱导潜在空间几何和学习动力学的详细分析，可用于设计其他具有理论依据的自监督学习方法。

翻译: 现代自监督表示学习方法通常依赖于缺乏理论依据的经验启发式方法。在这项研究中，我们提出了 HyDeS，这是一种基于多视图互信息最大化的理论上合理的方法，该方法在超球面空间内使用香农微分熵和非参数 von Mises-Fisher 密度估计器。我们表明，HyDeS 使训练模型倾向于关注图像的前景特征，并在分割任务（如 VOC PASCAL）上表现良好，但在细粒度分类上表现滞后。我们提供了对诱导的潜在空间几何和学习动力学的详细分析，可用于设计其他理论上合理的自监督学习方法。

Abstract

Modern self-supervised representation learning methods often relies on empirical heuristics that are not theoretically grounded. In this study we propose HyDeS, a theoretically grounded method based on multi-view mutual information maximization within an hyperspherical space using Shannon differential entropy with a non-parametric von Mises-Fisher density estimator. We show that HyDeS bias the trained model towards focusing on foreground features of the images and perform well on segmentation tasks such as VOC PASCAL, while it lags in fine-grained classification. We provide a detailed analysis of the induced latent space geometry and learning dynamics, that can be used for designing other theoretically grounded self-supervised learning methods.

item.title: MIMIC: A Generative Multimodal Foundation Model for Biomolecules
item.author: Siavash Golkar, Jake Kovalic, Irina Espejo Morales, Samuel Sledzieski, Minhuan Li, Ksenia Sokolova, Geraud Krawezik, Alberto Bietti, Claudia Skok Gibbs, Roman Klypa, Shengwei Xiong, Francois Lanusse, Liam Parker, Kyunghyun Cho, Miles Cranmer, Tom Hehir, Michael McCabe, Lucas Meyer, Rudy Morel, Payel Mukhopadhyay, Mariel Pettee, Helen Qu, Jeff Shen, David Fouhey, Hadi Sotoudeh, Vikram Mulligan, Pilar Cossio, Sonya M. Hanson, Alisha N. Jones, Olga G. Troyanskaya, Shirley Ho
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MIMIC是一个多模态生成基础模型，通过整合核酸、蛋白质、进化、结构、调控和语义/语境模态，在部分观察的生物分子状态下重建或生成缺失的分子状态组件。

背景: 生物功能源于序列、结构、调控、进化和细胞语境等多模态约束的耦合，但大多数生物学基础模型是在单一模态或固定前向任务下训练的。

目的: 提出MIMIC模型，旨在通过整合多种模态，在部分观察的生物分子状态下重建或生成缺失的分子状态组件。

方法: MIMIC采用分轨编码器-解码器架构，在新的LORE数据集上进行训练，该数据集对齐了多种模态。模型能够基于任意观察到的模态子集进行条件化，并在基因组、转录组和蛋白质组范围内重建或生成缺失组件。

主要发现: 多模态条件化一致地提高了MIMIC的序列重建性能；其学习到的表示在RNA和蛋白质下游任务上实现了最先进的性能；在剪接预测方面达到最先进水平；支持等位基因感知推断；能够识别临床相关的HBB剪接破坏突变中的校正编辑；在蛋白质设计中，联合条件化PD-L1和hACE2结合位点的形状和表面化学性质可产生具有强计算机模拟支持的高置信度序列；使用实验语境作为语义条件来建模实验依赖的RNA化学探测。

结论: MIMIC的多模态生成建模为统一表示学习、条件预测和约束生物分子设计提供了一个强大的基础。

翻译: 摘要：生物功能源于序列、结构、调控、进化和细胞语境等多模态约束的耦合，但大多数生物学基础模型是在单一模态或固定前向任务下训练的。我们提出了MIMIC，这是一个在新的经过整理和对齐的数据集LORE上训练的多模态生成基础模型，在部分观察的生物分子状态下连接了核酸、蛋白质、进化、结构、调控和语义/语境模态。MIMIC使用分轨编码器-解码器架构，以任意观察到的模态子集为条件，在基因组、转录组和蛋白质组范围内重建或生成缺失的分子状态组件。多模态条件化一致地提高了MIMIC相对于仅序列输入的序列重建性能，而其学习到的表示在RNA和蛋白质下游任务上实现了最先进的性能。MIMIC实现了最先进的剪接预测，其联合生成公式支持等位基因感知推断，进一步提高了性能。除了预测之外，相同的生成框架支持约束设计。对于RNA，MIMIC利用进化和结构信号识别临床相关的HBB剪接破坏突变中的校正编辑，而无需将其恢复。对于蛋白质，联合条件化PD-L1和hACE2结合位点的形状和表面化学性质可产生具有强计算机模拟支持的高置信度序列。最后，MIMIC使用实验语境作为语义条件来建模实验依赖的RNA化学探测，而不是将语境视为固定输出。这些结果共同将MIMIC的对齐多模态生成建模定位为在单个模型中统一表示学习、条件预测和约束生物分子设计的强大基础。

Abstract

Biological function emerges from coupled constraints across sequence, structure, regulation, evolution, and cellular context, yet most foundation models in biology are trained within one modality or for a fixed forward task. We present MIMIC, a generative multimodal foundation model trained on our newly curated and aligned dataset, LORE, linking nucleic acid, protein, evolutionary, structural, regulatory, and semantic/contextual modalities within partially observed biomolecular states. MIMIC uses a split-track encoder-decoder architecture to condition on arbitrary subsets of observed modalities and reconstruct or generate missing components of molecular state across the genome, transcriptome, and proteome. Multimodal conditioning consistently improves MIMIC's sequence reconstruction relative to sequence-only inputs, while its learned representations enable state-of-the-art performance on RNA and protein downstream tasks. MIMIC achieves state-of-the-art splicing prediction, and its joint generative formulation enables isoform-aware inference that further improves performance.
