Beyond prediction, the same generative framework supports constrained design. For RNA, MIMIC identifies corrective edits in a clinically relevant HBB splice-disrupting mutation without reverting it by using evolutionary and structural signals. For proteins, jointly conditioning on shape and surface chemistry of PD-L1 and hACE2 binding sites produces diverse, high-confidence sequences with strong in silico support for target binding. Finally, MIMIC uses experimental context as semantic conditioning to model assay-dependent RNA chemical probing, rather than treating context as a fixed output. Together, these results position MIMIC's aligned multimodal generative modeling as a strong foundation for unifying representation learning, conditional prediction, and constrained biomolecular design within a single model.

item.title: StarCLR: Contrastive Learning Representation for Astronomical Light Curves
item.author: Junyao Ding, Xiaodian Chen, Xinyi Gao, Xiaoyu Tang, Shu Wang, Yang Huang, Xinyu Qi, Guirong Xue, Ali Luo, Jifeng Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: StarCLR是一个用于大规模光变曲线的对比预训练框架，通过构建部分重叠子序列的正对来学习时间表示，并在TESS、ZTF和Gaia数据集上进行了微调，实现了高精度的变星分类。

背景: 随着时域巡天的快速发展，大量光变曲线数据的可用性为研究恒星演化和变星分类提供了新机遇，同时也对特征提取和建模提出了挑战。

目的: 提出StarCLR，一个用于大规模光变曲线的对比预训练框架，以解决特征提取和建模的挑战。

方法: 通过构建部分重叠子序列的正对来鼓励模型学习时间表示，在TESS数据集上进行预训练，并在TESS、ZTF和Gaia三个具有不同观测特征的数据集上进行微调。

主要发现: StarCLR在TESS和ZTF上相比从头训练的LSTM和Transformer表现更好，特别是在稀疏采样的ZTF光变曲线上增益最大；在Gaia上，由于涉及更广泛的类别空间和天体物理特征的影响，预训练骨干网络的贡献相对有限。

结论: 预训练表示通过捕获光变曲线的信息丰富的时序特征提供了性能增益；随着标准化数据集和更多样化的标记方案的出现，StarCLR的泛化能力可以进一步增强。

翻译: 随着时域巡天的快速发展，大量光变曲线数据的可用性为研究恒星演化和变星分类提供了新机遇，同时也对特征提取和建模提出了挑战。我们提出了StarCLR，一个用于大规模光变曲线的对比预训练框架。通过构建部分重叠子序列的正对，StarCLR鼓励模型学习时间表示。我们在TESS数据集上预训练StarCLR，并在三个具有不同观测特征的数据集上对其进行微调，即TESS（18种类型）、ZTF（11种类型）和Gaia（24种类型）。StarCLR分别实现了84.35%、87.82%和92.73%的宏观F1分数，以及94.46%、92.83%和99.49%的微观F1分数。与从头训练的LSTM和Transformer相比，StarCLR在TESS和ZTF上表现更好，在稀疏采样的ZTF光变曲线上增益最大，展示了良好的泛化能力。对于Gaia，由于涉及更广泛的类别空间，评估不是直接可比的，性能可能受到天体物理特征的影响，预训练骨干网络的贡献相对有限。对嵌入设计、池化策略和预训练设置的系统性消融实验进一步表明，预训练表示通过捕获光变曲线的信息丰富的时序特征提供了性能增益。展望未来，随着标准化数据集和更多样化的标记方案的出现，StarCLR的泛化能力可以进一步增强。

Abstract

With the rapid development of time-domain surveys, the availability of massive light curve data offers new opportunities for studying stellar evolution and variable star classification, while simultaneously posing challenges for feature extraction and modeling. We present StarCLR, a contrastive pretraining framework for large-scale light curves. By constructing positive pairs from partially overlapping sub-sequences, StarCLR encourages the model to learn temporal representations. We pretrain StarCLR on the TESS dataset and fine-tune it for variable star classification on three surveys with distinct observational characteristics, namely TESS (18 types), ZTF (11 types), and Gaia (24 types). StarCLR achieves macro-F1 scores of 84.35%, 87.82%, and 92.73%, and micro-F1 scores of 94.46%, 92.83%, and 99.49%, respectively. Compared with LSTM and Transformer trained from scratch, StarCLR performs better on TESS and ZTF, with the largest gains on sparsely sampled ZTF light curves, demonstrating promising generalization. For Gaia, which involves a broader class space, the evaluation is not directly comparable, and performance is likely influenced by astrophysical features, resulting in a more limited contribution from the pretrained backbone. Systematic ablations on embedding design, pooling strategy, and pretraining settings further indicate that the pretrained representations provide performance gains by capturing informative temporal characteristics of light curves. Looking ahead, with standardized datasets and more diverse labeling schemes, the generalization ability of StarCLR can be further enhanced.

item.title: Point Cloud Registration for Fusion between SPECT MPI and CTA Images
item.author: Ni Yao, Xiangyu Liu, Shaojie Tang, Danyang Sun, Chuang Han, Yanting Li, Jiaofen Nan, Chengyang Li, Fubao Zhu, Chen Zhao, Zhihui Xu, Weihua Zhou
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种结合单光子发射计算机断层扫描心肌灌注成像（SPECT MPI）和计算机断层扫描血管造影（CTA）的注册与融合框架，旨在解决跨模态配准和手动地标依赖的问题，以实现更准确的心肌缺血定位和病变功能评估。

背景: SPECT MPI与CTA的临床融合受到跨模态配准误差和依赖手动地标的影响，这阻碍了准确的心肌缺血定位和病变功能评估。

目的: 提出一个SPECT MPI和CTA的注册与融合框架，整合功能和解剖信息以进行全面的心脏评估。

方法: 该框架首先对两种模态进行基于U-Net的分割，从SPECT MPI中提取左心室并自动推导解剖地标，从CTA中分割双心室并利用其空间关系在室间隔交界处自动定义地标。采用尺度空间一致性预处理和地标驱动的粗配准来缓解初始错位，并在左心室心外膜表面点云上评估多种精细配准方法，包括ICP、SICP、CPD、CluReg、FFD和BCPD-plus-plus。最后将变换传播到体素级重采样以实现高精度融合。

主要发现: 在60名患者的回顾性队列中，该框架保留了来自CTA的亚毫米级冠状动脉细节，并准确叠加了定量的SPECT灌注。在评估的方法中，BCPD-plus-plus达到了最高的精度，平均点云距离为1.7毫米。

结论: 该方法通过稳健的初始化、比较精细配准和体素级融合，为心肌缺血定位和冠状动脉病变的功能评估提供了实用的解决方案，且不依赖于任何特定的精细配准算法。

翻译: Clinical fusion of Single Photon Emission Computed Tomography Myocardial Perfusion Imaging (SPECT MPI) and Computed Tomography Angiography (CTA) remains limited by cross-modality misregistration and reliance on manual landmarks, which can hinder accurate ischemia localization and lesion-level functional assessment. To address this issue, we propose a registration and fusion framework for SPECT MPI and CTA that integrates functional and structural information for comprehensive cardiac evaluation. The proposed pipeline performs U-Net-based segmentation on both modalities. On SPECT MPI, only the left ventricle (LV) is extracted, and anatomical landmarks are automatically derived from characteristic LV structures. On CTA, both ventricles are segmented, and their spatial relationship is used to automatically define landmarks at the interventricular septal junction. Scale-space consistency preprocessing and landmark-driven coarse registration are applied to mitigate initial misalignment. Based on this initialization, multiple fine registration methods are evaluated on LV epicardial surface point clouds, including ICP, SICP, CPD, CluReg, FFD, and BCPD-plus-plus. The resulting transformations are then propagated to voxel-level resampling for high-precision SPECT-CTA fusion. In a retrospective cohort of 60 patients, the proposed framework preserved sub-millimeter coronary detail from CTA while accurately overlaying quantitative SPECT perfusion. Among the evaluated methods, BCPD-plus-plus achieved the highest accuracy with a mean point cloud distance of 1.7 mm. By combining robust initialization, comparative fine registration, and voxel-level fusion, the proposed approach provides a practical solution for myocardial ischemia localization and functional evaluation of coronary lesions, while remaining independent of any specific fine registration algorithm.

Abstract

Clinical fusion of Single Photon Emission Computed Tomography Myocardial Perfusion Imaging (SPECT MPI) and Computed Tomography Angiography (CTA) remains limited by cross-modality misregistration and reliance on manual landmarks, which can hinder accurate ischemia localization and lesion-level functional assessment. To address this issue, we propose a registration and fusion framework for SPECT MPI and CTA that integrates functional and structural information for comprehensive cardiac evaluation. The proposed pipeline performs U-Net-based segmentation on both modalities. On SPECT MPI, only the left ventricle (LV) is extracted, and anatomical landmarks are automatically derived from characteristic LV structures. On CTA, both ventricles are segmented, and their spatial relationship is used to automatically define landmarks at the interventricular septal junction. Scale-space consistency preprocessing and landmark-driven coarse registration are applied to mitigate initial misalignment. Based on this initialization, multiple fine registration methods are evaluated on LV epicardial surface point clouds, including ICP, SICP, CPD, CluReg, FFD, and BCPD-plus-plus. The resulting transformations are then propagated to voxel-level resampling for high-precision SPECT-CTA fusion. In a retrospective cohort of 60 patients, the proposed framework preserved sub-millimeter coronary detail from CTA while accurately overlaying quantitative SPECT perfusion. Among the evaluated methods, BCPD-plus-plus achieved the highest accuracy with a mean point cloud distance of 1.7 mm. By combining robust initialization, comparative fine registration, and voxel-level fusion, the proposed approach provides a practical solution for myocardial ischemia localization and functional evaluation of coronary lesions, while remaining independent of any specific fine registration algorithm.

item.title: Generating Place-Based Compromises Between Two Points of View
item.author: Sumanta Bhattacharyya, Francine Chen, Scott Carter, Yan-Ying Chen, Tatiana Lau, Nayeli Suseth Bravo, Monica P. Van, Kate Sieck, Charlene C. Wu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究提出了一种生成共情中立妥协方案的方法，通过外部共情相似性作为迭代反馈，优于标准思维链推理，并利用生成的妥协数据集训练了更小的基础模型。

背景: 大型语言模型在学术任务上表现出色，但在社会智能任务，如创建良好妥协方案方面存在困难。

目的: 提出生成共情中立妥协方案的方法。

方法: 比较了四种不同的提示工程方法，使用Claude 3 Opus和2400条关于共享地点的对比观点数据集。最佳方法利用妥协方案与每个观点之间的外部共情相似性作为迭代反馈。随后使用生成的妥协数据集训练了两个较小的基础模型。

主要发现: 利用共情中立性提高了妥协方案的可接受性。最佳方法优于标准思维链推理。通过基于边界的偏好对齐训练较小的模型提高了效率，并在推理过程中消除了对共情估计的需求。

结论: 共情中立性在提高妥协方案可接受性方面是有效的。

翻译: 大型语言模型在学术方面表现出色，但在社会智能任务，如创建良好妥协方案方面存在困难。在本文中，我们提出了在两个对立观点之间生成共情中立妥协方案的方法。我们首先使用Claude 3 Opus和2400条关于共享地点的对比观点数据集比较了四种不同的提示工程方法。生成的妥协方案的一个子集在50名参与者的研究中进行了可接受性评估。我们发现，在两个观点之间生成妥协的最佳方法使用了妥协与每个观点之间的外部共情相似性作为迭代反馈，优于标准思维链推理。结果表明，共情中立性的使用提高了妥协方案的可接受性。生成的妥协数据集随后被用于通过基于边界的偏好对齐训练两个较小的基础模型，提高了效率，并在推理过程中消除了对共情估计的需求。

Abstract

Large Language Models (LLMs) excel academically but struggle with social intelligence tasks, such as creating good compromises. In this paper, we present methods for generating empathically neutral compromises between two opposing viewpoints. We first compared four different prompt engineering methods using Claude 3 Opus and a dataset of 2,400 contrasting views on shared places. A subset of the gen erated compromises was evaluated for acceptability in a 50-participant study. We found that the best method for generating compromises between two views used external empathic similarity between a compromise and each viewpoint as iterative feedback, outperforming stan dard Chain of Thought (CoT) reasoning. The results indicate that the use of empathic neutrality improves the acceptability of compromises. The dataset of generated compromises was then used to train two smaller foundation models via margin-based alignment of human preferences, improving efficiency and removing the need for empathy estimation during inference.

item.title: GradMAP: Gradient-Based Multi-Agent Proximal Learning for Grid-Edge Flexibility
item.author: Yihong Zhou, Hongtai Zeng, Thomas Morstyn
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于梯度的多智能体近端学习（GradMAP）方法，用于协调大规模电网边缘设备，该方法在部署时完全去中心化，同时遵守三相交流配电网络的物理约束。

背景: 协调大规模电网边缘设备需要学习方法在部署时保持完全去中心化，同时仍需遵守三相交流配电网络的物理约束。

目的: 提出梯度-based multi-agent proximal learning (GradMAP) 方法来解决这一挑战。

方法: GradMAP 为每个智能体训练独立的神经网络策略，无需参数共享；每个智能体仅使用自身局部观察进行在线决策，无需通信。在离线训练中，GradMAP 在原始-对偶学习循环中嵌入可微的三相交流潮流模型，并使用隐式微分传播精确的网络约束违规信息以更新策略参数。为了加速训练，GradMAP 在更直接的策略输出（动作）空间定义的信任域内，通过近端代理重用昂贵的环境梯度。

主要发现: 在包含1000个智能体管理电池、热泵和可控发电机的IEEE 123母线馈线案例研究中，GradMAP 在单工作站级 NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell 48GB GPU 上训练15分钟即可学习到最小化三相交流潮流约束违规的去中心化策略。相比基于梯度的自监督学习基准，训练速度提高了3-5倍，且比多智能体强化学习基准具有显著更好的训练效率。在样本外测试中，GradMAP 也提供了最低的运营成本和约束违规。

结论: GradMAP 能够高效地学习去中心化策略，在训练速度和效率上优于现有基准，并在样本外测试中表现出色。

翻译: 本文提出了一种基于梯度的多智能体近端学习（GradMAP）方法，用于协调大规模电网边缘设备，该方法在部署时完全去中心化，同时遵守三相交流配电网络的物理约束。GradMAP 为每个智能体训练独立的神经网络策略，无需参数共享；每个智能体仅使用自身局部观察进行在线决策，无需通信。在离线训练中，GradMAP 在原始-对偶学习循环中嵌入可微的三相交流潮流模型，并使用隐式微分传播精确的网络约束违规信息以更新策略参数。为了加速训练，GradMAP 在更直接的策略输出（动作）空间定义的信任域内，通过近端代理重用昂贵的环境梯度。在包含1000个智能体管理电池、热泵和可控发电机的IEEE 123母线馈线案例研究中，GradMAP 在单工作站级 NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell 48GB GPU 上训练15分钟即可学习到最小化三相交流潮流约束违规的去中心化策略。相比基于梯度的自监督学习基准，训练速度提高了3-5倍，且比多智能体强化学习基准具有显著更好的训练效率。在样本外测试中，GradMAP 也提供了最低的运营成本和约束违规。

Abstract

Coordinating large populations of grid-edge devices requires learning methods that remain fully decentralised in deployment while still respecting three-phase AC distribution-network physics. This paper proposes gradient-based multi-agent proximal learning (GradMAP) to address this challenge. GradMAP trains independent neural-network policies for each agent without any parameter sharing, and each agent uses only its own local observation for online decision-making without communication. During offline training, GradMAP embeds a differentiable three-phase AC power-flow model in a primal-dual learning loop and uses implicit differentiation to propagate exact network-constraint violations to update the policy parameters. To speed up training, GradMAP reuses expensive environment gradients through a proximal surrogate within a trust region defined in the more direct policy-output (action) space, instead of the probability distribution space used in other works, such as PPO. In case studies with 1,000 agents managing batteries, heat pumps, and controllable generators on the IEEE 123-bus feeder, GradMAP learns decentralised policies that minimise three-phase AC load-flow constraint violations within 15 minutes of training on a single workstation-class NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell 48GB GPU. This is a 3--5x training speed-up over gradient-based self-supervised learning benchmarks and substantially better training efficiency than multi-agent reinforcement-learning benchmarks. In out-of-sample tests, GradMAP also delivers among the lowest operating cost and constraint violations.

item.title: Point-MF: One-step Point Cloud Generation from a Single Image via Mean Flows
item.author: Yuta Baba, Keiji Yanai
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Point-MF是一种基于Mean-Flow的低NFE单图像点云重建框架，能够在单次网络函数评估（1-NFE）下实现快速重建。

背景: 现有的基于扩散的重建器虽然准确，但需要多次去噪迭代，导致推理慢且昂贵。

目的: 提出Point-MF框架，旨在实现低NFE（迭代次数）的单图像点云重建，平衡重建质量和推理速度。

方法: Point-MF直接在点云空间操作，学习平均速度场；采用Diffusion Transformer适配Mean-Flow设置；引入Denoised Space Anchor辅助损失以稳定大步生成。

主要发现: Point-MF在ShapeNet-R2N2和Pix3D数据集上，相比多步扩散基线和竞争性前馈模型，在重建质量和推理速度之间取得了良好平衡，且生成延迟在毫秒级。

结论: Point-MF成功实现了单步重建，具有高重建质量和极快的推理速度。

翻译: 单图像点云重建必须从单个RGB图像推断完整的3D几何形状，包括被遮挡的部分。虽然基于扩散的重建器实现了高精度，但通常需要多次去噪迭代，导致推理慢且昂贵。我们提出了Point-MF，一种基于Mean-Flow的低NFE单图像点云重建框架，将Mean-Flow兼容架构与辅助损失相结合。具体来说，Point-MF直接在点云空间操作以学习平均速度场，并允许通过单次网络函数评估（1-NFE）实现一步重建，而不依赖VAE潜变量表示。为了使Mean Flow在大间隔跳跃下有效，Point-MF采用针对Mean-Flow设置的Diffusion Transformer，通过轻量级token适配器对冻结的DINOv3图像特征进行条件化，并配备显式间隔/时间条件。此外，我们引入了Denoised Space Anchor，一种在去噪空间估计xθ上诱导的集合距离辅助损失，以稳定大步生成并减少离群值和密度伪影。在ShapeNet-R2N2和Pix3D上，与多步扩散基线和竞争性前馈模型相比，Point-MF在重建质量和推理速度之间取得了强有力的平衡，同时生成高质量的点云，延迟在毫秒级。

Abstract

Single-image point cloud reconstruction must infer complete 3D geometry, including occluded parts, from a single RGB image. While diffusion-based reconstructors achieve high accuracy, they typically require many denoising iterations, resulting in slow and expensive inference. We propose Point-MF, a Mean-Flow-based framework for low-NFE single-image point cloud reconstruction that couples a Mean-Flow-compatible architecture with an auxiliary loss. Specifically, Point-MF operates directly in point-cloud space to learn the mean velocity field and enables one-step reconstruction with a single network function evaluation (1-NFE), without relying on VAE-based latent representations. To make Mean Flow effective under large interval jumps, Point-MF employs a Diffusion Transformer tailored to the Mean-Flow setting, conditioned on frozen DINOv3 image features via a lightweight token adapter and equipped with explicit interval/time conditioning. Moreover, we introduce Denoised Space Anchor, a set-distance auxiliary loss on the denoised-space estimate $x_θ$ induced by the predicted velocity field, to stabilize large-step generation and reduce outliers and density artifacts. On ShapeNet-R2N2 and Pix3D, Point-MF strikes a strong balance between reconstruction quality and inference speed compared to multi-step diffusion baselines and competitive feedforward models, while generating high-quality point clouds with millisecond-level latency.

item.title: Quantum Kernel Advantage over Classical Collapse in Medical Foundation Model Embeddings
item.author: Sebastian Cajas Ordóñez, Felipe Ocampo Osorio, Dax Enshan Koh, Rafi Al Attrach, Aldo Marzullo, Ariel Guerra-Adames, J. Alejandro Andrade, Siong Thye Goh, Chi-Yu Chen, Rahul Gorijavolu, Xue Yang, Noah Dane Hebdon, Leo Anthony Celi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究在无噪声模拟条件下，利用量子支持向量机（QSVM）对MIMIC-CXR胸部X光片进行二分类，发现QSVM在处理少数类样本时优于传统线性SVM。

背景: 在医疗图像分类任务中，特别是使用MedSigLIP-448、RAD-DINO和ViT-patch32等医学基础模型提取的冻结嵌入特征时，评估量子核在无噪声模拟中的优势。

目的: 提出一个两层公平比较框架，以验证量子支持向量机（QSVM）在医疗图像分类任务中是否优于经典支持向量机。

方法: 使用MIMIC-CXR胸部X光片数据集，通过PCA-q特征处理，在无超参数调优的情况下，对比未调优的QSVM与未调优的线性SVM（C=1）以及调优后的RBF SVM（C-tuned）。

主要发现: 在第一层比较中，QSVM在所有18种测试配置下均赢得了少数类F1分数；在q=11时，QSVM的平均F1为0.343，而经典线性核在90-100%的种子中退化为多数类预测；在第二层比较中，QSVM在所有7种配置中均胜出；特征分析显示量子核的有效秩显著高于线性核。

结论: 量子支持向量机在医疗图像分类任务中表现出优于经典方法的性能，特别是在少数类样本的识别上，且无需超参数调优。

翻译: We provide evidence of quantum kernel advantage under noiseless simulation in binary insurance classification on MIMIC-CXR chest radiographs using quantum support vector machines (QSVM) with frozen embeddings from three medical foundation models (MedSigLIP-448, RAD-DINO, ViT-patch32). We propose a two-tier fair comparison framework in which both classifiers receive identical PCA-q features. At Tier 1 (untuned QSVM vs. untuned linear SVM, C = 1 both sides), QSVM wins minority-class F1 in all 18 tested configurations (17 at p < 0.001, 1 at p < 0.01). The classical linear kernel collapses to majority-class prediction on 90-100% of seeds at every qubit count, while QSVM maintains non-trivial recall. At q = 11 (MedSigLIP-448 plateau center), QSVM achieves mean F1 = 0.343 vs. classical F1 = 0.050 (F1 gain = +0.293, p < 0.001) without hyperparameter tuning. Under Tier 2 (untuned QSVM vs. C-tuned RBF SVM), QSVM wins all seven tested configurations (mean gain +0.068, max +0.112). Eigenspectrum analysis reveals quantum kernel effective rank reaches 69.80 at q = 11, far exceeding linear kernel rank, while classical collapse remains C-invariant. A full qubit sweep reveals architecture-dependent concentration onset across models. Code: https://github.com/sebasmos/qml-medimage

Abstract

We provide evidence of quantum kernel advantage under noiseless simulation in binary insurance classification on MIMIC-CXR chest radiographs using quantum support vector machines (QSVM) with frozen embeddings from three medical foundation models (MedSigLIP-448, RAD-DINO, ViT-patch32). We propose a two-tier fair comparison framework in which both classifiers receive identical PCA-q features. At Tier 1 (untuned QSVM vs. untuned linear SVM, C = 1 both sides), QSVM wins minority-class F1 in all 18 tested configurations (17 at p < 0.001, 1 at p < 0.01). The classical linear kernel collapses to majority-class prediction on 90-100% of seeds at every qubit count, while QSVM maintains non-trivial recall. At q = 11 (MedSigLIP-448 plateau center), QSVM achieves mean F1 = 0.343 vs. classical F1 = 0.050 (F1 gain = +0.293, p < 0.001) without hyperparameter tuning. Under Tier 2 (untuned QSVM vs. C-tuned RBF SVM), QSVM wins all seven tested configurations (mean gain +0.068, max +0.112). Eigenspectrum analysis reveals quantum kernel effective rank reaches 69.80 at q = 11, far exceeding linear kernel rank, while classical collapse remains C-invariant. A full qubit sweep reveals architecture-dependent concentration onset across models. Code: https://github.com/sebasmos/qml-medimage

item.title: Meta-CoT: Enhancing Granularity and Generalization in Image Editing
item.author: Shiyi Zhang, Yiji Cheng, Tiankai Hang, Zijin Yin, Runze He, Yu Xu, Wenxun Dai, Yunlong Lin, Chunyu Wang, Qinglin Lu, Yansong Tang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Meta-CoT的新范式，旨在通过分解思维链来提升图像编辑模型的理解粒度和泛化能力。

背景: 现有的统一多模理解/生成模型通过在思维链过程中融入细粒度理解来改善图像编辑性能，但关于何种形式的思维链和训练策略能同时增强理解粒度和泛化能力的问题尚未得到充分探索。

目的: 为了解决上述问题，本文提出了Meta-CoT范式，旨在通过两级分解策略来提升模型在图像编辑任务中的理解粒度和泛化能力。

方法: Meta-CoT包含两个关键属性：一是可分解性，将编辑意图表示为三元组，分解编辑任务和目标以生成特定任务的思维链；二是泛化性，将编辑任务分解为五个基本元任务，通过训练这些元任务来增强泛化能力。此外，引入了思维链编辑一致性奖励来对齐模型行为与思维链推理。

主要发现: 实验表明，该方法在21个编辑任务上实现了15.8%的整体提升，且在仅训练少量元任务的情况下，也能有效泛化到未见过的编辑任务。

结论: Meta-CoT通过两级分解策略和一致性奖励，显著提升了图像编辑模型的理解粒度和泛化能力，证明了其在多样化编辑任务中的有效性。

翻译: 本文提出了一种名为Meta-CoT的新范式，旨在通过分解思维链来提升图像编辑模型的理解粒度和泛化能力。现有的统一多模理解/生成模型通过在思维链过程中融入细粒度理解来改善图像编辑性能，但关于何种形式的思维链和训练策略能同时增强理解粒度和泛化能力的问题尚未得到充分探索。为了解决上述问题，本文提出了Meta-CoT范式，旨在通过两级分解策略来提升模型在图像编辑任务中的理解粒度和泛化能力。Meta-CoT包含两个关键属性：一是可分解性，将编辑意图表示为三元组，分解编辑任务和目标以生成特定任务的思维链；二是泛化性，将编辑任务分解为五个基本元任务，通过训练这些元任务来增强泛化能力。此外，引入了思维链编辑一致性奖励来对齐模型行为与思维链推理。实验表明，该方法在21个编辑任务上实现了15.8%的整体提升，且在仅训练少量元任务的情况下，也能有效泛化到未见过的编辑任务。Meta-CoT通过两级分解策略和一致性奖励，显著提升了图像编辑模型的理解粒度和泛化能力，证明了其在多样化编辑任务中的有效性。

Abstract

Unified multi-modal understanding/generative models have shown improved image editing performance by incorporating fine-grained understanding into their Chain-of-Thought (CoT) process. However, a critical question remains underexplored: what forms of CoT and training strategy can jointly enhance both the understanding granularity and generalization? To address this, we propose Meta-CoT, a paradigm that performs a two-level decomposition of any single-image editing operation with two key properties: (1) Decomposability. We observe that any editing intention can be represented as a triplet - (task, target, required understanding ability). Inspired by this, Meta-CoT decomposes both the editing task and the target, generating task-specific CoT and traversing editing operations on all targets. This decomposition enhances the model's understanding granularity of editing operations and guides it to learn each element of the triplet during training, substantially improving the editing capability. (2) Generalizability. In the second decomposition level, we further break down editing tasks into five fundamental meta-tasks. We find that training on these five meta-tasks, together with the other two elements of the triplet, is sufficient to achieve strong generalization across diverse, unseen editing tasks. To further align the model's editing behavior with its CoT reasoning, we introduce the CoT-Editing Consistency Reward, which encourages more accurate and effective utilization of CoT information during editing. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves an overall 15.8% improvement across 21 editing tasks, and generalizes effectively to unseen editing tasks when trained on only a small set of meta-tasks. Our code, benchmark, and model are released at https://shiyi-zh0408.github.io/projectpages/Meta-CoT/

item.title: Benchmarking Pathology Foundation Models for Breast Cancer Survival Prediction
item.author: Fredrik K. Gustafsson, Constance Boissin, Johan Vallon-Christersson, David A. Clifton, Mattias Rantalainen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究评估了病理学基础模型在乳腺癌生存预测任务中的表现，通过标准化流程在多个独立队列中进行外部验证。

背景: 病理学基础模型（PFMs）作为强大的预训练编码器，在计算病理学中广泛应用，但在临床有意义预测问题的系统性比较方面仍有限，特别是在外部验证背景下的生存预测。

目的: 基准测试广泛使用和最近提出的PFMs，用于从全切片组织病理学图像中进行乳腺癌生存预测。

方法: 使用基于补丁级特征提取的标准化管道和统一的生存建模框架，在三个独立临床队列（超过5400名患者）上评估模型表示。模型在一个队列上训练，在两个独立外部队列上评估。

主要发现: H-optimus-1在生存预测性能方面表现最强；第二代PFMs普遍优于第一代；许多近期PFMs之间的绝对性能差异仍然很小；紧凑的蒸馏模型H0-mini略优于其较大的教师模型H-optimus-0。

结论: 这些结果提供了PFMs在乳腺癌生存预测中的首次大规模、外部验证基准，并为在临床工作流程中高效部署PFMs提供了实用指导。

翻译: 病理学基础模型（PFMs）最近作为计算病理学强大的预训练编码器出现，能够在广泛的下游任务中进行迁移学习。然而，这些模型在临床有意义预测问题方面的系统性比较仍然有限，特别是在外部验证背景下的生存预测。在这项研究中，我们从全切片组织病理学图像中基准测试广泛使用和最近提出的PFMs，用于乳腺癌生存预测。使用基于补丁级特征提取的标准化管道和统一的生存建模框架，我们在三个独立临床队列（超过5400名患者，长期随访）上评估模型表示。模型在一个队列上训练，在两个独立外部队列上评估，从而实现跨数据集泛化的严格评估。总体而言，H-optimus-1实现了最强的生存预测性能。更广泛地说，我们观察到模型家族中一致的代际改进，第二代PFMs优于其第一代对应模型。然而，许多近期PFMs之间的绝对性能差异仍然很小，表明仅通过扩展预训练数据或模型大小无法获得进一步收益。值得注意的是，紧凑的蒸馏模型H0-mini略优于其较大的教师模型H-optimus-0，尽管它使用的参数不到8%，并且能够实现显著更快的特征提取。这些结果共同提供了PFMs在乳腺癌生存预测中的首次大规模、外部验证基准，并为在临床工作流程中高效部署PFMs提供了实用指导。

Abstract

Pathology foundation models (PFMs) have recently emerged as powerful pretrained encoders for computational pathology, enabling transfer learning across a wide range of downstream tasks. However, systematic comparisons of these models for clinically meaningful prediction problems remain limited, especially in the context of survival prediction under external validation. In this study, we benchmark widely used and recently proposed PFMs for breast cancer survival prediction from whole-slide histopathology images. Using a standardized pipeline based on patch-level feature extraction and a unified survival modeling framework, we evaluate model representations across three independent clinical cohorts comprising more than 5,400 patients with long-term follow-up. Models are trained on one cohort and evaluated on two independent external cohorts, enabling a rigorous assessment of cross-dataset generalization. Overall, H-optimus-1 achieves the strongest survival prediction performance. More broadly, we observe consistent generational improvements across model families, with second-generation PFMs outperforming their first-generation counterparts. However, absolute performance differences between many recent PFMs remain modest, suggesting diminishing returns from further scaling of pretraining data or model size alone. Notably, the compact distilled model H0-mini slightly outperforms its larger teacher model H-optimus-0, despite using fewer than 8% of the parameters and enabling significantly faster feature extraction. Together, these results provide the first large-scale, externally validated benchmark of PFMs for breast cancer survival prediction, and offer practical guidance for efficient deployment of PFMs in clinical workflows.

item.title: Learning Human-Intention Priors from Large-Scale Human Demonstrations for Robotic Manipulation
item.author: Yifan Xie, YuAn Wang, Guangyu Chen, Jinkun Liu, Yu Sun, Wenbo Ding
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MoT-HRA是一个分层视觉语言动作框架，通过大规模人类演示学习人类意图先验，将操作分解为三个耦合专家：视觉语言专家预测跨具身3D轨迹，意图专家建模MANO风格手部运动作为潜在人类运动先验，精细专家将意图感知表示映射到机器人动作块。

背景: 人类视频包含丰富的操作先验，但使用它们进行机器人学习仍然困难，因为原始观察结果纠缠了场景理解、人类运动和特定具身的动作。

目的: 引入MoT-HRA框架，从大规模人类演示中学习人类意图先验，以解决原始观察结果纠缠场景理解、人类运动和特定具身动作的问题。

方法: 1. 构建HA-2.2M数据集，包含220万episode的动作语言数据集，通过手部中心过滤、空间重建、时间分割和语言对齐从异构人类视频中重建。2. MoT-HRA将操作分解为三个耦合专家： - 视觉语言专家：预测跨具身的3D轨迹。 - 意图专家：将MANO风格的手部运动建模为潜在的人类运动先验。 - 精细专家：将意图感知的表示映射到机器人动作块。3. 使用共享注意力主干和只读键值转移，允许下游控制使用人类先验，同时限制对上游表示的干扰。

主要发现: 在手部运动生成、模拟操作和现实世界机器人任务上的实验表明，MoT-HRA提高了运动合理性和分布偏移下的鲁棒控制。

结论: MoT-HRA通过分层框架和三个耦合专家，有效利用人类先验，提升了机器人操作的合理性和鲁棒性。

翻译: 人类视频包含丰富的操作先验，但使用它们进行机器人学习仍然困难，因为原始观察结果纠缠了场景理解、人类运动和特定具身的动作。我们介绍了MoT-HRA，一个分层视觉语言动作框架，从大规模人类演示中学习人类意图先验。我们首先整理了HA-2.2M，一个220万episode的动作语言数据集，通过手部中心过滤、空间重建、时间分割和语言对齐从异构人类视频中重建。在这个数据集之上，MoT-HRA将操作分解为三个耦合专家：一个视觉语言专家预测跨具身的3D轨迹，一个意图专家将MANO风格的手部运动建模为潜在的人类运动先验，一个精细专家将意图感知的表示映射到机器人动作块。共享注意力主干和只读键值转移允许下游控制使用人类先验，同时限制对上游表示的干扰。在手部运动生成、模拟操作和现实世界机器人任务上的实验表明，MoT-HRA提高了运动合理性和分布偏移下的鲁棒控制。

Abstract

Human videos contain rich manipulation priors, but using them for robot learning remains difficult because raw observations entangle scene understanding, human motion, and embodiment-specific action. We introduce MoT-HRA, a hierarchical vision-language-action framework that learns human-intention priors from large-scale human demonstrations. We first curate HA-2.2M, a 2.2M-episode action-language dataset reconstructed from heterogeneous human videos through hand-centric filtering, spatial reconstruction, temporal segmentation, and language alignment. On top of this dataset, MoT-HRA factorizes manipulation into three coupled experts: a vision-language expert predicts an embodiment-agnostic 3D trajectory, an intention expert models MANO-style hand motion as a latent human-motion prior, and a fine expert maps the intention-aware representation to robot action chunks. A shared-attention trunk and read-only key-value transfer allow downstream control to use human priors while limiting interference with upstream representations. Experiments on hand motion generation, simulated manipulation, and real-world robot tasks show that MoT-HRA improves motion plausibility and robust control under distribution shift.

item.title: World-R1: Reinforcing 3D Constraints for Text-to-Video Generation
item.author: Weijie Wang, Xiaoxuan He, Youping Gu, Yifan Yang, Zeyu Zhang, Yefei He, Yanbo Ding, Xirui Hu, Donny Y. Chen, Zhiyuan He, Yuqing Yang, Bohan Zhuang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 World-R1 的框架，通过强化学习将视频生成与 3D 约束对齐

背景: 现有的视频基础模型在视觉合成方面表现出色，但经常出现几何不一致的问题；现有方法通过架构修改注入 3D 先验，但计算成本高且限制了可扩展性

目的: 提出 World-R1 框架，以强化学习的方式将视频生成与 3D 约束对齐，解决几何不一致问题

方法: 引入了专门用于世界模拟的纯文本数据集；利用 Flow-GRPO 优化模型，使用预训练的 3D 基础模型和视觉语言模型的反馈来强制结构一致性；采用周期性解耦训练策略来平衡刚体几何一致性与动态场景流动性

主要发现: 该方法显著增强了 3D 一致性，同时保留了基础模型的原始视觉质量

结论: 该方法有效地弥合了视频生成与可扩展世界模拟之间的差距

翻译: 最近的视频基础模型展示了令人印象深刻的视觉合成能力，但经常遭受几何不一致的困扰。虽然现有方法试图通过架构修改注入 3D 先验，但它们通常会产生高昂的计算成本并限制了可扩展性。我们提出了 World-R1，一个通过强化学习将视频生成与 3D 约束对齐的框架。为了促进这种对齐，我们引入了一个专门用于世界模拟的纯文本数据集。利用 Flow-GRPO，我们使用预训练的 3D 基础模型和视觉语言模型的反馈来优化模型，以强制结构一致性，而无需更改底层架构。我们进一步采用周期性解耦训练策略来平衡刚体几何一致性与动态场景流动性。广泛的评估表明，我们的方法显著增强了 3D 一致性，同时保留了基础模型的原始视觉质量，有效地弥合了视频生成与可扩展世界模拟之间的差距。

Abstract

Recent video foundation models demonstrate impressive visual synthesis but frequently suffer from geometric inconsistencies. While existing methods attempt to inject 3D priors via architectural modifications, they often incur high computational costs and limit scalability. We propose World-R1, a framework that aligns video generation with 3D constraints through reinforcement learning. To facilitate this alignment, we introduce a specialized pure text dataset tailored for world simulation. Utilizing Flow-GRPO, we optimize the model using feedback from pre-trained 3D foundation models and vision-language models to enforce structural coherence without altering the underlying architecture. We further employ a periodic decoupled training strategy to balance rigid geometric consistency with dynamic scene fluidity. Extensive evaluations reveal that our approach significantly enhances 3D consistency while preserving the original visual quality of the foundation model, effectively bridging the gap between video generation and scalable world simulation.

item.title: CRC-SAM: SAM-Based Multi-Modal Segmentation and Quantification of Colorectal Cancer in CT, Colonoscopy, and Histology Images
item.author: Daniel Lao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CRC-SAM是一个统一框架，用于跨结肠镜、CT和病理图像进行结直肠癌分割。

背景: 与先前的单模态方法不同，CRC-SAM在临床工作流程中提供一致且模态无关的分割。

目的: 构建一个统一的框架以实现跨不同模态的结直肠癌分割。

方法: 基于MedSAM，它将低秩适应（LoRA）层集成到冻结的编码器中，以实现高效且参数量少的域迁移。

主要发现: 在MSD-Colon、CVC-ClinicDB和EBHI-Seg数据集上的实验表明，CRC-SAM在跨模态方面优于最先进的基线，并突显了轻量级LoRA适应在基于基础模型的结直肠癌分析中的有效性。

结论: CRC-SAM通过轻量级LoRA适应，在保持编码器冻结的同时，实现了高效且有效的跨模态结直肠癌分割。

翻译: 我们提出了CRC-SAM，一个用于跨结肠镜、CT和病理图像进行结直肠癌分割的统一框架。与先前的单模态方法不同，CRC-SAM在整个临床工作流程中提供一致、模态无关的分割。它基于MedSAM构建，将低秩适应（LoRA）层集成到冻结的编码器中，使得能够以最少的可训练参数向代表性不足的模态进行高效域迁移。在MSD-Colon、CVC-ClinicDB和EBHI-Seg上的实验表明，CRC-SAM在跨模态方面优于最先进的基线，并突显了轻量级LoRA适应在基于基础模型的结直肠癌分析中的有效性。

Abstract

We present CRC-SAM, a unified framework for colorectal cancer segmentation across colonoscopy, CT, and histopathology images. Unlike prior single-modality methods, CRC-SAM provides consistent, modality-agnostic segmentation throughout the clinical workflow. Built on MedSAM, it incorporates low-rank adaptation (LoRA) layers into a frozen encoder, enabling efficient domain transfer to underrepresented modalities with minimal trainable parameters. Experiments on MSD-Colon, CVC-ClinicDB, and EBHI-Seg demonstrate superior performance across modalities, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines and highlighting the effectiveness of lightweight LoRA adaptation for foundation-model-based colorectal cancer analysis.

item.title: A multi-stage soft computing framework for complex disease modelling and decision support: A liver cirrhosis case study
item.author: Xueyuan Huang, Yuheng Wang, Yuanzhi He, Siqi Gou, Lu Bai, Wenqian Wu, Peifeng Liu, Aijia Wang, Tianhui Fan, Jiayu Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于机器学习的多阶段决策框架，用于复杂疾病的建模和治疗探索，并以肝硬化为例进行了验证。

背景: 肝硬化是全球重大健康问题，每年导致数百万人死亡。从生物医学数据建模复杂疾病面临高维性、强特征相关性、噪声和有限标记样本等计算挑战。

目的: 提出一种机器驱动多阶段决策框架，用于复杂疾病建模和治疗探索，旨在解决传统机器学习管道在稳健性、可解释性和泛化能力方面的不足。

方法: 该框架整合了单细胞转录组分析、基于网络的特征稳定化、多模型学习、深度表示构建和事后决策支持。具体包括单细胞测序数据分析、高维加权基因共表达网络分析、将表格分子特征重构为二维疾病地图并使用CNN分析，以及分子对接作为决策支持模块。

主要发现: 以肝硬化为例，该框架识别出疾病相关内皮亚群并提取了七个稳健的标志基因。CNN表示学习模块在分类任务中优于传统管道。

结论: 该框架具有疾病无关性，可轻松扩展到其他涉及不确定性、异质性和有限样本的基于组学的生物医学应用。

翻译: 肝硬化是一种全球性的重大健康问题，每年导致数百万人死亡，及时检测和积极治疗可显著改善患者的生活质量。由于高维性、强特征相关性、噪声和有限标记样本，从生物医学数据建模复杂疾病在计算上具有挑战性。传统机器学习管道在这些条件下往往在稳健性、可解释性和泛化能力方面表现不佳。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种用于复杂疾病建模和治疗探索的机器驱动多阶段决策框架。该框架整合了单细胞转录组分析、基于网络的特征稳定化、多模型学习、深度表示构建和事后决策支持。具体而言，对单细胞测序数据进行分析以识别关键细胞亚群，随后进行高维加权基因共表达网络分析以在稀疏性和噪声下稳定基因模块。为了增强非线性特征交互建模，将表格分子特征重构为二维疾病地图并使用CNN进行分析。最后，将分子对接作为决策支持模块纳入，以评估候选治疗化合物。以肝硬化为例，该框架识别出疾病相关内皮亚群并提取了七个稳健的标志基因。基于CNN的表示学习模块在分类方面优于传统管道。该框架具有疾病无关性，可轻松扩展到其他涉及不确定性、异质性和有限样本的基于组学的生物医学应用。

Abstract

Liver cirrhosis is a major global health problem causing millions of deaths annually, and timely detection with aggressive treatment can significantly improve patients' quality of life. Modelling complex diseases from biomedical data is computationally challenging due to high dimensionality, strong feature correlations, noise, and limited labelled samples. Conventional Machine Learning (ML) pipelines often struggle with robustness, interpretability, and generalisation under such conditions. In this study, we propose an ML-driven multi-stage decision framework for complex disease modelling and therapeutic exploration. The framework integrates single-cell transcriptomic profiling, high-dimensional network-based feature stabilisation, multi-model learning, deep representation construction, and post-hoc decision support. Specifically, single-cell sequencing data were analysed to identify key cellular subpopulations, followed by high-dimensional weighted gene co-expression network analysis (hdWGCNA) to stabilise gene modules under sparsity and noise. To enhance non-linear feature interaction modelling, tabular molecular features were restructured into two-dimensional disease maps and analysed using a CNN. Finally, molecular docking was incorporated as a decision-support module to evaluate candidate therapeutic compounds. Using liver cirrhosis as a representative case, the framework identified a disease-associated endothelial subpopulation and extracted seven robust signature genes (HSPB1, GADD45A, CLDN5, ATP1B3, C1QBP, ENPP2, and PARL). The CNN-based representation learning module outperformed conventional pipelines in classification. The framework is disease-agnostic and readily extends to other omics-driven biomedical applications involving uncertainty, heterogeneity, and limited samples.

item.title: Time-varying Interaction Graph ODE for Dynamic Graph Representation Learning
item.author: Xiaoyi Wang, Zhiqiang Wang, Jianqing Liang, Xingwang Zhao, Chuangyin Dang, Zhen Jin, Jiye Liang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Graph neural ODE结合了神经ODE与图神经网络的消息传递机制，为图表示学习提供了一种连续时间建模方法。

背景: 在动态图场景中，现有的图神经ODE通常采用统一的消息传递机制，假设节点间的交互在任何时间都共享相同的消息传递函数，这难以捕捉节点间交互模式的多样性和时变性。

目的: 为了解决上述问题，提出Time-varying Interaction Graph Ordinary Differential Equations (TI-ODE)。

方法: TI-ODE的核心思想是将图ODE的演化函数分解为一组可学习的交互基函数，每个基函数对应一种不同的节点间交互类型。这些基函数通过时间相关的可学习权重动态组合，使节点间交互模式能够随时间自适应演化。

主要发现: 在六个动态图数据集上的实验结果表明，TI-ODE始终优于现有方法，在属性预测任务上达到最先进性能；在Covid数据集上的实验进一步验证了TI-ODE的可解释性和泛化能力；理论和实证表明，TI-ODE比使用统一消息传递机制的模型表现出更强的鲁棒性。

结论: TI-ODE通过分解演化函数和动态组合基函数，有效捕捉了节点间交互模式的多样性和时变性，在性能和鲁棒性上均表现出色。

翻译: Graph neural ODE结合了神经ODE与图神经网络的消息传递机制，为图表示学习提供了一种连续时间建模方法。然而，在动态图场景中，现有的图神经ODE通常采用统一的消息传递机制，假设节点间的交互在任何时间都共享相同的消息传递函数，这难以捕捉节点间交互模式的多样性和时变性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Time-varying Interaction Graph Ordinary Differential Equations (TI-ODE)。TI-ODE的核心思想是将图ODE的演化函数分解为一组可学习的交互基函数，每个基函数对应一种不同的节点间交互类型。这些基函数通过时间相关的可学习权重动态组合，使节点间交互模式能够随时间自适应演化。在六个动态图数据集上的实验结果表明，TI-ODE始终优于现有方法，在属性预测任务上达到最先进性能；在Covid数据集上的实验进一步验证了TI-ODE的可解释性和泛化能力。此外，我们从理论和实证上证明了TI-ODE比使用统一消息传递机制的模型表现出更强的鲁棒性。

Abstract

Graph neural Ordinary Differential Equations (ODE) combine neural ODE with the message passing mechanism of Graph Neural Networks (GNN), providing a continuous-time modeling method for graph representation learning. However, in dynamic graph scenarios, existing graph neural ODEs typically employ a unified message passing mechanism, assuming that inter-node interactions share the same message passing function at any time, which makes it challenging to capture the diversity and time-varying nature of inter-node interaction patterns. To address this, we propose Time-varying Interaction Graph Ordinary Differential Equations (TI-ODE). The core idea of TI-ODE is to decompose the evolution function of a graph ODE into a set of learnable interaction basis functions, where each basis function corresponds to a distinct type of inter-node interaction. These basis functions are dynamically combined through time-dependent learnable weights, enabling inter-node interaction patterns to adaptively evolve over time. Experimental results on six dynamic graph datasets demonstrate that TI-ODE consistently outperforms existing methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance on attribute prediction tasks, and experiments on the \textit{Covid} dataset further verify the interpretability and generalizability of our TI-ODE. Furthermore, we demonstrate both theoretically and empirically that TI-ODE exhibits superior robustness compared to models utilizing a unified message-passing mechanism.

item.title: Programming with Data: Test-Driven Data Engineering for Self-Improving LLMs from Raw Corpora
item.author: Chenkai Pan, Xinglong Xu, Yuhang Xu, Yujun Wu, Siyuan Li, Jintao Chen, Conghui He, Jingxuan Wei, Cheng Tan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为'数据编程'的方法，通过将结构化知识表示作为训练数据和评估的共同基础，将数据工程生命周期映射到软件开发生命周期中，从而实现模型训练、编译、单元测试和调试的对应，并展示了该方法在多个学科领域的应用和效果。

背景: 将专门的人类知识从文本可靠地转移到大型语言模型中仍然是一个基本挑战。虽然领域语料库的微调带来了显著的能力提升，但该过程缺乏反馈：当模型在领域任务上失败时，没有方法来诊断训练数据中缺乏什么，唯一的补救措施是盲目地添加更多数据。

目的: 本文旨在展示当从源语料库提取的结构化知识表示作为训练数据和评估的共同基础时，完整的数据工程生命周期可以精确且可操作地映射到软件开发生命周期中。

方法: 本文将模型训练视为编译，基准测试视为单元测试，而由失败驱动的数据修复视为调试。通过这种对应关系，模型失败被分解为概念级差距和推理链断裂，这些可以追溯到数据中的具体缺陷，并通过针对性补丁进行修复。

主要发现: 每个修复循环都能产生跨模型规模和架构的一致改进，而不会降低通用能力。本文在涵盖自然科学、工程、生物医学和社会科学的十六个学科中实例化了这一原则，并发布了结构化知识库、基准套件和训练语料库作为开放资源。

结论: 这项工作通过证明训练数据与模型行为之间的关系在结构上是可追溯的和可系统修复的，为将人类专业知识可靠地工程化到语言模型中建立了一个原则性基础。

翻译: 将专门的人类知识从文本可靠地转移到大型语言模型中仍然是一个基本挑战。领域语料库的微调带来了显著的能力提升，但该过程缺乏反馈：当模型在领域任务上失败时，没有方法来诊断训练数据中缺乏什么，唯一的补救措施是盲目地添加更多数据。本文展示了当从源语料库提取的结构化知识表示作为训练数据和评估的共同基础时，完整的数据工程生命周期可以精确且可操作地映射到软件开发生命周期中：训练数据成为指定模型应学习内容的源代码，模型训练成为编译，基准测试成为单元测试，而由失败驱动的数据修复成为调试。在这种对应关系下，模型失败被分解为概念级差距和推理链断裂，这些可以追溯到数据中的具体缺陷，并通过针对性补丁进行修复，每个修复循环都能产生跨模型规模和架构的一致改进，而不会降低通用能力。本文将这一原则形式化为'数据编程'，并在涵盖自然科学、工程、生物医学和社会科学的十六个学科中实例化了它，发布了结构化知识库、基准套件和训练语料库作为开放资源。通过证明训练数据与模型行为之间的关系在结构上是可追溯的和可系统修复的，这项工作为将人类专业知识可靠地工程化到语言模型中建立了一个原则性基础。

Abstract

Reliably transferring specialized human knowledge from text into large language models remains a fundamental challenge in artificial intelligence. Fine-tuning on domain corpora has enabled substantial capability gains, but the process operates without feedback: when a model fails on a domain task, there is no method to diagnose what is deficient in the training data, and the only recourse is to add more data indiscriminately. Here we show that when a structured knowledge representation extracted from the source corpus serves as the shared foundation for both training data and evaluation, the complete data-engineering lifecycle maps onto the software development lifecycle in a precise and operative way: training data becomes source code specifying what the model should learn, model training becomes compilation, benchmarking becomes unit testing, and failure-driven data repair becomes debugging. Under this correspondence, model failures decompose into concept-level gaps and reasoning-chain breaks that can be traced back to specific deficiencies in the data and repaired through targeted patches, with each repair cycle producing consistent improvements across model scales and architectures without degrading general capabilities. We formalize this principle as Programming with Data and instantiate it across sixteen disciplines spanning the natural sciences, engineering, biomedicine, and the social sciences, releasing a structured knowledge base, benchmark suite, and training corpus as open resources. By demonstrating that the relationship between training data and model behaviour is structurally traceable and systematically repairable, this work establishes a principled foundation for the reliable engineering of human expertise into language models.

item.title: A systematic literature Review for Transformer-based Software Vulnerability detection
item.author: Fiza Naseer, Javed Ali Khan, Muhammad Yaqoob, Alexios Mylonas, Ishaya Gambo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究对2021年至2025年间利用Transformer模型进行软件漏洞识别的80项研究进行了系统性文献综述。

背景: 软件漏洞对软件系统构成重大安全威胁，特别是在医疗、政府和金融等日常生活的各个领域。Transformer模型因其强大的上下文建模和表示学习能力，在自动软件漏洞识别方面显示出有前景的结果。

目的: 尽管已有许多系统性文献综述考察了机器学习和深度学习方法，但针对Transformer模型的分析仍有待探索。本研究旨在填补这一空白。

方法: 采用Kitchenham的系统性文献综述指南，从研究趋势、数据集和来源、编程语言、Transformer框架、检测细节级别、评估指标、参考模型、漏洞类型和实验配置等多个角度对现有研究进行了系统评估。

主要发现: 将Transformer模型分为编码器、解码器和组合架构，分析了在源代码、日志和智能合约上使用的预训练和微调版本。研究强调了当前的研究趋势、常用基准和主要基线，并揭示了数据不平衡、可解释性、可扩展性和跨编程语言泛化等关键技术问题。

结论: 通过整合现有证据并识别未解决的问题，本研究为研究人员和专业人士提供了宝贵的资源，有助于开发更可靠、精确和可解释的基于Transformer的漏洞识别系统。

翻译: Context: Software vulnerabilities pose significant security threats to software systems, especially as software is increasingly used across many areas of daily life, including health, government, and finance. Recently, transformer-based models have demonstrated promising results in automatic software vulnerability identification due to their robust contextual modelling and representation learning capabilities. Objectives: While numerous systematic literature reviews (SLRs) have examined machine learning and deep learning methods for identifying vulnerabilities, a more transformer-centric analysis remains to be explored. This SLR critically analysed 80 studies published between 2021 and 2025 that utilised transformer models to identify software vulnerabilities. Methods: Using Kitchenhams SLR guidelines, we methodically evaluate current research from various perspectives, encompassing study trends, datasets and sources, programming languages, transformer frameworks, detection detail levels, assessment metrics, reference models, types of vulnerabilities, and experimental configurations. Results: We classify transformer models into encoder, decoder, and combined architectures and analyse both pre-trained and fine-tuned versions utilized on source code, logs, and smart contracts. The results emphasise prevailing research trends, frequently utilised benchmarks, and main baselines. It also uncovers crucial technical issues like data imbalance, interpretability, scalability, and generalization across programming languages. Conclusion: By integrating current evidence and recognising unaddressed research areas, this SLR provides a consolidated resource for researchers and professionals seeking to develop more reliable, precise, and interpretable transformer-based vulnerability identification systems.

Abstract

Context: Software vulnerabilities pose significant security threats to software systems, especially as software is increasingly used across many areas of daily life, including health, government, and finance. Recently, transformer-based models have demonstrated promising results in automatic software vulnerability identification due to their robust contextual modelling and representation learning capabilities. Objectives: While numerous systematic literature reviews (SLRs) have examined machine learning and deep learning methods for identifying vulnerabilities, a more transformer-centric analysis remains to be explored. This SLR critically analysed 80 studies published between 2021 and 2025 that utilised transformer models to identify software vulnerabilities. Methods: Using Kitchenhams SLR guidelines, we methodically evaluate current research from various perspectives, encompassing study trends, datasets and sources, programming languages, transformer frameworks, detection detail levels, assessment metrics, reference models, types of vulnerabilities, and experimental configurations. Results: We classify transformer models into encoder, decoder, and combined architectures and analyse both pre-trained and fine-tuned versions utilized on source code, logs, and smart contracts. The results emphasise prevailing research trends, frequently utilised benchmarks, and main baselines. It also uncovers crucial technical issues like data imbalance, interpretability, scalability, and generalization across programming languages. Conclusion: By integrating current evidence and recognising unaddressed research areas, this SLR provides a consolidated resource for researchers and professionals seeking to develop more reliable, precise, and interpretable transformer-based vulnerability identification systems.

item.title: Co-Director: Agentic Generative Video Storytelling
item.author: Yale Song, Yiwen Song, Nick Losier, Nathan Hodson, Ye Jin, Rhyard Zhu, Yan Xu, Daniel Vlasic, Carina Claassen, Jasmine Leon, Khanh G. LeViet, Zack Chomyn, Joe Timmons, Brett Slatkin, Scott Penberthy, Tomas Pfister
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Co-Director是一个分层多智能体框架，用于将扩散模型生成的视频片段转化为连贯的故事讲述引擎，通过全局优化问题形式化视频故事讲述，并引入分层参数化方法确保语义连贯性。

背景: 当前基于代理的管道通过链式模块自动化视频故事讲述，但存在语义漂移和级联失败的问题，这是因为独立的手工提示导致。

目的: 提出Co-Director框架，将视频故事讲述形式化为全局优化问题，以解决语义连贯性问题，并平衡探索新颖叙事策略与利用有效创意配置。

方法: 引入分层参数化：多臂老虎机全局识别有前景的创意方向，局部多模态自精炼循环缓解身份漂移并确保序列级一致性。

主要发现: Co-Director显著优于最先进的基线，提供了一种原则性的方法，能够无缝泛化到更广泛的电影叙事。

结论: Co-Director框架有效解决了视频故事讲述中的语义连贯性问题，并在GenAD-Bench数据集上表现出色，能够处理个性化广告的虚构产品场景。

翻译: 虽然扩散模型生成高保真视频片段，但将其转化为连贯的故事讲述引擎仍然具有挑战性。当前的代理管道通过链式模块自动化这一过程，但由于独立的手工提示，它们遭受语义漂移和级联失败的困扰。我们提出了Co-Director，一个分层多代理框架，将视频故事讲述形式化为全局优化问题。为了确保语义连贯性，我们引入了分层参数化：多臂老虎机全局识别有前景的创意方向，而局部多模态自精炼循环缓解身份漂移并确保序列级一致性。这平衡了新颖叙事策略的探索与有效创意配置的利用。为了评估，我们引入了GenAD-Bench，一个用于个性化广告的400个虚构产品场景数据集。实验表明，Co-Director显著优于最先进的基线，提供了一种原则性的方法，能够无缝泛化到更广泛的电影叙事。

Abstract

While diffusion models generate high-fidelity video clips, transforming them into coherent storytelling engines remains challenging. Current agentic pipelines automate this via chained modules but suffer from semantic drift and cascading failures due to independent, handcrafted prompting. We present Co-Director, a hierarchical multi-agent framework formalizing video storytelling as a global optimization problem. To ensure semantic coherence, we introduce hierarchical parameterization: a multi-armed bandit globally identifies promising creative directions, while a local multimodal self-refinement loop mitigates identity drift and ensures sequence-level consistency. This balances the exploration of novel narrative strategies with the exploitation of effective creative configurations. For evaluation, we introduce GenAD-Bench, a 400-scenario dataset of fictional products for personalized advertising. Experiments demonstrate that Co-Director significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, offering a principled approach that seamlessly generalizes to broader cinematic narratives. Project Page: https://co-director-agent.github.io/

item.title: Safety Drift After Fine-Tuning: Evidence from High-Stakes Domains
item.author: Emaan Bilal Khan, Amy Winecoff, Miranda Bogen, Dylan Hadfield-Menell
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究探讨了基础模型在特定领域微调后的安全性变化，发现微调会导致安全行为的不稳定性和矛盾变化。

背景: 基础模型通常被微调用于特定领域，但安全评估通常仅针对基础模型进行，隐含假设安全属性在下游适应中保持不变。

目的: 通过分析100个模型（包括广泛部署的微调模型和开放基础模型的控制适应）来检验这一假设。

方法: 在通用和特定领域的安全基准测试中，对100个模型（包括医疗和法律领域的微调模型及开放基础模型）进行了安全性分析。

主要发现: 良性微调在测量的安全性上引起大范围、异质且往往矛盾的变化：模型在部分指标上改善，而在其他指标上退化，且评估结果存在显著分歧。

结论: 安全行为在普通下游适应中不稳定，基于基础模型评估的治理和部署实践存在不足，忽视了对微调模型在部署相关情境下的显式重新评估，导致对下游风险的管控不足，特别是在高风险情境下，这挑战了当前的责任制范式。

翻译: 基础模型通常被微调用于特定领域，但安全评估通常仅针对基础模型进行，隐含假设安全属性在下游适应中保持不变。我们通过分析100个模型（包括广泛部署的微调模型和开放基础模型的控制适应）来检验这一假设。在通用和特定领域的安全基准测试中，我们发现良性微调在测量的安全性上引起大范围、异质且往往矛盾的变化：模型在部分指标上改善，而在其他指标上退化，且评估结果存在显著分歧。这些结果表明安全行为在普通下游适应中不稳定，引发了关于以基础模型评估为中心的治理和部署实践的关键问题。如果没有在部署相关情境下对微调模型进行显式重新评估，这些方法无法充分管理下游风险，忽视了实际伤害来源——这些失败在高风险情境中尤为重要，并挑战了当前的责任制范式。

Abstract

Foundation models are routinely fine-tuned for use in particular domains, yet safety assessments are typically conducted only on base models, implicitly assuming that safety properties persist through downstream adaptation. We test this assumption by analyzing the safety behavior of 100 models, including widely deployed fine-tunes in the medical and legal domains as well as controlled adaptations of open foundation models alongside their bases. Across general-purpose and domain-specific safety benchmarks, we find that benign fine-tuning induces large, heterogeneous, and often contradictory changes in measured safety: models frequently improve on some instruments while degrading on others, with substantial disagreement across evaluations. These results show that safety behavior is not stable under ordinary downstream adaptation, raising critical questions about governance and deployment practices centered on base-model evaluations. Without explicit re-evaluation of fine-tuned models in deployment-relevant contexts, such approaches fall short of adequately managing downstream risk, overlooking practical sources of harm -- failures that are especially consequential in high-stakes settings and challenge current accountability paradigms.

item.title: Generative diffusion models for spatiotemporal influenza forecasting
item.author: Joseph Lemaitre, Justin Lessler
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Influpaint是一种基于去噪扩散概率模型的流行病预测方法，通过将流感季节编码为时空图像，从混合数据集中学习疾病动力学分布，并将其视为从部分观测中进行条件生成的任务。

背景: 流行病预测对公共卫生规划至关重要，但由于流行病动力学复杂，当前机制性和统计方法往往难以捕捉多模态不确定性或新兴趋势。

目的: 开发一种能够捕捉流行病动力学时空结构并提供概率性流行病预测灵活框架的方法。

方法: Influpaint采用去噪扩散概率模型，将流感季节编码为像素强度代表发病率的时空图像，从包含30%监测轨迹和70%模拟轨迹的混合数据集中学习丰富的分布。

主要发现: 在2023-2025年美国CDC FluSight挑战赛中的实时评估显示，Influpaint在多个季节的表现显著提高，2024-2025年的预测高度准确但略显过度自信；在回顾性评估中，其预测准确性可与领先的集成方法相媲美。

结论: 扩散模型能够捕捉流感动力学中的重要时空结构，为概率性流行病预测提供了灵活框架。

翻译: 预测传染病发病率可以为公共卫生规划提供重要信息，但由于流行病动力学复杂，这很难实现。当前的机制性和统计方法往往难以捕捉多模态不确定性或新兴趋势。Influpaint采用去噪扩散概率模型来适应流行病预测。通过将流感季节编码为像素强度代表发病率的时空图像，Influpaint从监测和模拟轨迹的混合数据集中学习丰富的疾病动力学分布。预测被表述为从部分观测中进行条件生成（修复）任务。我们表明，Influpaint生成逼真、多样化的流行病轨迹，并在回顾性评估中实现了可与领先的集成方法相媲美的预测准确性。在2023-2025年美国CDC FluSight挑战赛中的实时评估显示，性能在多个季节显著提高，2024-2025年的预测高度准确但略显过度自信。最佳性能是在包含30%监测轨迹和70%模拟轨迹的训练数据集上实现的。这些结果表明，扩散模型能够捕捉流感动力学中的重要时空结构，并为概率性流行病预测提供了灵活框架。

Abstract

Forecasting infectious disease incidence can provide important information to guide public health planning, yet is difficult because epidemic dynamics are complex. Current mechanistic and statistical approaches often struggle to capture multimodal uncertainty or emergent trends. Influpaint adapts denoising diffusion probabilistic models to epidemic forecasting. By encoding influenza seasons as spatiotemporal images in which pixel intensity represents incidence, Influpaint learns a rich distribution of disease dynamics from a hybrid dataset of surveillance and simulated trajectories. Forecasting is formulated as a conditional generation (inpainting) task from partial observations. We show that Influpaint generates realistic, diverse epidemic trajectories and achieves forecast accuracy that is competitive with leading ensemble methods in retrospective evaluation. In real-time evaluation during the 2023--2025 U.S. CDC FluSight challenges, performance improved substantially across seasons, with highly accurate but somewhat overconfident projections in 2024--2025. The best performance was achieved with a training dataset containing 30% surveillance and 70% simulated trajectories. These results show that diffusion models can capture important spatiotemporal structure in influenza dynamics and provide a flexible framework for probabilistic infectious disease forecasting.

item.title: Agentic AI for Remote Sensing: Technical Challenges and Research Directions
item.author: Muhammad Akhtar Munir, Muhammad Umer Sheikh, Akashah Shabbir, Muhammad Haris Khan, Fahad Khan, Xiao Xiang Zhu, Begum Demir, Salman Khan
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该论文提出地球观测（EO）代理需要重新设计，以应对多步骤分析工作流中数据、工具和地理空间状态的协调推理挑战，强调结构化地理空间状态、工具感知推理、验证器引导执行以及与地理空间和物理有效性一致的学习目标的重要性。

背景: 地球观测正从静态预测转向多步骤分析工作流，需要协调数据、工具和地理空间状态的推理。虽然基础模型和视觉语言模型扩展了表示学习和语言引导交互，代理AI展示了长期推理和外部工具使用，但地球观测并非通用代理AI的简单扩展。

目的: 识别通用代理模型中常见的隐含假设，分析这些假设在地理空间工作流中如何失效，并表征多步骤地球观测管道中由此产生的失效模式。

方法: 提出以结构化地理空间状态、工具感知推理、验证器引导执行以及与地理空间和物理有效性一致的学习目标为中心的地球观测原生代理设计原则。

主要发现: 地球观测工作流中的挑战是结构性的而非偶然的，错误可能在步骤间静默传播，正确性不仅取决于内部一致性，还取决于地理空间一致性、时间有效比较和物理有效性。

结论: 构建可靠的地理空间代理需要围绕支配地球观测分析的物质、地理空间和工作流约束重新思考代理设计。

翻译: 地球观测正从静态预测转向需要协调数据、工具和地理空间状态推理的多步骤分析工作流。虽然基础模型和视觉语言模型扩展了遥感表示学习和语言引导交互，代理AI展示了长期推理和外部工具使用，但地球观测并非通用代理AI的简单扩展。地球观测工作流在地理参考、多模态和时间结构化数据上运行，重投影、重采样、合成和聚合等操作会主动转换底层状态并可能限制后续分析。因此，错误可能在步骤间静默传播，正确性不仅取决于内部一致性，还取决于地理空间一致性、时间有效比较和物理有效性。本文认为这些挑战是结构性的而非偶然的。我们识别了通用代理模型中常见的隐含假设，分析了这些假设在地理空间工作流中如何失效，并表征了多步骤地球观测管道中由此产生的失效模式。然后，我们概述了以结构化地理空间状态、工具感知推理、验证器引导执行以及与地理空间和物理有效性一致的学习目标为中心的地球观测原生代理设计原则。最后，我们提出了涵盖地球观测特定基准、混合监督和强化学习、约束自改进以及超越最终答案准确性的轨迹级评估的研究方向。因此，构建可靠的地理空间代理需要围绕支配地球观测分析的物质、地理空间和工作流约束重新思考代理设计。

Abstract

Earth Observation (EO) is moving beyond static prediction toward multi-step analytical workflows that require coordinated reasoning over data, tools, and geospatial state. While foundation models and vision-language models have expanded representation learning and language-grounded interaction for remote sensing, and agentic AI has demonstrated long-horizon reasoning and external tool use, EO is not a straightforward extension of generic agentic AI. EO workflows operate over georeferenced, multi-modal, and temporally structured data, where operations such as reprojection, resampling, compositing, and aggregation actively transform the underlying state and can constrain subsequent analysis. As a result, errors may propagate silently across steps, and correctness depends not only on internal coherence, but also on geospatial consistency, temporally valid comparisons, and physical validity. This position paper argues that these challenges are structural rather than incidental. We identify the implicit assumptions commonly made in generic agentic models, analyze how they break in geospatial workflows, and characterize the resulting failure modes in multi-step EO pipelines. We then outline design principles for EO-native agents centered on structured geospatial state, tool-aware reasoning, verifier-guided execution, and learning objectives aligned with geospatial and physical validity. Finally, we present research directions spanning EO-specific benchmarks, hybrid supervised and reinforcement learning, constrained self-improvement, and trajectory-level evaluation beyond final-answer accuracy. Building reliable geospatial agents therefore requires rethinking agent design around the physical, geospatial, and workflow constraints that govern EO analysis.

item.title: S-SONDO: Self-Supervised Knowledge Distillation for General Audio Foundation Models
item.author: Mohammed Ali El Adlouni, Aurian Quelennec, Pierre Chouteau, Geoffroy Peeters, Slim Essid
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: S-SONDO 是首个仅利用输出嵌入对通用音频基础模型进行知识蒸馏的框架，实现了模型压缩与性能保留。

背景: 通用音频基础模型参数量巨大，导致推理成本高且难以在边缘设备部署。现有知识蒸馏方法多依赖监督设置和特定架构假设，如依赖类别 logits 或中间特征。

目的: 提出 S-SONDO 框架，旨在仅利用输出嵌入对通用音频模型进行知识蒸馏，以实现模型压缩并保持高性能。

方法: S-SONDO 框架通过避免对 logits 或层级对齐的依赖，实现了架构无关性，并广泛适用于基于嵌入的教师模型。

主要发现: 将两个音频基础模型蒸馏为三个高效学生模型，学生模型比教师模型小 61 倍，同时保留了高达 96% 的教师性能。

结论: S-SONDO 提供了关于损失函数选择和基于聚类的平衡数据采样的实用见解，代码已开源。

翻译: 通用音频基础模型最近取得了显著进展，能够在各种任务中表现出色。然而，最先进的模型仍然非常庞大，通常拥有数亿个参数，导致推理成本高昂且在边缘设备上的部署能力有限。知识蒸馏是一种经过验证的模型压缩策略，但音频领域的先前工作大多集中在监督设置上，依赖于类别 logits、中间特征或特定的架构技术。这些假设排除了仅输出嵌入的模型，如自监督或度量学习模型。我们介绍了 S-SONDO（通用音频基础模型的自我监督知识蒸馏），这是第一个仅使用其输出嵌入来蒸馏通用音频模型的框架。通过避免对 logits 或层级对齐的需求，S-SONDO 是架构无关的，并广泛适用于基于嵌入的教师模型。我们通过将两个音频基础模型蒸馏为三个高效学生模型来展示其有效性，学生模型比教师模型小 61 倍，同时保留了高达 96% 的教师性能。我们还提供了关于损失函数选择和基于聚类的平衡数据采样的实用见解。代码可在 https://github.com/MedAliAdlouni/ssondo 获取。

Abstract

General audio foundation models have recently achieved remarkable progress, enabling strong performance across diverse tasks. However, state-of-the-art models remain extremely large, often with hundreds of millions of parameters, leading to high inference costs and limited deployability on edge devices. Knowledge distillation is a proven strategy for model compression, but prior work in audio has mostly focused on supervised settings, relying on class logits, intermediate features, or architecture-specific techniques. Such assumptions exclude models that output only embeddings, such as self-supervised or metric-learning models. We introduce S-SONDO (Self-Supervised KnOwledge DistillatioN for General AuDio FOundation Models), the first framework to distill general audio models using only their output embeddings. By avoiding the need for logits or layer-level alignment, S-SONDO is architecture-agnostic and broadly applicable to embedding-based teachers. We demonstrate its effectiveness by distilling two audio foundation models into three efficient students that are up to 61 times smaller while retaining up to 96% of teacher performance. We also provide practical insights on loss choice and clustering-based balanced data sampling. Code is available here: https://github.com/MedAliAdlouni/ssondo.

item.title: CAN-QA: A Question-Answering Benchmark for Reasoning over In-Vehicle CAN Traffic
item.author: Jing Chen, Abhijay Deevi, Onat Gungor, Tajana Rosing
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了CAN-QA基准，将CAN流量分析重新定义为问答任务，以解决现有方法在处理时间关系和推理方面的不足。

背景: CAN协议缺乏内置安全机制，现有入侵检测方法主要将其视为分类任务，忽略了流量时间关系和关系结构，且与实际取证工作流程不匹配。

目的: 引入CAN-QA基准，将CAN流量分析重新定义为问答任务，以更好地捕捉流量的语义和时间属性。

方法: 将原始CAN日志转换为时间分段窗口，应用确定性基于规则的模板生成自然语言问题及自动推导的答案，构建了包含33,128对QA对的数据集。

主要发现: 大型语言模型虽然能捕捉表面统计规律，但在时间推理、多条件推断和高层行为解释方面存在困难。

结论: CAN-QA基准验证了将CAN流量分析作为问答任务的可行性，并指出了当前模型在处理复杂推理任务上的局限性。

翻译: 控制器局域网（CAN）是一种关键车辆通信协议，缺乏内置安全机制，因此入侵检测至关重要。现有方法主要将CAN入侵检测表述为分类任务，将复杂的交通模式映射到攻击标签。然而，这种表述抽象了CAN流量的时间和关系结构，与需要系统推理流量行为的现实世界取证工作流程不匹配。为了填补这一空白，我们介绍了CAN-QA，这是第一个将CAN流量分析重新表述为问答（QA）任务的基准。CAN-QA将原始CAN日志转换为时间分段窗口，并应用确定性基于规则的模板生成自然语言问题，并配以自动推导的答案。由此产生的数据集包含10个类别的33,128对QA对，每个类别针对CAN流量的不同语义和时间属性。使用CAN-QA，我们在真/假和多项选择格式下评估了大型语言模型。我们的结果表明，虽然这些模型捕捉到了表面的统计规律，但在时间推理、多条件推断和高层行为解释方面存在困难。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Kriiiiss/CAN-QA 获取。

Abstract

The Controller Area Network (CAN) is a safety-critical in-vehicle communication protocol that lacks built-in security mechanisms, making intrusion detection essential. Existing approaches predominantly formulate CAN intrusion detection as a classification task, mapping complex traffic patterns to attack labels. However, this formulation abstracts away the temporal and relational structure of CAN traffic and misaligns with real-world forensic workflows, which require systematic reasoning about traffic behavior. To address this gap, we introduce CAN-QA, the first benchmark that reformulates CAN traffic analysis as a question-answering (QA) task. CAN-QA converts raw CAN logs into temporally segmented windows and applies deterministic rule-based templates to generate natural-language questions paired with automatically derived ground-truth answers. The resulting dataset comprises 33,128 QA pairs across 10 categories, each targeting distinct semantic and temporal properties of CAN traffic. Using CAN-QA, we evaluate large language models across both True/False and multiple-choice formats. Our results indicate that, although these models capture superficial statistical regularities, they struggle with temporal reasoning, multi-condition inference, and higher-level behavioral interpretation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Kriiiiss/CAN-QA.

item.title: DouC: Dual-Branch CLIP for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
item.author: Mohamad Zamini, Diksha Shukla
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 DouC 的训练无关双分支 CLIP 框架，用于开放词汇语义分割，通过两个互补组件提升预测性能。

背景: 现有的基于 CLIP 的训练无关方法通常依赖单一推理机制，难以同时处理不可靠的局部标记和空间连贯性不足的问题。

目的: 解决开放词汇语义分割中局部标记不可靠和空间连贯性不足的问题，同时保持 CLIP 的零样本泛化能力。

方法: 提出 DouC 框架，包含 OG-CLIP（通过轻量级门控机制提高补丁级可靠性）和 FADE-CLIP（通过冻结视觉基础模型引导的代理注意力注入外部结构先验），并在对数概率级别融合两个分支，可选实例感知校正作为后处理。

主要发现: 在八个基准测试和多个 CLIP 后端上进行了广泛实验，DouC 一致地优于先前的训练无关方法，并随着模型容量的增加而良好扩展。

结论: DouC 引入了额外的可学习参数，不需要重新训练，并保留了 CLIP 的零样本泛化能力。

翻译: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation requires assigning pixel-level semantic labels while supporting an open and unrestricted set of categories. Training-free CLIP-based approaches preserve strong zero-shot generalization but typically rely on a single inference mechanism, limiting their ability to jointly address unreliable local tokens and insufficient spatial coherence. We propose DouC, a training-free dual-branch CLIP framework that decomposes dense prediction into two complementary components. OG-CLIP improves patch-level reliability via lightweight, inference-time token gating, while FADE-CLIP injects external structural priors through proxy attention guided by frozen vision foundation models. The two branches are fused at the logit level, enabling local token reliability and structure-aware patch interactions to jointly influence final predictions, with optional instance-aware correction applied as post-processing. DouC introduces no additional learnable parameters, requires no retraining, and preserves CLIP's zero-shot generalization. Extensive experiments across eight benchmarks and multiple CLIP backbones demonstrate that DouC consistently outperforms prior training-free methods and scales favorably with model capacity.

Abstract

Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation requires assigning pixel-level semantic labels while supporting an open and unrestricted set of categories. Training-free CLIP-based approaches preserve strong zero-shot generalization but typically rely on a single inference mechanism, limiting their ability to jointly address unreliable local tokens and insufficient spatial coherence. We propose DouC, a training-free dual-branch CLIP framework that decomposes dense prediction into two complementary components. OG-CLIP improves patch-level reliability via lightweight, inference-time token gating, while FADE-CLIP injects external structural priors through proxy attention guided by frozen vision foundation models. The two branches are fused at the logit level, enabling local token reliability and structure-aware patch interactions to jointly influence final predictions, with optional instance-aware correction applied as post-processing. DouC introduces no additional learnable parameters, requires no retraining, and preserves CLIP's zero-shot generalization. Extensive experiments across eight benchmarks and multiple CLIP backbones demonstrate that DouC consistently outperforms prior training-free methods and scales favorably with model capacity.

item.title: Why Search When You Can Transfer? Amortized Agentic Workflow Design from Structural Priors
item.author: Shiyi Du, Jiayuan Liu, Weihua Du, Yue Huang, Jiayi Li, Yingtao Luo, Xiangliang Zhang, Vincent Conitzer, Carl Kingsford
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SWIFT框架通过利用可重用的结构先验，避免了传统基于迭代的搜索方法，实现了高效的工作流设计。

背景: 现有的自动化代理工作流设计依赖于针对每个任务的迭代搜索，计算成本高昂，且无法跨任务复用结构知识。

目的: 提出SWIFT（Synthesizing Workflows via Few-shot Transfer）框架，旨在通过可重用的结构先验来分摊工作流设计成本。

方法: SWIFT首先从源任务的对比分析中提炼组合启发式规则和输出接口契约，然后在推理时结合这些先验和跨任务演示，通过单次LLM生成合成目标任务的完整可执行工作流。

主要发现: 优化的工作流收敛到特定的拓扑结构家族，SWIFT在五个基准测试中优于最先进的搜索方法，并将边际优化成本降低了三个数量级；该方法在四个未见基准上泛化良好，并能从GPT-4o-mini迁移到其他基础模型；控制性消融实验表明工作流演示主要转移拓扑结构而非表面语义。

结论: SWIFT通过结构先验和单次生成实现了高效的工作流合成，显著降低了计算成本，并证明了其结构迁移能力优于表面语义迁移。

翻译: Automated agentic workflow design currently relies on per-task iterative search, which is computationally prohibitive and fails to reuse structural knowledge across tasks. We observe that optimized workflows converge to a small family of domain-specific topologies, suggesting that this combinatorial search is largely redundant. Building on this insight, we propose SWIFT (Synthesizing Workflows via Few-shot Transfer), a framework that amortizes workflow design into reusable structural priors. SWIFT first distills compositional heuristics and output-interface contracts from contrastive analysis of prior search trajectories across source tasks. At inference time, it conditions a single LLM generation pass on these priors together with cross-task workflow demonstrations to synthesize a complete, executable workflow for an unseen target task, bypassing iterative search entirely. On five benchmarks, SWIFT outperforms the state-of-the-art search-based method while reducing marginal per-task optimization cost by three orders of magnitude. It further generalizes to four additional unseen benchmarks and transfers successfully from GPT-4o-mini to three additional foundation models (Grok, Qwen, Gemma). Controlled ablations reveal that workflow demonstrations primarily transfer topological structure rather than surface semantics: replacing all operator names with random strings still retains over 93% of the full system's average performance.

Abstract

Automated agentic workflow design currently relies on per-task iterative search, which is computationally prohibitive and fails to reuse structural knowledge across tasks. We observe that optimized workflows converge to a small family of domain-specific topologies, suggesting that this combinatorial search is largely redundant. Building on this insight, we propose SWIFT (Synthesizing Workflows via Few-shot Transfer), a framework that amortizes workflow design into reusable structural priors. SWIFT first distills compositional heuristics and output-interface contracts from contrastive analysis of prior search trajectories across source tasks. At inference time, it conditions a single LLM generation pass on these priors together with cross-task workflow demonstrations to synthesize a complete, executable workflow for an unseen target task, bypassing iterative search entirely. On five benchmarks, SWIFT outperforms the state-of-the-art search-based method while reducing marginal per-task optimization cost by three orders of magnitude. It further generalizes to four additional unseen benchmarks and transfers successfully from GPT-4o-mini to three additional foundation models (Grok, Qwen, Gemma). Controlled ablations reveal that workflow demonstrations primarily transfer topological structure rather than surface semantics: replacing all operator names with random strings still retains over 93% of the full system's average performance.

item.title: Prior-Aligned Data Cleaning for Tabular Foundation Models
item.author: Laure Berti-Equille
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了L2C2，这是一个基于深度强化学习的框架，旨在解决表格基础模型在处理现实世界脏数据时的分布不匹配问题。

背景: 表格基础模型（TFMs）通过元学习合成数据生成过程在小数据集上实现了最先进的零样本准确率，但其假设输入数据相对干净。现实世界数据中的缺失值、异常值和重复数据会导致分布不匹配，从而降低TFMs的准确性和置信度校准。

目的: 提出L2C2框架，将表格数据清洗视为先验对齐问题，通过学习策略序列化操作符以最小化脏输入与TFMs合成先验之间的分布差距。

方法: L2C2是一个深度强化学习框架，将表格数据清洗定义为先验对齐。它使用学习到的策略来序列化操作符。文中提出了TFMAwareReward奖励设计，并使用了参数化的清洗动作。

主要发现: 1) 三个奖励设计退化为微不足道的清洗策略，表明有原则的奖励工程具有科学上的非平凡性；2) 提出的TFMAwareReward在4/10的数据集上选择了结构不同的管道，并在这些情况下实现了更高的TabPFN准确率；3) 参数化的清洗动作在9/10的数据集上提高了最佳管道奖励；4) 在单个源数据集上预训练的策略在所有三个保留数据集上超过了从头训练，证明了跨数据集的先验对齐知识转移。

结论: 先验对齐是TFMs在现实世界表格数据上部署的有原则的数据准备策略。

翻译: 表格基础模型（TFMs）通过元学习合成数据生成过程在小数据集上实现了最先进的零样本准确率，使其对无法承担大量标注语料库的从业者极具吸引力。然而，它们在上下文学习机制中假设输入数据相对干净：现实世界数据中的缺失值、异常值和重复数据产生了一种先验不匹配，同时降低了准确性和置信度校准。纠正这种不匹配需要对清洗操作符进行序列决策，其交互作用无法由静态预处理规则预见——这非常适合强化学习。我们介绍了L2C2，第一个深度RL框架，将表格数据清洗定义为先验对齐：学习到的策略序列化操作符以最小化脏输入与TFMs合成先验之间的分布差距。在十个OpenML基准数据集上的六项实验确立了：1) 七个奖励设计中有三个退化为微不足道的清洗策略——有原则的奖励工程具有科学上的非平凡性；2) 我们提出的TFMAwareReward在4/10的数据集上选择了结构不同的管道，并在这些分歧情况下实现了更高的TabPFN准确率（平均0.851 vs 0.843；Wilcoxon p=0.063，n=4），且从未表现不佳；3) 参数化的清洗动作在9/10的数据集上提高了最佳管道奖励（Wilcoxon p=0.004）；4) 在单个源数据集上预训练的策略在所有三个保留数据集上的2000步微调检查点上都超过了从头训练（完全微调后最高+28.8%），证明了跨数据集的先验对齐知识转移。这些发现确立了先验对齐是TFMs在现实世界表格数据上部署的有原则的数据准备策略。

Abstract

Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) achieve state-of-the-art zero-shot accuracy on small tabular datasets by meta-learning over synthetic data-generating processes -- making them highly attractive for practitioners who cannot afford large annotated corpora. However, their in-context learning mechanism assumes approximately clean inputs: missing values, outliers, and duplicates in the real-world data create a prior mismatch that degrades both accuracy and confidence calibration simultaneously. Correcting this mismatch requires sequential decisions over cleaning operators whose interactions no static preprocessing rule can anticipate -a natural fit for reinforcement learning~(RL). We introduce L2C2, the first deep RL framework framing tabular data cleaning as prior alignment: a learned policy sequences operators to minimize the distributional gap between dirty input and the TFM's synthetic prior. Six experiments on ten OpenML benchmark datasets establish: 1) three of seven reward designs collapse to degenerate trivial cleaning strategies -- principled reward engineering is scientifically non-trivial; 2) the novel TFMAwareReward reward we propose selects structurally distinct pipelines on 4/10 datasets and achieves higher TabPFN accuracy on those diverging cases (mean 0.851 vs. 0.843; Wilcoxon p=0.063, n=4) while never underperforming; 3) parameterized cleaning actions improve best-found pipeline reward on 9/10 datasets (Wilcoxon p=0.004); and 4) a policy pre-trained on one single source dataset exceeds scratch training at the 2,000-step fine-tuning checkpoint on all three held-out datasets (up to +28.8% after full fine-tuning) demonstrating cross-dataset transfer of prior-alignment knowledge. These findings establish that prior alignment is a principled data preparation strategy for TFM deployment on real-world tabular data.

item.title: Accurate and Robust Generative Approach for Overcoming Data Sparsity and Imbalance in Landslide Modeling with A Tabular Foundation Model
item.author: Kaixuan Shao, Gang Mei, Yinghan Wu, Nengxiong Xu, Jianbing Peng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于表格基础模型的多特征滑坡数据集生成方法，旨在解决滑坡调查中观测数据稀疏和不平衡的问题。

背景: 滑坡调查依赖于受地质、水文和人为因素影响的充足且平衡的观测数据。然而，现有的滑坡目录通常稀疏且不平衡，限制了对其触发条件和失效机制的理解。

目的: 生成准确且稳健的多特征滑坡数据集，以帮助从有限的滑坡观测中捕获特征依赖关系。

方法: 利用表格基础模型，通过从有限观测中学习的能力，生成多特征滑坡数据集。

主要发现: 在20个滑坡目录上的比较实验表明，生成的数据集与观测分布紧密一致，保持了现实的特征依赖性，并在不同的环境背景下表现出稳健性。

结论: 该工作提供了一种有效的方法来克服数据稀疏和不平衡问题，并在有限观测下加强了滑坡易发性建模和风险评估。

翻译: 本文提出了一种基于表格基础模型的多特征滑坡数据集生成方法，旨在解决滑坡调查中观测数据稀疏和不平衡的问题。滑坡调查依赖于受地质、水文和人为因素影响的充足且平衡的观测数据。然而，现有的滑坡目录通常稀疏且不平衡，限制了对其触发条件和失效机制的理解。生成数据提供了一种有效的方法，有助于从有限的滑坡观测中捕获特征依赖关系。然而，现有的滑坡生成方法往往难以捕获特征之间的复杂关系，并且在多个场景和交互因素方面缺乏稳健性。在这里，我们提出了一种利用表格基础模型生成准确且稳健的多特征滑坡数据集的方法。通过利用从有限观测中学习的能力，所提出的方法有效地保留了滑坡发生固有的多变量依赖性和统计特征。在20个滑坡目录上的比较实验表明，生成的数据集与观测分布紧密一致，保持了现实的特征依赖性，并在不同的环境背景下表现出稳健性。这项工作提供了一种有效的方法来克服数据稀疏和不平衡问题，并在有限观测下加强了滑坡易发性建模和风险评估。

Abstract

Landslide investigation relies on sufficient and well-balanced observational data influenced by geological, hydrological, and anthropogenic factors. Available landslide inventories are often sparse and imbalanced, which limits understanding of triggering conditions and failure mechanisms. Data generation provides an effective approach to help capture feature dependencies from limited landslide observations. However, existing generation approaches for landslides often struggle to capture complex relationships among features and lack robustness across multiple scenarios and interacting factors. Here, we propose an accurate and robust approach for generating multi-feature landslide datasets by utilizing a tabular foundation model. By leveraging the capacity to learn from limited observations, the proposed approach effectively preserves the multivariate dependencies and statistical characteristics inherent in landslide occurrences. Comparative experiments on 20 landslide inventories demonstrate that the generated datasets closely align with observed distributions, maintain realistic feature dependencies, and exhibit robustness across different environmental contexts. This work provides an effective approach to overcome data sparsity and imbalance and strengthens landslide susceptibility modeling and risk assessment under limited observations.

item.title: Target-depth sensing with metasurface-encoder integrated optoelectronic neural network
item.author: Shuo Wang, Deyu Zhu, Chenjie Xiong, Bin Hu, Chunqi Jin, Yu Wang, Chengjun Zou
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于超表面编码器和光电神经网络架构的3D目标感知方法，通过将深度信息编码为二维图像，实现了实时、高精度的目标分类和深度估计。

背景: 现代机器视觉在三维环境中的目标感知对于自动驾驶、机器人操作、增强现实和智能监控等新兴技术至关重要。然而，现有的3D感知方法通常依赖于对多视图图像或激光雷达点云的复杂后处理，导致计算负载、功耗和延迟较高。

目的: 为了解决现有3D感知方法计算复杂、功耗高和延迟大的问题，提出了一种轻量级的超表面编码器集成光电神经网络架构。

方法: 该架构利用超表面产生的双螺旋点扩散函数将三维信息压缩为二维图像，使用单目相机捕获这些深度编码图像，并通过轻量级阴影ResNet神经网络进行处理。

主要发现: 在MNIST和车辆图像数据集上的实验验证表明，该方法在目标分类和深度估计方面均实现了高精度，从而支持实时目标跟踪。

结论: 该框架易于扩展到其他深度或角度编码超表面，用于多维压缩和检测。结果表明，该超光学编码器/电子解码器范式显著降低了网络复杂性和计算负担，同时保持了智能视觉传感应用中的强大性能。

翻译: Accurate and real-time sensing of targets in three-dimensional (3D) environments is essential for modern machine vision, underpinning emerging technologies such as autonomous systems, robotic manipulation, augmented reality, and intelligent surveillance. However, state-of-the-art 3D sensing approaches typically rely on complex postprocessing of multi-view images or LiDAR point clouds, resulting in considerable computational load, power consumption, and latency. To address these challenges, we propose a metasurface-encoder integrated optoelectronic neural network architecture that compresses 3D information into two-dimensional images by encoding depth using double-helix point spread function generated by a metasurface. The depth-encoded images are captured with a conventional monocular camera and subsequently processed by a lightweight shadow ResNet neural network. We experimentally validate the proposed architecture on the MNIST and Vehicle-Image datasets, achieving high accuracy simultaneously in target classification and depth estimation, thereby enabling real-time target tracking. The framework is readily extendable to other depth- or angle-encoding metasurfaces for multidimensional compression and detection. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of the meta-optic-encoder/electronic-decoder paradigm in significantly reducing network complexity and computational burden while maintaining strong performance for smart vision sensory applications.

Abstract

Accurate and real-time sensing of targets in three-dimensional (3D) environments is essential for modern machine vision, underpinning emerging technologies such as autonomous systems, robotic manipulation, augmented reality, and intelligent surveillance. However, state-of-the-art 3D sensing approaches typically rely on complex postprocessing of multi-view images or LiDAR point clouds, resulting in considerable computational load, power consumption, and latency. To address these challenges, we propose a metasurface-encoder integrated optoelectronic neural network architecture that compresses 3D information into two-dimensional images by encoding depth using double-helix point spread function generated by a metasurface. The depth-encoded images are captured with a conventional monocular camera and subsequently processed by a lightweight shadow ResNet neural network. We experimentally validate the proposed architecture on the MNIST and Vehicle-Image datasets, achieving high accuracy simultaneously in target classification and depth estimation, thereby enabling real-time target tracking. The framework is readily extendable to other depth- or angle-encoding metasurfaces for multidimensional compression and detection. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of the meta-optic-encoder/electronic-decoder paradigm in significantly reducing network complexity and computational burden while maintaining strong performance for smart vision sensory applications.

item.title: IAM: Identity-Aware Human Motion and Shape Joint Generation
item.author: Wenqi Jia, Zekun Li, Abhay Mittal, Chengcheng Tang, Chuan Guo, Lezi Wang, James Matthew Rehg, Lingling Tao, Size An
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种身份感知的运动生成框架，通过联合运动-形状生成范式同时合成运动序列和身体形状参数，以解决现有方法忽略身体形态对运动动力学影响的物理不一致性问题。

背景: 现有文本驱动的运动生成方法大多假设身份中性的运动，使用标准身体表示生成动作，忽略了身体比例、质量分布和年龄等属性对动作表现方式的强烈影响，导致物理不一致的运动。

目的: 提出一种身份感知的运动生成框架，明确建模身体形态与运动动力学之间的关系，通过联合运动-形状生成范式，使身份线索直接调节运动动力学。

方法: 不依赖显式几何测量，使用包括自然语言描述和视觉线索在内的多模态信号表示身份；引入联合运动-形状生成范式，同时合成运动序列和身体形状参数。

主要发现: 在运动捕捉数据集和大规模野外视频上的广泛实验表明，该方法提高了运动的真实性和运动-身份一致性，同时保持了高运动质量。

结论: 该方法有效解决了忽略身体形态耦合导致的物理不一致问题，实现了更真实的运动生成。

翻译: Recent advances in text-driven human motion generation enable models to synthesize realistic motion sequences from natural language descriptions. However, most existing approaches assume identity-neutral motion and generate movements using a canonical body representation, ignoring the strong influence of body morphology on motion dynamics. In practice, attributes such as body proportions, mass distribution, and age significantly affect how actions are performed, and neglecting this coupling often leads to physically inconsistent motions. We propose an identity-aware motion generation framework that explicitly models the relationship between body morphology and motion dynamics. Instead of relying on explicit geometric measurements, identity is represented using multimodal signals, including natural language descriptions and visual cues. We further introduce a joint motion-shape generation paradigm that simultaneously synthesizes motion sequences and body shape parameters, allowing identity cues to directly modulate motion dynamics. Extensive experiments on motion capture datasets and large-scale in-the-wild videos demonstrate improved motion realism and motion-identity consistency while maintaining high motion quality.

Abstract

Recent advances in text-driven human motion generation enable models to synthesize realistic motion sequences from natural language descriptions. However, most existing approaches assume identity-neutral motion and generate movements using a canonical body representation, ignoring the strong influence of body morphology on motion dynamics. In practice, attributes such as body proportions, mass distribution, and age significantly affect how actions are performed, and neglecting this coupling often leads to physically inconsistent motions. We propose an identity-aware motion generation framework that explicitly models the relationship between body morphology and motion dynamics. Instead of relying on explicit geometric measurements, identity is represented using multimodal signals, including natural language descriptions and visual cues. We further introduce a joint motion-shape generation paradigm that simultaneously synthesizes motion sequences and body shape parameters, allowing identity cues to directly modulate motion dynamics. Extensive experiments on motion capture datasets and large-scale in-the-wild videos demonstrate improved motion realism and motion-identity consistency while maintaining high motion quality. Project page: https://vjwq.github.io/IAM

item.title: FCMBench-Video: Benchmarking Document Video Intelligence
item.author: Runze Cui, Fangxin Shang, Yehui Yang, Qing Yang, Tao Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: FCMBench-Video是一个用于评估文档视频智能的基准测试数据集，旨在评估文档感知、时间定位和基于证据的推理能力。

背景: 文档理解在金融信贷审查、入职和远程验证中至关重要，文档视频提供了时间冗余和顺序展开的证据流，需要跨帧的证据整合，并保留与真实性敏感和反欺诈审查相关的获取过程线索。

目的: 介绍FCMBench-Video基准测试，用于评估文档视频智能，包括文档感知、时间定位和基于证据的推理能力。

方法: 通过原子获取和组合工作流程构建数据集，记录可重用的单文档片段，应用受控降级，并组装具有指定时间跨度的长形式多文档视频。数据集包含495个原子视频，组成1200个长形式视频，配对11322个专家标注的问题-答案实例，涵盖28种文档类型，时长20秒至60秒，包含5960个中文和5362个英文实例。

主要发现: 在九个最近的视频多模态大模型上的评估显示，FCMBench-Video在系统和能力之间提供了有意义的区分；计数是最对时长敏感的任务；跨文档验证和基于证据的选择探测更高层次的证据整合；视觉提示注入提供了互补的鲁棒性维度；整体分数分布广泛且近似呈钟形，表明基准测试既未饱和也不被简单案例主导。

结论: FCMBench-Video被定位为可重复的基准测试，用于跟踪文档视频理解中视频多模态大模型的进展，并探测真实性敏感信贷领域应用中的能力边界。

翻译: 文档理解是金融信贷审查、入职和远程验证中的关键能力，其中决策准确性和证据可追溯性都很重要。与静态文档图像相比，文档视频呈现时间冗余和顺序展开的证据流，需要跨帧的证据整合，并保留与真实性敏感和反欺诈审查相关的获取过程线索。我们介绍了FCMBench-Video，这是一个文档视频智能的基准测试，用于在现实捕获条件下评估文档感知、时间定位和基于证据的推理能力。为了在规模上实现隐私合规且现实的数据，我们组织了原子获取和组合工作流程，记录可重用的单文档片段，应用受控降级，并组装具有指定时间跨度的长形式多文档视频。FCMBench-Video由495个原子视频组成，组成1200个长形式视频，配对11322个专家标注的问题-答案实例，涵盖28种文档类型，时长20秒至60秒，包含5960个中文和5362个英文实例。在九个最近的视频多模态大模型上的评估显示，FCMBench-Video在系统和能力之间提供了有意义的区分；计数是最对时长敏感的任务；跨文档验证和基于证据的选择探测更高层次的证据整合；视觉提示注入提供了互补的鲁棒性维度；整体分数分布广泛且近似呈钟形，表明基准测试既未饱和也不被简单案例主导。这些结果共同将FCMBench-Video定位为可重复的基准测试，用于跟踪文档视频理解中视频多模态大模型的进展，并探测真实性敏感信贷领域应用中的能力边界。

Abstract
