Document understanding is a critical capability in financial credit review, onboarding, and remote verification, where both decision accuracy and evidence traceability matter. Compared with static document images, document videos present a temporally redundant and sequentially unfolding evidence stream, require evidence integration across frames, and preserve acquisition-process cues relevant to authenticity-sensitive and anti-fraud review. We introduce FCMBench-Video, a benchmark for document-video intelligence that evaluates document perception, temporal grounding, and evidence-grounded reasoning under realistic capture conditions. For privacy-compliant yet realistic data at scale, we organize construction as an atomic-acquisition and composition workflow that records reusable single-document clips, applies controlled degradations, and assembles long-form multi-document videos with prescribed temporal spans. FCMBench-Video is built from 495 atomic videos composed into 1,200 long-form videos paired with 11,322 expert-annotated question--answer instances, covering 28 document types over 20s--60s duration tiers and 5,960 Chinese / 5,362 English instances. Evaluations on nine recent Video-MLLMs show that FCMBench-Video provides meaningful separation across systems and capabilities: counting is the most duration-sensitive task, Cross-Document Validation and Evidence-Grounded Selection probe higher-level evidence integration, and Visual Prompt Injection provides a complementary robustness dimension. The overall score distribution is broad and approximately bell-shaped, indicating a benchmark that is neither saturated nor dominated by trivial cases. Together, these results position FCMBench-Video as a reproducible benchmark for tracking Video-MLLM progress on document-video understanding and probing capability boundaries in authenticity-sensitive credit-domain applications.

item.title: Knowledge-Data Dually Driven Paradigm for Accurate Landslide Susceptibility Prediction under Data-Scarce Conditions Using Geomorphic Priors and Tabular Foundation Model
item.author: Yuting Yang, Gang Mei, Feng Chen, Yongshuang Zhang, Jianbing Peng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对山区和高原地区数据稀缺条件下滑坡易发性预测的挑战，提出了一种知识-数据双驱动范式，通过整合地貌先验知识与稀缺滑坡数据，实现了高精度的滑坡易发性预测。

背景: 传统的数据驱动范式虽然预测精度高，但需要大量的条件因子和滑坡数据，而在实际工程应用中，山区和高原地区常面临数据稀缺的困境，导致传统方法难以适用。

目的: 为了解决数据稀缺条件下滑坡易发性预测的难题，提出一种知识-数据双驱动范式，旨在通过整合地貌先验知识与稀缺数据来提高预测准确性。

方法: 该范式将地貌先验知识与稀缺滑坡数据相结合。首先在意大利中部数据丰富区域进行了验证，仅使用30%的数据就达到了与传统方法相当的精度；随后在青藏高原祁连山冻土区这一真正数据稀缺的环境中进行评估，也获得了可靠的预测结果。

主要发现: 在意大利中部数据丰富区域，仅使用30%的滑坡数据即可达到与传统方法相当的预测精度；在青藏高原祁连山冻土区这一数据稀缺环境中，该范式同样提供了可靠的易发性预测。

结论: 所提出的知识-数据双驱动范式在数据稀缺条件下能够有效且可靠地进行滑坡易发性预测，证明了其在实际工程应用中的适用性。

翻译: Landslide susceptibility prediction is critical for geohazard risk assessment and mitigation. Conventional data-driven paradigm achieves high predictive accuracy but require sufficient conditioning factors and large-scale landslide inventories. However, in practical engineering applications across mountainous and plateau regions, data-scarce conditions are commonly observed, where such data requirements are rarely satisfied, rendering conventional data-driven paradigm inapplicable. To address this issue, we propose a knowledge-data dually driven paradigm for accurate landslide susceptibility prediction under data-scarce conditions. The essential idea behind the proposed novel paradigm is the integration of the geomorphic prior knowledge with scarce landslide data. To validate the proposed paradigm, we first applied it to a data-rich region in central Italy, where a conventional data-driven paradigm trained on the full dataset served as the baseline. By utilizing only 30% of the available landslide data, the proposed paradigm achieved comparable predictive accuracy to the baseline, demonstrating its effectiveness under data-scarce conditions. The paradigm was further evaluated in a genuinely data-scarce environment for application, the Qilian Permafrost Region of the Tibetan Plateau, where it also yielded reliable susceptibility predictions, confirming its applicability under data-scarce conditions.

Abstract

Landslide susceptibility prediction is critical for geohazard risk assessment and mitigation. Conventional data-driven paradigm achieves high predictive accuracy but require sufficient conditioning factors and large-scale landslide inventories. However, in practical engineering applications across mountainous and plateau regions, data-scarce conditions are commonly observed, where such data requirements are rarely satisfied, rendering conventional data-driven paradigm inapplicable. To address this issue, we propose a knowledge-data dually driven paradigm for accurate landslide susceptibility prediction under data-scarce conditions. The essential idea behind the proposed novel paradigm is the integration of the geomorphic prior knowledge with scarce landslide data. To validate the proposed paradigm, we first applied it to a data-rich region in central Italy, where a conventional data-driven paradigm trained on the full dataset served as the baseline. By utilizing only 30% of the available landslide data, the proposed paradigm achieved comparable predictive accuracy to the baseline, demonstrating its effectiveness under data-scarce conditions. The paradigm was further evaluated in a genuinely data-scarce environment for application, the Qilian Permafrost Region of the Tibetan Plateau, where it also yielded reliable susceptibility predictions, confirming its applicability under data-scarce conditions.

item.title: BARRED: Synthetic Training of Custom Policy Guardrails via Asymmetric Debate
item.author: Arnon Mazza, Elad Levi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: BARRED框架通过生成忠实且多样的合成训练数据，实现了对自定义策略的边界对齐和细化

背景: 部署自定义策略的护栏具有挑战性，通用安全模型无法捕捉特定任务要求，提示LLM存在边界情况性能不一致和高推理成本问题，而训练自定义分类器需要大量昂贵的人工标注数据

目的: 提出BARRED框架，旨在仅利用任务描述和少量未标注示例生成忠实且多样的合成训练数据，以解决现有方法在数据获取和性能上的瓶颈

方法: 将领域空间分解为维度以确保全面覆盖，并采用多智能体辩论来验证标签正确性，从而获得高保真训练语料库

主要发现: 在多种自定义策略上的实验表明，使用合成数据微调的小型语言模型 consistently 超越了最先进的专有LLM（包括推理模型）和专用护栏模型；消融研究证实维度分解和基于辩论的验证对于确保多样性和标签保真度至关重要

结论: BARRED框架消除了对广泛人工标注的依赖，为准确的自定义护栏提供了可扩展的解决方案

翻译: 部署自定义策略的护栏仍然具有挑战性，因为通用安全模型无法捕捉特定任务要求，而提示LLM suffers from inconsistent boundary-case performance and high inference costs。训练自定义分类器可以达到准确性和效率，但需要大量昂贵的人工标注数据。我们提出了BARRED（通过反思和辩论进行边界对齐细化），这是一个仅使用任务描述和少量未标注示例即可生成忠实且多样的合成训练数据的框架。我们的方法将领域空间分解为维度以确保全面覆盖，并采用多智能体辩论来验证标签正确性，从而获得高保真训练语料库。在多种自定义策略上的实验表明，使用我们的合成数据微调的小型语言模型 consistently 超越了最先进的专有LLM（包括推理模型）和专用护栏模型。消融研究证实，维度分解和基于辩论的验证对于确保有效微调所需的多样性和标签保真度至关重要。BARRED框架消除了对广泛人工标注的依赖，为准确的自定义护栏提供了可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract

Deploying guardrails for custom policies remains challenging, as generic safety models fail to capture task-specific requirements, while prompting LLMs suffers from inconsistent boundary-case performance and high inference costs. Training custom classifiers achieves both accuracy and efficiency, yet demands substantial labeled data that is costly to obtain. We present BARRED (Boundary Alignment Refinement through REflection and Debate), a framework for generating faithful and diverse synthetic training data using only a task description and a small set of unlabeled examples. Our approach decomposes the domain space into dimensions to ensure comprehensive coverage, and employs multi-agent debate to verify label correctness, yielding a high-fidelity training corpus. Experiments across diverse custom policies demonstrate that small language models finetuned on our synthetic data consistently outperform state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs (including reasoning models) and dedicated guardrail models. Ablation studies confirm that both dimension decomposition and debate-based verification are critical for ensuring the diversity and label fidelity required for effective fine-tuning. The BARRED framework eliminates the reliance on extensive human annotation, offering a scalable solution for accurate custom guardrails.

item.title: AutoResearchBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Complex Scientific Literature Discovery
item.author: Lei Xiong, Kun Luo, Ziyi Xia, Wenbo Zhang, Jin-Ge Yao, Zheng Liu, Jingying Shao, Jianlyu Chen, Hongjin Qian, Xi Yang, Qian Yu, Hao Li, Chen Yue, Xiaan Du, Yuyang Wang, Yesheng Liu, Haiyu Xu, Zhicheng Dou
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AutoResearchBench是一个用于评估AI代理在自主科学文献发现方面能力的基准测试，包含深度研究和广度研究两种互补任务类型。

背景: AI代理的发展显著推动了自主科学研究，其中寻找合适的科学文献是一个关键步骤。

目的: 评估AI代理在驱动科学文献发现过程方面的能力。

方法: AutoResearchBench包含两种互补的任务类型：深度研究和广度研究。深度研究需要通过渐进的多步探测过程追踪特定的目标论文，而广度研究需要全面收集满足给定条件的一组论文。

主要发现: 即使是最强大的LLM，在深度研究任务上仅达到9.39%的准确率，在广度研究任务上仅达到9.31%的IoU，而许多其他强基线模型甚至低于5%。

结论: AutoResearchBench在研究导向、文献聚焦和开放性方面具有独特优势，使其非常适合评估自主研究能力，但也极具挑战性。

翻译: 由于AI代理的发展，自主科学研究取得了显著进步。该过程中的一个关键步骤是找到合适的科学文献，无论是为了探索现有知识来解决研究问题，还是为了获取证据来验证假设和支持主张。为了评估AI代理在驱动这一过程方面的能力，我们提出了AutoResearchBench，这是一个用于自主科学文献发现的专用基准测试。AutoResearchBench由两种互补的任务类型组成：(1)深度研究，它需要通过渐进的多步探测过程追踪特定的目标论文，以及(2)广度研究，它需要全面收集满足给定条件的一组论文。与之前的代理网络浏览基准测试相比，AutoResearchBench在三个维度上有所不同：它是研究导向的，需要深入理解科学概念；它是文献聚焦的，要求精细利用详细信息；它是开放式的，涉及未知数量的合格论文，因此需要在整个过程中进行深思熟虑的推理和搜索。这些特性使AutoResearchBench非常适合评估自主研究能力，并且极其具有挑战性。即使是最强大的LLM，尽管已经很大程度上征服了通用代理网络浏览基准测试如BrowseComp，在深度研究上仅达到9.39%的准确率，在广度研究上仅达到9.31%的IoU，而许多其他强基线模型甚至低于5%。我们公开发布了数据集和评估流程，以促进该方向的未来研究。

Abstract

Autonomous scientific research is significantly advanced thanks to the development of AI agents. One key step in this process is finding the right scientific literature, whether to explore existing knowledge for a research problem, or to acquire evidence for verifying assumptions and supporting claims. To assess AI agents' capability in driving this process, we present AutoResearchBench, a dedicated benchmark for autonomous scientific literature discovery. AutoResearchBench consists of two complementary task types: (1) Deep Research, which requires tracking down a specific target paper through a progressive, multi-step probing process, and (2) Wide Research, which requires comprehensively collecting a set of papers satisfying given conditions. Compared to previous benchmarks on agentic web browsing, AutoResearchBench is distinguished along three dimensions: it is research-oriented, calling for in-depth comprehension of scientific concepts; literature-focused, demanding fine-grained utilization of detailed information; and open-ended, involving an unknown number of qualified papers and thus requiring deliberate reasoning and search throughout. These properties make AutoResearchBench uniquely suited for evaluating autonomous research capabilities, and extraordinarily challenging. Even the most powerful LLMs, despite having largely conquered general agentic web-browsing benchmarks such as BrowseComp, achieve only 9.39% accuracy on Deep Research and 9.31% IoU on Wide Research, while many other strong baselines fall below 5%. We publicly release the dataset and evaluation pipeline to facilitate future research in this direction. We publicly release the dataset, evaluation pipeline, and code at https://github.com/CherYou/AutoResearchBench.

item.title: Combating Visual Neglect and Semantic Drift in Large Multimodal Models for Enhanced Cross-Modal Retrieval
item.author: Guosheng Zhang, Linkai Liu, Keyao Wang, Haixiao Yue, Zhiwen Tan, Xiao Tan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SSA-ME的新框架，旨在通过显著感知建模增强细粒度表示学习，从而提升多模态检索性能。

背景: 现有的统一多模态检索（UMR）方法主要关注样本级目标，忽视了关键的主体级语义，导致模型难以在复杂多模态查询中对语义连贯的主体进行分组，并出现语义对齐偏差。

目的: 为了解决上述问题，本文旨在通过显著感知建模增强细粒度表示学习，使模型能够准确识别和强调图像-文本对中的显著视觉概念，并更好地对齐跨模态注意力与语义有意义的区域。

方法: SSA-ME框架利用大模型和视觉专家来识别和强调显著视觉概念，引入显著引导目标来对齐跨模态注意力，并使用特征重生成模块根据生成的显著图重新校准视觉特征，确保跨模态的平衡和语义连贯集成。

主要发现: 在MMEB基准测试中，该方法实现了最先进的性能，表明 incorporating 主体级建模显著改善了多模态检索。

结论: 通过显著感知建模和特征重生成，SSA-ME有效解决了视觉模态忽视和语义对齐偏差问题，提高了多模态检索的准确性和可解释性。

翻译: 尽管在大模型（LMMs）的推动下，统一多模态检索（UMR）取得了显著进展，但现有的嵌入方法主要关注样本级目标，忽视了关键的主体级语义。这一限制阻碍了模型在复杂多模态查询中对语义连贯的主体进行分组的能力，表现为语义对齐偏差——即模型无法在视觉内容中准确定位与文本相关的显著区域。此外，由于缺乏明确指导模型显著视觉主体的机制，LMMs倾向于过度依赖文本线索，导致视觉模态被忽视以及视觉知识利用不充分。为此，我们提出了显著主体感知多模态嵌入（SSA-ME），这是一个旨在通过显著感知建模增强细粒度表示学习的新框架。SSA-ME利用LMMs和视觉专家来识别和强调图像-文本对中的显著视觉概念，并引入显著引导目标来更好地对齐跨模态注意力与语义有意义的区域。此外，特征重生成模块根据生成的显著图重新校准视觉特征，确保跨模态的平衡和语义连贯集成。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法在MMEB基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，证明 incorporating 主体级建模显著改善了多模态检索。全面的定性分析进一步阐明了我们方法的可解释性和有效性。

Abstract

Despite significant progress in Unified Multimodal Retrieval (UMR) powered by Large Multimodal Models (LMMs), existing embedding methods primarily focus on sample-level objectives via contrastive learning while overlooking the crucial subject-level semantics. This limitation hinders the model's ability to group semantically coherent subjects in complex multimodal queries, manifesting as semantic alignment deviation--where models fail to accurately localize salient text-referred regions in visual content. Moreover, without explicit guidance to model salient visual subjects, LMMs tend to over-rely on textual cues, resulting in visual modality neglect and suboptimal utilization of visual knowledge. To this end, we propose Salient Subject-Aware Multimodal Embedding (SSA-ME), a novel framework designed to enhance fine-grained representation learning through saliency-aware modeling. SSA-ME leverages LMMs and visual experts to identify and emphasize salient visual concepts in image-text pairs, and introduces a saliency-guided objective to better align cross-modal attention with semantically meaningful regions. Additionally, a feature regeneration module recalibrates visual features based on the derived saliency maps, ensuring a balanced and semantically coherent integration across modalities. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the MMEB benchmark, demonstrating that incorporating subject-level modeling substantially improves multimodal retrieval. Comprehensive qualitative analyses further illustrate the interpretability and effectiveness of our approach.

item.title: OmniVTG: A Large-Scale Dataset and Training Paradigm for Open-World Video Temporal Grounding
item.author: Minghang Zheng, Zihao Yin, Yi Yang, Yuxin Peng, Yang Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了OmniVTG数据集和自校正思维链训练范式，以提升多模态大模型在开放世界视频时间定位任务中的性能。

背景: 现有的视频时间定位任务在开放世界设置中面临数据集规模有限和语义多样性不足的问题，导致常见概念和罕见概念之间存在性能差距。

目的: 为了克服这些限制，作者引入了OmniVTG数据集和自校正思维链训练范式，以增强多模态大模型的定位能力。

方法: 1. 构建数据集：采用语义覆盖迭代扩展管道，识别现有数据集词汇缺口并收集包含目标概念的视频；利用多模态大模型擅长密集描述而非直接定位的特点，设计基于描述的数据引擎生成高质量标注。2. 训练范式：提出自校正思维链训练范式，通过监督微调、思维链微调和强化学习三个阶段，训练模型先预测再反思和细化自身预测。

主要发现: 1. 简单的监督微调不足以解决问题，罕见概念和常见概念之间的性能差距依然存在。2. 多模态大模型的视频理解能力显著超过其直接定位能力。3. 提出的方法在OmniVTG数据集上实现了开放世界定位的卓越性能，并在四个现有VTG基准测试中实现了最先进的零样本性能。

结论: OmniVTG数据集和自校正思维链训练范式有效解决了开放世界视频时间定位中的数据局限和性能差距问题，显著提升了多模态大模型的定位能力。

翻译: 视频时间定位任务，即从文本查询中定位视频片段，在开放世界设置中因数据集规模有限和语义多样性不足而面临困难，导致常见概念和罕见概念之间存在性能差距。为了克服这些限制，我们引入了OmniVTG，这是一个用于开放世界VTG的新的大规模数据集，结合了自校正思维链训练范式，旨在增强多模态大模型的定位能力。我们的OmniVTG是通过一种新颖的语义覆盖迭代扩展管道构建的，该管道首先识别现有数据集词汇中的缺口，并收集高度可能包含这些目标概念的视频。为了获得高质量的标注，我们利用了现代多模态大模型在密集描述方面比直接定位更出色的见解，并设计了一个以描述为中心的数据引擎，提示多模态大模型生成密集的、带时间戳的描述。除了数据集之外，我们观察到简单的监督微调是不够的，因为罕见概念和常见概念之间的性能差距仍然存在。我们发现多模态大模型的视频理解能力显著超过其直接定位能力。基于此，我们提出了自校正思维链训练范式。我们训练多模态大模型首先预测，然后利用其理解能力来反思和细化其自身预测。这种能力通过监督微调、思维链微调和强化学习的三个阶段管道来灌输。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法不仅在我们的OmniVTG数据集上在开放世界定位方面表现出色，而且在四个现有VTG基准测试中实现了最先进的零样本性能。代码可在 https://github.com/oceanflowlab/OmniVTG 获取。

Abstract

Video Temporal Grounding (VTG), the task of localizing video segments from text queries, struggles in open-world settings due to limited dataset scale and semantic diversity, causing performance gaps between common and rare concepts. To overcome these limitations, we introduce OmniVTG, a new large-scale dataset for open-world VTG, coupled with a Self-Correction Chain-of-Thought (CoT) training paradigm designed to enhance the grounding capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Our OmniVTG is constructed via a novel Semantic Coverage Iterative Expansion pipeline, which first identifies gaps in the vocabulary of existing datasets and collects videos that are highly likely to contain these target concepts. For high-quality annotation, we leverage the insight that modern MLLMs excel at dense captioning more than direct grounding and design a caption-centric data engine to prompt MLLMs to generate dense, timestamped descriptions. Beyond the dataset, we observe that simple supervised finetuning (SFT) is insufficient, as a performance gap between rare and common concepts still persists. We find that MLLMs' video understanding ability significantly surpasses their direct grounding ability. Based on this, we propose a Self-Correction Chain-of-Thought (CoT) training paradigm. We train the MLLM to first predict, then use its understanding capabilities to reflect on and refine its own predictions. This capability is instilled via a three-stage pipeline of SFT, CoT finetuning, and reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments show our approach not only excels at open-world grounding in our OmniVTG dataset but also achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on four existing VTG benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/OmniVTG.

item.title: Optimization-Free Topological Sort for Causal Discovery via the Schur Complement of Score Jacobians
item.author: Rui Wu, Hong Xie
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种解耦的连续因果发现范式，将因果发现瓶颈从非凸优化转移到统计得分估计，通过Score-Schur拓扑排序算法直接从无约束生成模型中提取拓扑顺序。

背景: 连续因果发现通常通过非凸无环性惩罚将表示学习与结构优化耦合，这使求解器容易陷入局部最优，并限制了在高维情况下的可扩展性。

目的: 提出一种解耦范式，将因果发现的瓶颈从非凸优化转移到统计得分估计，并引入Score-Schur拓扑排序算法以绕过约束结构优化。

方法: 提出Score-Schur拓扑排序（SSTS）算法，从无约束生成模型中直接提取拓扑顺序；建立因果层级在得分函数中留下几何签名，迭代图边缘化在数学上等价于计算线性条件下得分-雅可比信息矩阵的Schur补；针对非线性系统，提出Block-SSTS压缩提取深度。

主要发现: SSTS允许对非线性图进行高达d=1000的因果结构分析；一旦数学上绕过非凸优化瓶颈，连续因果发现的结构保真度由全局得分几何的有限样本估计方差决定。

结论: 通过将图提取简化为矩阵运算，本文将可扩展因果发现从约束优化问题重新框架化为统计估计挑战。

翻译: Continuous causal discovery typically couples representation learning with structural optimization via non-convex acyclicity penalties, which subjects solvers to local optima and restricts scalability in high-dimensional regimes. We propose a decoupled paradigm that shifts the causal discovery bottleneck from non-convex optimization to statistical score estimation. We introduce the Score-Schur Topological Sort (SSTS), an algorithm that extracts topological order directly from unconstrained generative models, bypassing constrained structure optimization. We establish that the causal hierarchy leaves a geometric signature within the score function: iterative graph marginalization is mathematically equivalent to computing the Schur complement of the Score-Jacobian Information Matrix (SJIM) under linear conditions. This translates the acyclicity constraint into an algebraic procedure with a dominant cost of O(d^3) operations. For non-linear systems, we formulate the expectation gap of Schur marginalization and introduce Block-SSTS to compress extraction depth, bounding structural error. Empirically, SSTS allows causal structural analysis on non-linear graphs up to d=1000. At this scale, our framework indicates that once the non-convex optimization bottleneck is mathematically bypassed, the structural fidelity of continuous causal discovery is bounded by the finite-sample estimation variance of the global score geometry. By reducing graph extraction to matrix operations, this work reframes scalable causal discovery from a constrained optimization problem to a statistical estimation challenge.

Abstract

Continuous causal discovery typically couples representation learning with structural optimization via non-convex acyclicity penalties, which subjects solvers to local optima and restricts scalability in high-dimensional regimes. We propose a decoupled paradigm that shifts the causal discovery bottleneck from non-convex optimization to statistical score estimation. We introduce the Score-Schur Topological Sort (SSTS), an algorithm that extracts topological order directly from unconstrained generative models, bypassing constrained structure optimization. We establish that the causal hierarchy leaves a geometric signature within the score function: iterative graph marginalization is mathematically equivalent to computing the Schur complement of the Score-Jacobian Information Matrix (SJIM) under linear conditions. This translates the acyclicity constraint into an algebraic procedure with a dominant cost of O(d^3) operations. For non-linear systems, we formulate the expectation gap of Schur marginalization and introduce Block-SSTS to compress extraction depth, bounding structural error. Empirically, SSTS allows causal structural analysis on non-linear graphs up to d=1000. At this scale, our framework indicates that once the non-convex optimization bottleneck is mathematically bypassed, the structural fidelity of continuous causal discovery is bounded by the finite-sample estimation variance of the global score geometry. By reducing graph extraction to matrix operations, this work reframes scalable causal discovery from a constrained optimization problem to a statistical estimation challenge.

item.title: VAE-Inf: A statistically interpretable generative paradigm for imbalanced classification
item.author: Hongfei Wu, Ruijian Han, Yancheng Yuan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为VAE-Inf的两阶段框架，用于解决机器学习中的不平衡分类问题，通过结合生成模型和判别式分类来提高性能。

背景: 不平衡分类是机器学习中的一个普遍挑战，特别是当少数类样本稀缺时，传统模型往往面临决策边界不稳定和缺乏可靠错误控制的问题。

目的: 为了弥合生成建模和判别式分类之间的差距，提出一种两阶段框架，以在极端场景下实现稳定决策边界和可靠错误控制。

方法: 第一阶段：使用变分自编码器（VAE）仅对多数类数据进行训练，通过Wasserstein重心聚合潜在后验，构建全局高斯参考模型；第二阶段：通过分布感知损失函数微调编码器，利用有限少数类样本实现判别式分类；推理阶段：引入基于投影的评分方法，允许进行分布无关的校准程序。

主要发现: 该方法在不依赖限制性参数假设的情况下，实现了对第一类错误（假阳性率）的精确有限样本控制；在多种现实世界基准测试中，与其他方法相比取得了竞争性的性能表现。

结论: 提出的VAE-Inf框架有效解决了少数类样本稀缺时的分类问题，提供了稳定且可靠的分类性能。

翻译: 不平衡分类仍然是机器学习中的一个普遍挑战，特别是当少数类样本太少而无法提供稳健的判别边界时。在这种极端情况下，传统模型往往面临决策边界不稳定和缺乏可靠错误控制的问题。为了弥合生成建模和判别式分类之间的差距，我们提出了一种两阶段框架VAE-Inf，它将深度表示学习与统计上可解释的假设检验相结合。在第一阶段，我们采用单类建模视角，仅对多数类数据训练变分自编码器（VAE）以捕获潜在参考分布。通过Wasserstein重心聚合得到的潜在后验，构建全局高斯参考模型，为多数类提供几何上合理的基线。在第二阶段，通过分布感知损失函数微调编码器，利用有限的少数类样本将这种生成基础转化为判别式分类器。这是通过一种新颖的分布感知损失实现的，该损失基于方差归一化投影统计量强制类间概率分离。对于推理，我们引入了一种基于投影的评分方法，允许进行自然的假设检验解释，从而进行分布无关的校准程序。这种方法在不依赖限制性参数假设的情况下，实现了对第一类错误（假阳性率）的精确有限样本控制。在多样化的现实世界基准测试中的大量实验表明，我们的框架与其他方法相比取得了竞争性的性能表现。代码可根据请求提供。

Abstract

Imbalanced classification remains a pervasive challenge in machine learning, particularly when minority samples are too scarce to provide a robust discriminative boundary. In such extreme scenarios, conventional models often suffer from unstable decision boundaries and a lack of reliable error control. To bridge the gap between generative modeling and discriminative classification, we propose a two-stage framework \textbf{VAE-Inf} that integrates deep representation learning with statistically interpretable hypothesis testing. In the first stage, we adopt a one-class modeling perspective by training a variational autoencoder (VAE) exclusively on majority-class data to capture the underlying reference distribution. The resulting latent posteriors are aggregated via a Wasserstein barycenter to construct a global Gaussian reference model, providing a geometrically principled baseline for the majority class. In the second stage, we transform this generative foundation into a discriminative classifier by fine-tuning the encoder with limited minority samples. This is achieved through a novel distribution-aware loss that enforces probabilistic separation between classes based on variance-normalized projection statistics. For inference, we introduce a projection-based score that admits a natural hypothesis testing interpretation, allowing for a distribution-free calibration procedure. This approach yields exact finite-sample control of the Type-I error (false positive rate) without relying on restrictive parametric assumptions. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world benchmarks demonstrate that our framework achieves competitive performance against other approaches. The codes are available upon request.

item.title: Leveraging Previous-Traversal Point Cloud Map Priors for Camera-Based 3D Object Detection and Tracking
item.author: Markus Käppeler, Özgün Çiçek, Yakov Miron, Abhinav Valada
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DualViewMapDet 是一种仅使用摄像头的推理框架，通过在线检索静态点云地图的几何先验信息，来缓解在缺乏昂贵激光雷达传感器时的深度模糊问题。

背景: 在自动驾驶中，基于摄像头的3D物体检测和跟踪至关重要，但在没有昂贵且深度丰富的在线激光雷达可用时，精确的3D物体定位受到深度模糊的根本性限制。

目的: 提出 DualViewMapDet 框架，利用车辆重复经过同一环境时生成的静态点云地图作为实用的几何先验信息，以缓解部署过程中激光雷达传感器的缺失。

方法: 采用双空间摄像头-地图融合策略，避免单向视图转换。具体包括：(i) 将地图投影到透视视图并编码多通道几何线索以丰富图像特征并支持鸟瞰图提升；(ii) 使用稀疏体素骨干网络直接在鸟瞰图编码地图，并在共享度量空间中与提升的摄像头特征融合。

主要发现: 在 nuScenes 和 Argoverse 2 数据集上的广泛评估显示，与强大的仅摄像头基线相比，该方法取得了持续改进，特别是在物体定位方面。

结论: 消融实验进一步验证了透视视图/鸟瞰图融合以及先验地图覆盖的贡献。

翻译: DualViewMapDet 是一种仅使用摄像头的推理框架，通过在线检索静态点云地图的几何先验信息，来缓解在缺乏昂贵激光雷达传感器时的深度模糊问题。

Abstract

Camera-based 3D object detection and tracking are central to autonomous driving, yet precise 3D object localization remains fundamentally constrained by depth ambiguity when no expensive, depth-rich online LiDAR is available at inference. In many deployments, however, vehicles repeatedly traverse the same environments, making static point cloud maps from prior traversals a practical source of geometric priors. We propose DualViewMapDet, a camera-only inference framework that retrieves such map priors online and leverages them to mitigate the absence of a LiDAR sensor during deployment. The key idea is a dual-space camera-map fusion strategy that avoids one-sided view conversion. Specifically, we (i) project the map into perspective view (PV) and encode multi-channel geometric cues to enrich image features and support BEV lifting, and (ii) encode the map directly in bird's-eye view (BEV) with a sparse voxel backbone and fuse it with lifted camera features in a shared metric space. Extensive evaluations on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 demonstrate consistent improvements over strong camera-only baselines, with particularly strong gains in object localization. Ablations further validate the contributions of PV/BEV fusion and prior-map coverage. We make the code and pre-trained models available at https://dualviewmapdet.cs.uni-freiburg.de .

item.title: A Systematic Post-Train Framework for Video Generation
item.author: Zeyue Xue, Siming Fu, Jie Huang, Shuai Lu, Haoran Li, Yijun Liu, Yuming Li, Xiaoxuan He, Mengzhao Chen, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan, Ping Luo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种综合的后训练框架，通过四个阶段将预训练模型与用户意图对齐，以解决视频扩散模型在部署中的问题。

背景: 大规模视频扩散模型在生成高质量内容方面表现出色，但在部署时面临提示敏感性、时间不一致和推理成本高昂等关键问题。

目的: 构建一个实用的后训练管道，以弥合预训练性能与现实世界部署要求之间的差距，提高视觉质量、时间一致性和指令遵循能力。

方法: 采用监督微调将基础模型转化为稳定的指令遵循策略，利用针对视频扩散的新型组相对策略优化方法进行强化学习从人类反馈，集成提示增强和推理优化。

主要发现: 该统一管道有效缓解了常见伪影，显著提高了可控性和视觉美感，同时遵守严格的采样成本约束。

结论: 该框架为构建稳定、可适应且有效的现实世界部署后训练管道提供了实用蓝图。

翻译: 大规模视频扩散模型在生成高分辨率和语义丰富内容方面表现出令人印象深刻的 capabilities，但由于提示敏感性、时间不一致和禁止的推理成本等关键问题，其预训练性能与现实世界部署要求之间存在显著差距。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种综合的后训练框架，通过四个协同阶段系统地将预训练模型与用户意图对齐：我们首先采用监督微调将基础模型转化为稳定的指令遵循策略，随后利用针对视频扩散的新型组相对策略优化方法进行强化学习从人类反馈，以增强感知质量和时间一致性；随后，我们通过专用语言模型集成提示增强来细化用户输入，最后通过推理优化解决系统效率问题。这些组件共同提供了一种提高视觉质量、时间一致性和指令遵循的系统方法，同时保留了预训练期间学习的可控性。结果是构建稳定、可适应且有效的现实世界部署后训练管道的实用蓝图。大量实验表明，该统一管道有效缓解了常见伪影，并显著提高了可控性和视觉美感，同时遵守严格的采样成本约束。

Abstract

While large-scale video diffusion models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in generating high-resolution and semantically rich content, a significant gap remains between their pretraining performance and real-world deployment requirements due to critical issues such as prompt sensitivity, temporal inconsistency, and prohibitive inference costs. To bridge this gap, we propose a comprehensive post-training framework that systematically aligns pretrained models with user intentions through four synergistic stages: we first employ Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to transform the base model into a stable instruction-following policy, followed by a Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) stage that utilizes a novel Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) method tailored for video diffusion to enhance perceptual quality and temporal coherence; subsequently, we integrate Prompt Enhancement via a specialized language model to refine user inputs, and finally address system efficiency through Inference Optimization. Together, these components provide a systematic approach to improving visual quality, temporal coherence, and instruction following, while preserving the controllability learned during pretraining. The result is a practical blueprint for building scalable post-training pipelines that are stable, adaptable, and effective in real-world deployment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this unified pipeline effectively mitigates common artifacts and significantly improves controllability and visual aesthetics while adhering to strict sampling cost constraints.

item.title: Training cell stress patterns in 3D cellular packings
item.author: Shabeeb Ameen, Tao Zhang, J. M. Schwarz
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究展示了在可重构细胞组织中，模式学习可以通过调整机械参数和网络拓扑结构来实现，学习过程涉及对比学习算法更新隐藏细胞形状指数，且学习具有集体性，受组织刚性和训练协议影响。

背景: 模式学习通常与在固定架构上更新参数的系统相关，如神经网络，其中学习通过连续优化进行。

目的: 展示在可重构细胞组织中，模式学习如何通过机械参数和网络拓扑结构的演变而出现，并利用三维顶点模型和对比学习算法训练细胞排列以实现特定的细胞应力模式。

方法: 使用三维顶点模型，通过对比学习算法更新隐藏细胞形状指数来训练细胞排列。

主要发现: 学习具有集体性，需要系统范围的协调参数调整；组织的刚性控制了探索-利用权衡；细胞重排引入了不连续的学习动态，使系统能够在成本函数景观中在不同局部最小值之间过渡；随着目标细胞与总细胞比例或约束负载的增加，学习变慢、更不均匀且越来越依赖于允许从几何约束状态中逃脱的罕见重排；顺序训练比并行协议更稳健但耗时更长。

结论: 提出了由约束负载、细胞排列刚性和训练协议支配的学习相图；这项工作使组织不仅成为适应性材料，而且成为非传统的人工智能平台。

翻译: The task of learning patterns is typically associated with systems that update parameters on fixed architectures, such as neural networks, where learning proceeds through continuous optimization. Here, we demonstrate that pattern learning can also emerge in reconfigurable cellular tissue, where both mechanical parameters and network topology evolve. Using a three-dimensional vertex model, we show that cellular packings can be trained to realize prescribed cell stress patterns through a contrastive learning algorithm to update hidden-cell shape indices. We find that learning is intrinsically collective, requiring coordinated, system-wide parameter adjustments, with learnability governed by an interplay between mechanical state, capacity, and training protocol. In particular, the rigidity of the tissue controls an effective exploration-exploitation tradeoff: fluid-like regimes enhance exploration through cellular rearrangements, while rigid regimes constrain dynamics and favor exploitation of existing configurations. These rearrangements introduce discontinuous learning dynamics, enabling the system to transition between distinct local minima in the cost function landscape. As the ratio of target cells to the total number cells in the packing or constraint load increases, learning becomes slower, more heterogeneous, and increasingly dependent on rare rearrangements that allow escape from geometrically constrained states. Finally, training cells in sequence, in contrast to parallel protocols, provides an alternative route that can be more robust but generally takes longer to train for the constraint loads studied. These results suggest a learning phase diagram governed by constraint load, cell packing rigidity, and training protocol. By enabling the training of localized internal states, this work positions tissues not only as adaptive materials, but as nonconventional AI platforms.

Abstract

The task of learning patterns is typically associated with systems that update parameters on fixed architectures, such as neural networks, where learning proceeds through continuous optimization. Here, we demonstrate that pattern learning can also emerge in reconfigurable cellular tissue, where both mechanical parameters and network topology evolve. Using a three-dimensional vertex model, we show that cellular packings can be trained to realize prescribed cell stress patterns through a contrastive learning algorithm to update hidden-cell shape indices. We find that learning is intrinsically collective, requiring coordinated, system-wide parameter adjustments, with learnability governed by an interplay between mechanical state, capacity, and training protocol. In particular, the rigidity of the tissue controls an effective exploration-exploitation tradeoff: fluid-like regimes enhance exploration through cellular rearrangements, while rigid regimes constrain dynamics and favor exploitation of existing configurations. These rearrangements introduce discontinuous learning dynamics, enabling the system to transition between distinct local minima in the cost function landscape. As the ratio of target cells to the total number cells in the packing or constraint load increases, learning becomes slower, more heterogeneous, and increasingly dependent on rare rearrangements that allow escape from geometrically constrained states. Finally, training cells in sequence, in contrast to parallel protocols, provides an alternative route that can be more robust but generally takes longer to train for the constraint loads studied. These results suggest a learning phase diagram governed by constraint load, cell packing rigidity, and training protocol. By enabling the training of localized internal states, this work positions tissues not only as adaptive materials, but as nonconventional AI platforms.

item.title: DualGeo: A Dual-View Framework for Worldwide Image Geo-localization
item.author: Junchao Cui, Wenqi Shi, Shaoyong Du, Hang He, Xuanzi Ma, Hao Tang, Xiangyang Luo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DualGeo是一个用于全球图像地理定位的两阶段框架，通过融合图像和语义分割特征以及双重视图对比学习来建立地理表示基础，并利用地理聚类和大型多模态模型进行地理认知细化，从而提高定位精度。

背景: 现有的图像地理定位方法依赖于对环境变化敏感的视觉特征，且缺乏有效的后处理来过滤异常候选者，限制了定位精度。

目的: 为了解决现有方法在环境变化敏感性和异常候选者过滤方面的局限性，提出DualGeo框架以提升全球图像地理定位的准确性。

方法: DualGeo包含两个阶段：第一阶段建立地理表示基础，通过双向交叉注意力融合图像和语义分割特征，并通过双重视图对比学习与GPS坐标对齐；第二阶段进行地理认知细化，利用地理聚类重新排序候选者，并输入大型多模态模型进行最终坐标预测。

主要发现: 在IM2GPS、IM2GPS3k和YFCC4k数据集上的实验表明，DualGeo优于最先进的方法，在街道级和城市级定位精度上分别提高了3.6%-16.58%和1.29%-8.77%。

结论: DualGeo通过其两阶段框架显著提高了全球图像地理定位的准确性，代码和数据集已公开。

翻译: DualGeo是一个用于全球图像地理定位的两阶段框架，通过融合图像和语义分割特征以及双重视图对比学习来建立地理表示基础，并利用地理聚类和大型多模态模型进行地理认知细化，从而提高定位精度。

Abstract

Worldwide image geo-localization aims to infer the geographic location of an image captured anywhere on Earth, spanning street, city, regional, national, and continental scales. Existing methods rely on visual features that are sensitive to environmental variations (e.g., lighting, season, and weather) and lack effective post-processing to filter outlier candidates, limiting localization accuracy. To address these limitations, we propose DualGeo, a two-stage framework for worldwide image geo-localization. First, it establishes a geo-representational foundation by fusing image and semantic segmentation features via bidirectional cross-attention. The fused features are then aligned with GPS coordinates through dual-view contrastive learning to build a global retrieval database. Second, it performs geo-cognitive refinement by re-ranking retrieved candidates using geographic clustering. It then feeds them into large multimodal models (LMMs) for final coordinate prediction. Experiments on IM2GPS, IM2GPS3k, and YFCC4k show that DualGeo outperforms state-of-the-art methods, improving street-level (<1 km) and city-level (<25 km) localization accuracy by 3.6%-16.58% and 1.29%-8.77%, respectively. Our code and datasets are available : https://github.com/CJ310177/DualGeo.

item.title: Control Your Queries: Heterogeneous Query Interaction for Camera-Radar Fusion
item.author: Jialong Wu, Yihan Wang, Matthias Rottmann
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种新的异构查询交互融合范式，并开发了名为ConFusion的相机-雷达3D目标检测器，通过引入异构查询混合和交互式查询交换采样来提升性能。

背景: 在自动驾驶中，相机-雷达融合提供了互补的感知能力和低部署成本。现有方法主要通过输入混合、特征图混合或基于查询的特征采样进行融合。

目的: 提出一种新的融合范式，即异构查询交互，以改善查询初始化和物体覆盖率，并鼓励不同类型查询之间的交叉交互。

方法: 提出了ConFusion相机-雷达3D目标检测器，结合图像查询、雷达查询和可学习的世界查询。引入了异构查询混合（QMix）以执行专门的跨类型注意力机制，以及交互式查询交换采样（QSwap）以允许相关查询在注意力和几何约束下交换信息丰富的特征标记。

主要发现: 在nuScenes数据集上的实验显示，ConFusion在验证集上达到了59.1 mAP和65.6 NDS，在测试集上达到了61.6 mAP和67.9 NDS，实现了最先进的性能。

结论: ConFusion在nuScenes数据集上实现了最先进的性能，验证了所提出的异构查询交互融合范式和方法的可行性。

翻译: 在自动驾驶中，相机-雷达融合提供了互补的感知和低部署成本。现有方法通过输入混合、特征图混合或基于查询的特征采样进行融合。我们提出了一种新的融合范式，称为异构查询交互，并提出了ConFusion，一种相机-雷达3D目标检测器。ConFusion结合了分布在3D空间中的图像查询、雷达查询和可学习的世界查询，以改善查询初始化和物体覆盖率。为了鼓励异构查询之间的交叉交互，我们引入了异构查询混合（QMix），它在特征采样后执行专门的跨类型注意力，以巩固互补的物体证据。我们进一步提出了交互式查询交换采样（QSwap），它通过允许相关查询在注意力和几何约束下交换信息丰富的特征标记来改善特征采样。在nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，ConFusion实现了最先进的性能，在验证集上达到59.1 mAP和65.6 NDS，在测试集上达到61.6 mAP和67.9 NDS。

Abstract

In autonomous driving, camera-radar fusion offers complementary sensing and low deployment cost. Existing methods perform fusion through input mixing, feature map mixing, or query-based feature sampling. We propose a new fusion paradigm, termed heterogeneous query interaction, and present ConFusion, a camera-radar 3D object detector. ConFusion combines image queries, radar queries, and learnable world queries distributed in 3D space to improve query initialization and object coverage. To encourage cross-type interaction among heterogeneous queries, we introduce heterogeneous query mixing (QMix), which performs dedicated cross-type attention after feature sampling to consolidate complementary object evidence. We further propose interactive query swap sampling (QSwap), which improves feature sampling by allowing related queries to exchange informative feature tokens under attention and geometric constraints. Experiments on the nuScenes dataset show that ConFusion achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching 59.1 mAP and 65.6 NDS on the validation set, and 61.6 mAP and 67.9 NDS on the test set.

item.title: DualFact+: A Multimodal Fact Verification Framework for Procedural Video Understanding
item.author: Cennet Oguz, Yasser Hamidullah, Josef van Genabith, Simon Ostermann
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DualFact是一个用于程序化视频描述的双层多模态事实性评估框架，将事实正确性分为概念事实和上下文事实，并包含隐式参数增强和对比事实集。

背景: 现有的多模态语言模型在生成程序化视频描述时，虽然流畅但往往事实不完整，存在系统性遗漏和角色级别的不一致。

目的: 为了支持完整且角色一致的评估，DualFact引入了隐式参数增强（VIA）和对比事实集，并区分了基于文本证据和视频 grounded 视觉证据的两种验证模式。

方法: DualFact将事实正确性分离为概念事实（捕获抽象语义角色）和上下文事实（捕获 grounded 谓词-参数实现），并包含隐式参数增强和对比事实集。

主要发现: 在YouCook3-Fact和CraftBench-Fact上的实验表明，最先进的多模态语言模型生成的描述往往事实不完整，且DualFact与人类事实性判断的相关性比标准指标更强，特别是对于上下文事实。

结论: DualFact提供了一种可解释且与人类对齐的评估协议，揭示了多模态事实性基础中持续存在的挑战，超越了表面流畅性。

翻译: 我们介绍了DualFact，这是一个用于程序化视频描述的双层、多模态事实性评估框架。DualFact将事实正确性分离为概念事实，捕获抽象语义角色（如动作、成分、工具、地点），以及上下文事实，捕获它们在视频中的 grounded 谓词-参数实现。为了支持完整且角色一致的评估，DualFact结合了隐式参数增强（VIA）和对比事实集。我们在两种模式下实例化了DualFact：DualFact-T，它根据文本证据验证事实，以及DualFact-V，它根据视频 grounded 的视觉证据验证事实。在YouCook3-Fact和CraftBench-Fact上的实验表明，最先进的多模态语言模型生成的描述流畅但往往事实不完整，存在系统性遗漏和角色级别的不一致。与标准指标相比，DualFact与人类事实性判断的相关性更强，特别是对于上下文事实，并且揭示了仅基于描述的评估相比视频 grounded 验证会高估幻觉。总体而言，DualFact提供了一种可解释且与人类对齐的评估协议，突出了多模态事实性基础中持续存在的挑战，超越了表面流畅性。

Abstract

We introduce DualFact, a dual-layer, multimodal factuality evaluation framework for procedural video captioning. DualFact separates factual correctness into conceptual facts, capturing abstract semantic roles (e.g., Action, Ingredient, Tool, Location), and contextual facts, capturing their grounded predicate-argument realizations in video. To support complete and role-consistent evaluation, DualFact incorporates implicit argument augmentation (VIA) and contrastive fact sets. We instantiate DualFact in two modes: DualFact-T, which verifies facts against textual evidence, and DualFact-V, which verifies facts against video-grounded visual evidence. Experiments on YouCook3-Fact and CraftBench-Fact show that state-of-the-art multimodal language models produce fluent but often factually incomplete captions, with systematic omissions and role-level inconsistencies. DualFact correlates more strongly with human factuality judgments than standard metrics, particularly for contextual facts, and reveals that caption-only evaluation overestimates hallucinations compared to video-grounded verification. Overall, DualFact offers an interpretable and human-aligned evaluation protocol that highlights persistent challenges in multimodal factual grounding, extending beyond surface-level fluency.

item.title: Refinement via Regeneration: Enlarging Modification Space Boosts Image Refinement in Unified Multimodal Models
item.author: Jiayi Guo, Linqing Wang, Jiangshan Wang, Yang Yue, Zeyu Liu, Zhiyuan Zhao, Qinglin Lu, Gao Huang, Chunyu Wang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为RvR的新框架，通过条件图像再生而非编辑来改进统一多模态模型在文本到图像任务中的性能。

背景: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）在文本到图像任务中具有统一的理解和生成能力，允许在初始生成后进行优化。现有的基于UMMs的优化方法主要遵循通过编辑进行优化的范式，但存在描述提示-图像错位粗糙、优化不完整以及像素级内容保留限制有效修改空间的问题。

目的: 为了解决现有方法中编辑指令描述粗糙导致优化不完整以及像素级内容保留限制有效修改空间的问题，提出一种新的优化框架。

方法: 提出Refinement via Regeneration (RvR)框架，将优化重新定义为条件图像再生而非编辑。该方法不依赖编辑指令，而是根据目标提示和初始图像的语义标记来再生图像，从而实现更完整的语义对齐和更大的修改空间。

主要发现: 实验表明RvR框架有效，将Geneval从0.78提高到0.91，DPGBench从84.02提高到87.21，UniGenBench++从61.53提高到77.41。

结论: RvR框架通过条件图像再生方法，克服了现有编辑范式的局限性，显著提升了文本到图像任务的性能指标。

翻译: 提出了一种名为RvR的新框架，通过条件图像再生而非编辑来改进统一多模态模型在文本到图像任务中的性能。

Abstract

Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate visual understanding and generation within a single framework. For text-to-image (T2I) tasks, this unified capability allows UMMs to refine outputs after their initial generation, potentially extending the performance upper bound. Current UMM-based refinement methods primarily follow a refinement-via-editing (RvE) paradigm, where UMMs produce editing instructions to modify misaligned regions while preserving aligned content. However, editing instructions often describe prompt-image misalignment only coarsely, leading to incomplete refinement. Moreover, pixel-level preservation, though necessary for editing, unnecessarily restricts the effective modification space for refinement. To address these limitations, we propose Refinement via Regeneration (RvR), a novel framework that reformulates refinement as conditional image regeneration rather than editing. Instead of relying on editing instructions and enforcing strict content preservation, RvR regenerates images conditioned on the target prompt and the semantic tokens of the initial image, enabling more complete semantic alignment with a larger modification space. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of RvR, improving Geneval from 0.78 to 0.91, DPGBench from 84.02 to 87.21, and UniGenBench++ from 61.53 to 77.41.

item.title: Intensity-guided pose-free multiview fusion for single photon sensing
item.author: Jinyi Liu, Lijun Liu, Shuming Cheng, Xiaomin Hu, Yiguang Hong, Weiping Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种无姿态多视图融合的几何-强度耦合注册框架，用于单光子传感，通过结合物理感知预处理、联合几何-强度网格特征聚合、全局匹配和局部歧义消除来估计视图间的刚体变换并构建全局一致的重建。

背景: 单光子激光雷达在极端环境下的长距离操作、低反射率目标和恶劣能见度中具有应用，但获取的测量结果往往产生稀疏、空间非均匀且受离群点和深度畸变破坏的单光子点云，使得多视图注册具有挑战性，尤其是当传感器姿态未准确已知时。

目的: 提出一种无姿态多视图融合的几何-强度耦合注册框架，以解决单光子点云稀疏、空间非均匀、受离群点和深度畸变破坏导致的注册困难问题。

方法: 结合物理感知预处理、联合几何-强度网格特征聚合、全局匹配和局部歧义消除来估计视图间的刚体变换，从而构建全局一致的重建。

主要发现: 在合成基准测试中，该方法在所有背景噪声和dropout率下均具有最低的相对旋转误差、相对平移误差和均方根误差；在最严重的dropout情况下，相对旋转误差从13.167度降低到8.459度；在约80米处的真实多视图数据上，实现了更可靠的全局方向和局部对齐。

结论: 光子强度为稳定单光子点云多视图注册提供了有效的物理线索，该工作有助于探索单光子传感的实际效用。

翻译: Single-photon light detection and ranging (LiDAR) extends active three-dimensional sensing at the fundamental level and has found applications in extreme environments involving long-range operation, low-reflectance targets, and adverse visibility. However, the acquired measurements often give rise to single-photon point clouds that are sparse, spatially non-uniform, and corrupted by outliers and depth distortions, making multi-view registration challenging especially when sensor poses are not accurately known. In this work, we present a geometry-intensity coupled registration framework (GIC-Reg) of pose-free multi-view fusion for single-photon sensing. It is established by combining physical-aware preprocessing, joint geometry-intensity grid feature aggregation, global matching, and local ambiguity disambigulation to estimate inter-view rigid transformations and hence to construct a globally consistent reconstruction. On the synthetic benchmark, it admits the lowest relative rotation error (RRE), relative translation error, and root mean square error across all background-noise and dropout rates, in comparison to baselines. Notably, under the most degraded dropout, it reduces the RRE from $13.167^ext{extdegree}$ to $8.459^ext{extdegree}$ compared with the learning-based baseline. Furthermore, experimental results on real multi-view data acquired at about 80~m show that it achieves more reliable global orientation and local alignment. Our results show that photon intensity provides an effective physical cue for stabilizing multiview registration in single-photon point cloud, and thus our work aids significant progress in exploring practical utility of single-photon sensing.

Abstract

Single-photon light detection and ranging (LiDAR) extends active three-dimensional sensing at the fundamental level and has found applications in extreme environments involving long-range operation, low-reflectance targets, and adverse visibility. However, the acquired measurements often give rise to single-photon point clouds that are sparse, spatially non-uniform, and corrupted by outliers and depth distortions, making multi-view registration challenging especially when sensor poses are not accurately known. In this work, we present a geometry-intensity coupled registration framework (GIC-Reg) of pose-free multi-view fusion for single-photon sensing. It is established by combining physical-aware preprocessing, joint geometry-intensity grid feature aggregation, global matching, and local ambiguity disambiguation to estimate inter-view rigid transformations and hence to construct a globally consistent reconstruction. On the synthetic benchmark, it admits the lowest relative rotation error (RRE), relative translation error, and root mean square error across all background-noise and dropout rates, in comparison to baselines. Notably, under the most degraded dropout, it reduces the RRE from $13.167^\circ$ to $8.459^\circ$ compared with the learning-based baseline. Furthermore, experimental results on real multi-view data acquired at about 80~m show that it achieves more reliable global orientation and local alignment. Our results show that photon intensity provides an effective physical cue for stabilizing multiview registration in single-photon point cloud, and thus our work aids significant progress in exploring practical utility of single-photon sensing.

item.title: Toward Scalable Terminal Task Synthesis via Skill Graphs
item.author: Zhiyuan Fan, Tinghao Yu, Yuanjun Cai, Jiangtao Guan, Yun Yang, Dingxin Hu, Jiang Zhou, Xing Wu, Zhuo Han, Feng Zhang, Lilin Wang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SkillSynth是一个自动化框架，用于合成终端任务，通过场景中介的技能图来控制执行轨迹的多样性。

背景: 终端代理在自主命令行执行方面显示出强大潜力，但训练受限于高质量和多样化执行轨迹的稀缺。现有方法通过合成大规模终端任务实例来缓解这一瓶颈，但主要关注任务数量，对训练过程中代理实际经历的执行轨迹多样性控制有限。

目的: 提出SkillSynth，一个基于场景中介技能图的自动化终端任务合成框架，以显式控制合成任务所需的最小执行轨迹的多样性。

方法: SkillSynth首先构建大规模技能图，其中场景作为连接多样化命令行技能的中间转换节点；然后从图中采样路径作为现实世界工作流的抽象，并使用多代理Harness将其实例化为可执行的任务实例。

主要发现: 在Terminal-Bench上的实验证明了SkillSynth的有效性；由SkillSynth合成的任务实例被用于训练Hy3 Preview，增强了其在基于终端环境中的代理能力。

结论: 通过将任务合成建立在图采样的工作流路径上，SkillSynth显式控制了解决合成任务所需的最小执行轨迹的多样性。

翻译: 终端代理在自主命令行执行方面显示出强大潜力，但训练受限于高质量和多样化执行轨迹的稀缺。现有方法通过合成大规模终端任务实例来缓解这一瓶颈，但主要关注任务数量，对训练过程中代理实际经历的执行轨迹多样性控制有限。本文提出SkillSynth，一个基于场景中介技能图的自动化终端任务合成框架。SkillSynth首先构建大规模技能图，其中场景作为连接多样化命令行技能的中间转换节点；然后从图中采样路径作为现实世界工作流的抽象，并使用多代理Harness将其实例化为可执行的任务实例。通过将任务合成建立在图采样的工作流路径上，SkillSynth显式控制了解决合成任务所需的最小执行轨迹的多样性。在Terminal-Bench上的实验证明了SkillSynth的有效性；由SkillSynth合成的任务实例被用于训练Hy3 Preview，增强了其在基于终端环境中的代理能力。

Abstract

Terminal agents have demonstrated strong potential for autonomous command-line execution, yet their training remains constrained by the scarcity of high-quality and diverse execution trajectories. Existing approaches mitigate this bottleneck by synthesizing large-scale terminal task instances for trajectory sampling. However, they primarily focus on scaling the number of tasks while providing limited control over the diversity of execution trajectories that agents actually experience during training. In this paper, we present SkillSynth, an automated framework for terminal task synthesis built on a scenario-mediated skill graph. SkillSynth first constructs a large-scale skill graph, where scenarios serve as intermediate transition nodes that connect diverse command-line skills. It then samples paths from this graph as abstractions of real-world workflows, and uses a multi-agent harness to instantiate them into executable task instances. By grounding task synthesis in graph-sampled workflow paths, SkillSynth explicitly controls the diversity of minimal execution trajectories required to solve the synthesized tasks. Experiments on Terminal-Bench demonstrate the effectiveness of SkillSynth. Moreover, task instances synthesized by SkillSynth have been adopted to train Hy3 Preview, contributing to its enhanced agentic capabilities in terminal-based settings.

item.title: QAROO: AI-Driven Online Task Offloading for Energy-Efficient and Sustainable MEC Networks
item.author: Yongtao Yao, Yao Yang, Haorui Shi, Canglu Zhu, Miaojiang Chen, Ahmed Farouk
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于量子注意力和强化学习的在线任务卸载框架QAROO，用于无线供电移动边缘计算网络。

背景: 随着人工智能和智能科学的快速发展，智能边缘计算被广泛采用，但传统方法在适应性和启发式算法收敛速度方面存在局限性。

目的: 为了实现可持续和资源高效的边缘应用，提出在线任务卸载框架以在动态信道环境中协同优化计算和能源资源。

方法: 采用二进制卸载策略，集成量子神经网络和注意力机制，利用循环神经网络增强时序建模能力，提出不确定性引导的量化方法提高探索效率，并将注意力机制融入量子网络以加强特征表示。

主要发现: 实验表明，该方法在归一化计算速度和处理时间方面优于对比方案，为大规模物联网动态环境中的在线任务卸载提供了高效稳定的解决方案。

结论: 该方法有效解决了传统方法适应性和收敛速度的问题，为大规模物联网动态环境下的在线任务卸载提供了高效稳定的解决方案。

翻译: 随着人工智能和智能科学的快速发展，智能边缘计算已被广泛采用。然而，传统方法的局限性，如适应性差和启发式算法收敛慢，变得越来越明显。为了实现可持续和资源高效的边缘应用，本文提出了一种用于无线供电移动边缘计算（MEC）网络的在线任务卸载框架，称为基于量子注意力的在线卸载强化学习（QAROO）。该系统采用二进制卸载策略，旨在在动态信道环境中协同优化计算和能源资源。针对传统方法的适应性问题以及启发式算法收敛慢的问题，该框架集成了量子神经网络和注意力机制，引入了三个关键改进：使用循环神经网络增强时序建模能力，提出不确定性引导的量化方法以提高探索效率，并将注意力机制融入量子网络以加强特征表示。实验表明，所提出的方法在归一化计算速度和处理时间方面优于对比方案，为大规模物联网（IoT）动态环境中的在线任务卸载提供了高效稳定的解决方案。

Abstract

With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) and intelligent science, intelligent edge computing has been widely adopted. However, the limitations of traditional methods, such as poor adaptability and the slow convergence of heuristic algorithms, are becoming increasingly evident. To enable sustainable and resource-efficient edge applications, this paper proposes an online task offloading framework for wireless powered mobile edge computing (MEC) networks, called Quantum Attention-based Reinforcement learning for Online Offloading (QAROO). The system employs a binary offloading strategy with the aim of co-optimizing computing and energy resources in dynamic channel environments. In response to the issues of poor adaptability in traditional approaches and the slow convergence of heuristic algorithms, the framework integrates quantum neural networks and attention mechanisms, introducing three key improvements: using recurrent neural networks to enhance temporal modeling capability, proposing an uncertainty-guided quantization method to improve exploration efficiency, and incorporating attention mechanisms into quantum networks to strengthen feature representation. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms comparative schemes in terms of normalized computation speed and processing time, offering an efficient and stable solution for online task offloading in large-scale Internet of Things (IoT) dynamic environments.

item.title: KinDER: A Physical Reasoning Benchmark for Robot Learning and Planning
item.author: Yixuan Huang, Bowen Li, Vaibhav Saxena, Yichao Liang, Utkarsh Aashu Mishra, Liang Ji, Lihan Zha, Jimmy Wu, Nishanth Kumar, Sebastian Scherer, Danfei Xu, Tom Silver
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: KinDER是一个针对机器人学习与规划中物理推理挑战的基准测试，包含25个程序化生成环境、Gymnasium兼容库及标准化评估套件。

背景: 机器人系统与物理世界交互时必须推理自身、环境和任务所施加的动力学和运动学约束。

目的: 引入KinDER基准测试，以解决机器人学习与规划中产生的物理推理挑战。

方法: KinDER包含25个程序化生成环境、Gymnasium兼容Python库（含参数化技能和演示）及标准化评估套件（含13种基线方法），旨在隔离五种核心物理推理挑战。

主要发现: 现有方法难以解决许多环境中的问题，表明当前物理推理方法存在显著差距；真实到仿真再到真实的实验显示仿真与真实世界物理交互存在对应关系。

结论: KinDER完全开源，旨在促进不同范式间的系统比较，以推进机器人物理推理的发展。

翻译: 摘要：与物理世界交互的机器人系统必须推理由其自身、环境和任务施加的运动学和动力学约束。我们介绍了KinDER，这是一个针对机器人学习和规划中产生的物理推理挑战的基准测试。KinDER包含25个程序化生成环境、一个与Gymnasium兼容的Python库（含参数化技能和演示）以及一个标准化评估套件，其中包含13种基线方法，涵盖任务和运动规划、模仿学习、强化学习和基于基础模型的方法。这些环境旨在隔离五种核心物理推理挑战：基本空间关系、非抓取多物体操作、工具使用、组合几何约束和动态约束，同时与感知、语言理解和特定应用复杂性解耦。实证评估表明，现有方法难以解决许多环境中的问题，这表明当前物理推理方法存在显著差距。我们还在移动操作器上进行了真实到仿真再到真实的实验，以评估仿真与真实世界物理交互之间的对应关系。KinDER完全开源，旨在促进不同范式间的系统比较，以推进机器人物理推理的发展。

Abstract

Robotic systems that interact with the physical world must reason about kinematic and dynamic constraints imposed by their own embodiment, their environment, and the task at hand. We introduce KinDER, a benchmark for Kinematic and Dynamic Embodied Reasoning that targets physical reasoning challenges arising in robot learning and planning. KinDER comprises 25 procedurally generated environments, a Gymnasium-compatible Python library with parameterized skills and demonstrations, and a standardized evaluation suite with 13 implemented baselines spanning task and motion planning, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and foundation-model-based approaches. The environments are designed to isolate five core physical reasoning challenges: basic spatial relations, nonprehensile multi-object manipulation, tool use, combinatorial geometric constraints, and dynamic constraints, disentangled from perception, language understanding, and application-specific complexity. Empirical evaluation shows that existing methods struggle to solve many of the environments, indicating substantial gaps in current approaches to physical reasoning. We additionally include real-to-sim-to-real experiments on a mobile manipulator to assess the correspondence between simulation and real-world physical interaction. KinDER is fully open-sourced and intended to enable systematic comparison across diverse paradigms for advancing physical reasoning in robotics. Website and code: https://prpl-group.com/kinder-site/

item.title: Diverse Image Priors for Black-box Data-free Knowledge Distillation
item.author: Tri-Nhan Vo, Dang Nguyen, Trung Le, Kien Do, Sunil Gupta
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DIP-KD 是一种用于解决受限 AI 环境下无数据知识蒸馏的框架，通过三个阶段实现高效的学生模型训练。

背景: 在去中心化或安全的 AI 生态系统中，隐私法规和专有利益限制了访问教师网络的接口和原始数据集，导致只能在无训练数据的情况下进行黑盒数据无知识蒸馏。

目的: 解决受限 AI 环境下数据多样性和蒸馏信号有限的问题，提出一种新的知识蒸馏框架。

方法: DIP-KD 框架包含三个阶段：1. 合成图像先验以捕获多样化的视觉模式和语义；2. 使用对比学习增强合成样本之间的集体区分度；3. 通过新颖的引导学生模型实现软概率知识蒸馏。

主要发现: 在 12 个基准测试中，DIP-KD 取得了最先进的性能；消融实验证实数据多样性对于受限 AI 环境中的知识获取至关重要。

结论: DIP-KD 通过三个阶段的协作流程，有效解决了黑盒数据无知识蒸馏中的数据多样性和蒸馏信号问题，实现了高性能的学生模型。

翻译: 知识蒸馏代表了一种将专业知识从复杂的教师网络转移到高效学生模型的重要机制。然而，在去中心化或安全的 AI 生态系统中，隐私法规和专有利益往往限制了访问教师接口和原始数据集。这些限制定义了一个具有挑战性的黑盒数据无知识蒸馏场景，其中仅提供 top-1 预测且没有训练数据。虽然最近的方法利用合成数据，但它们在数据多样性和蒸馏信号方面仍面临限制。我们提出了多样化的图像先验知识蒸馏 DIP-KD，这是一个通过三个阶段的协作流程来解决这些挑战的框架：(1) 合成图像先验以捕获多样化的视觉模式和语义；(2) 使用对比学习增强合成样本之间的集体区分度；以及 (3) 通过新颖的引导学生模型实现软概率知识蒸馏。我们在 12 个基准测试中的评估表明，DIP-KD 取得了最先进的性能，消融实验证实数据多样性对于受限 AI 环境中的知识获取至关重要。

Abstract

Knowledge distillation (KD) represents a vital mechanism to transfer expertise from complex teacher networks to efficient student models. However, in decentralized or secure AI ecosystems, privacy regulations and proprietary interests often restrict access to the teacher's interface and original datasets. These constraints define a challenging black-box data-free KD scenario where only top-1 predictions and no training data are available. While recent approaches utilize synthetic data, they still face limitations in data diversity and distillation signals. We propose Diverse Image Priors Knowledge Distillation (DIP-KD), a framework that addresses these challenges through a three-phase collaborative pipeline: (1) Synthesis of image priors to capture diverse visual patterns and semantics; (2) Contrast to enhance the collective distinction between synthetic samples via contrastive learning; and (3) Distillation via a novel primer student that enables soft-probability KD. Our evaluation across 12 benchmarks shows that DIP-KD achieves state-of-the-art performance, with ablations confirming data diversity as critical for knowledge acquisition in restricted AI environments.

item.title: MAIC-UI: Making Interactive Courseware with Generative UI
item.author: Shangqing Tu, Yanjia Li, Keyu Chen, Sichen Zhang, Jifan Yu, Daniel Zhang-Li, Lei Hou, Juanzi Li, Yu Zhang, Huiqin Liu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MAIC-UI是一个零代码创作系统，允许教育工作者从教科书、PPT和PDF中快速创建和编辑交互式课程材料。

背景: 传统的交互式STEM课程材料创作需要HTML/CSS/JavaScript专业知识，阻碍了教育工作者。现有的生成式AI工具存在生成静态演示而非交互式模拟、难以处理长文档、缺乏教学准确性机制以及修改需要较长时间等问题。

目的: 提出MAIC-UI，一个零代码创作系统，使教育工作者能够从教科书、PPT和PDF中创建和快速编辑交互式课程材料。

方法: MAIC-UI采用结构化知识分析（多模态理解以确保教学严谨性）、两阶段生成-验证-优化流程（将内容对齐与视觉优化分离）以及基于统一Diff的增量生成（点击定位编辑，实现不到10秒的迭代周期）。

主要发现: 在40名参与者的受控实验室研究中，MAIC-UI减少了编辑迭代次数（4.9次对比7.0次），并显著提高了可学习性和可控性。在53名高中学生的三个月课堂部署中，MAIC-UI促进了学习能动性并减少了结果差异——试点班级在STEM科目上取得了9.21分的进步，而对照组则下降了2.32分。

结论: MAIC-UI通过减少编辑迭代次数、提高可学习性和可控性，以及促进学习能动性和减少结果差异，优于直接文本到HTML的生成。

翻译: 创建交互式STEM课程材料传统上需要HTML/CSS/JavaScript专业知识，给教育工作者设置了障碍。虽然生成式AI可以生成HTML代码，但现有工具生成的是静态演示而不是交互式模拟，难以处理长文档，缺乏教学准确性机制。此外，修改需要200-600秒的全量重新生成，会打断创作流程。我们提出了MAIC-UI，一个零代码创作系统，使教育工作者能够从教科书、PPT和PDF中创建和快速编辑交互式课程材料。MAIC-UI采用：(1)结构化知识分析，结合多模态理解以确保教学严谨性；(2)两阶段生成-验证-优化流程，将内容对齐与视觉优化分离；(3)点击定位编辑，结合基于统一Diff的增量生成，实现不到10秒的迭代周期。一项包含40名参与者的受控实验室研究显示，与直接文本到HTML生成相比，MAIC-UI减少了编辑迭代次数（4.9次对比7.0次），并显著提高了可学习性和可控性。一项包含53名高中学生的三个月课堂部署表明，MAIC-UI促进了学习能动性并减少了结果差异——试点班级在STEM科目上取得了9.21分的进步，而对照组则下降了2.32分。我们的代码可在https://github.com/THU-MAIC/MAIC-UI获取。

Abstract

Creating interactive STEM courseware traditionally requires HTML/CSS/JavaScript expertise, leaving barriers for educators. While generative AI can produce HTML codes, existing tools generate static presentations rather than interactive simulations, struggle with long documents, and lack pedagogical accuracy mechanisms. Furthermore, full regeneration for modifications requires 200--600 seconds, disrupting creative flow. We present MAIC-UI, a zero-code authoring system that enables educators to create and rapidly edit interactive courseware from textbooks, PPTs, and PDFs. MAIC-UI employs: (1) structured knowledge analysis with multi-modal understanding to ensure pedagogical rigor; (2) a two-stage generate-verify-optimize pipeline separating content alignment from visual refinement; and (3) Click-to-Locate editing with Unified Diff-based incremental generation achieving sub-10-second iteration cycles. A controlled lab study with 40 participants shows MAIC-UI reduces editing iterations (4.9 vs. 7.0) and significantly improves learnability and controllability compared to direct Text-to-HTML generation. A three-month classroom deployment with 53 high school students demonstrates that MAIC-UI fosters learning agency and reduces outcome disparities -- the pilot class achieved 9.21-point gains in STEM subjects compared to -2.32 points in control classes. Our code is available at https://github.com/THU-MAIC/MAIC-UI.

item.title: Mutual Forcing: Dual-Mode Self-Evolution for Fast Autoregressive Audio-Video Character Generation
item.author: Yupeng Zhou, Lianghua Huang, Zhifan Wu, Jiabao Wang, Yupeng Shi, Biao Jiang, Daquan Zhou, Yu Liu, Ming-Ming Cheng, Qibin Hou
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 Mutual Forcing 的框架，用于快速自回归音频视频生成，并解决长时音频视频同步问题。

背景: 现有方法在联合音频视频建模和快速自回归生成方面面临挑战，且现有流式生成管道通常需要先训练双向模型再通过多阶段蒸馏转换为因果生成器。

目的: 解决联合音频视频建模和快速自回归生成两个关键挑战，旨在构建一个无需额外双向教师模型、支持灵活训练序列长度、减少训练开销且能直接从真实配对数据中改进的框架。

方法: 采用两阶段训练策略：先训练单模态生成器，再耦合为统一音频视频模型进行联合训练。在流式生成方面，直接构建原生自回归模型，将少步和多步生成集成在单一权重共享模型中，实现自蒸馏。

主要发现: Mutual Forcing 消除了对额外双向教师模型的需求，支持更灵活的训练序列长度，减少了训练开销，并能直接从真实配对数据中改进。多步模式通过自蒸馏改进少步模式，而少步模式在训练中生成历史上下文以改善训练推理一致性，两者在单一模型中相互强化。

结论: 实验表明，Mutual Forcing 在仅使用 4 到 8 步采样时，就能匹配或超越需要约 50 步采样的强基线，在效率和质量方面均表现出显著优势。

翻译: 本文提出了一种名为 Mutual Forcing 的框架，用于快速自回归音频视频生成，并解决长时音频视频同步问题。现有方法在联合音频视频建模和快速自回归生成方面面临挑战，且现有流式生成管道通常需要先训练双向模型再通过多阶段蒸馏转换为因果生成器。解决联合音频视频建模和快速自回归生成两个关键挑战，旨在构建一个无需额外双向教师模型、支持灵活训练序列长度、减少训练开销且能直接从真实配对数据中改进的框架。采用两阶段训练策略：先训练单模态生成器，再耦合为统一音频视频模型进行联合训练。在流式生成方面，直接构建原生自回归模型，将少步和多步生成集成在单一权重共享模型中，实现自蒸馏。Mutual Forcing 消除了对额外双向教师模型的需求，支持更灵活的训练序列长度，减少了训练开销，并能直接从真实配对数据中改进。多步模式通过自蒸馏改进少步模式，而少步模式在训练中生成历史上下文以改善训练推理一致性，两者在单一模型中相互强化。实验表明，Mutual Forcing 在仅使用 4 到 8 步采样时，就能匹配或超越需要约 50 步采样的强基线，在效率和质量方面均表现出显著优势。

Abstract

In this work, we propose Mutual Forcing, a framework for fast autoregressive audio-video generation with long-horizon audio-video synchronization. Our approach addresses two key challenges: joint audio-video modeling and fast autoregressive generation. To ease joint audio-video optimization, we adopt a two-stage training strategy: we first train uni-modal generators and then couple them into a unified audio-video model for joint training on paired data. For streaming generation, we ask whether a native fast causal audio-video model can be trained directly, instead of following existing streaming distillation pipelines that typically train a bidirectional model first and then convert it into a causal generator through multiple distillation stages. Our answer is Mutual Forcing, which builds directly on native autoregressive model and integrates few-step and multi-step generation within a single weight-shared model, enabling self-distillation and improved training-inference consistency. The multi-step mode improves the few-step mode via self-distillation, while the few-step mode generates historical context during training to improve training-inference consistency; because the two modes share parameters, these two effects reinforce each other within a single model. Compared with prior approaches such as Self-Forcing, Mutual Forcing removes the need for an additional bidirectional teacher model, supports more flexible training sequence lengths, reduces training overhead, and allows the model to improve directly from real paired data rather than a fixed teacher. Experiments show that Mutual Forcing matches or surpasses strong baselines that require around 50 sampling steps while using only 4 to 8 steps, demonstrating substantial advantages in both efficiency and quality. The project page is available at https://mutualforcing.github.io.

item.title: Model-agnostic information transfer and fusion for classification with label noise
item.author: Zhu Guojun, Zhang Sanguo, Ren Mingyang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种通用的、模型无关的非参数分类框架，用于处理标签噪声问题，该框架利用少量干净数据来净化大量噪声数据，并通过严格的统计理论支持。

背景: 标签噪声是现代机器学习中的基本挑战，特别是在通过自动化流程生成的大规模数据集中。在医学成像等领域，一种常见的数据范式涉及从带有粗略噪声标签的大数据集和少量专家验证的干净数据集中学习。

目的: 解决现有统计迁移学习方法在处理标签噪声时，因噪声数据和干净数据之间存在显著分布偏移而违反核心参数相似性假设的问题，以及现有方法依赖参数模型不适合图像等复杂数据的局限性。

方法: 开发了一个通用的、模型无关的非参数分类框架，利用少量干净数据来净化大量噪声数据，并仔细管理剩余的模糊样本。该框架基于严格的统计理论。

主要发现: 通过模拟和医学图像分析中肺炎诊断的实际应用，证明了该框架在处理标签噪声分类任务中的有效性。

结论: 该框架适用于广泛的分类器，能够有效处理标签噪声问题，并在医学图像分析中表现出良好的性能。

翻译: 标签噪声是现代机器学习中的基本挑战，特别是在通过自动化流程生成的大规模数据集中。一种日益普遍且重要的数据范式，特别是在医学成像等领域，涉及从带有粗略噪声标签的大数据集和少量专家验证的干净数据集中学习。这种设置构成了典型的信息转移和融合问题。然而，噪声数据和干净数据之间显著的分布偏移违反了现有统计迁移学习方法的核心整体参数相似性假设，而它们对参数模型的依赖也不适合图像等复杂数据。为了解决这些局限性，本文开发了一个通用的、模型无关的非参数分类框架，用于处理标签噪声问题，该框架适用于广泛的分类器。我们的方法利用少量干净数据来“净化”大量噪声数据，并仔细管理剩余的模糊样本。该框架建立在严格的统计理论基础之上。其性能通过模拟和医学图像分析中肺炎诊断的实际应用得到了证明。

Abstract

Label noise presents a fundamental challenge in modern machine learning, especially when large-scale datasets are generated via automated processes. An increasingly common and important data paradigm, particularly in domains like medical imaging, involves learning from a large dataset with coarse, noisy labels supplemented by a small, expert-verified, clean dataset. This setting constitutes a typical information transfer and fusion problem. However, the significant distribution shift between the noisy and clean data violates the core overall parametric similarity assumptions of existing statistical transfer learning methods, while their reliance on parametric models is ill-suited for complex data like images. To address these limitations, this paper develops a generic model-agnostic nonparametric framework for classification with label noise, which applies to a broad class of classifiers. Our approach leverages the small clean dataset to ``purify'' the large noisy one and carefully manages the remaining ambiguous samples. This framework is underpinned by a rigorous statistical theory. Its empirical performance is demonstrated through simulations and a real-world application to medical image analysis for pneumonia diagnosis.

item.title: Explainable AI for Jet Tagging: A Comparative Study of GNNExplainer, GNNShap, and GradCAM for Jet Tagging in the Lund Jet Plane
item.author: Pahal D. Patel, Sanmay Ganguly
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了图神经网络在大型强子对撞机喷注标记任务中的可解释性，通过物理信息评估框架分析了模型预测背后的物理推理机制。

背景: 粒子神经网络和基于点云的变换器网络在大型强子对撞机的喷注标记基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，但它们的预测背后的物理推理仍然不透明。

目的: 提出不同的方法，即基于扰动的方法、基于Shapley值的方法和基于梯度的方法，并针对LundNet的Lund平面图表示进行了适配。

方法: 利用Lund平面中的每个节点对应一个物理上有意义的部分子分裂的事实，构建蒙特卡罗真值解释掩码，并引入了超越标准保真度指标的物理信息评估框架。

主要发现: 分析在三个横动量区间内进行，揭示了可解释性质量和非微扰与微扰区域之间的关注点如何变化。进一步量化了解释器分配的节点重要性与经典喷注子结构可观测量之间的相关性，表明模型已学习到已知的QCD特征。

结论: 解释性方法分配的权重与解析可观测量具有相关性，在不同相空间区域之间存在预期偏移，表明训练好的神经网络确实学习到了喷注子结构矩的一些方面。

翻译: Graph neural networks such as ParticleNet and transformer based networks on point clouds such as ParticleTransformer achieve state-of-the-art performance on jet tagging benchmarks at the Large Hadron Collider, yet the physical reasoning behind their predictions remains opaque. We present different methods, i.e. perturbation-based (GNNExplainer), Shapley-value-based (GNNShap), and gradient-based (GRADCam); adapted to operate on LundNet's Lund-plane graph representation. Leveraging the fact that each node in the Lund plane corresponds to a physically meaningful parton splitting, we construct Monte Carlo truth explanation masks and introduce a physics-informed evaluation framework that goes beyond standard fidelity metrics. We perform the analysis in three transverse-momentum bins ($ext{p}_T ext{ in } [500,700]$, $[800,1000]$, and the inclusive region $[500,1000]$ GeV), revealing how explanation quality and focus shift between non-perturbative and perturbative regimes. We further quantify the correlation between explainer-assigned node importance and classical jet substructure observables -- $N$-subjettiness ratios $au_{21}$ and $au_{32}$ and the energy correlation functions -- establishing the degree to which the model has learned known QCD features. We find that overall the weight assigned by explainability methods has a correlation with analytic observables, with expected shift across different phase space regimes, indicating that a trained neural network indeed learns some aspects of jet-substructure moments. Our open-source implementation enables reproducible explainability studies for graph-based jet taggers.

Abstract

Graph neural networks such as ParticleNet and transformer based networks on point clouds such as ParticleTransformer achieve state-of-the-art performance on jet tagging benchmarks at the Large Hadron Collider, yet the physical reasoning behind their predictions remains opaque. We present different methods, i.e. perturbation-based (GNNExplainer), Shapley-value-based (GNNShap), and gradient-based (GRADCam); adapted to operate on LundNet's Lund-plane graph representation. Leveraging the fact that each node in the Lund plane corresponds to a physically meaningful parton splitting, we construct Monte Carlo truth explanation masks and introduce a physics-informed evaluation framework that goes beyond standard fidelity metrics. We perform the analysis in three transverse-momentum bins ($\mathrm{p_T} \in [500,700]$, $[800,1000]$, and the inclusive region $[500,1000]$ GeV), revealing how explanation quality and focus shift between non-perturbative and perturbative regimes. We further quantify the correlation between explainer-assigned node importance and classical jet substructure observables -- $N$-subjettiness ratios $τ_{21}$ and $τ_{32}$ and the energy correlation functions -- establishing the degree to which the model has learned known QCD features. We find that overall the weight assigned by explainability methods has a correlation with analytic observables, with expected shift across different phase space regimes, indicating that a trained neural network indeed learns some aspects of jet-substructure moments. Our open-source implementation enables reproducible explainability studies for graph-based jet taggers.

item.title: MarkIt: Training-Free Visual Markers for Precise Video Temporal Grounding
item.author: Pengcheng Fang, Yuxia Chen, Xiaohao Cai
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MarkIt框架通过将输入视频转换为查询条件标记视频，使视频语言大模型能够生成更可靠的时间定位预测。

背景: 尽管视频语言大模型具有强大的开放世界视频理解和识别能力，但由于未修剪视频中显式时间线索稀缺，且查询相关实体在视频时间轴上难以持续跟踪，输出精确的时间定位信息仍然具有挑战性。

目的: 提出MarkIt框架，旨在解决视频时间定位中输出精确时间定位信息面临的挑战，使视频语言大模型能够生成更可靠的时间定位预测。

方法: MarkIt是一个无需训练的框架，其核心组件是标注自由的查询到掩码桥接（Q2M-Bridge）。给定自然语言查询，它通过语言解析和规范化自动推导出一组紧凑的规范主体标签，然后使用文本条件开放词汇分割将这些标签映射到查询条件实例掩码。该桥接还在每一帧中嵌入轻量级语义实例标记和持久帧索引，有效地将长距离时间推理转化为视频语言大模型的显式视觉线索。MarkIt采用推理时即插即用设计，无需修改视频语言大模型权重，并与监督微调完全兼容。

主要发现: 在多个主流时刻检索和高亮检测基准上进行的实验表明，MarkIt实现了最先进的结果，并在广泛现有的模型中提供了一致的时序定位改进。

结论: MarkIt框架通过将输入视频转换为查询条件标记视频，使视频语言大模型能够生成更可靠的时间定位预测，在多个主流基准上取得了最先进的结果。

翻译: Video temporal grounding (VTG) aims to localize the start and end timestamps of the event described by a given query within an untrimmed video. Despite the strong open-world video understanding and recognition ability of video language large models (Vid-LLMs), outputting precise temporal grounding information remains challenging, since explicit temporal cues are scarce in untrimmed videos, and query-relevant entities are hard to track consistently across the video timeline. In this paper, we present extbackslash MarkIt{}, a training-free framework that transforms an input video into a query-conditioned marked video, which empowers Vid-LLMs to generate more reliable temporal localization predictions. The core component of extbackslash MarkIt{} is an annotation-free query-to-mask grounding bridge (Q2M-Bridge). Given a natural-language query, it automatically derives a compact set of canonical subject tags through linguistic parsing and normalization, then maps these tags to query-conditioned instance masks using text-conditioned open-vocabulary segmentation. The bridge also embeds lightweight semantic instance markers and a persistent frame index into each frame, effectively transforming long-range temporal reasoning into explicit visual cues for Vid-LLMs. extbackslash MarkIt{} adopts an inference-time plug-and-play design, needs no modifications to Vid-LLM weights, and is fully compatible with supervised fine-tuning. Experiments conducted on multiple mainstream moment retrieval and highlight detection benchmarks demonstrate that extbackslash MarkIt {} achieves state-of-the-art results, delivering consistent temporal grounding improvements across a wide range of existing models.

Abstract

Video temporal grounding (VTG) aims to localize the start and end timestamps of the event described by a given query within an untrimmed video. Despite the strong open-world video understanding and recognition ability of video language large models (Vid-LLMs), outputting precise temporal grounding information remains challenging, since explicit temporal cues are scarce in untrimmed videos, and query-relevant entities are hard to track consistently across the video timeline. In this paper, we present \MarkIt{}, a training-free framework that transforms an input video into a query-conditioned marked video, which empowers Vid-LLMs to generate more reliable temporal localization predictions. The core component of \MarkIt{} is an annotation-free query-to-mask grounding bridge (Q2M-Bridge). Given a natural-language query, it automatically derives a compact set of canonical subject tags through linguistic parsing and normalization, then maps these tags to query-conditioned instance masks using text-conditioned open-vocabulary segmentation. The bridge also embeds lightweight semantic instance markers and a persistent frame index into each frame, effectively transforming long-range temporal reasoning into explicit visual cues for Vid-LLMs. \MarkIt{} adopts an inference-time plug-and-play design, needs no modifications to Vid-LLM weights, and is fully compatible with supervised fine-tuning. Experiments conducted on multiple mainstream moment retrieval and highlight detection benchmarks demonstrate that \MarkIt {} achieves state-of-the-art results, delivering consistent temporal grounding improvements across a wide range of existing models.

item.title: DV-World: Benchmarking Data Visualization Agents in Real-World Scenarios
item.author: Jinxiang Meng, Shaoping Huang, Fangyu Lei, Jingyu Guo, Haoxiang Liu, Jiahao Su, Sihan Wang, Yao Wang, Enrui Wang, Ye Yang, Hongze Chai, Jinming Lv, Anbang Yu, Huangjing Zhang, Yitong Zhang, Yiming Huang, Zeyao Ma, Shizhu He, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了一个名为DV-World的新基准测试，旨在评估数据可视化代理在真实世界专业生命周期中的表现。

背景: 现有的基准测试往往受限于代码沙盒环境、仅支持单一语言创建任务，且假设用户意图完美。

目的: 为了弥合这些差距，DV-World旨在评估数据可视化代理在真实世界专业生命周期中的能力。

方法: DV-World包含260个任务，分为三个领域：DV-Sheet（电子表格操作）、DV-Evolution（跨编程范式适应）和DV-Interact（与模拟用户进行主动意图对齐）。评估框架结合了表格值对齐和基于多模态大语言模型作为评判者的语义-视觉评估。

主要发现: 最先进的模型在DV-World上的整体性能低于50%，暴露了它们在处理真实世界数据可视化复杂挑战方面的关键缺陷。

结论: DV-World提供了一个现实的测试平台，可以引导开发朝着企业工作流程所需的多样化专业知识方向发展。

翻译: 真实世界的数据可视化需要原生环境基础、跨平台演进和主动意图对齐。然而，现有的基准测试往往受限于代码沙盒、仅支持单一语言创建任务，并假设意图完美。为了弥合这些差距，我们引入了DV-World，这是一个由260个任务组成的基准测试，旨在评估数据可视化代理在真实世界专业生命周期中的表现。DV-World涵盖三个领域：DV-Sheet用于原生电子表格操作，包括图表和仪表板创建以及诊断修复；DV-Evolution用于跨不同编程范式适应和重组参考视觉工件以适应新数据；DV-Interact用于与模拟用户进行主动意图对齐，该用户模拟了现实世界中的模糊需求。我们的混合评估框架集成了表格值对齐用于数值精度，以及用于语义-视觉评估的多模态大语言模型作为评判者。实验表明，最先进的模型整体性能低于50%，暴露了在处理真实世界数据可视化复杂挑战方面的关键缺陷。DV-World提供了一个现实的测试平台，可以引导开发朝着企业工作流程所需的多样化专业知识方向发展。我们的数据和代码可在该项目页面获取。

Abstract

Real-world data visualization (DV) requires native environmental grounding, cross-platform evolution, and proactive intent alignment. Yet, existing benchmarks often suffer from code-sandbox confinement, single-language creation-only tasks, and assumption of perfect intent. To bridge these gaps, we introduce DV-World, a benchmark of 260 tasks designed to evaluate DV agents across real-world professional lifecycles. DV-World spans three domains: DV-Sheet for native spreadsheet manipulation including chart and dashboard creation as well as diagnostic repair; DV-Evolution for adapting and restructuring reference visual artifacts to fit new data across diverse programming paradigms and DV-Interact for proactive intent alignment with a user simulator that mimics real-world ambiguous requirements. Our hybrid evaluation framework integrates Table-value Alignment for numerical precision and MLLM-as-a-Judge with rubrics for semantic-visual assessment. Experiments reveal that state-of-the-art models achieve less than 50% overall performance, exposing critical deficits in handling the complex challenges of real-world data visualization. DV-World provides a realistic testbed to steer development toward the versatile expertise required in enterprise workflows. Our data and code are available at \href{https://github.com/DA-Open/DV-World}{this project page}.

item.title: Recursive Multi-Agent Systems
item.author: Xiyuan Yang, Jiaru Zou, Rui Pan, Ruizhong Qiu, Pan Lu, Shizhe Diao, Jindong Jiang, Hanghang Tong, Tong Zhang, Markus J. Buehler, Jingrui He, James Zou
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 RecursiveMAS 的递归多智能体框架，通过将整个系统视为统一的潜在空间递归计算，实现了多智能体协作的递归扩展。

背景: 递归或循环语言模型通过在潜在状态上迭代细化模型计算来加深推理，最近成为新的扩展轴。

目的: 将这种扩展原则从单个模型扩展到多智能体系统，探究智能体协作本身是否可以通过递归进行扩展。

方法: RecursiveMAS 框架通过轻量级的 RecursiveLink 模块将异构智能体连接为协作循环，实现分布内潜在思维生成和跨智能体潜在状态转移。开发了基于共享梯度的内-外循环学习算法进行迭代整体系统协同优化。

主要发现: 理论分析表明 RecursiveMAS 比标准基于文本的多智能体系统更高效，且在递归训练期间保持稳定的梯度。在 9 个涵盖数学、科学、医学、搜索和代码生成的基准上，与先进的单/多智能体及递归计算基线相比，RecursiveMAS 平均准确率提高了 8.3%，端到端推理速度提升了 1.2 倍到 2.4 倍，令牌使用量减少了 34.6% 到 75.6%。

结论: RecursiveMAS 在多个任务和基准上表现出色，证明了递归多智能体协作的有效性和效率。

翻译: 递归或循环语言模型最近通过在潜在状态上迭代细化相同的模型计算来加深推理，成为了一种新的扩展轴。我们将这种扩展原则从单个模型扩展到了多智能体系统，并问道：智能体协作本身是否可以通过递归进行扩展？为此，我们介绍了 RecursiveMAS，一个递归多智能体框架，它将整个系统视为统一的潜在空间递归计算。RecursiveMAS 通过轻量级的 RecursiveLink 模块将异构智能体连接为协作循环，实现分布内潜在思维生成和跨智能体潜在状态转移。为了优化我们的框架，我们开发了一种内-外循环学习算法，通过递归轮次间的基于共享梯度的信用分配进行迭代整体系统协同优化。对运行时复杂度和学习动态的理论分析表明，RecursiveMAS 比标准基于文本的多智能体系统更高效，并且在递归训练期间保持稳定的梯度。在 4 种代表性的智能体协作模式和 9 个涵盖数学、科学、医学、搜索和代码生成的基准上进行了实证评估。与先进的单/多智能体和递归计算基线相比，RecursiveMAS 一致地实现了平均 8.3% 的准确率提升，以及 1.2 倍到 2.4 倍的端到端推理加速，以及 34.6% 到 75.6% 的令牌使用量减少。代码和数据可在 https://recursivemas.github.io 获取。

Abstract

Recursive or looped language models have recently emerged as a new scaling axis by iteratively refining the same model computation over latent states to deepen reasoning. We extend such scaling principle from a single model to multi-agent systems, and ask: Can agent collaboration itself be scaled through recursion? To this end, we introduce RecursiveMAS, a recursive multi-agent framework that casts the entire system as a unified latent-space recursive computation. RecursiveMAS connects heterogeneous agents as a collaboration loop through the lightweight RecursiveLink module, enabling in-distribution latent thoughts generation and cross-agent latent state transfer. To optimize our framework, we develop an inner-outer loop learning algorithm for iterative whole-system co-optimization through shared gradient-based credit assignment across recursion rounds. Theoretical analyses of runtime complexity and learning dynamics establish that RecursiveMAS is more efficient than standard text-based MAS and maintains stable gradients during recursive training. Empirically, we instantiate RecursiveMAS under 4 representative agent collaboration patterns and evaluate across 9 benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, medicine, search, and code generation. In comparison with advanced single/multi-agent and recursive computation baselines, RecursiveMAS consistently delivers an average accuracy improvement of 8.3%, together with 1.2$\times$-2.4$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup, and 34.6%-75.6% token usage reduction. Code and Data are provided in https://recursivemas.github.io.

item.title: REVNET: Rotation-Equivariant Point Cloud Completion via Vector Neuron Anchor Transformer
item.author: Zhifan Ni, Eckehard Steinbach
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为REVNET的新型框架，用于在任意旋转下实现鲁棒的点云补全。

背景: 3D传感器捕获的不完整点云往往导致几何和语义信息的丢失。大多数现有的点云补全方法基于旋转敏感框架，在真实场景中适用性受限。虽然随机旋转数据增强可以部分缓解这一问题，但显著增加了学习负担，且仍无法保证在任意姿态下的鲁棒性能。

目的: 提出REVNET框架，以解决在任意旋转下鲁棒点云补全的挑战。

方法: 基于向量神经元VN网络构建，将部分点云表示为等变锚点的集合，设计VN Missing Anchor Transformer来预测缺失锚点的位置和特征。此外，扩展了VN网络，引入了旋转等变偏置公式和基于ZCA的层归一化。利用等变和不变VN特征之间的灵活转换，模型可以生成坐标更稳定的点。

主要发现: 在合成MVP数据集的等变设置中，该方法优于最先进的方法。在真实世界的KITTI数据集上，REVNET与非等变网络相比具有竞争力，且不需要输入姿态对齐。

结论: REVNET在处理任意旋转下的点云补全任务上表现良好，无需输入姿态对齐即可在真实数据集上取得有竞争力的结果。

翻译: 3D传感器捕获的不完整点云往往导致几何和语义信息的丢失。大多数现有的点云补全方法基于旋转敏感框架，在真实场景中适用性受限。虽然随机旋转数据增强可以部分缓解这一问题，但显著增加了学习负担，且仍无法保证在任意姿态下的鲁棒性能。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了旋转等变锚点Transformer（REVNET），这是一个基于向量神经元（VN）网络的新型框架，用于在任意旋转下实现鲁棒的点云补全。为了保留局部细节，我们将部分点云表示为等变锚点的集合，并设计了一个VN Missing Anchor Transformer来预测缺失锚点的位置和特征。此外，我们通过旋转等变偏置公式和基于ZCA的层归一化扩展了VN网络，以提高特征表达能力。利用等变和不变VN特征之间的灵活转换，我们的模型可以生成坐标更稳定的点。实验结果表明，在合成MVP数据集的等变设置中，我们的方法优于最先进的方法。在真实世界的KITTI数据集上，REVNET与非等变网络相比具有竞争力，且不需要输入姿态对齐。源代码将在GitHub上发布。

Abstract

Incomplete point clouds captured by 3D sensors often result in the loss of both geometric and semantic information. Most existing point cloud completion methods are built on rotation-variant frameworks trained with data in canonical poses, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios. While data augmentation with random rotations can partially mitigate this issue, it significantly increases the learning burden and still fails to guarantee robust performance under arbitrary poses. To address this challenge, we propose the Rotation-Equivariant Anchor Transformer (REVNET), a novel framework built upon the Vector Neuron (VN) network for robust point cloud completion under arbitrary rotations. To preserve local details, we represent partial point clouds as sets of equivariant anchors and design a VN Missing Anchor Transformer to predict the positions and features of missing anchors. Furthermore, we extend VN networks with a rotation-equivariant bias formulation and a ZCA-based layer normalization to improve feature expressiveness.
