Across three simulated environments, ViLiNT improves Success Rate on average by 166\% over equivalent state-of-the-art vision-only baseline (NoMaD). This increase in performance is confirmed through real-world deployments of a rover navigating in obstacle fields. These results highlight that combining multimodal fusion with our collision prediction mechanism leads to improved off-road navigation robustness.

item.title: Community Detection with the Canonical Ensemble
item.author: Rudy Arthur
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 将网络社区检测视为假设检验问题，通过定义适当的检验统计量和基于最大熵原理的多种零模型，对特定社区结构的存在性进行检验。

背景: 网络社区检测通常被视为无监督学习问题，旨在使用通用算法对网络进行划分。

目的: 将社区检测视为假设检验问题，通过比较观察到的网络与零模型，检验特定社区结构存在的证据。

方法: 定义了类似于z分数的检验统计量，并基于不同约束下的最大熵原理推导了多种零模型。

主要发现: 该方法在真实和合成数据上进行了应用，并与基于随机块模型的贝叶斯方法进行了对比。

结论: 该方法能对具体问题给出确定的答案，比通用算法的输出对分析师更有用。

翻译: 网络社区检测通常被视为无监督学习问题。给定一个网络，目标是使用某种通用算法对其进行划分。在本文中，我们将社区检测视为假设检验问题。给定一个网络，我们比较观察到的网络与零模型，检验特定社区结构存在的证据。为此，我们定义了适当的检验统计量，类似于z分数，以及在正则系综中在不同约束下最大化熵推导出的几种零模型。我们在真实和合成数据上演示了该方法的应用，并将我们的方法与基于随机块模型的贝叶斯方法进行了对比。我们证明该方法能对具体问题给出确定的答案，这比通用算法的输出对分析师更有用。

Abstract

Network community detection is usually considered as an unsupervised learning problem. Given a network, the aim is to partition it using some general purpose algorithm. In this paper we instead treat community detection as a hypothesis testing problem. Given a network, we examine the evidence for specific community structure in the observed network compared to a null model. To do this we define an appropriate test statistic, analogous to a z-score, and several null models derived from maximising entropy under different constraints in the canonical ensemble. We demonstrate the application of this method on real and synthetic data and contrast our method to Bayesian approaches based on the stochastic block model. We demonstrate that this method gives definitive answers to concrete questions, which can be more useful to analysts than the output of a generic algorithm.

item.title: IndiaFinBench: An Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Model Performance on Indian Financial Regulatory Text
item.author: Rajveer Singh Pall
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

summary: 本文介绍了 IndiaFinBench，这是一个用于评估大语言模型在印度金融监管文本上表现的首个公开评估基准。

background: 现有的金融自然语言处理基准主要来自西方金融语料库（如美国证券交易委员会文件、美国收益报告和英文金融新闻），对非西方监管框架的覆盖存在显著缺口。

purpose: 为了填补这一空白，构建了 IndiaFinBench 基准，以评估大语言模型在印度金融监管文本上的表现。

method: 该基准包含 406 个由专家标注的问题-答案对，来源于印度证券交易委员会（SEBI）和印度储备银行（RBI）的 192 份文档，涵盖四种任务类型：监管解释（174项）、数值推理（92项）、矛盾检测（62项）和时间推理（78项）。标注质量通过基于模型的二次验证（矛盾检测 kappa=0.918）和 60 项人类标注者间一致性评估（kappa=0.611；整体一致性 76.7%）进行了验证。

main_finding: 在零样本条件下评估了十二个模型，准确率在 70.4%（Gemma 4 E4B）到 89.7%（Gemini 2.5 Flash）之间。所有模型均显著优于 60.0% 的非专家人类基线。数值推理是最具区分性的任务，模型间准确率差距达 35.9 个百分点。Bootstrap 显著性测试（10,000 次重采样）揭示了三个统计上不同的性能层级。

conclusion: 该数据集、评估代码和所有模型输出均可在 https://github.com/rajveerpall/IndiaFinBench 获取。

translation: We introduce IndiaFinBench, to our knowledge the first publicly available evaluation benchmark for assessing large language model (LLM) performance on Indian financial regulatory text. Existing financial NLP benchmarks draw exclusively from Western financial corpora (SEC filings, US earnings reports, and English-language financial news), leaving a significant gap in coverage of non-Western regulatory frameworks. IndiaFinBench addresses this gap with 406 expert-annotated question-answer pairs drawn from 192 documents sourced from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) and the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), spanning four task types: regulatory interpretation (174 items), numerical reasoning (92 items), contradiction detection (62 items), and temporal reasoning (78 items). Annotation quality is validated through a model-based secondary pass (kappa=0.918 on contradiction detection) and a 60-item human inter-annotator agreement evaluation (kappa=0.611; 76.7% overall agreement). We evaluate twelve models under zero-shot conditions, with accuracy ranging from 70.4% (Gemma 4 E4B) to 89.7% (Gemini 2.5 Flash). All models substantially outperform a non-specialist human baseline of 60.0%. Numerical reasoning is the most discriminative task, with a 35.9 percentage-point spread across models. Bootstrap significance testing (10,000 resamples) reveals three statistically distinct performance tiers. The dataset, evaluation code, and all model outputs are available at https://github.com/rajveerpall/IndiaFinBench

Abstract

We introduce IndiaFinBench, to our knowledge the first publicly available evaluation benchmark for assessing large language model (LLM) performance on Indian financial regulatory text. Existing financial NLP benchmarks draw exclusively from Western financial corpora (SEC filings, US earnings reports, and English-language financial news), leaving a significant gap in coverage of non-Western regulatory frameworks. IndiaFinBench addresses this gap with 406 expert-annotated question-answer pairs drawn from 192 documents sourced from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) and the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), spanning four task types: regulatory interpretation (174 items), numerical reasoning (92 items), contradiction detection (62 items), and temporal reasoning (78 items). Annotation quality is validated through a model-based secondary pass (kappa=0.918 on contradiction detection) and a 60-item human inter-annotator agreement evaluation (kappa=0.611; 76.7% overall agreement). We evaluate twelve models under zero-shot conditions, with accuracy ranging from 70.4% (Gemma 4 E4B) to 89.7% (Gemini 2.5 Flash). All models substantially outperform a non-specialist human baseline of 60.0%. Numerical reasoning is the most discriminative task, with a 35.9 percentage-point spread across models. Bootstrap significance testing (10,000 resamples) reveals three statistically distinct performance tiers. The dataset, evaluation code, and all model outputs are available at https://github.com/rajveerpall/IndiaFinBench

item.title: HalluAudio: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Hallucination Detection in Large Audio-Language Models
item.author: Feiyu Zhao, Yiming Chen, Wenhuan Lu, Daipeng Zhang, Xianghu Yue, Jianguo Wei
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者介绍了HalluAudio，这是一个大规模的音频幻觉评估基准，包含超过5K个人工验证的问答对，涵盖语音、环境声音和音乐，旨在评估大型音频语言模型在幻觉问题上的表现。

背景: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在各种音频任务中表现出色，但幻觉问题（模型生成语义不正确或声学上不支持的响应）在音频领域尚未得到充分探索。现有的幻觉基准主要关注文本或视觉，而音频导向的研究在规模、模态覆盖和诊断深度上有限。

目的: 介绍HalluAudio，首个大规模的跨语音、环境声音和音乐评估幻觉的基准。

方法: HalluAudio包含超过5K个人工验证的问答对，涵盖二值判断、多选推理、属性验证和开放式问答等任务类型。通过设计对抗性提示和混合音频条件来系统性地诱导幻觉。评估协议除了准确率外，还测量幻觉率、是/否偏差、错误类型分析和拒绝率。

主要发现: 在基准测试中，开源和专有模型在声学基础、时间推理和音乐属性理解方面存在显著缺陷。

结论: 需要可靠和稳健的大型音频语言模型。

翻译: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) 最近在各种以音频为中心的任务中取得了强大的性能。然而，幻觉，即模型生成语义不正确或声学上不支持的响应，在音频领域仍然很大程度上未被探索。现有的幻觉基准主要关注文本或视觉，而少数音频导向的研究在规模、模态覆盖和诊断深度上有限。因此，我们介绍了 HalluAudio，这是第一个大规模的跨语音、环境声音和音乐评估幻觉的基准。HalluAudio 包含超过 5K 个人工验证的问答对，跨越多样化的任务类型，包括二值判断、多选推理、属性验证和开放式问答。为了系统性地诱导幻觉，我们设计了对抗性提示和混合音频条件。除了准确率外，我们的评估协议测量幻觉率、是/否偏差、错误类型分析和拒绝率，能够对 LALM 的失败模式进行细粒度分析。我们对广泛的开放源代码和专有模型进行了基准测试，提供了跨语音、声音和音乐的大规模比较。我们的结果揭示了声学基础、时间推理和音乐属性理解方面的显著缺陷，强调了可靠和稳健的 LALM 的必要性。

Abstract

Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have recently achieved strong performance across various audio-centric tasks. However, hallucination, where models generate responses that are semantically incorrect or acoustically unsupported, remains largely underexplored in the audio domain. Existing hallucination benchmarks mainly focus on text or vision, while the few audio-oriented studies are limited in scale, modality coverage, and diagnostic depth. We therefore introduce HalluAudio, the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating hallucinations across speech, environmental sound, and music. HalluAudio comprises over 5K human-verified QA pairs and spans diverse task types, including binary judgments, multi-choice reasoning, attribute verification, and open-ended QA. To systematically induce hallucinations, we design adversarial prompts and mixed-audio conditions. Beyond accuracy, our evaluation protocol measures hallucination rate, yes/no bias, error-type analysis, and refusal rate, enabling a fine-grained analysis of LALM failure modes. We benchmark a broad range of open-source and proprietary models, providing the first large-scale comparison across speech, sound, and music. Our results reveal significant deficiencies in acoustic grounding, temporal reasoning, and music attribute understanding, underscoring the need for reliable and robust LALMs.

item.title: RAFT-MSF++: Temporal Geometry-Motion Feature Fusion for Self-Supervised Monocular Scene Flow
item.author: Xunpei Sun, Zuoxun Hou, Yi Chang, Gang Chen, Wei-Shi Zheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: RAFT-MSF++ 提出了一种自监督多帧框架，通过几何运动特征 GMF 和相对位置注意力机制，有效恢复密集 3D 运动并提高在遮挡区域下的鲁棒性。

背景: 现有的单目场景流估计方法大多仅限于两帧输入，限制了时间建模能力和对遮挡的鲁棒性。

目的: 提出 RAFT-MSF++ 框架，以自监督方式联合估计深度和场景流，并增强对遮挡的鲁棒性。

方法: 通过几何运动特征 GMF 融合时间特征，结合相对位置注意力注入空间先验，并引入遮挡正则化模块从可见区域传播可靠运动。

主要发现: RAFT-MSF++ 在 KITTI Scene Flow 基准上实现了 24.14% 的 SF-all 得分，比基线提高了 30.99%，并在遮挡区域表现出更好的鲁棒性。

结论: 该方法有效实现了信息传播，即使在模糊区域也能有效工作，代码已开源。

翻译: 单目场景流估计旨在从图像序列中恢复密集的 3D 运动，然而现有的大多数方法仅限于两帧输入，限制了时间建模能力和对遮挡的鲁棒性。我们提出了 RAFT-MSF++，一种自监督的多帧框架，它递归地融合时间特征以联合估计深度和场景流。我们方法的核心是几何运动特征（GMF），它紧凑地编码了耦合的运动和几何线索，并迭代更新以进行有效的时间推理。为了确保这种时间融合在遮挡情况下的鲁棒性，我们结合了相对位置注意力来注入空间先验，并引入了一个遮挡正则化模块，以从可见区域传播可靠的运动。这些组件使得 GMF 能够即使在模糊区域也能有效地传播信息。广泛的实验表明，RAFT-MSF++ 在 KITTI 场景流基准上实现了 24.14% 的 SF-all，比基线提高了 30.99%，并且在遮挡区域表现出更好的鲁棒性。代码可在 https://github.com/sunzunyi/RAFT-MSF-PlusPlus 获取。

Abstract

Monocular scene flow estimation aims to recover dense 3D motion from image sequences, yet most existing methods are limited to two-frame inputs, restricting temporal modeling and robustness to occlusions. We propose RAFT-MSF++, a self-supervised multi-frame framework that recurrently fuses temporal features to jointly estimate depth and scene flow. Central to our approach is the Geometry-Motion Feature (GMF), which compactly encodes coupled motion and geometry cues and is iteratively updated for effective temporal reasoning. To ensure the robustness of this temporal fusion against occlusions, we incorporate relative positional attention to inject spatial priors and an occlusion regularization module to propagate reliable motion from visible regions. These components enable the GMF to effectively propagate information even in ambiguous areas. Extensive experiments show that RAFT-MSF++ achieves 24.14% SF-all on the KITTI Scene Flow benchmark, with a 30.99% improvement over the baseline and better robustness in occluded regions. The code is available at https://github.com/sunzunyi/RAFT-MSF-PlusPlus.

item.title: Attend what matters: Leveraging vision foundational models for breast cancer classification using mammograms
item.author: Samyak Sanghvi, Piyush Miglani, Sarvesh Shashikumar, Kaustubh R Borgavi, Veenu Singla, Chetan Arora
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于区域兴趣和对比学习的框架，用于提升Vision Transformer在乳腺X光片癌症检测中的性能

背景: Vision Transformers在计算机辅助诊断中表现有限，特别是在乳腺X光片检测中，主要由于图像分辨率高、异常区域小导致token数量过多，以及分类任务本身具有细粒度特征和低类间高类内变异性

目的: 克服Vision Transformer在医学图像分类中的挑战，特别是乳腺X光片检测中的性能瓶颈

方法: 提出包含三个关键组件的框架：(1)基于区域兴趣的token减少，使用目标检测模型引导注意力；(2)基于区域兴趣的对比学习，通过难负样本训练增强细粒度区分；(3)使用DINOv2预训练的Vision Transformer，捕获定位感知的细粒度特征而非全局CLIP表示

主要发现: 在公开乳腺X光片数据集上的实验表明，该方法在现有基线方法上取得了优越的性能，证明了其有效性和大规模乳腺癌症筛查的临床潜力

结论: 该方法在乳腺癌症筛查中具有临床应用潜力，代码已公开以便复现

翻译: Vision Transformers已成为许多计算机视觉任务的首选架构，但它们在计算机辅助诊断中的表现仍然有限。专注于从乳腺X光片中检测乳腺癌，我们确定了导致这种不足的两个主要原因。首先，医学图像是高分辨率的，异常区域很小，导致token数量过多，使得基于softmax的注意力难以定位和关注相关区域。其次，医学图像分类本质上具有细粒度特征，类间差异低，类内差异高，标准交叉熵训练是不够的。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了一个包含三个关键组件的框架：(1)基于区域兴趣的token减少，使用目标检测模型引导注意力；(2)基于区域兴趣的对比学习，通过难负样本训练增强细粒度区分；(3)使用DINOv2预训练的Vision Transformer，捕获定位感知的细粒度特征而非全局CLIP表示。在公开乳腺X光片数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法在现有基线方法上取得了优越的性能，证明了其有效性和大规模乳腺癌症筛查的临床潜力。我们的代码已公开以便复现：https://aih-iitd.github.io/publications/attend-what-matters

Abstract

Vision Transformers $(\texttt{ViT})$ have become the architecture of choice for many computer vision tasks, yet their performance in computer-aided diagnostics remains limited. Focusing on breast cancer detection from mammograms, we identify two main causes for this shortfall. First, medical images are high-resolution with small abnormalities, leading to an excessive number of tokens and making it difficult for the softmax-based attention to localize and attend to relevant regions. Second, medical image classification is inherently fine-grained, with low inter-class and high intra-class variability, where standard cross-entropy training is insufficient. To overcome these challenges, we propose a framework with three key components: (1) Region of interest $(\texttt{RoI})$ based token reduction using an object detection model to guide attention; (2) contrastive learning between selected $\texttt{RoI}$ to enhance fine-grained discrimination through hard-negative based training; and (3) a $\texttt{DINOv2}$ pretrained $\texttt{ViT}$ that captures localization-aware, fine-grained features instead of global $\texttt{CLIP}$ representations. Experiments on public mammography datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance over existing baselines, establishing its effectiveness and potential clinical utility for large-scale breast cancer screening. Our code is available for reproducibility here: https://aih-iitd.github.io/publications/attend-what-matters

item.title: TACENR: Task-Agnostic Contrastive Explanations for Node Representations
item.author: Vasiliki Papanikou, Evaggelia Pitoura
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为TACENR的方法，用于解释图节点表示的局部解释，识别对节点表示贡献最大的属性特征、邻近特征和结构特征。

背景: 现有的图表示学习方法虽然成功，但其节点表示不透明且难以解释。现有的可解释性方法主要关注监督设置或解释单个表示维度，忽略了解释节点表示的整体结构。

目的: 提出一种任务无关的对比解释方法TACENR，用于识别对节点表示贡献最大的特征，包括属性特征、邻近特征和结构特征。

方法: TACENR基于对比学习，学习表示空间中的相似度函数，以揭示在节点表示中起重要作用的特征。该方法适用于任务无关的解释，也可应用于监督场景。

主要发现: 邻近特征和结构特征在塑造节点表示中起着重要作用；在识别最具影响力的特征方面，TACENR的监督变体与现有的特定任务方法表现相当。

结论: TACENR能够有效解释节点表示的整体结构，证明了邻近和结构特征的重要性，并在监督场景下保持了良好的性能。

翻译: Graph representation learning has achieved notable success in encoding graph-structured data into latent vector spaces, enabling a wide range of downstream tasks. However, these node representations remain opaque and difficult to interpret. Existing explainability methods primarily focus on supervised settings or on explaining individual representation dimensions, leaving a critical gap in explaining the overall structure of node representations. In this paper, we propose TACENR (Task-Agnostic Contrastive Explanations for Node Representations), a local explanation method that identifies not only attribute features but also proximity and structural ones that contribute the most in the representation space. TACENR builds on contrastive learning, through which we learn a similarity function in the representation space, revealing which are the features that play an important role in the representation of a node. While our focus is on task-agnostic explanations, TACENR can be applied to supervised scenarios as well. Experimental results demonstrate that proximity and structural features play a significant role in shaping node representations and that our supervised variant performs comparably to existing task-specific approaches in identifying the most impactful features.

Abstract

Graph representation learning has achieved notable success in encoding graph-structured data into latent vector spaces, enabling a wide range of downstream tasks. However, these node representations remain opaque and difficult to interpret. Existing explainability methods primarily focus on supervised settings or on explaining individual representation dimensions, leaving a critical gap in explaining the overall structure of node representations. In this paper, we propose TACENR (Task-Agnostic Contrastive Explanations for Node Representations), a local explanation method that identifies not only attribute features but also proximity and structural ones that contribute the most in the representation space. TACENR builds on contrastive learning, through which we learn a similarity function in the representation space, revealing which are the features that play an important role in the representation of a node. While our focus is on task-agnostic explanations, TACENR can be applied to supervised scenarios as well. Experimental results demonstrate that proximity and structural features play a significant role in shaping node representations and that our supervised variant performs comparably to existing task-specific approaches in identifying the most impactful features.

item.title: PanDA: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Multimodal 3D Panoptic Segmentation in Autonomous Driving
item.author: Yining Pan, Shijie Li, Yuchen Wu, Xulei Yang, Na Zhao
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了首个针对多模态三维全景分割的无监督域适应框架PanDA，通过引入非对称多模态增强和双专家伪标签细化模块，解决了现有方法在单一传感器退化下的脆弱性问题，并在多种域偏移场景下显著超越了现有基线。

背景: 现有监督的多模态三维全景分割方法严重依赖激光雷达和RGB输入之间的强跨模态互补性，在光照不良或恶劣天气等单一传感器退化场景下容易失效。

目的: 研究多模态三维全景分割的无监督域适应，以提高在真实世界自动驾驶中常见的域偏移情况下的泛化能力。

方法: 提出了PanDA框架，包括用于模拟域偏移和提升鲁棒表示学习的非对称多模态增强，以及用于从2D和3D模态中提取域不变先验的双专家伪标签细化模块。

主要发现: 在涵盖时间、天气、地点和传感器变化的各种域偏移场景下的广泛实验中，PanDA显著超越了现有的3D语义分割无监督域适应基线。

结论: PanDA框架有效解决了多模态三维全景分割在无监督域适应中的挑战，显著提升了模型在真实世界复杂环境下的泛化性能。

翻译: 本文提出了首个针对多模态三维全景分割的无监督域适应框架PanDA，旨在提高在真实世界自动驾驶中常见的域偏移情况下的泛化能力。一种直接的解决方案是采用伪标签策略，结合多模态三维全景分割骨干网络。然而，现有的监督多模态三维全景分割方法严重依赖激光雷达和RGB输入之间的强跨模态互补性，使其在单一传感器退化（如光照不良或恶劣天气）的域偏移下变得脆弱。此外，传统的伪标签通常仅保留高置信度区域，导致掩码碎片化和物体监督不完整，这对全景分割尤为不利。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了PanDA，这是首个专门为多模态三维全景分割设计的无监督域适应框架。为了提高对单传感器退化的鲁棒性，我们引入了一种非对称多模态增强，选择性丢弃区域以模拟域偏移并改善鲁棒表示学习。为了增强伪标签的完整性和可靠性，我们进一步开发了一个双专家伪标签细化模块，从2D和3D模态中提取域不变先验。在涵盖时间、天气、地点和传感器变化的各种域偏移场景下的广泛实验中，PanDA显著超越了现有的3D语义分割无监督域适应基线。

Abstract

This paper presents the first study on Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) for multimodal 3D panoptic segmentation (mm-3DPS), aiming to improve generalization under domain shifts commonly encountered in real-world autonomous driving. A straightforward solution is to employ a pseudo-labeling strategy, which is widely used in UDA to generate supervision for unlabeled target data, combined with an mm-3DPS backbone. However, existing supervised mm-3DPS methods rely heavily on strong cross-modal complementarity between LiDAR and RGB inputs, making them fragile under domain shifts where one modality degrades (e.g., poor lighting or adverse weather). Moreover, conventional pseudo-labeling typically retains only high-confidence regions, leading to fragmented masks and incomplete object supervision, which are issues particularly detrimental to panoptic segmentation. To address these challenges, we propose PanDA, the first UDA framework specifically designed for multimodal 3D panoptic segmentation. To improve robustness against single-sensor degradation, we introduce an asymmetric multimodal augmentation that selectively drops regions to simulate domain shifts and improve robust representation learning. To enhance pseudo-label completeness and reliability, we further develop a dual-expert pseudo-label refinement module that extracts domain-invariant priors from both 2D and 3D modalities. Extensive experiments across diverse domain shifts, spanning time, weather, location, and sensor variations, significantly surpass state-of-the-art UDA baselines for 3D semantic segmentation.

item.title: DINO Eats CLIP: Adapting Beyond Knowns for Open-set 3D Object Retrieval
item.author: Xinwei He, Yansong Zheng, Qianru Han, Zhichuan Wang, Yuxuan Cai, Yang Zhou, Jingbo Xia, Yulong Wang, Jinhai Xiang, Xiang Bai
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DEC的新框架，用于开放集3D目标检索，通过动态多视图集成和合成数据正则化来提升性能。

背景: 视觉基础模型在开放集3D目标检索中显示出巨大潜力，但CLIP编码器缺乏细粒度性，导致性能受限。

目的: 探索DINO自监督编码器的潜力，以解决CLIP在细粒度特征提取上的不足，并提升开放集3DOR的性能。

方法: 提出DEC框架，包含Chunking and Adapting Module (CAM)用于动态多视图集成，以及Virtual Feature Synthesis (VFS)模块用于合成未见类别的虚拟特征。

主要发现: 冻结DINO骨干网络的平均池化已显示出不错的性能；CAM模块通过分割多视图图像和动态集成局部视图关系，比标准池化策略产生更稳健的特征；VFS利用CLIP的视觉-语言空间合成虚拟特征，显著增强了开放集判别能力。

结论: 在标准开放集3DOR基准上的广泛实验证明了DEC框架的优越有效性。

翻译: Vision foundation models have shown great promise for open-set 3D object retrieval (3DOR) through efficient adaptation to multi-view images. Leveraging semantically aligned latent space, previous work typically adapts the CLIP encoder to build view-based 3D descriptors. Despite CLIP's strong generalization ability, its lack of fine-grainedness prompted us to explore the potential of a more recent self-supervised encoder-DINO. To address this, we propose DINO Eats CLIP (DEC), a novel framework for dynamic multi-view integration that is regularized by synthesizing data for unseen classes. We first find that simply mean-pooling over view features from a frozen DINO backbone gives decent performance. Yet, further adaptation causes severe overfitting on average view patterns of known classes. To combat it, we then design a module named Chunking and Adapting Module (CAM). It segments multi-view images into chunks and dynamically integrates local view relations, yielding more robust features than the standard pooling strategy. Finally, we propose Virtual Feature Synthesis (VFS) module to mitigate bias towards known categories explicitly. Under the hood, VFS leverages CLIP's broad, pre-aligned vision-language space to synthesize virtual features for unseen classes. By exposing DEC to these virtual features, we greatly enhance its open-set discrimination capacity. Extensive experiments on standard open-set 3DOR benchmarks demonstrate its superior efficacy.

Abstract

Vision foundation models have shown great promise for open-set 3D object retrieval (3DOR) through efficient adaptation to multi-view images. Leveraging semantically aligned latent space, previous work typically adapts the CLIP encoder to build view-based 3D descriptors. Despite CLIP's strong generalization ability, its lack of fine-grainedness prompted us to explore the potential of a more recent self-supervised encoder-DINO. To address this, we propose DINO Eats CLIP (DEC), a novel framework for dynamic multi-view integration that is regularized by synthesizing data for unseen classes. We first find that simply mean-pooling over view features from a frozen DINO backbone gives decent performance. Yet, further adaptation causes severe overfitting on average view patterns of known classes. To combat it, we then design a module named Chunking and Adapting Module (CAM). It segments multi-view images into chunks and dynamically integrates local view relations, yielding more robust features than the standard pooling strategy. Finally, we propose Virtual Feature Synthesis (VFS) module to mitigate bias towards known categories explicitly. Under the hood, VFS leverages CLIP's broad, pre-aligned vision-language space to synthesize virtual features for unseen classes. By exposing DEC to these virtual features, we greatly enhance its open-set discrimination capacity. Extensive experiments on standard open-set 3DOR benchmarks demonstrate its superior efficacy.

item.title: Deep Supervised Contrastive Learning of Pitch Contours for Robust Pitch Accent Classification in Seoul Korean
item.author: Hyunjung Joo, GyeongTaek Lee
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

summary: 本文提出了一种名为 Dual-Glob 的深度监督对比学习框架，旨在对首尔韩语的细微音高重音模式进行稳健分类。

background: 在基于音调的韵律语音学模型中，首尔韩语的语调结构被定义为离散的音调类别，但在现实语音中，由于音高曲线 $F_0$ 的实现方式多变，将连续的音高曲线映射到这些不变类别具有挑战性。

purpose: 为了解决将连续音高曲线映射到离散音调类别时的挑战，本文提出了一种能够稳健分类首尔韩语细微音高重音模式的框架。

method: Dual-Glob 框架通过在共享潜在空间中强制清洁视图和增强视图之间的结构一致性，来捕获整体音高曲线形状，不同于传统的局部预测模型。

main_findings: 实验结果表明，Dual-Glob 显著优于强基线模型，达到了最先进的准确率（77.75%）和 F1 分数（51.54%）。

conclusion: 本研究支持基于 AM 的韵律语音学，表明深度对比学习能够有效捕获连续音高曲线的整体结构特征。

translation: 首尔韩语的语调结构在音调的韵律语音学模型中被定义为离散的音调类别。然而，由于现实世界语音中音高曲线 $F_0$ 的实现方式多变，将其映射到这些不变类别具有挑战性。本文提出 Dual-Glob，一种深度监督对比学习框架，旨在稳健地对首尔韩语的细微音高重音模式进行分类。与传统的局部预测模型不同，我们的方法通过在共享潜在空间中强制清洁视图和增强视图之间的结构一致性，来捕获整体音高曲线形状。为此，我们引入了第一个大规模基准数据集，包含首尔韩语中手动标注的 10,093 个重音短语。实验结果表明，我们的 Dual-Glob 显著优于强基线模型，达到了最先进的准确率（77.75%）和 F1 分数（51.54%）。因此，我们的工作支持基于 AM 的韵律语音学，表明深度对比学习能够有效捕获连续音高曲线的整体结构特征。

Abstract

The intonational structure of Seoul Korean has been defined with discrete tonal categories within the Autosegmental-Metrical model of intonational phonology. However, it is challenging to map continuous $F_0$ contours to these invariant categories due to variable $F_0$ realizations in real-world speech. Our paper proposes Dual-Glob, a deep supervised contrastive learning framework to robustly classify fine-grained pitch accent patterns in Seoul Korean. Unlike conventional local predictive models, our approach captures holistic $F_0$ contour shapes by enforcing structural consistency between clean and augmented views in a shared latent space. To this aim, we introduce the first large-scale benchmark dataset, consisting of manually annotated 10,093 Accentual Phrases in Seoul Korean. Experimental results show that our Dual-Glob significantly outperforms strong baseline models with state-of-the-art accuracy (77.75%) and F1-score (51.54%). Therefore, our work supports AM-based intonational phonology using data-driven methodology, showing that deep contrastive learning effectively captures holistic structural features of continuous $F_0$ contours.

item.title: Deep sprite-based image models: An analysis
item.author: Zeynep Sonat Baltacı, Romain Loiseau, Mathieu Aubry
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于精灵的图像分解方法，该方法在CLEVR基准测试中表现与最先进的无监督类别感知图像分割方法相当，能够线性扩展到包含大量对象的图像，明确识别对象类别，并以易于解释的方式完全建模图像。

背景: 虽然基础模型推动了图像分割和扩散算法的稳步发展，但在图像集合中识别重复模式的问题仍然非常开放。基于精灵的图像分解模型在聚类和图像分解方面显示出一些前景，并且具有很高的可解释性，但它们需要针对特定数据集进行调整，难以扩展到包含许多对象的图像。

目的: 深入研究基于精灵的图像分解模型的设计细节，识别其核心组件，并在聚类基准测试上进行广泛分析，以提出一种新的深度基于精灵的图像分解方法。

方法: 通过分析现有基于精灵的图像分解模型的设计细节和核心组件，在聚类基准测试上进行广泛分析，提出了一种新的深度基于精灵的图像分解方法。

主要发现: 提出的方法在标准CLEVR基准测试上与最先进的无监督类别感知图像分割方法表现相当，能够线性扩展到包含大量对象的图像，明确识别对象类别，并以易于解释的方式完全建模图像。

结论: 提出的方法在CLEVR基准测试上与最先进的无监督类别感知图像分割方法表现相当，能够线性扩展到包含大量对象的图像，明确识别对象类别，并以易于解释的方式完全建模图像。

翻译: 虽然基础模型推动了图像分割和扩散算法的稳步发展，但在图像集合中识别重复模式的问题仍然非常开放。本文专注于基于精灵的图像分解模型，这些模型在聚类和图像分解方面显示出一些前景，并且具有很高的可解释性。这些模型有不同的形式，需要针对特定数据集进行调整，并且在处理包含许多对象的图像时难以扩展。本文深入研究了它们的设计细节，识别了核心组件，并在聚类基准测试上进行了广泛分析。利用这些分析，我们提出了一种深度基于精灵的图像分解方法，该方法在标准CLEVR基准测试上与最先进的无监督类别感知图像分割方法表现相当，能够线性扩展到包含大量对象的图像，明确识别对象类别，并以易于解释的方式完全建模图像。

Abstract

While foundation models drive steady progress in image segmentation and diffusion algorithms compose always more realistic images, the seemingly simple problem of identifying recurrent patterns in a collection of images remains very much open. In this paper, we focus on sprite-based image decomposition models, which have shown some promise for clustering and image decomposition and are appealing because of their high interpretability. These models come in different flavors, need to be tailored to specific datasets, and struggle to scale to images with many objects. We dive into the details of their design, identify their core components, and perform an extensive analysis on clustering benchmarks. We leverage this analysis to propose a deep sprite-based image decomposition method that performs on par with state-of-the-art unsupervised class-aware image segmentation methods on the standard CLEVR benchmark, scales linearly with the number of objects, identifies explicitly object categories, and fully models images in an easily interpretable way.

item.title: A Nonparametric Goodness-of-Fit Test for High-Dimensional Generalized Gaussian Distributions via Nearest-Neighbor Graphs
item.author: Mehmet Sıddık Çadırcı, Yener Ünal
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种针对多元广义高斯分布（MGGD）的拟合优度检验方法，该方法基于最近邻图拓扑和适应零原则，旨在解决高维样本下MGGD模型的拟合优度评估难题。

背景: 多元广义高斯分布常用于建模具有非高斯径向行为的高维向量，但在现代高维情形（维度与样本量相当或超过样本量）下，由于许多经典多元检验依赖于协方差逆矩阵或高维密度估计，对MGGD模型的拟合优度评估仍面临挑战。

目的: 提出一种基于最近邻图拓扑和适应零原则的仿射不变、完全非参数拟合优度检验程序，以解决MGGD模型在高维情形下的拟合优度评估问题。

方法: 通过稳健标准化构建适应标准化的MGGD独立参考样本，在组合最近邻图上测量交叉边数以评估观测和参考点云如何展示模型预期的混合行为；使用重拟合参数自助法进行校准以处理 nuisance-parameter 不确定性；在高维缩放下建立渐近有效性，并基于径向集中和壳分离提供几何解释。

主要发现: 模拟研究显示，该方法在广泛的维度和尾形范围内具有准确的类型I误差控制和相对于重尾及轻尾替代方案的稳健功效，优于能量距离基准和面向正态性的图形检验。

结论: 该方法在高维缩放下具有渐近有效性，对固定椭圆偏离具有一致性，提供了基于径向集中和壳分离的几何解释，并在MGGD建模适用的情境下优于现有方法。

翻译: 多元广义高斯分布（MGGD）常用于建模具有非高斯径向行为的高维向量，从尖峰到重尾轮廓不等。然而，由于许多经典多元检验基于协方差逆矩阵或高维密度估计，在现代维度与样本量相当或超过样本量的情形下，MGGD模型的拟合优度评估仍面临挑战。我们介绍了一种基于最近邻图拓扑和适应零原则的仿射不变、完全非参数拟合优度程序。经过稳健标准化后，我们从适应标准化的MGGD构建独立参考样本，并在组合最近邻图上测量交叉边数以评估观测和参考点云如何展示模型预期的混合行为。使用重拟合参数自助法进行的校准处理了 nuisance-parameter 不确定性，从而在复合规范下确保了可靠的规模。在本文中，我们在高维缩放下建立了渐近有效性，并证明了相对于固定椭圆偏离的一致性，提供了基于径向集中和壳分离的几何解释。我们在广泛的维度和尾形范围内的模拟研究揭示了准确的类型I误差控制和相对于重尾及轻尾替代方案的稳健功效，从而在MGGD建模最适用的情境下优于能量距离基准和面向正态性的图形检验。

Abstract

The multivariate generalised Gaussian distribution (MGGD) is commonly used to model high-dimensional vectors with non-Gaussian radial behaviour, ranging from sharp-peaked to heavy-tailed profiles. However, because many classical multivariate tests are based on covariance inversion or high-dimensional density estimation, formal goodness-of-fit assessment for MGGD models remains challenging in modern regimes where the dimension is comparable to or exceeds the sample size. We introduce an affine-invariant, fully non-parametric goodness-of-fit procedure based on the nearest neighbour (NN) graph topology and the adapted zero principle. Following robust standardisation, we construct an independent reference sample from the adapted standardised MGGD and measure, on the combined NN graph, the cross-edge count to assess how well the observed and reference point clouds exhibit the mixture behaviour anticipated by the model. Calibration performed using a refitted parametric bootstrap accounts for nuisance-parameter uncertainty, thus ensuring reliable size under a composite specification. In this paper, we establish asymptotic validity under high-dimensional scaling and demonstrate consistency with respect to fixed elliptical departures, providing a geometric interpretation based on radial concentration and shell separation. Our simulation studies across a broad spectrum of dimensions and tail shapes reveal accurate Type I error control and robust power relative to heavy- and light-tailed alternatives, thus improving upon energy-distance benchmarks and normality-oriented graphical tests in contexts where MGGD modelling is most applicable.

item.title: Defining Robust Ultrasound Quality Metrics via an Ultrasound Foundation Model
item.author: Ziyang Huang, Bingyan Li, Chen Ma, Tianyi Liu, Yihui Zhai, Hong Xu, Yi Guo, Zeju Li, Yuanyuan Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TinyUSFM-uLPIPS和TinyUSFM-NRQ

背景: 临床医生缺乏量化超声重建诊断效用的原则性框架，现有标准如PSNR和VGG-LPIPS因未考虑模态特定物理特性或声学成像结构细微差别而不适用

目的: 构建基于TinyUSFM的评估框架，包含TinyUSFM-uLPIPS和TinyUSFM-NRQ两种指标

方法: TinyUSFM-uLPIPS是基于多层标记关系的全参考感知距离；TinyUSFM-NRQ是利用清洁流形建模和最坏区域聚合的可部署无参考质量评分

主要发现: 1) 任务关联质量：TinyUSFM-uLPIPS在语义任务损伤校准上表现优越，准确反映分割中Dice分数下降；2) 跨器官可比性：在不同解剖部位和域偏移数据上保持稳定的评分刻度和一致严重程度排名；3) PSNR一致敏感性：TinyUSFM-NRQ提供可靠质量评分且与传统保真度基准一致；4) 临床效用：专家偏好预测准确率从47.2%提高到72.8%，产生超声医师偏好的超分辨率重建

结论: 该工作建立了模态对齐标准，最终弥合了算法性能与诊断效用之间的差距

翻译: Clinicians lack a principled framework to quantify diagnostic utility in ultrasound reconstructions. Existing standards like PSNR and VGG-LPIPS are inadequate, failing to account for modality-specific physics or the structural nuances of acoustic imaging. We close this gap with a TinyUSFM-based evaluation framework featuring two distinct metrics: TinyUSFM-uLPIPS, a full-reference perceptual distance based on multi-layer token relations, and TinyUSFM-NRQ, a deployable no-reference quality score utilizing clean-manifold modeling and worst-region aggregation to detect localized harmful artifacts. We demonstrate that the presented metrics have four unique advantages: 1) Task-linked quality, where TinyUSFM-uLPIPS achieves superior calibration with semantic task damage, accurately reflecting Dice-score drops in segmentation where VGG-based metrics fail; 2) Cross-organ comparability, maintaining stable scoring scales and consistent severity rankings across diverse anatomical sites and domain-shifted data; 3) PSNR-consistent sensitivity, with TinyUSFM-NRQ providing a reliable quality score without ground-truth images that remains consistent with traditional fidelity benchmarks (i.e. PSNR); and 4) Clinical utility, improving the prediction of expert preference from 47.2% to 72.8% accuracy and producing super-resolution reconstructions preferred by sonographers. By integrating these advantages into a unified assessment and optimization loop, this work establishes a modality-aligned standard that finally bridges the gap between algorithmic performance and diagnostic utility.

Abstract

Clinicians lack a principled framework to quantify diagnostic utility in ultrasound reconstructions. Existing standards like PSNR and VGG-LPIPS are inadequate, failing to account for modality-specific physics or the structural nuances of acoustic imaging. We close this gap with a TinyUSFM-based evaluation framework featuring two distinct metrics: TinyUSFM-uLPIPS, a full-reference perceptual distance based on multi-layer token relations, and TinyUSFM-NRQ, a deployable no-reference quality score utilizing clean-manifold modeling and worst-region aggregation to detect localized harmful artifacts. We demonstrate that the presented metrics have four unique advantages: 1) Task-linked quality, where TinyUSFM-uLPIPS achieves superior calibration with semantic task damage, accurately reflecting Dice-score drops in segmentation where VGG-based metrics fail; 2) Cross-organ comparability, maintaining stable scoring scales and consistent severity rankings across diverse anatomical sites and domain-shifted data; 3) PSNR-consistent sensitivity, with TinyUSFM-NRQ providing a reliable quality score without ground-truth images that remains consistent with traditional fidelity benchmarks (i.e. PSNR); and 4) Clinical utility, improving the prediction of expert preference from 47.2$\%$ to 72.8$\%$ accuracy and producing super-resolution reconstructions preferred by sonographers. By integrating these advantages into a unified assessment and optimization loop, this work establishes a modality-aligned standard that finally bridges the gap between algorithmic performance and diagnostic utility. https://github.com/sextant-fable/US-Metrics

item.title: GenerativeMPC: VLM-RAG-guided Whole-Body MPC with Virtual Impedance for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
item.author: Marcelino Julio Fernando, Miguel Altamirano Cabrera, Jeffrin Sam, Yara Mahmoud, Konstantin Gubernatorov, Dzmitry Tsetserukou
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为GenerativeMPC的分层物理框架，旨在将语义场景理解与物理控制参数无缝集成，以解决双臂移动操作中高层语义推理与安全物理交互的挑战。

背景: 双臂移动操作需要高层语义推理与安全、合规的物理交互的紧密集成，但端到端模型对此处理方式不透明，而经典控制器缺乏处理此类上下文的语境。

目的: 构建一个分层物理框架，明确将语义场景理解与物理控制参数连接起来，以实现安全、符合社会意识的导航和操作。

方法: 利用带有检索增强生成的视觉语言模型（VLM-RAG）将视觉和语言上下文转化为 grounded 控制约束，输出动态速度限制和安全裕度；同时，VLM-RAG 模块调节统一阻抗-导纳控制器的虚拟刚度和阻尼增益；系统还利用经验驱动的向量数据库确保参数 grounding 的一致性。

主要发现: 在 MuJoCo、IsaacSim 和实体双臂平台上进行的实验表明，该框架在靠近人类时减少了 60% 的速度，实现了安全且具有社会意识的导航和操作。

结论: 该工作通过将大规模认知模型落地到可预测的高频物理控制回路中，推进了以人为中心的控制论领域的发展。

翻译: 双臂移动操作需要高层语义推理与安全、合规的物理交互的紧密集成——这是一个端到端模型以不透明方式处理，而经典控制器缺乏语境来解决的问题。本文提出了GenerativeMPC，一个分层物理框架，明确将语义场景理解与物理控制参数连接起来，用于双臂移动操作器。该系统利用带有检索增强生成的视觉语言模型（VLM-RAG）将视觉和语言上下文转化为 grounded 控制约束，具体为 Whole-Body Model Predictive Controller (MPC) 输出动态速度限制和安全裕度。同时，VLM-RAG 模块调节统一阻抗-导纳控制器的虚拟刚度和阻尼增益，使其在人类-机器人交互期间具有上下文感知的合规性。我们的框架利用经验驱动的向量数据库确保参数 grounding 的一致性，无需重新训练。在 MuJoCo、IsaacSim 和实体双臂平台上的实验结果证实，靠近人类时速度减少了 60%，并通过语义到物理的参数 grounding 实现了安全、社会意识的导航和操作。这项工作通过将大规模认知模型落地到可预测的高频物理控制回路中，推进了以人为中心的控制论领域的发展。

Abstract

Bimanual mobile manipulation requires a seamless integration between high-level semantic reasoning and safe, compliant physical interaction - a challenge that end-to-end models approach opaquely and classical controllers lack the context to address. This paper presents GenerativeMPC, a hierarchical cyber-physical framework that explicitly bridges semantic scene understanding with physical control parameters for bimanual mobile manipulators. The system utilizes a Vision-Language Model with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (VLM-RAG) to translate visual and linguistic context into grounded control constraints, specifically outputting dynamic velocity limits and safety margins for a Whole-Body Model Predictive Controller (MPC). Simultaneously, the VLM-RAG module modulates virtual stiffness and damping gains for a unified impedance-admittance controller, enabling context-aware compliance during human-robot interaction. Our framework leverages an experience-driven vector database to ensure consistent parameter grounding without retraining. Experimental results in MuJoCo, IsaacSim, and on a physical bimanual platform confirm a 60% speed reduction near humans and safe, socially-aware navigation and manipulation through semantic-to-physical parameter grounding. This work advances the field of human-centric cybernetics by grounding large-scale cognitive models into predictable, high-frequency physical control loops.

item.title: Calibrating Scientific Foundation Models with Inference-Time Stochastic Attention
item.author: Akash Yadav, Taiwo A. Adebiyi, Ruda Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Stochastic Attention的轻量级推理时修改方法，通过随机化注意力机制来提高科学基础模型在关键任务中的预测不确定性校准能力。

背景: 当前的Transformer架构输出确定性的结果，并且对校准预测不确定性的支持有限。

目的: 为了解决当前架构在关键设置中缺乏校准预测不确定性的问题，提出一种无需重新训练即可产生预测集成的方法。

方法: 提出Stochastic Attention，这是一种轻量级的推理时修改，通过用受单一集中度参数控制的归一化多项式采样替换softmax权重来随机化注意力。为了设置这个参数，引入了一个校准目标，使随机注意力输出与目标匹配，从而形成一个高效的单变量事后调优问题。

主要发现: 在天气和时序预测的两个科学基础模型以及一个额外的回归任务上进行了评估。与不确定性感知的基线相比，Stochastic Attention在可比的覆盖率下实现了最强的原生校准和最尖锐的预测区间。

结论: Stochastic Attention只需要几分钟的事后调优，而竞争性基线则需要数天的重新训练，因此更加高效。

翻译: 基于Transformer的科学基础模型正越来越多地部署在高风险的设置中，但当前的架构给出确定性的输出，并且对校准预测不确定性的支持有限。我们提出了Stochastic Attention，这是一种轻量级的推理时修改，通过用受单一集中度参数控制的归一化多项式采样替换softmax权重来随机化注意力，并在不重新训练的情况下产生预测集成。为了设置这个参数，我们引入了一个校准目标，使随机注意力输出与目标匹配，从而形成一个高效的单变量事后调优问题。我们在天气和时序预测的两个科学基础模型以及一个额外的回归任务上评估了这种机制。在与不确定性感知基线的基准测试中，我们发现Stochastic Attention在可比的覆盖率下实现了最强的原生校准和最尖锐的预测区间，而竞争性基线需要数天的重新训练，相比之下只需要几分钟的事后调优。

Abstract

Transformer-based scientific foundation models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, but current architectures give deterministic outputs and provide limited support for calibrated predictive uncertainty. We propose Stochastic Attention, a lightweight inference-time modification that randomizes attention by replacing softmax weights with normalized multinomial samples controlled by a single concentration parameter, and produces predictive ensembles without retraining. To set this parameter, we introduce a calibration objective that matches the stochastic attention output with the target, yielding an efficient univariate post-hoc tuning problem. We evaluate this mechanism on two scientific foundation models for weather and timeseries forecasting along with an additional regression task. Across benchmarks against uncertainty-aware baselines, we find that Stochastic Attention achieves the strongest native calibration and the sharpest prediction intervals at comparable coverage, while requiring only minutes of post-hoc tuning versus days of retraining for competitive baselines.

item.title: Paparazzo: Active Mapping of Moving 3D Objects
item.author: Davide Allegro, Shiyao Li, Stefano Ghidoni, Vincent Lepetit
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Paparazzo 是一种无学习解决方案，用于主动映射移动对象，通过预测目标轨迹并识别最具信息量的观测点来自主规划路径，从而显著提高 3D 重建的完整性和准确性。

背景: 现有的 3D 映射管道通常假设环境是静态的，这限制了它们准确捕获和重建移动对象的能力。

目的: 引入主动映射移动对象的新任务，使映射代理能够在补偿物体运动的同时规划其轨迹。

方法: Paparazzo 提供了一种无学习解决方案，能够稳健地预测目标的轨迹，并识别最具信息量的观测点以规划自身路径。

主要发现: Paparazzo 相比几种强有力的基线显著提高了 3D 重建的完整性和准确性。

结论: Paparazzo 是迈向动态场景理解的重要一步。

翻译: 现有的 3D 映射管道通常假设环境是静态的，这限制了它们准确捕获和重建移动对象的能力。为了解决这一局限性，我们引入了主动映射移动对象的新任务，其中映射代理必须在补偿物体运动的同时规划其轨迹。我们的方法 Paparazzo 提供了一种无学习解决方案，能够稳健地预测目标的轨迹，并识别最具信息量的观测点以规划自身路径。我们还为此新任务设计了一个全面的基准。通过广泛的实验，我们表明 Paparazzo 相比几种强有力的基线显著提高了 3D 重建的完整性和准确性，这是迈向动态场景理解的重要一步。

Abstract

Current 3D mapping pipelines generally assume static environments, which limits their ability to accurately capture and reconstruct moving objects. To address this limitation, we introduce the novel task of active mapping of moving objects, in which a mapping agent must plan its trajectory while compensating for the object's motion. Our approach, Paparazzo, provides a learning-free solution that robustly predicts the target's trajectory and identifies the most informative viewpoints from which to observe it, to plan its own path. We also contribute a comprehensive benchmark designed for this new task. Through extensive experiments, we show that Paparazzo significantly improves 3D reconstruction completeness and accuracy compared to several strong baselines, marking an important step toward dynamic scene understanding. Project page: https://davidea97.github.io/paparazzo-page/

item.title: Structure-guided molecular design with contrastive 3D protein-ligand learning
item.author: Carles Navarro, Philipp Tholke, Gianni de Fabritiis
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种结合对比3D结构编码与自回归分子生成的统一框架，旨在解决基于结构的药物发现中准确捕捉蛋白质-配体相互作用及在超大规模化学空间中识别可合成候选物的双重挑战。

背景: 基于结构的药物发现面临两大挑战：准确捕捉3D蛋白质-配体相互作用，以及在超大规模化学空间中识别可合成的候选物。

目的: 开发一个统一框架，通过结合对比3D结构编码与自回归分子生成来解决上述挑战。

方法: 1. 引入SE(3)-等变Transformer，通过对比学习将配体和口袋结构编码到共享嵌入空间，实现零样本虚拟筛选；2. 将这些嵌入集成到多模态化学语言模型（MCLM）中，该模型在口袋或配体结构条件下生成目标特定分子，并使用学习到的数据集令牌引导输出朝向目标化学空间。

主要发现: 该模型生成的候选物在多种靶点上具有有利的预测结合性质。

结论: 提出的统一框架能够有效解决基于结构的药物发现中的关键挑战，通过对比3D结构编码和自回归分子生成，在目标化学空间内生成具有良好结合性质的候选分子。

翻译: Structure-based drug discovery faces the dual challenge of accurately capturing 3D protein-ligand interactions while navigating ultra-large chemical spaces to identify synthetically accessible candidates. In this work, we present a unified framework that addresses these challenges by combining contrastive 3D structure encoding with autoregressive molecular generation conditioned on commercial compound spaces. First, we introduce an SE(3)-equivariant transformer that encodes ligand and pocket structures into a shared embedding space via contrastive learning, achieving competitive results in zero-shot virtual screening. Second, we integrate these embeddings into a multimodal Chemical Language Model (MCLM). The model generates target-specific molecules conditioned on either pocket or ligand structures, with a learned dataset token that steers the output toward targeted chemical spaces, yielding candidates with favorable predicted binding properties across diverse targets.

Abstract

Structure-based drug discovery faces the dual challenge of accurately capturing 3D protein-ligand interactions while navigating ultra-large chemical spaces to identify synthetically accessible candidates. In this work, we present a unified framework that addresses these challenges by combining contrastive 3D structure encoding with autoregressive molecular generation conditioned on commercial compound spaces. First, we introduce an SE(3)-equivariant transformer that encodes ligand and pocket structures into a shared embedding space via contrastive learning, achieving competitive results in zero-shot virtual screening. Second, we integrate these embeddings into a multimodal Chemical Language Model (MCLM). The model generates target-specific molecules conditioned on either pocket or ligand structures, with a learned dataset token that steers the output toward targeted chemical spaces, yielding candidates with favorable predicted binding properties across diverse targets.

item.title: Structure-Semantic Decoupled Modulation of Global Geospatial Embeddings for High-Resolution Remote Sensing Mapping
item.author: Jienan Lyu, Miao Yang, Jinchen Cai, Yiwen Hu, Guanyi Lu, Junhao Qiu, Runmin Dong
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种结构-语义解耦调制框架，通过将全局地理空间表示解耦为两个互补的跨模态注入路径，有效解决了高分辨率遥感制图中局部视觉特征限制跨域泛化能力及预测碎片化的问题。

背景: 细粒度高分辨率遥感制图通常依赖局部视觉特征，这限制了跨域泛化能力，并导致大面积土地覆盖预测出现碎片化。虽然全局地理空间基础模型提供了强大的泛化表示，但直接融合其高维隐式嵌入与高分辨率视觉特征会因严重的语义-空间差距引发特征干扰和空间结构退化。

目的: 克服现有方法的局限性，通过结构-语义解耦调制框架，抑制高频细节噪声和过度类内方差引起的预测碎片化，增强语义一致性和类别级判别力。

方法: 提出结构-语义解耦调制框架，包含结构先验调制分支和全局语义注入分支。前者将全局表示中的宏观感受野先验引入高分辨率编码器的自注意力模块，指导局部特征提取；后者明确对齐整体上下文与深层高分辨率特征空间，并通过跨模态集成直接补充全局语义。

主要发现: 实验表明，该方法在现有跨模态融合方法中取得了最先进的性能，在多样化场景中一致提高了高分辨率制图精度。

结论: SSDM通过释放全局嵌入的潜力，为将地理空间基础模型集成到高分辨率视觉任务中提供了一种通用且有效的范式。

翻译: Fine-grained high-resolution remote sensing mapping typically relies on localized visual features, which restricts cross-domain generalizability and often leads to fragmented predictions of large-scale land covers. While global geospatial foundation models offer powerful, generalizable representations, directly fusing their high-dimensional implicit embeddings with high-resolution visual features frequently triggers feature interference and spatial structure degradation due to a severe semantic-spatial gap. To overcome these limitations, we propose a Structure-Semantic Decoupled Modulation (SSDM) framework, which decouples global geospatial representations into two complementary cross-modal injection pathways. First, the structural prior modulation branch introduces the macroscopic receptive field priors from global representations into the self-attention modules of the high-resolution encoder. By guiding local feature extraction with holistic structural constraints, it effectively suppresses prediction fragmentation caused by high-frequency detail noise and excessive intra-class variance. Second, the global semantic injection branch explicitly aligns holistic context with the deep high-resolution feature space and directly supplements global semantics via cross-modal integration, thereby significantly enhancing the semantic consistency and category-level discrimination of complex land covers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing cross-modal fusion approaches. By unleashing the potential of global embeddings, SSDM consistently improves high-resolution mapping accuracy across diverse scenarios, providing a universal and effective paradigm for integrating geospatial foundation models into high-resolution vision tasks.

Abstract

Fine-grained high-resolution remote sensing mapping typically relies on localized visual features, which restricts cross-domain generalizability and often leads to fragmented predictions of large-scale land covers. While global geospatial foundation models offer powerful, generalizable representations, directly fusing their high-dimensional implicit embeddings with high-resolution visual features frequently triggers feature interference and spatial structure degradation due to a severe semantic-spatial gap. To overcome these limitations, we propose a Structure-Semantic Decoupled Modulation (SSDM) framework, which decouples global geospatial representations into two complementary cross-modal injection pathways. First, the structural prior modulation branch introduces the macroscopic receptive field priors from global representations into the self-attention modules of the high-resolution encoder. By guiding local feature extraction with holistic structural constraints, it effectively suppresses prediction fragmentation caused by high-frequency detail noise and excessive intra-class variance. Second, the global semantic injection branch explicitly aligns holistic context with the deep high-resolution feature space and directly supplements global semantics via cross-modal integration, thereby significantly enhancing the semantic consistency and category-level discrimination of complex land covers. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing cross-modal fusion approaches. By unleashing the potential of global embeddings, SSDM consistently improves high-resolution mapping accuracy across diverse scenarios, providing a universal and effective paradigm for integrating geospatial foundation models into high-resolution vision tasks.

item.title: PC2Model: ISPRS benchmark on 3D point cloud to model registration
item.author: Mehdi Maboudi, Said Harb, Jackson Ferrao, Kourosh Khoshelham, Yelda Turkan, Karam Mawas
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该论文介绍了PC2Model基准数据集，旨在支持点云到模型配准任务的训练和评估，结合了模拟数据和真实世界扫描数据。

背景: 随着点云采集技术的普及和深度学习的进步，研究重点转向下游任务，特别是点云到模型配准。

目的: 为了解决数据驱动方法在稀疏性、噪声、杂乱和遮挡等现实世界扫描问题上的局限性，该论文引入了PC2Model基准数据集。

方法: 该基准数据集由ICWG II/Ib领导开发，采用混合设计，结合模拟点云和真实世界扫描及其对应的3D模型。

主要发现: 模拟数据提供精确的地面真值和受控条件，而真实世界数据引入传感器和环境伪影。这种设计支持跨域的鲁棒训练和评估，并能够系统分析从模拟到现实世界的模型可迁移性。

结论: PC2Model基准数据集是公开可用的，旨在支持经典和数据驱动方法的训练和评估，促进点云配准领域的研究。

翻译: 点云配准涉及将一个点云与另一个或与三维模型对齐，使多模态数据集成到统一表示中。这在建筑监测、自动驾驶、机器人和虚拟或增强现实等应用中至关重要。随着点云采集技术如激光雷达和结构光扫描的日益普及，以及深度学习的最新进展，研究重点正越来越多地转向下游任务，特别是点云到模型配准。虽然数据驱动方法旨在自动化这一过程，但它们在现实世界扫描的稀疏性、噪声、杂乱和遮挡方面面临困难，这限制了它们的性能。为了解决这些挑战，本文介绍了PC2Model基准，这是一个公开可用的数据集，旨在支持经典和数据驱动方法的训练和评估。在ICWG II/Ib的领导下，PC2Model基准采用混合设计，结合模拟点云和某些情况下的真实世界扫描及其对应的3D模型。模拟数据提供精确的地面真值和受控条件，而真实世界数据引入传感器和环境伪影。这种设计支持跨域的鲁棒训练和评估，并能够系统分析从模拟到现实世界场景的模型可迁移性。该数据集可在以下网址公开获取：https://zenodo.org/uploads/17581812。

Abstract

Point cloud registration involves aligning one point cloud with another or with a three-dimensional (3D) model, enabling the integration of multimodal data into a unified representation. This is essential in applications such as construction monitoring, autonomous driving, robotics, and virtual or augmented reality (VR/AR).With the increasing accessibility of point cloud acquisition technologies, such as Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) and structured light scanning, along with recent advances in deep learning, the research focus has increasingly shifted towards downstream tasks, particularly point cloud-to-model (PC2Model) registration. While data-driven methods aim to automate this process, they struggle with sparsity, noise, clutter, and occlusions in real-world scans, which limit their performance. To address these challenges, this paper introduces the PC2Model benchmark, a publicly available dataset designed to support the training and evaluation of both classical and data-driven methods. Developed under the leadership of ICWG II/Ib, the PC2Model benchmark adopts a hybrid design that combines simulated point clouds with, in some cases, real-world scans and their corresponding 3D models. Simulated data provide precise ground truth and controlled conditions, while real-world data introduce sensor and environmental artefacts. This design supports robust training and evaluation across domains and enables the systematic analysis of model transferability from simulated to real-world scenarios. The dataset is publicly accessible at: https://zenodo.org/uploads/17581812.

item.title: Volume Transformer: Revisiting Vanilla Transformers for 3D Scene Understanding
item.author: Kadir Yilmaz, Adrian Kruse, Tristan Höfer, Daan de Geus, Bastian Leibe
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 Volume Transformer 的模型，通过将3D场景划分为体素块并利用全局自注意力机制处理，实现了在3D语义分割和实例分割任务上的先进性能，证明了其作为通用骨干网络的潜力。

背景: 现有的3D场景理解方法依赖于具有强领域先验的专用骨干网络，导致该领域与更广泛的Transformer生态系统隔离，限制了新进展的转移以及优化软件和硬件栈带来的益处。

目的: 为了弥合这一差距，本文旨在将通用Transformer编码器适配到3D场景中，构建一个简单、可扩展且通用的骨干网络。

方法: 将输入的3D场景划分为体素块标记，利用全局自注意力机制处理这些标记，并通过旋转位置编码的3D扩展注入位置信息。为了解决数据效率问题，引入了基于强3D增强、正则化和从卷积教师模型蒸馏的训练配方，并通过在多个数据集上的联合训练来扩展监督规模。

主要发现: 在标准3D基准上直接训练会导致捷径学习，表明当前3D监督的规模有限；通过数据高效训练配方和联合训练，Volt比特定领域的3D骨干网络更能从增加的规模中受益；在室内和室外数据集上实现了最先进的结果；在3D实例分割管道中作为即插即用的骨干网络也取得了新的最先进性能。

结论: Volume Transformer作为一个简单、可扩展且通用的骨干网络，在3D场景理解任务中表现出色，证明了其作为通用基础模型的潜力。

翻译: Transformers已成为深度学习中的常见基础，然而3D场景理解仍然依赖于具有强领域先验的专用骨干网络。这使该领域与更广泛的Transformer生态系统隔离，限制了新进展的转移以及优化软件和硬件栈带来的益处。为了弥合这一差距，我们以最小的修改将通用Transformer编码器适配到3D场景中。给定输入的3D场景，我们将其划分为体素块标记，利用全局自注意力机制处理它们，并通过旋转位置编码的3D扩展注入位置信息。我们将由此产生的模型称为Volume Transformer，并将其应用于3D语义分割。在标准3D基准上直接训练Volt会导致捷径学习，突显了当前3D监督的规模有限。为了克服这一点，我们引入了一种基于强3D增强、正则化和从卷积教师模型蒸馏的数据高效训练配方，使Volt与最先进的方法竞争。然后，我们通过在多个数据集上的联合训练来扩展监督，并表明Volt比特定领域的3D骨干网络更能从增加的规模中受益，在室内和室外数据集上实现了最先进的结果。最后，当在标准3D实例分割管道中用作即插即用的骨干网络时，Volt再次设定了新的最先进性能，突显了其作为3D场景理解的简单、可扩展、通用骨干网络的潜力。

Abstract

Transformers have become a common foundation across deep learning, yet 3D scene understanding still relies on specialized backbones with strong domain priors. This keeps the field isolated from the broader Transformer ecosystem, limiting the transfer of new advances as well as the benefits of increasingly optimized software and hardware stacks. To bridge this gap, we adapt the vanilla Transformer encoder to 3D scenes with minimal modifications. Given an input 3D scene, we partition it into volumetric patch tokens, process them with full global self-attention, and inject positional information via a 3D extension of rotary positional embeddings. We call the resulting model the Volume Transformer (Volt) and apply it to 3D semantic segmentation. Naively training Volt on standard 3D benchmarks leads to shortcut learning, highlighting the limited scale of current 3D supervision. To overcome this, we introduce a data-efficient training recipe based on strong 3D augmentations, regularization, and distillation from a convolutional teacher, making Volt competitive with state-of-the-art methods. We then scale supervision through joint training on multiple datasets and show that Volt benefits more from increased scale than domain-specific 3D backbones, achieving state-of-the-art results across indoor and outdoor datasets. Finally, when used as a drop-in backbone in a standard 3D instance segmentation pipeline, Volt again sets a new state of the art, highlighting its potential as a simple, scalable, general-purpose backbone for 3D scene understanding.

item.title: Disentangling Damage from Operational Variability: A Label-Free Self-Supervised Representation Learning Framework for Output-Only Structural Damage Identification
item.author: Xudong Jian, Charikleia Stoura, Simon Scandella, Eleni Chatzi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种自监督无标签解耦表示学习框架，用于鲁棒的振动结构损伤识别。

背景: 在实际结构健康监测中，损伤识别的可靠性常受到非损伤效应（如激励和环境条件变化）的干扰，这些干扰引起的改变可能与损伤引起的改变相当或更大。

目的: 为了解决这一挑战，提出了一种自监督无标签解耦表示学习框架，以实现鲁棒的基于振动的结构损伤识别。

方法: 该框架采用具有两个潜在表示的自编码器直接从原始振动加速度信号中学习。通过在假设结构损伤恒定但运行和环境条件变化的基线数据上施加自监督不变性正则化（VICREG），并在潜在表示中引入频域约束以强制重构功率谱密度与输入时间序列计算得到的功率谱密度一致。

主要发现: 在两个不同的真实世界振动数据集（包括桥梁和齿轮箱）上验证了该框架的有效性，结果表明其对运行变化具有鲁棒性、强泛化能力，并在损伤检测和量化方面表现良好。

结论: 该框架在完全端到端和无标签方式下训练，无需关于损伤、激励或环境条件的先验信息，非常适合实际应用。

翻译: Damage identification is a core task in structural health monitoring. In practice, however, its reliability is often compromised by confounding non-damage effects, such as variations in excitation and environmental conditions, which can induce changes comparable to or larger than those caused by structural damage. To address this challenge, this study proposes a self-supervised label-free disentangled representation learning framework for robust vibration-based structural damage identification. The proposed framework employs an autoencoder with two latent representations to learn directly from raw vibration acceleration signals. A self-supervised invariance regularization, implemented via Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization (VICREG), is imposed on one latent representation using baseline data where structural damage is assumed constant but operational and environmental conditions vary. In addition, a frequency-domain constraint is introduced to enforce agreement between the power spectral density reconstructed from the latent representation and that computed from the corresponding input time series. Together, these mechanisms promote disentanglement, enabling the learned representation to be sensitive to damage-related characteristics while remaining invariant to nuisance variability. The framework is trained in a fully end-to-end and label-free manner, requiring no prior information on damage, excitation, or environmental conditions, making it well-suited for real-world applications. Its effectiveness is validated on two distinct real-world vibration datasets, including a bridge and a gearbox. The results demonstrate robustness to operational variability, strong generalization capability, and good performance in both damage detection and quantification.

Abstract

Damage identification is a core task in structural health monitoring. In practice, however, its reliability is often compromised by confounding non-damage effects, such as variations in excitation and environmental conditions, which can induce changes comparable to or larger than those caused by structural damage. To address this challenge, this study proposes a self-supervised label-free disentangled representation learning framework for robust vibration-based structural damage identification. The proposed framework employs an autoencoder with two latent representations to learn directly from raw vibration acceleration signals. A self-supervised invariance regularization, implemented via Variance-Invariance-Covariance Regularization (VICReg), is imposed on one latent representation using baseline data where structural damage is assumed constant but operational and environmental conditions vary. In addition, a frequency-domain constraint is introduced to enforce agreement between the power spectral density reconstructed from the latent representation and that computed from the corresponding input time series. Together, these mechanisms promote disentanglement, enabling the learned representation to be sensitive to damage-related characteristics while remaining invariant to nuisance variability. The framework is trained in a fully end-to-end and label-free manner, requiring no prior information on damage, excitation, or environmental conditions, making it well-suited for real-world applications. Its effectiveness is validated on two distinct real-world vibration datasets, including a bridge and a gearbox. The results demonstrate robustness to operational variability, strong generalization capability, and good performance in both damage detection and quantification.

item.title: ECLASS-Augmented Semantic Product Search for Electronic Components
item.author: Nico Baumgart, Markus Lange-Hegermann, Jan Henze
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究评估了基于大语言模型的密集检索方法在工业电子元件语义搜索中的应用，并探讨了将ECLASS标准中的层级语义融入嵌入检索的集成方法。

背景: 工业产品数据的语义访问对工厂自动化和基于大语言模型代理的工作流程至关重要，但自然语言查询与以属性为中心的产品描述之间存在词汇不匹配，限制了传统检索方法（如BM25）的有效性。

目的: 对工业电子元件上基于大语言模型的密集检索进行系统评估，并研究将ECLASS标准的层级语义集成到基于嵌入的检索中。

方法: 结合密集检索与重排序的方法，并利用ECLASS标准中的层级语义来增强产品表示。

主要发现: 密集检索结合重排序的方法显著优于传统的词汇方法和基础模型网络搜索基线。提出的方案在专家查询上实现了94.3%的命中率，而BM25仅为31.4%，且在有效性和效率上均超过了基础模型基线。此外，利用ECLASS语义增强产品表示在所有配置下均带来了持续的性能提升。

结论: 标准化的层级元数据在用户意图和稀疏的产品描述之间提供了至关重要的语义桥梁。

翻译: 对工业电子元件上基于大语言模型的密集检索进行系统评估，并研究将ECLASS标准的层级语义集成到基于嵌入的检索中。

Abstract

Efficient semantic access to industrial product data is a key enabler for factory automation and emerging LLM-based agent workflows, where both human engineers and autonomous agents must identify suitable components from highly structured catalogs. However, the vocabulary mismatch between natural-language queries and attribute-centric product descriptions limits the effectiveness of traditional retrieval approaches, e.g., BM25. In this work, we present a systematic evaluation of LLM-assisted dense retrieval for semantic product search on industrial electronic components, and investigate the integration of hierarchical semantics from the ECLASS standard into embedding-based retrieval. Our results show that dense retrieval combined with re-ranking substantially outperforms classical lexical methods and foundation model web-search baselines. In particular, the proposed approach achieves a Hit_Rate@5 of 94.3 %, compared to 31.4 % for BM25 on expert queries, while also exceeding foundation model baselines in both effectiveness and efficiency. Furthermore, augmenting product representations with ECLASS semantics yields consistent performance gains across configurations, demonstrating that standardized hierarchical metadata provides a crucial semantic bridge between user intent and sparse product descriptions.

item.title: InHabit: Leveraging Image Foundation Models for Scalable 3D Human Placement
item.author: Nikita Kister, Pradyumna YM, István Sárándi, Jiayi Wang, Anna Khoreva, Gerard Pons-Moll
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: InHabit是一个全自动且可扩展的数据生成器，用于在3D场景中生成具有交互性的人类，并创建了一个包含78K样本的大规模逼真3D人类-场景交互数据集。

背景: 训练具身智能体理解3D场景需要大量人类有意义地与多样化环境交互的数据，但此类数据稀缺。现实世界运动捕捉成本高昂且局限于受控环境，而现有合成数据集依赖简单的几何启发式方法，忽略了丰富的场景上下文。

目的: 将2D基础模型在互联网规模数据上训练时隐式获得的人类-环境交互常识知识转移到3D中。

方法: InHabit遵循渲染-生成-提升原则：给定渲染的3D场景，视觉语言模型提出上下文有意义的动作，图像编辑模型插入人类，优化过程将编辑结果提升为与场景几何对齐的物理合理的SMPL-X身体。

主要发现: 将我们的样本作为标准训练数据的增强，改善了基于RGB的3D人类-场景重建和接触估计；在感知用户研究中，我们的数据在78%的情况下优于最先进技术。

结论: InHabit成功生成了大规模逼真3D人类-场景交互数据集，并证明其能有效提升相关任务性能。

翻译: 摘要：训练具身智能体像人类一样理解3D场景需要大量人类有意义地与多样化环境交互的数据，但此类数据稀缺。现实世界运动捕捉成本高昂且局限于受控环境，而现有合成数据集依赖简单的几何启发式方法，忽略了丰富的场景上下文。相比之下，在互联网规模数据上训练的2D基础模型隐式获得了人类-环境交互的常识知识。为了将这种知识转移到3D中，我们介绍了InHabit，这是一个全自动且可扩展的数据生成器，用于在3D场景中填充交互性人类。InHabit遵循渲染-生成-提升原则：给定渲染的3D场景，视觉语言模型提出上下文有意义的动作，图像编辑模型插入人类，优化过程将编辑结果提升为与场景几何对齐的物理合理的SMPL-X身体。应用于Habitat-Matterport3D，InHabit生成了第一个大规模逼真3D人类-场景交互数据集，包含800个建筑级场景中的78K样本，具有完整的3D几何、SMPL-X身体和RGB图像。用我们的样本增强标准训练数据改善了基于RGB的3D人类-场景重建和接触估计，并且在感知用户研究中，我们的数据在78%的情况下优于最先进技术。

Abstract

Training embodied agents to understand 3D scenes as humans do requires large-scale data of people meaningfully interacting with diverse environments, yet such data is scarce. Real-world motion capture is costly and limited to controlled settings, while existing synthetic datasets rely on simple geometric heuristics that ignore rich scene context. In contrast, 2D foundation models trained on internet-scale data have implicitly acquired commonsense knowledge of human-environment interactions. To transfer this knowledge into 3D, we introduce InHabit, a fully automatic and scalable data generator for populating 3D scenes with interacting humans. InHabit follows a render-generate-lift principle: given a rendered 3D scene, a vision-language model proposes contextually meaningful actions, an image-editing model inserts a human, and an optimization procedure lifts the edited result into physically plausible SMPL-X bodies aligned with the scene geometry. Applied to Habitat-Matterport3D, InHabit produces the first large-scale photorealistic 3D human-scene interaction dataset, containing 78K samples across 800 building-scale scenes with complete 3D geometry, SMPL-X bodies, and RGB images. Augmenting standard training data with our samples improves RGB-based 3D human-scene reconstruction and contact estimation, and in a perceptual user study our data is preferred in 78% of cases over the state of the art.

item.title: ReImagine: Rethinking Controllable High-Quality Human Video Generation via Image-First Synthesis
item.author: Zhengwentai Sun, Keru Zheng, Chenghong Li, Hongjie Liao, Xihe Yang, Heyuan Li, Yihao Zhi, Shuliang Ning, Shuguang Cui, Xiaoguang Han
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于图像优先视角的、可控的人体视频生成方法，通过解耦外观建模与时间一致性，结合姿态和视角控制管道及无训练时间细化阶段，生成高质量、时间一致的视频。

背景: 人类视频生成面临挑战，难以在有限的多视角数据下联合建模人类外观、运动和相机视角。现有方法通常分别处理这些因素，导致可控性有限或视觉质量降低。

目的: 从图像优先视角重新审视问题，通过高质量图像生成学习人类外观作为视频合成的先验，解耦外观建模与时间一致性。提出姿态和视角可控的管道，结合预训练图像骨干网络、SMPL-X运动引导及基于预训练视频扩散模型的无训练时间细化阶段。

方法: 结合预训练图像骨干网络与SMPL-X运动引导，以及基于预训练视频扩散模型的无训练时间细化阶段。同时发布了规范人类数据集和辅助模型用于组合式人类图像合成。

主要发现: 该方法在多样化的姿态和视角下产生高质量、时间一致的视频。

结论: 该方法成功实现了高质量、时间一致的人体视频生成，并提供了公开的代码和数据集。

翻译: Human video generation remains challenging due to the difficulty of jointly modeling human appearance, motion, and camera viewpoint under limited multi-view data. Existing methods often address these factors separately, resulting in limited controllability or reduced visual quality. We revisit this problem from an image-first perspective, where high-quality human appearance is learned via image generation and used as a prior for video synthesis, decoupling appearance modeling from temporal consistency. We propose a pose- and viewpoint-controllable pipeline that combines a pretrained image backbone with SMPL-X-based motion guidance, together with a training-free temporal refinement stage based on a pretrained video diffusion model. Our method produces high-quality, temporally consistent videos under diverse poses and viewpoints. We also release a canonical human dataset and an auxiliary model for compositional human image synthesis. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Taited/ReImagine.

Abstract

Human video generation remains challenging due to the difficulty of jointly modeling human appearance, motion, and camera viewpoint under limited multi-view data. Existing methods often address these factors separately, resulting in limited controllability or reduced visual quality. We revisit this problem from an image-first perspective, where high-quality human appearance is learned via image generation and used as a prior for video synthesis, decoupling appearance modeling from temporal consistency. We propose a pose- and viewpoint-controllable pipeline that combines a pretrained image backbone with SMPL-X-based motion guidance, together with a training-free temporal refinement stage based on a pretrained video diffusion model. Our method produces high-quality, temporally consistent videos under diverse poses and viewpoints. We also release a canonical human dataset and an auxiliary model for compositional human image synthesis. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Taited/ReImagine.

item.title: UniT: Toward a Unified Physical Language for Human-to-Humanoid Policy Learning and World Modeling
item.author: Boyu Chen, Yi Chen, Lu Qiu, Jerry Bai, Yuying Ge, Yixiao Ge
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为 UniT 的统一潜在动作标记器框架，旨在解决人形机器人基础模型因机器人数据稀缺而面临的瓶颈问题，通过统一物理语言实现跨具身迁移。

背景: 大规模自主体数据提供了可扩展的替代方案，但跨具身的鸿沟仍然是一个基本挑战，因为存在运动学不匹配。

目的: 建立一种统一的物理语言，用于从人类数据向人形机器人转移，并利用人类数据实现高效的数据利用和鲁棒的泛化。

方法: UniT 采用三分支交叉重建机制：动作预测视觉以锚定运动学，视觉重建动作以过滤无关视觉混淆因素，以及融合分支将纯化模态整合到共享的离散潜在空间中。

主要发现: 在策略学习范式下，VLA-UniT 实现了最先进的数据效率和鲁棒的分布外泛化；在世界建模范式下，WM-UniT 实现了直接的人类到人形机器人的动作转移，增强了动作可控性。

结论: UniT 通过诱导高度对齐的跨具身表示，提供了将大量人类知识蒸馏为通用人形机器人能力的可扩展路径。

翻译: Scaling humanoid foundation models is bottlenecked by the scarcity of robotic data. While massive egocentric human data offers a scalable alternative, bridging the cross-embodiment chasm remains a fundamental challenge due to kinematic mismatches. We introduce UniT (Unified Latent Action Tokenizer via Visual Anchoring), a framework that establishes a unified physical language for human-to-humanoid transfer. Grounded in the philosophy that heterogeneous kinematics share universal visual consequences, UniT employs a tri-branch cross-reconstruction mechanism: actions predict vision to anchor kinematics to physical outcomes, while vision reconstructs actions to filter out irrelevant visual confounders. Concurrently, a fusion branch synergies these purified modalities into a shared discrete latent space of embodiment-agnostic physical intents. We validate UniT across two paradigms: 1) Policy Learning (VLA-UniT): By predicting these unified tokens, it effectively leverages diverse human data to achieve state-of-the-art data efficiency and robust out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization on both humanoid simulation benchmark and real-world deployments, notably demonstrating zero-shot task transfer. 2) World Modeling (WM-UniT): By aligning cross-embodiment dynamics via unified tokens as conditions, it realizes direct human-to-humanoid action transfer. This alignment ensures that human data seamlessly translates into enhanced action controllability for humanoid video generation. Ultimately, by inducing a highly aligned cross-embodiment representation (empirically verified by t-SNE visualizations revealing the convergence of human and humanoid features into a shared manifold), UniT offers a scalable path to distill vast human knowledge into general-purpose humanoid capabilities.

Abstract

Scaling humanoid foundation models is bottlenecked by the scarcity of robotic data. While massive egocentric human data offers a scalable alternative, bridging the cross-embodiment chasm remains a fundamental challenge due to kinematic mismatches. We introduce UniT (Unified Latent Action Tokenizer via Visual Anchoring), a framework that establishes a unified physical language for human-to-humanoid transfer. Grounded in the philosophy that heterogeneous kinematics share universal visual consequences, UniT employs a tri-branch cross-reconstruction mechanism: actions predict vision to anchor kinematics to physical outcomes, while vision reconstructs actions to filter out irrelevant visual confounders. Concurrently, a fusion branch synergies these purified modalities into a shared discrete latent space of embodiment-agnostic physical intents. We validate UniT across two paradigms: 1) Policy Learning (VLA-UniT): By predicting these unified tokens, it effectively leverages diverse human data to achieve state-of-the-art data efficiency and robust out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization on both humanoid simulation benchmark and real-world deployments, notably demonstrating zero-shot task transfer. 2) World Modeling (WM-UniT): By aligning cross-embodiment dynamics via unified tokens as conditions, it realizes direct human-to-humanoid action transfer. This alignment ensures that human data seamlessly translates into enhanced action controllability for humanoid video generation. Ultimately, by inducing a highly aligned cross-embodiment representation (empirically verified by t-SNE visualizations revealing the convergence of human and humanoid features into a shared manifold), UniT offers a scalable path to distill vast human knowledge into general-purpose humanoid capabilities.

item.title: Diagnosing Urban Street Vitality via a Visual-Semantic and Spatiotemporal Framework for Street-Level Economics
item.author: Xinxin Zhuo, Mengyuan Niu, Ruizhe Wang, Junyan Yang, Qiao Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于视觉语义和场域的时空框架，通过街景经济活力指数量化商业活力，并结合LBS数据捕捉需求变化，构建了包含商业活动、空间利用和物理环境的三维诊断系统。

背景: 微尺度街景经济评估对于精准空间资源配置至关重要。虽然街景影像技术推动了城市感知的发展，但现有方法在语义理解上仍显表面化，且忽视了品牌层级异质性和结构性衰退问题。

目的: 提出一种视觉-语义和场域基础的时空框架，通过街景经济活力指数量化商业活力，构建三维诊断系统，以解决现有方法在语义理解、品牌层级异质性和结构性衰退方面的不足。

方法: 通过实例分割解析物理和语义街景（包括招牌、玻璃界面和店面关闭）；采用双阶段VLM-LLM管道将招牌标准化为全球层级以量化空间平滑的品牌溢价指数；利用LBS数据引入时间滞后设计捕捉实现需求；结合类别加权的Gaussian溢出模型构建三维诊断系统；基于南京八个潮汐时段的时间滞后地理加权回归进行实验。

主要发现: 街景活力源于品牌层级聚类与商场诱导外部性的相互作用；高质量界面在中午和晚上显示峰值吸引力；结构性衰退产生夜间滞后排斥效应；实验揭示了准因果时空异质性。

结论: 该框架为精准空间治理提供了基于证据的支持。

翻译: 微尺度街景经济评估对于精准空间资源配置至关重要。虽然街景影像技术推动了城市感知的发展，但现有方法在语义理解上仍显表面化，且忽视了品牌层级异质性和结构性衰退问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于视觉语义和场域的时空框架，通过街景经济活力指数进行操作化。我们的方法通过实例分割解析物理和语义街景，包括招牌、玻璃界面和店面关闭。采用双阶段VLM-LLM管道将招牌标准化为全球层级，以量化空间平滑的品牌溢价指数。为了克服静态街景影像的局限性，我们引入了基于位置服务的时间滞后设计，以捕捉实现需求。结合类别加权的Gaussian溢出模型，我们构建了一个涵盖商业活动、空间利用和物理环境的三维诊断系统。基于南京八个潮汐时段的时间滞后地理加权回归实验揭示了准因果时空异质性。街景活力源于品牌层级聚类与商场诱导外部性的相互作用。高质量界面在中午和晚上显示峰值吸引力，而结构性衰退产生夜间滞后排斥效应。该框架为精准空间治理提供了基于证据的支持。

Abstract

Micro-scale street-level economic assessment is fundamental for precision spatial resource allocation. While Street View Imagery (SVI) advances urban sensing, existing approaches remain semantically superficial and overlook brand hierarchy heterogeneity and structural recession. To address this, we propose a visual-semantic and field-based spatiotemporal framework, operationalized via the Street Economic Vitality Index (SEVI). Our approach integrates physical and semantic streetscape parsing through instance segmentation of signboards, glass interfaces, and storefront closures. A dual-stage VLM-LLM pipeline standardizes signage into global hierarchies to quantify a spatially smoothed brand premium index. To overcome static SVI limitations, we introduce a temporal lag design using Location-Based Services (LBS) data to capture realized demand. Combined with a category-weighted Gaussian spillover model, we construct a three-dimensional diagnostic system covering Commercial Activity, Spatial Utilization, and Physical Environment. Experiments based on time-lagged geographically weighted regression across eight tidal periods in Nanjing reveal quasi-causal spatiotemporal heterogeneity. Street vibrancy arises from interactions between hierarchical brand clustering and mall-induced externalities. High-quality interfaces show peak attraction during midday and evening, while structural recession produces a lagged nighttime repulsion effect. The framework offers evidence-based support for precision spatial governance.

item.title: Rabies diagnosis in low-data settings: A comparative study on the impact of data augmentation and transfer learning
item.author: Khalil Akremi, Mariem Handous, Zied Bouslama, Farah Bassalah, Maryem Jebali, Mariem Hanachi, Ines Abdeljaoued-Tej
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的自动化狂犬病诊断系统，旨在解决非洲和亚洲部分地区因缺乏专业人员和样本量低而导致的诊断难题。

背景: 狂犬病在非洲和亚洲许多国家仍是主要的公共卫生关注问题，准确诊断对有效流行病学监测至关重要。传统的金标准诊断方法严重依赖荧光显微镜，需要熟练的实验室人员来准确解读结果，而这种专业知识往往稀缺，特别是在样本量低的地区。

目的: 开发一种自动化、AI驱动的诊断系统，以应对这些挑战，实现快速可靠的狂犬病检测。

方法: 利用荧光图像分析构建了稳健的管道，采用四种深度学习架构：EfficientNetB0、EfficientNetB2、VGG16和Vision Transformer (ViTB16)。在包含155张显微图像（123张阳性，32张阴性）的数据集上评估了三种不同的数据增强策略。

主要发现: TrivialAugmentWide是最有效的增强技术，因为它在保持关键荧光图案的同时提高了模型的鲁棒性。EfficientNetB0模型，利用几何与颜色增强并通过分层3折交叉验证选择，在裁剪图像上实现了最佳分类性能。

结论: 尽管存在类别不平衡和有限数据集大小的限制，这项工作证实了深度学习在自动化狂犬病诊断中的可行性。该方法能够实现快速可靠的检测，具有进一步优化的潜力。已部署在线工具以促进实际访问，为未来的医学影像应用建立了框架。

翻译: 狂犬病在非洲和亚洲许多国家仍是主要的公共卫生关注问题，准确诊断对有效流行病学监测至关重要。传统的金标准诊断方法严重依赖荧光显微镜，需要熟练的实验室人员来准确解读结果，而这种专业知识往往稀缺，特别是在样本量低的地区。本文提出了一种自动化、AI驱动的诊断系统，旨在解决这些挑战。我们开发了一个稳健的管道，利用荧光图像分析通过四种深度学习架构的迁移学习：EfficientNetB0、EfficientNetB2、VGG16和Vision Transformer (ViTB16)。评估了三种不同的数据增强策略，以增强模型在包含155张显微图像（123张阳性和32张阴性）的数据集上的泛化能力。我们的结果表明，TrivialAugmentWide是最有效的增强技术，因为它在保持关键荧光图案的同时提高了模型的鲁棒性。EfficientNetB0模型，利用几何与颜色增强并通过分层3折交叉验证选择，在裁剪图像上实现了最佳分类性能。尽管存在类别不平衡和有限数据集大小的限制，这项工作证实了深度学习在自动化狂犬病诊断中的可行性。该方法能够实现快速可靠的检测，具有进一步优化的潜力。已部署在线工具以促进实际访问，为未来的医学影像应用建立了框架。这项研究强调了优化深度学习模型在改变狂犬病诊断和改善公共卫生结果方面的潜力。

Abstract

Rabies remains a major public health concern across many African and Asian countries, where accurate diagnosis is critical for effective epidemiological surveillance. The gold standard diagnostic methods rely heavily on fluorescence microscopy, necessitating skilled laboratory personnel for the accurate interpretation of results. Such expertise is often scarce, particularly in regions with low annual sample volumes. This paper presents an automated, AI-driven diagnostic system designed to address these challenges. We developed a robust pipeline utilizing fluorescent image analysis through transfer learning with four deep learning architectures: EfficientNetB0, EfficientNetB2, VGG16, and Vision Transformer (ViTB16). Three distinct data augmentation strategies were evaluated to enhance model generalization on a dataset of 155 microscopic images (123 positive and 32 negative). Our results demonstrate that TrivialAugmentWide was the most effective augmentation technique, as it preserved critical fluorescent patterns while improving model robustness. The EfficientNetB0 model, utilizing Geometric & Color augmentation and selected through stratified 3fold cross-validation, achieved optimal classification performance on cropped images. Despite constraints posed by class imbalance and a limited dataset size, this work confirms the viability of deep learning for automating rabies diagnosis. The proposed method enables fast and reliable detection with significant potential for further optimization. An online tool was deployed to facilitate practical access, establishing a framework for future medical imaging applications. This research underscores the potential of optimized deep learning models to transform rabies diagnostics and improve public health outcomes.

item.title: Spatio-temporal modelling of electric vehicle charging demand
item.author: Kaoutar Bouaachra, Yvenn Amara-Ouali, Yannig Goude, Raphaël Lachieze-Rey
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究引入了一个新的苏格兰电动汽车充电需求数据集，并利用近似贝叶斯推断方法进行预测。

背景: 现有的基准数据集如Palo Alto (2020)无法反映现代充电网络的规模和行为多样性。

目的: 发布一个新的苏格兰数据集作为开放基准，并构建模型以准确预测电动汽车充电需求。

方法: 将充电需求建模为时空潜在高斯场，并通过INLA进行近似贝叶斯推断。

主要发现: 在站点级预测任务中，该方法在预测准确性上与机器学习基线具有竞争力，同时提供了原则性的不确定性量化和可解释的空间及时间分解。

结论: 该方法能够联合捕捉空间依赖性、时间动态和协变量效应，对于风险感知的基础设施规划至关重要。

翻译: 准确预测电动汽车（EV）充电需求对于电网管理和基础设施规划至关重要。然而，该领域继续依赖遗留基准，例如Palo Alto (2020)数据集，这些数据集无法反映现代充电网络的规模和行为多样性。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个新的大规模纵向数据集，该数据集在苏格兰（2022-2025年）收集，并将其作为社区开放基准发布。基于该数据集，我们将EV充电需求建模为时空潜在高斯场，并通过集成嵌套拉普拉斯近似（INLA）进行近似贝叶斯推断。由此产生的模型在统一的概率框架内联合捕捉空间依赖性、时间动态和协变量效应。在站点级预测任务中，我们的方法在预测准确性上与机器学习基线具有竞争力，同时提供了原则性的不确定性量化和可解释的空间及时间分解属性，这些属性对于风险感知的基础设施规划至关重要。

Abstract

Accurate forecasting of electric vehicle (EV) charging demand is critical for grid management and infrastructure planning. Yet the field continues to rely on legacy benchmarks; such as the Palo Alto (2020) dataset; that fail to reflect the scale and behavioral diversity of modern charging networks. To address this, we introduce a novel large-scale longitudinal dataset collected across Scotland (2022 2025), which release it as an open benchmark for the community. Building on this dataset, we formulate EV charging demand as a spatio-temporal latent Gaussian field and perform approximate Bayesian inference via Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation (INLA). The resulting model jointly captures spatial dependence, temporal dynamics, and covariate effects within a unified proba bilistic framework. On station-level forecasting tasks, our approach achieves competitive predictive accuracy against machine learning baselines, while additionally providing principled uncertainty quan tification and interpretable spatial and temporal decompositions properties that are essential for risk-aware infrastructure planning.

item.title: DR-Venus: Towards Frontier Edge-Scale Deep Research Agents with Only 10K Open Data
item.author: Venus Team, Sunhao Dai, Yong Deng, Jinzhen Lin, Yusheng Song, Guoqing Wang, Xiaofeng Wu, Yuqi Zhou, Shuo Yang, Zhenzhe Ying, Zhanwei Zhang, Changhua Meng, Weiqiang Wang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究如何在有限开放数据下训练强大的小型深度研究代理，提出了DR-Venus模型。

背景: 边缘规模的深度研究代理基于小型语言模型，在成本、延迟和隐私方面具有优势。

目的: 研究如何在有限开放数据下训练强大的小型深度研究代理，通过改进数据质量和数据利用来实现。

方法: 提出DR-Venus模型，训练过程分为两个阶段：第一阶段使用代理监督微调建立基础代理能力；第二阶段使用代理强化学习提高长跨度深度研究任务的执行可靠性。

主要发现: 基于约1万条开放数据的4B参数DR-Venus模型在多个深度研究基准测试中显著优于之前9B参数的代理模型，缩小了与30B级系统的差距。

结论: 4B代理已经表现出惊人的强大性能潜力，突显了小型模型的部署前景以及测试时扩展在此场景下的价值。

翻译: 基于小型语言模型的边缘规模深度研究代理因在成本、延迟和隐私方面的优势，对现实世界部署具有吸引力。在这项工作中，我们研究了如何在有限的开放数据下训练强大的小型深度研究代理，通过改进数据质量和数据利用来实现。我们提出了DR-Venus，这是一个用于边缘规模部署的前沿4B深度研究代理，完全基于开放数据构建。我们的训练配方包含两个阶段。在第一阶段，我们使用代理监督微调来建立基础代理能力，结合严格的数据清洗和长跨度轨迹的重采样以提高数据质量和利用。在第二阶段，我们应用代理强化学习来进一步提高长跨度深度研究任务的执行可靠性。为了使RL在此设置中有效地用于小型代理，我们基于IGPO并设计了基于信息增益和格式感知正则化的回合级奖励，从而增强了监督密度和回合级信用分配。基于约1万条开放数据构建的DR-Venus-4B在多个深度研究基准测试中显著优于之前9B参数的代理模型，同时也缩小了与更大的30B级系统的差距。我们进一步的分析表明，4B代理已经拥有令人惊讶的强大性能潜力，突显了小型模型的部署前景以及在此设置中测试时扩展的价值。我们发布了我们的模型、代码和关键配方，以支持边缘规模深度研究代理的可重复研究。

Abstract

Edge-scale deep research agents based on small language models are attractive for real-world deployment due to their advantages in cost, latency, and privacy. In this work, we study how to train a strong small deep research agent under limited open-data by improving both data quality and data utilization. We present DR-Venus, a frontier 4B deep research agent for edge-scale deployment, built entirely on open data. Our training recipe consists of two stages. In the first stage, we use agentic supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to establish basic agentic capability, combining strict data cleaning with resampling of long-horizon trajectories to improve data quality and utilization. In the second stage, we apply agentic reinforcement learning (RL) to further improve execution reliability on long-horizon deep research tasks. To make RL effective for small agents in this setting, we build on IGPO and design turn-level rewards based on information gain and format-aware regularization, thereby enhancing supervision density and turn-level credit assignment. Built entirely on roughly 10K open-data, DR-Venus-4B significantly outperforms prior agentic models under 9B parameters on multiple deep research benchmarks, while also narrowing the gap to much larger 30B-class systems. Our further analysis shows that 4B agents already possess surprisingly strong performance potential, highlighting both the deployment promise of small models and the value of test-time scaling in this setting. We release our models, code, and key recipes to support reproducible research on edge-scale deep research agents.

item.title: MMCORE: MultiModal COnnection with Representation Aligned Latent Embeddings
