结论: CLIMB在保持高质量图像合成的同时，有效降低了计算成本，并显著提升了脑结构演变建模的性能。

翻译: CLIMB是一个基于状态空间模型的可控纵向脑部图像生成框架，用于预测脑结构随时间的变化。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决纵向脑部图像生成中计算成本高的问题，特别是现有方法依赖自注意力模块导致效率低的问题。这个问题在研究中很重要，因为预测患者大脑随时间的演变有助于早期干预、预后和治疗规划，特别是在神经退行性疾病如阿尔茨海默病的诊断中。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有基于扩散模型的方法（如BrLP）使用自注意力模块计算成本高，且传统变分自编码器采样引入噪声导致图像模糊。因此，他们设计CLIMB框架，利用Mamba架构减少计算开销，并引入GATE模型通过切片分布对齐强制潜在分布符合高斯分布，从而保持图像清晰度。在借鉴现有工作方面，他们参考了BrLP的纵向生成思路，并使用了IRLSTM模型来预测未来的疾病状态和脑结构体积。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用基线 MRI 扫描和采集年龄，结合年龄、性别、疾病状态等多种条件变量，通过基于 Mamba 的潜在扩散模型来模拟脑结构随时间的演变，从而生成可控的纵向脑图像。整体实现流程包括：首先，利用高斯对齐自编码器（GATE）将输入数据压缩到低维潜在空间，并通过切片累积分布函数对齐策略使潜在特征符合高斯先验分布；其次，使用 Mamba 架构作为骨干网络构建潜在扩散模型，将基线扫描、采集年龄和预测数据作为条件输入进行训练，以生成未来的 MRI 扫描图像。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点包括：提出了CLIMB模型，利用基线MRI扫描和预测数据生成纵向脑图像；引入了GATE（高斯对齐自编码器），在潜在空间提取符合先验分布的特征且无采样噪声；采用Mamba架构作为骨干，在保持高质量的同时降低计算成本。相比之前的工作，CLIMB不再依赖计算昂贵且需大量数据的自注意力模块，而是使用Mamba；此外，它用GATE替代了传统VAE，消除了导致图像模糊的随机噪声，从而提高了图像保真度。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了 CLIMB 框架，利用 Mamba 架构和高斯对齐自编码器生成可控的纵向脑部 MRI 图像，通过结合多种条件变量来模拟大脑结构随时间的变化，同时降低了计算成本。

Abstract

Latent diffusion models have emerged as powerful generative models in medical imaging, enabling the synthesis of high quality brain magnetic resonance imaging scans. In particular, predicting the evolution of a patients brain can aid in early intervention, prognosis, and treatment planning. In this study, we introduce CLIMB, Controllable Longitudinal brain Image generation via state space based latent diffusion model, an advanced framework for modeling temporal changes in brain structure. CLIMB is designed to model the structural evolution of the brain structure over time, utilizing a baseline MRI scan and its acquisition age as foundational inputs. Additionally, multiple conditional variables, including projected age, gender, disease status, genetic information, and brain structure volumes, are incorporated to enhance the temporal modeling of anatomical changes. Unlike existing LDM methods that rely on self attention modules, which effectively capture contextual information from input images but are computationally expensive, our approach leverages state space, a state space model architecture that substantially reduces computational overhead while preserving high-quality image synthesis. Furthermore, we introduce a Gaussian-aligned autoencoder that extracts latent representations conforming to prior distributions without the sampling noise inherent in conventional variational autoencoders. We train and evaluate our proposed model on the Alzheimers Disease Neuroimaging Initiative dataset, consisting of 6,306 MRI scans from 1,390 participants. By comparing generated images with real MRI scans, CLIMB achieves a structural similarity index of 0.9433, demonstrating notable improvements over existing methods.

item.title: Flexible Empowerment at Reasoning with Extended Best-of-N Sampling
item.author: Taisuke Kobayashi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法，通过在强化学习中结合赋能来推理动作，从而实现探索与利用困境的灵活性。

背景: 在先前的方法中，赋能作为内在动机强化学习的一部分被添加到特定任务的奖励函数中，但这会导致直到学习到考虑赋能的策略时才生效，使得难以按需调整探索的侧重。

目的: 研究最佳采样方法在赋能中的应用，以实现更灵活的探索与利用困境调整。此外，提出了一种基于Tsalis统计学的扩展最佳采样方法，以便在保持计算成本的同时以可泛化的方式调整策略修改的程度。

方法: 通过玩具问题验证所提方法平衡探索与利用困境的能力，并展示了该方法在解决复杂运动任务中提升强化学习性能的效果。

主要发现: 该方法能够平衡探索与利用困境，并在解决复杂运动任务时提升了强化学习的性能。

结论: 通过将最佳采样技巧应用于探索促进项（如赋能），实现了对探索与利用困境的更灵活调整，且提出的扩展最佳采样方法在保持计算成本的同时实现了策略修改程度的可泛化调整。

翻译: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法，通过在强化学习中结合赋能来推理动作，从而实现探索与利用困境的灵活性。在先前的方法中，赋能作为内在动机强化学习的一部分被添加到特定任务的奖励函数中，但这会导致直到学习到考虑赋能的策略时才生效，使得难以按需调整探索的侧重。研究最佳采样方法在赋能中的应用，以实现更灵活的探索与利用困境调整。此外，提出了一种基于Tsalis统计学的扩展最佳采样方法，以便在保持计算成本的同时以可泛化的方式调整策略修改的程度。通过玩具问题验证所提方法平衡探索与利用困境的能力，并展示了该方法在解决复杂运动任务中提升强化学习性能的效果。

Abstract

This paper proposes a novel method that incorporates empowerment when reasoning actions in reinforcement learning (RL), thereby achieving the flexibility of exploration-exploitation dilemma (EED). In previous methods, empowerment for promoting exploration has been provided as a bonus term to the task-specific reward function as an intrinsically-motivated RL. However, this approach introduces a delay until the policy that accounts for empowerment is learned, making it difficult to adjust the emphasis on exploration as needed. On the other hand, a trick devised for fine-tuning recent foundation models at reasoning, so-called best-of-N (BoN) sampling, allows for the implicit acquisition of modified policies without explicitly learning them. It is expected that applying this trick to exploration-promoting terms, such as empowerment, will enable more flexible adjustment of EED. Therefore, this paper investigates BoN sampling for empowerment. Furthermore, to adjust the degree of policy modification in a generalizable manner while maintaining computational cost, this paper proposes a novel BoN sampling method extended by Tsalis statistics. Through toy problems, the proposed method's cability to balance EED is verified. In addition, it is demonstrated that the proposed method improves RL performance to solve complex locomotion tasks.

item.title: AdaVFM: Adaptive Vision Foundation Models for Edge Intelligence via LLM-Guided Execution
item.author: Yiwei Zhao, Yi Zheng, Huapeng Su, Jieyu Lin, Stefano Ambrogio, Cijo Jose, Michaël Ramamonjisoa, Patrick Labatut, Barbara De Salvo, Chiao Liu, Phillip B. Gibbons, Ziyun Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AdaVFM是一个自适应框架，用于在边缘设备上高效运行语言对齐的视觉基础模型，通过动态调整计算量来平衡性能和效率。

背景: 语言对齐的视觉基础模型（VFMs）在边缘设备上部署受到严格延迟和功耗限制的阻碍。

目的: 提出AdaVFM框架，以实现语言对齐VFMs在边缘设备上的高效推理，动态调整计算量。

方法: AdaVFM将神经架构搜索（NAS）集成到语言对齐VFMs骨干网中，以实现轻量级子网的运行时执行；并利用部署在云端的云端多模态大语言模型（LLM）通过上下文感知代理进行运行时控制。

主要发现: 在零样本分类和开放词汇分割任务中，AdaVFM实现了最先进的精度-效率权衡；在IN1K上acc@1比同类模型高7.9%，在ADE20K上mIoU高5.2%；对于相似精度的模型，平均FLOPs进一步降低高达77.9%。

结论: AdaVFM能够在多样化条件下实现高效模型适应，同时保持强精度。

翻译: 语言对齐的视觉基础模型（VFMs）使始终在线的上下文AI能够实现多功能的视觉理解，但它们在边缘设备上的部署受到严格的延迟和功耗限制的阻碍。我们提出了AdaVFM，这是一个用于语言对齐VFMs高效设备端推理的自适应框架，它根据场景上下文和任务复杂性动态调整计算量。我们的关键见解是，模型大小缩减对性能的影响在视觉应用中是任务依赖的，这激发了一种运行时自适应执行策略。AdaVFM将神经架构搜索（NAS）集成到语言对齐VFMs骨干网中，以实现运行时的轻量级子网执行。部署在云端的云端多模态大语言模型（LLM）利用上下文感知代理进行运行时控制。这种协同作用允许在多样化条件下实现高效模型适应，同时保持强精度。在零样本分类和开放词汇分割上的广泛实验表明，AdaVFM实现了最先进的精度-效率权衡，在IN1K上acc@1比同类模型的最佳模型高出7.9%，在ADE20K上mIoU高出5.2%。对于具有相似精度的模型，AdaVFM进一步将平均FLOPs降低了高达77.9%。

Abstract

Language-aligned vision foundation models (VFMs) enable versatile visual understanding for always-on contextual AI, but their deployment on edge devices is hindered by strict latency and power constraints. We present AdaVFM, an adaptive framework for efficient on-device inference of language-aligned VFMs that dynamically adjusts computation based on scene context and task complexity. Our key insight is that the effect of model size reduction on performance is task-dependent in vision applications, motivating a runtime-adaptive execution strategy. AdaVFM integrates neural architecture search (NAS) into the language-aligned VFM backbone to enable lightweight subnet execution during runtime. A multimodal large language model (LLM) deployed on the cloud enables runtime control with a context-aware agent. This synergy allows efficient model adaptation under diverse conditions while maintaining strong accuracy. Extensive experiments on zero-shot classification and open-vocabulary segmentation demonstrate that AdaVFM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency trade-offs, surpassing prior baselines by up to $7.9\%$ in acc@1 on IN1K and $5.2\%$ mIoU on ADE20K over the best models of comparable VFM sizes. For models with similar accuracy, AdaVFM further reduces average FLOPs by up to $77.9\%$.

item.title: Causal Bootstrapped Alignment for Unsupervised Video-Based Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
item.author: Shuang Li, Jiaxu Leng, Changjiang Kuang, Mingpi Tan, Yu Yuan, Xinbo Gao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种针对无监督视频视频行人重识别（USL-VVI-ReID）的因果引导对齐框架，旨在解决现有方法在扩展到无监督设置时性能不佳的问题。

背景: 现有的视频视频行人重识别方法严重依赖昂贵的跨模态标注的全监督学习，限制了其可扩展性。直接将基于图像的无监督方法扩展到视频轨迹设置时，由于预训练编码器存在弱身份判别性和强模态偏差，导致严重的模态内身份混淆和可见光与红外模态间聚类粒度不平衡。

目的: 研究无监督视频视频行人重识别（USL-VVI-ReID），学习直接来自未标记视频轨迹的身份判别性表示。

方法: 提出因果引导对齐（CBA）框架，包含两个主要组件：1. 因果干预预热（CIW），利用时间身份一致性和跨模态身份一致性进行序列级因果干预，抑制模态和运动引起的虚假相关性；2. 原型引导不确定性细化（PGUR），采用粗到细的对齐策略解决跨模态粒度不匹配，在可靠可见光原型的指导下重新组织红外表示。

主要发现: 在HITSZ-VCM和BUPTCampus基准测试上，CBA在扩展到USL-VVI-ReID设置时显著优于现有的USL-VI-ReID方法。

结论: CBA框架通过显式利用固有的视频先验，有效解决了无监督设置下的表示学习问题，显著提升了性能。

翻译: VVI-ReID是全天候监控中的关键技术，其中时序信息提供了超越静态图像的额外线索。然而，现有方法严重依赖昂贵的跨模态标注的全监督学习，限制了可扩展性。为了解决这个问题，我们研究了无监督VVI-ReID（USL-VVI-ReID），它直接从未标记的视频轨迹中学习身份判别性表示。直接将基于图像的无监督VVI-ReID方法扩展到这种设置会导致性能次优。此类编码器 suffer from weak identity discrimination and strong modality bias，导致严重的模态内身份混淆和可见光与红外模态间聚类粒度不平衡。这些问题共同降低了伪标签的可靠性并阻碍了有效的跨模态对齐。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一个因果引导对齐（CBA）框架，显式利用固有的视频先验。首先，我们引入因果干预预热（CIW），它通过利用时间身份一致性和跨模态身份一致性执行序列级因果干预，抑制模态和运动引起的虚假相关性，同时保留身份相关的语义，为无监督聚类产生更清洁的表示。其次，我们提出原型引导不确定性细化（PGUR），它采用粗到细的对齐策略来解决跨模态粒度不匹配，在可靠可见光原型的指导下重新组织不确定性感知监督下的红外表示。在HITSZ-VCM和BUPTCampus基准测试上的大量实验表明，当扩展到USL-VVI-ReID设置时，CBA显著优于现有的USL-VI-ReID方法。

Abstract

VVI-ReID is a critical technique for all-day surveillance, where temporal information provides additional cues beyond static images. However, existing approaches rely heavily on fully supervised learning with expensive cross-modality annotations, limiting scalability. To address this issue, we investigate Unsupervised Learning for VVI-ReID (USL-VVI-ReID), which learns identity-discriminative representations directly from unlabeled video tracklets. Directly extending image-based USL-VI-ReID methods to this setting with generic pretrained encoders leads to suboptimal performance. Such encoders suffer from weak identity discrimination and strong modality bias, resulting in severe intra-modality identity confusion and pronounced clustering granularity imbalance between visible and infrared modalities. These issues jointly degrade pseudo-label reliability and hinder effective cross-modality alignment. To address these challenges, we propose a Causal Bootstrapped Alignment (CBA) framework that explicitly exploits inherent video priors. First, we introduce Causal Intervention Warm-up (CIW), which performs sequence-level causal interventions by leveraging temporal identity consistency and cross-modality identity consistency to suppress modality- and motion-induced spurious correlations while preserving identity-relevant semantics, yielding cleaner representations for unsupervised clustering. Second, we propose Prototype-Guided Uncertainty Refinement (PGUR), which employs a coarse-to-fine alignment strategy to resolve cross-modality granularity mismatch, reorganizing under-clustered infrared representations under the guidance of reliable visible prototypes with uncertainty-aware supervision. Extensive experiments on the HITSZ-VCM and BUPTCampus benchmarks demonstrate that CBA significantly outperforms existing USL-VI-ReID methods when extended to the USL-VVI-ReID setting.

item.title: Graph self-supervised learning based on frequency corruption
item.author: Haojie Li, Mengjiao Zhang, Guanfeng Liu, Qiang Hu, Yan Wang, Junwei Du
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: FC-GSSL是一种基于频率破坏的图自监督学习方法，通过构建偏向高频信息的破坏图来提高表示质量和泛化能力。

背景: 现有图自监督学习方法往往低估高频信号，且容易过度拟合特定局部模式，限制了表示质量和泛化能力。

目的: 提出FC-GSSL方法，旨在通过破坏节点和边来构建偏向高频信息的破坏图，并利用自编码器融合多频带信息，从而提高模型性能和泛化能力。

方法: FC-GSSL方法构建破坏图作为自编码器输入，以低频和通用特征作为监督目标，设计多种采样策略生成多样化的破坏图，通过对齐不同视图的节点表示来发现有用的频率组合。

主要发现: 在14个数据集上的节点分类、图预测和迁移学习实验表明，FC-GSSL一致地提高了性能和泛化能力。

结论: FC-GSSL通过破坏图和视图对齐技术，有效减少了模型对特定高频组件的依赖，提高了鲁棒性。

翻译: Graph self-supervised learning can reduce the need for labeled graph data and has been widely used in recommendation, social networks, and other web applications. However, existing methods often underuse high-frequency signals and may overfit to specific local patterns, which limits representation quality and generalization. We propose Frequency-Corrupt Based Graph Self-Supervised Learning (FC-GSSL), a method that builds corrupted graphs biased toward high-frequency information by corrupting nodes and edges according to their low-frequency contributions. These corrupted graphs are used as inputs to an autoencoder, while low-frequency and general features are reconstructed as supervision targets, forcing the model to fuse information from multiple frequency bands. We further design multiple sampling strategies and generate diverse corrupted graphs from the intersections and unions of the sampling results. By aligning node representations from these views, the model can discover useful frequency combinations, reduce reliance on specific high-frequency components, and improve robustness. Experiments on 14 datasets across node classification, graph prediction, and transfer learning show that FC-GSSL consistently improves performance and generalization.

Abstract

Graph self-supervised learning can reduce the need for labeled graph data and has been widely used in recommendation, social networks, and other web applications. However, existing methods often underuse high-frequency signals and may overfit to specific local patterns, which limits representation quality and generalization. We propose Frequency-Corrupt Based Graph Self-Supervised Learning (FC-GSSL), a method that builds corrupted graphs biased toward high-frequency information by corrupting nodes and edges according to their low-frequency contributions. These corrupted graphs are used as inputs to an autoencoder, while low-frequency and general features are reconstructed as supervision targets, forcing the model to fuse information from multiple frequency bands. We further design multiple sampling strategies and generate diverse corrupted graphs from the intersections and unions of the sampling results. By aligning node representations from these views, the model can discover useful frequency combinations, reduce reliance on specific high-frequency components, and improve robustness. Experiments on 14 datasets across node classification, graph prediction, and transfer learning show that FC-GSSL consistently improves performance and generalization.

item.title: P3T: Prototypical Point-level Prompt Tuning with Enhanced Generalization for 3D Vision-Language Models
item.author: Geunyoung Jung, Soohong Kim, Kyungwoo Song, Jiyoung Jung
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种针对预训练3D视觉语言模型的参数高效提示微调方法，名为原型点级提示微调（P3T），旨在解决传统微调计算成本高和提示微调易过拟合的问题。

背景: 随着预训练模型在3D点云领域的广泛应用，将其适配到下游任务变得日益重要。然而，传统的全量微调方法计算成本高昂且存储需求大。虽然提示微调作为一种高效的替代方案出现，但它往往 suffers from overfitting（过拟合），从而损害了泛化能力。

目的: 为了解决上述问题，提出了一种参数高效的提示微调方法，专门设计用于预训练的3D视觉语言模型。

方法: 该方法包含两个组件：1) Point Prompter，生成对输入点云具有实例感知的点级提示；2) Text Prompter，在输入文本中使用可学习的提示而非手工制作的提示。此外，引入了原型损失以减少类内方差，从而增强嵌入空间的对齐。

主要发现: 广泛的实验表明，该方法在分类和少样本学习中匹配或优于全量微调，并且在跨数据集设置下的数据偏移中表现出鲁棒的泛化能力。

结论: P3T能够在不牺牲泛化能力的情况下，实现对3D VLMs的任务特定适配。

翻译: 随着预训练模型在3D点云领域的广泛应用，将它们适配到下游任务变得越来越重要。然而，传统的全量微调方法计算成本高昂且存储密集。虽然提示微调作为一种高效的替代方案出现，但它经常遭受过拟合，从而损害了泛化能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了原型点级提示微调，这是一种针对预训练3D视觉语言模型的参数高效提示微调方法。P3T由两个组件组成：1) Point Prompter，为输入点云生成实例感知的点级提示；2) Text Prompter，在输入文本中使用可学习的提示而不是手工制作的提示。由于两个提示器都直接在输入数据上操作，P3T使得3D VLMs的任务特定适配成为可能，而不会牺牲泛化能力。此外，为了增强嵌入空间对齐，这是微调3D VLMs的关键，我们引入了一种原型损失，以减少类内方差。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法在分类和少样本学习中匹配或优于全量微调，并且在跨数据集设置下的数据偏移中进一步表现出鲁棒的泛化能力。代码可在 https://github.com/gyjung975/P3T 获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决预训练的3D视觉语言模型在下游任务中适配效率低且容易过拟合的问题。现有的全量微调方法计算和存储成本过高，而传统的提示微调方法往往破坏了模型原有的泛化能力。这很重要，因为它在大幅减少参数量的同时，实现了模型的高效适配和跨数据集的强泛化性能。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对全微调计算成本高且现有提示微调易过拟合的问题，借鉴了输入空间提示和文本提示微调的思想。他们设计 P3T 方法，通过 Point Prompter 直接在输入点云上生成提示，以及 Text Prompter 在文本中引入可学习提示，从而在不修改模型内部参数的情况下实现任务适配，并利用原型损失增强嵌入空间对齐。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过参数高效的微调技术，在输入数据层面直接操作点云和文本，从而在不破坏模型内部参数的情况下，实现特定任务的适应并保持模型的泛化能力。整体实现流程包括：首先利用Point Prompter分析点云，选择关键区域并生成偏移量修改其位置，同时生成提示令牌以增强输入特征；其次利用Text Prompter将固定文本提示替换为可学习向量以适应任务；最后通过原型损失减少类别内方差，增强嵌入空间的对齐。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了P3T方法，包含点级提示器和文本提示器，直接在输入数据上操作以保持模型冻结；引入了原型损失以减少类别内方差，增强嵌入空间对齐；以及使用一致性约束防止文本提示过拟合。相比之前的工作，P3T避免了在模型内部插入参数（如IDPT和DAPT），从而不破坏预训练模型的对齐嵌入空间，同时支持3D视觉语言模型的多模态交互，实现了更强的泛化能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为 P3T 的参数高效微调方法，通过在输入端生成点级提示和文本提示，并引入原型损失来增强嵌入空间对齐，从而在不破坏模型泛化能力的前提下，在 3D 识别任务上达到了与全微调相当甚至更优的性能。

Abstract

With the rise of pre-trained models in the 3D point cloud domain for a wide range of real-world applications, adapting them to downstream tasks has become increasingly important. However, conventional full fine-tuning methods are computationally expensive and storage-intensive. Although prompt tuning has emerged as an efficient alternative, it often suffers from overfitting, thereby compromising generalization capability. To address this issue, we propose Prototypical Point-level Prompt Tuning (P$^3$T), a parameter-efficient prompt tuning method designed for pre-trained 3D vision-language models (VLMs). P$^3$T consists of two components: 1) \textit{Point Prompter}, which generates instance-aware point-level prompts for the input point cloud, and 2) \textit{Text Prompter}, which employs learnable prompts into the input text instead of hand-crafted ones. Since both prompters operate directly on input data, P$^3$T enables task-specific adaptation of 3D VLMs without sacrificing generalizability. Furthermore, to enhance embedding space alignment, which is key to fine-tuning 3D VLMs, we introduce a prototypical loss that reduces intra-category variance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method matches or outperforms full fine-tuning in classification and few-shot learning, and further exhibits robust generalization under data shift in the cross-dataset setting. The code is available at \textcolor{violet}{https://github.com/gyjung975/P3T}.

item.title: Intent Propagation Contrastive Collaborative Filtering
item.author: Haojie Li, Junwei Du, Guanfeng Liu, Feng Jiang, Yan Wang, Xiaofang Zhou
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 协作过滤中的解纠缠技术能揭示节点间的交互意图，提升节点表示的可解释性和推荐性能。

背景: 现有的解纠缠方法存在两个问题：一是仅关注直接节点交互产生的局部结构特征，忽视了全面的图结构；二是解纠缠过程依赖于推荐任务的反向传播信号，缺乏直接监督，可能导致偏差和过拟合。

目的: 提出一种意图传播对比协作过滤算法，以解决现有方法在解纠缠准确性和监督方面的不足。

方法: 设计了双螺旋消息传播框架以更有效地提取节点的深层语义信息；开发了意图消息传播方法，将图结构信息融入解纠缠过程；并采用对比学习技术对齐结构和意图节点表示，提供直接监督。

主要发现: 在三个真实数据图上的实验表明，该方法具有优越性。

结论: 该方法通过改进消息传播和引入对比学习，有效缓解了偏差和过拟合问题，提升了模型性能。

翻译: Disentanglement techniques used in collaborative filtering uncover interaction intents between nodes, improving the interpretability of node representations and enhancing recommendation performance. However, existing disentanglement methods still face two problems. First, they focus on local structural features derived from direct node interactions and overlook the comprehensive graph structure, which limits disentanglement accuracy. Second, the disentanglement process depends on backpropagation signals derived from recommendation tasks and lacks direct supervision, which may lead to biases and overfitting. To address these issues, we propose the Intent Propagation Contrastive Collaborative Filtering (IPCCF) algorithm. Specifically, we design a double helix message propagation framework to more effectively extract the deep semantic information of nodes, thereby improving the model's understanding of interactions between nodes. We also develop an intent message propagation method that incorporates graph structure information into the disentanglement process, thereby expanding the consideration scope of disentanglement. In addition, contrastive learning techniques are employed to align node representations derived from structure and intents, providing direct supervision for the disentanglement process, mitigating biases, and enhancing the model's robustness to overfitting. Experiments on three real data graphs illustrate the superiority of the proposed approach.

Abstract

Disentanglement techniques used in collaborative filtering uncover interaction intents between nodes, improving the interpretability of node representations and enhancing recommendation performance. However, existing disentanglement methods still face two problems. First, they focus on local structural features derived from direct node interactions and overlook the comprehensive graph structure, which limits disentanglement accuracy. Second, the disentanglement process depends on backpropagation signals derived from recommendation tasks and lacks direct supervision, which may lead to biases and overfitting. To address these issues, we propose the Intent Propagation Contrastive Collaborative Filtering (IPCCF) algorithm. Specifically, we design a double helix message propagation framework to more effectively extract the deep semantic information of nodes, thereby improving the model's understanding of interactions between nodes. We also develop an intent message propagation method that incorporates graph structure information into the disentanglement process, thereby expanding the consideration scope of disentanglement. In addition, contrastive learning techniques are employed to align node representations derived from structure and intents, providing direct supervision for the disentanglement process, mitigating biases, and enhancing the model's robustness to overfitting. Experiments on three real data graphs illustrate the superiority of the proposed approach.

item.title: APC: Transferable and Efficient Adversarial Point Counterattack for Robust 3D Point Cloud Recognition
item.author: Geunyoung Jung, Soohong Kim, Inseok Kong, Jiyoung Jung
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为对抗点反击（APC）的方法，旨在同时提升深度神经网络的鲁棒性和迁移性。

背景: 深度神经网络在3D点云识别中取得了显著进展，但仍然容易受到对抗性攻击的威胁。

目的: 解决现有防御方法在鲁棒性和迁移性之间存在的权衡问题，实现两者的同时提升。

方法: APC是一种轻量级的输入级净化模块，利用清洁-对抗对对数据空间和特征空间施加几何一致性和语义一致性约束，并采用混合训练策略提高对不同攻击类型的泛化能力。

主要发现: APC在两个3D识别基准测试中实现了最先进的防御性能，跨模型评估验证了其优越的迁移性，且在推理时仅增加极小的计算和参数开销。

结论: APC能够有效中和攻击，直接迁移到未见过的模型上，无需重新训练即可防御针对这些模型的攻击。

翻译: 深度神经网络的兴起推动了3D点云识别的显著进展，但它们仍然容易受到对抗性攻击。尽管已经研究了各种防御方法，但它们在鲁棒性和迁移性之间存在权衡。我们提出了对抗点反击（APC）来同时实现这两者。APC是一种轻量级的输入级净化模块，为每个点生成实例特定的反扰动，有效地中和攻击。利用清洁-对抗对，APC在数据空间中强制几何一致性，在特征空间中强制语义一致性。为了提高对不同攻击类型的泛化能力，我们采用了一种混合训练策略，使用来自多种攻击类型的对抗点云。由于APC纯粹在输入点云上操作，它直接迁移到未见过的模型上，并防御针对它们的攻击，而无需重新训练。在推理时，单次APC前向传播提供净化后的点云，几乎没有时间和参数开销。在两个3D识别基准测试上的广泛实验表明，APC实现了最先进的防御性能。此外，跨模型评估验证了其优越的迁移性。代码可在 https://github.com/gyjung975/APC 获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决深度神经网络在3D点云识别中容易受到对抗性攻击的问题，特别是现有防御方法在鲁棒性和可迁移性之间难以兼顾的困境。这很重要，因为3D点云数据被广泛应用于自动驾驶和机器人等安全关键领域，确保网络对这些攻击的鲁棒性对于可靠和安全部署这些技术至关重要。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有防御方法存在鲁棒性与可迁移性难以兼顾的权衡。为此，他们设计了一种轻量级的输入级净化模块，通过生成针对每个点的反扰动来中和攻击，并利用干净-对抗样本对进行训练。该方法借鉴了输入级防御（如随机采样）和模型级防御（如对抗训练）的思想，同时借鉴了 3D 点云去噪中的编码器-解码器架构，以及 IF-Defense 和 CausalPC 中的几何与语义一致性损失设计。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用输入级防御模块，通过生成特定的反扰动来中和对抗攻击，从而净化点云数据。整体实现流程包括：首先利用编码器-解码器架构，结合局部几何信息和全局形状信息生成反扰动；然后将这些反扰动点对点地加到对抗点云上，得到净化后的点云；训练过程中通过几何一致性损失和语义一致性损失来恢复原始数据。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了APC，这是一种轻量级的输入级防御模块，通过生成反扰动来中和攻击。它利用混合训练策略，使得单个模型能防御多种攻击。相比之前的工作，它解决了输入级防御鲁棒性弱和模型级防御不可转移的权衡问题，实现了同时兼顾两者。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为APC的轻量级输入级防御模块，通过生成反扰动来中和攻击，并利用混合训练策略实现了对未见攻击和模型的通用防御，在3D点云识别中达到了最先进的防御性能。

Abstract

The advent of deep neural networks has led to remarkable progress in 3D point cloud recognition, but they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Although various defense methods have been studied, they suffer from a trade-off between robustness and transferability. We propose Adversarial Point Counterattack (APC) to achieve both simultaneously. APC is a lightweight input-level purification module that generates instance-specific counter-perturbations for each point, effectively neutralizing attacks. Leveraging clean-adversarial pairs, APC enforces geometric consistency in data space and semantic consistency in feature space. To improve generalizability across diverse attacks, we adopt a hybrid training strategy using adversarial point clouds from multiple attack types. Since APC operates purely on input point clouds, it directly transfers to unseen models and defends against attacks targeting them without retraining. At inference, a single APC forward pass provides purified point clouds with negligible time and parameter overhead. Extensive experiments on two 3D recognition benchmarks demonstrate that the APC achieves state-of-the-art defense performance. Furthermore, cross-model evaluations validate its superior transferability. The code is available at https://github.com/gyjung975/APC.

item.title: SSMamba: A Self-Supervised Hybrid State Space Model for Pathological Image Classification
item.author: Enhui Chai, Sicheng Chen, Tianyi Zhang, Xingyu Li, Tianxiang Cui
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为SSMamba的混合自监督学习框架，用于病理图像分析，通过引入三个领域自适应组件来提升特征学习效果。

背景: 病理诊断高度依赖图像分析，感兴趣区域（ROIs）是诊断证据的主要基础，而全切片图像（WSI）级别的任务主要捕捉聚合模式。

目的: 解决基于Vision Transformers（ViTs）和大规模自监督学习（SSL）的ROI级基础模型在病理分析应用中的三个核心局限性：跨倍率域偏移、局部-全局关系建模不足以及细粒度敏感性不足。

方法: 提出SSMamba框架，包含三个领域自适应组件：用于缓解域偏移的Mamba Masked Image Modeling（MAMIM）、用于平衡局部-全局建模的Directional Multi-scale（DMS）模块、以及用于增强细粒度敏感性的Local Perception Residual（LPR）模块。采用两阶段流程：在目标ROI数据集上进行SSL预训练，随后进行监督微调（SFT）。

主要发现: 在10个公共ROI数据集上，SSMamba优于11个最先进（SOTA）的病理基础模型；在6个公共WSI数据集上，SSMamba超越了8个SOTA方法。

结论: 验证了针对病理图像分析的任务特定架构设计的优越性。

翻译: 病理诊断高度依赖图像分析，其中感兴趣区域（ROIs）作为诊断证据的主要基础，而全切片图像（WSI）级别的任务主要捕捉聚合模式。为了提取这些关键形态学特征，基于Vision Transformers（ViTs）和大规模自监督学习（SSL）的ROI级基础模型已被广泛采用。然而，它们在ROI分析应用中仍存在三个核心局限性：（1）跨倍率域偏移，固定尺度的预训练阻碍了适应多样化的临床环境；（2）局部-全局关系建模不足，其中FMs的ViT骨干网络计算开销高且局部表征不精确；（3）细粒度敏感性不足，传统的自注意力机制往往忽略细微的诊断线索。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了SSMamba，一个无需依赖大型外部数据集即可实现有效细粒度特征学习的混合SSL框架。该框架集成了三个领域自适应组件：用于缓解域偏移的Mamba Masked Image Modeling（MAMIM），用于平衡局部-全局建模的Directional Multi-scale（DMS）模块，以及用于增强细粒度敏感性的Local Perception Residual（LPR）模块。采用两阶段流程，即目标ROI数据集上的SSL预训练随后进行监督微调（SFT），SSMamba在10个公共ROI数据集上优于11个最先进的病理基础模型，并在6个公共WSI数据集上超越了8个SOTA方法。这些结果验证了针对病理图像分析的任务特定架构设计的优越性。

Abstract

Pathological diagnosis is highly reliant on image analysis, where Regions of Interest (ROIs) serve as the primary basis for diagnostic evidence, while whole-slide image (WSI)-level tasks primarily capture aggregated patterns. To extract these critical morphological features, ROI-level Foundation Models (FMs) based on Vision Transformers (ViTs) and large-scale self-supervised learning (SSL) have been widely adopted. However, three core limitations remain in their application to ROI analysis: (1) cross-magnification domain shift, as fixed-scale pretraining hinders adaptation to diverse clinical settings; (2) inadequate local-global relationship modeling, wherein the ViT backbone of FMs suffers from high computational overhead and imprecise local characterization; (3) insufficient fine-grained sensitivity, as traditional self-attention mechanisms tend to overlook subtle diagnostic cues. To address these challenges, we propose SSMamba, a hybrid SSL framework that enables effective fine-grained feature learning without relying on large external datasets. This framework incorporates three domain-adaptive components: Mamba Masked Image Modeling (MAMIM) for mitigating domain shift, a Directional Multi-scale (DMS) module for balanced local-global modeling, and a Local Perception Residual (LPR) module for enhanced fine-grained sensitivity. Employing a two-stage pipeline, SSL pretraining on target ROI datasets followed by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), SSMamba outperforms 11 state-of-the-art (SOTA) pathological FMs on 10 public ROI datasets and surpasses 8 SOTA methods on 6 public WSI datasets. These results validate the superiority of task-specific architectural designs for pathological image analysis.

item.title: GTA-2: Benchmarking General Tool Agents from Atomic Tool-Use to Open-Ended Workflows
item.author: Jize Wang, Xuanxuan Liu, Yining Li, Songyang Zhang, Yijun Wang, Zifei Shan, Xinyi Le, Cailian Chen, Xinping Guan, Dacheng Tao
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: GTA-2是一个用于评估通用工具代理的分层基准测试，包含原子工具使用和开放工作流任务，旨在解决当前基准测试与真实世界需求不匹配的问题。

背景: 当前的工具使用基准测试依赖于AI生成的查询、虚拟工具和有限的系统级协调，无法满足复杂、现实世界生产力工作流的需求。

目的: 提出GTA-2分层基准测试，评估通用工具代理在原子工具使用和开放工作流任务上的能力，以解决基准测试与真实世界需求不匹配的问题。

方法: GTA-2基于真实世界的真实性，利用真实用户查询、部署的工具和多模态上下文。它包含两个部分：GTA-Atomic（继承自先前的GTA基准，评估短期、封闭式工具使用精度）和GTA-Workflow（引入长期、开放式的任务用于现实世界的端到端完成）。此外，提出了一种基于递归检查点的评估机制，将目标分解为可验证的子目标。

主要发现: 实验揭示了显著的能力断层：前沿模型在原子任务上已经困难（低于50%），而在工作流上几乎完全失败，顶级模型仅达到14.39%的成功率。检查点引导的反馈提高了性能，而先进的执行框架（如Manus和OpenClaw）显著增强了工作流完成能力。

结论: 执行框架的设计比底层模型能力更重要，这些发现为开发可靠的个人和专业助手提供了指导。

翻译: 通用代理的发展需要从执行简单指令转向完成复杂、现实世界的生产力工作流。然而，当前的工具使用基准测试仍然与真实世界需求不匹配，依赖于AI生成的查询、虚拟工具和有限的系统级协调。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了GTA-2，这是一个用于通用工具代理的分层基准测试，涵盖原子工具使用和开放工作流。GTA-2建立在真实世界的真实性基础上，利用真实用户查询、部署的工具和多模态上下文。GTA-Atomic继承了先前的GTA基准，评估短期、封闭式的工具使用精度。GTA-Workflow引入了长期、开放式的任务，用于现实世界的端到端完成。为了评估开放式的交付成果，我们提出了一种基于递归检查点的评估机制，将目标分解为可验证的子目标，从而能够统一评估模型能力和代理执行框架（即执行框架）。实验揭示了显著的能力断层：前沿模型在原子任务上已经困难（低于50%），而在工作流上几乎完全失败，顶级模型仅达到14.39%的成功率。进一步的分析表明，检查点引导的反馈提高了性能，而先进的执行框架（如Manus和OpenClaw）显著增强了工作流完成能力，突出了执行框架设计的重要性，而不仅仅是底层模型能力。这些发现为开发可靠的个人和专业助手提供了指导。数据集和代码将在 https://github.com/open-compass/GTA 上提供。

Abstract

The development of general-purpose agents requires a shift from executing simple instructions to completing complex, real-world productivity workflows. However, current tool-use benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world requirements, relying on AI-generated queries, dummy tools, and limited system-level coordination. To address this, we propose GTA-2, a hierarchical benchmark for General Tool Agents (GTA) spanning atomic tool use and open-ended workflows. Built on real-world authenticity, it leverages real user queries, deployed tools, and multimodal contexts. (i) GTA-Atomic, inherited from our prior GTA benchmark, evaluates short-horizon, closed-ended tool-use precision. (ii) GTA-Workflow introduces long-horizon, open-ended tasks for realistic end-to-end completion. To evaluate open-ended deliverables, we propose a recursive checkpoint-based evaluation mechanism that decomposes objectives into verifiable sub-goals, enabling unified evaluation of both model capabilities and agent execution frameworks (i.e., execution harnesses). Experiments reveal a pronounced capability cliff: while frontier models already struggle on atomic tasks (below 50%), they largely fail on workflows, with top models achieving only 14.39% success. Further analysis shows that checkpoint-guided feedback improves performance, while advanced frameworks such as Manus and OpenClaw substantially enhance workflow completion, highlighting the importance of execution harness design beyond the underlying model capacity. These findings provide guidance for developing reliable personal and professional assistants. Dataset and code will be available at https://github.com/open-compass/GTA.

item.title: NeuroLip: An Event-driven Spatiotemporal Learning Framework for Cross-Scene Lip-Motion-based Visual Speaker Recognition
item.author: Junguang Yao, Wenye Liu, Stjepan Picek, Yue Zheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于事件相机的 NeuroLip 框架，用于在单次受控条件下训练，并在未见过的视角和光照条件下实现鲁棒的唇语识别。

背景: 基于唇语的视觉说话人识别提供了一种无声、免提且行为驱动的生物识别解决方案，即使在声学线索不可用时依然有效。与严重依赖外观表示的传统方法相比，唇语编码了受试者特定的行为动态，由一致的发音模式和肌肉协调驱动，具有跨环境变化的本征稳定性。然而，由于运动模糊和动态范围低，传统基于帧的相机难以捕捉这些稳健的细粒度动态。

目的: 为了利用唇语的内在稳定性并解决这些传感限制，提出 NeuroLip 框架，旨在在单次受控条件下训练，并在未见过的视角和光照条件下实现鲁棒的唇语识别。

方法: NeuroLip 框架包含三个主要组件：1) 时序感知体素编码模块，具有自适应事件加权；2) 结构感知空间增强器，通过抑制噪声同时保留垂直结构运动信息来放大判别性行为模式；3) 极性一致性正则化机制，以保留编码在事件极性中的运动方向线索。

主要发现: 引入了 DVSpeaker 数据集，包含 50 名受试者在四种不同视角和光照场景下记录的数据。实验表明，NeuroLip 在匹配场景下实现了近乎完美的准确率，并在未见过的视角下达到超过 71% 的准确率，在低光照条件下接近 76%，比代表性现有方法至少高出 8.54%。

结论: NeuroLip 框架在单次受控训练条件下实现了鲁棒的跨场景泛化能力，显著优于现有方法，证明了其在各种环境变化下的有效性。

翻译: 本文提出了一种基于事件相机的 NeuroLip 框架，用于在单次受控条件下训练，并在未见过的视角和光照条件下实现鲁棒的唇语识别。基于唇语的视觉说话人识别提供了一种无声、免提且行为驱动的生物识别解决方案，即使在声学线索不可用时依然有效。与严重依赖外观表示的传统方法相比，唇语编码了受试者特定的行为动态，由一致的发音模式和肌肉协调驱动，具有跨环境变化的本征稳定性。然而，由于运动模糊和动态范围低，传统基于帧的相机难以捕捉这些稳健的细粒度动态。为了利用唇语的内在稳定性并解决这些传感限制，提出 NeuroLip 框架，旨在在单次受控条件下训练，并在未见过的视角和光照条件下实现鲁棒的唇语识别。NeuroLip 框架包含三个主要组件：1) 时序感知体素编码模块，具有自适应事件加权；2) 结构感知空间增强器，通过抑制噪声同时保留垂直结构运动信息来放大判别性行为模式；3) 极性一致性正则化机制，以保留编码在事件极性中的运动方向线索。引入了 DVSpeaker 数据集，包含 50 名受试者在四种不同视角和光照场景下记录的数据。实验表明，NeuroLip 在匹配场景下实现了近乎完美的准确率，并在未见过的视角下达到超过 71% 的准确率，在低光照条件下接近 76%，比代表性现有方法至少高出 8.54%。NeuroLip 框架在单次受控训练条件下实现了鲁棒的跨场景泛化能力，显著优于现有方法，证明了其在各种环境变化下的有效性。

Abstract

Visual speaker recognition based on lip motion offers a silent, hands-free, and behavior-driven biometric solution that remains effective even when acoustic cues are unavailable. Compared to traditional methods that rely heavily on appearance-dependent representations, lip motion encodes subject-specific behavioral dynamics driven by consistent articulation patterns and muscle coordination, offering inherent stability across environmental changes. However, capturing these robust, fine-grained dynamics is challenging for conventional frame-based cameras due to motion blur and low dynamic range. To exploit the intrinsic stability of lip motion and address these sensing limitations, we propose NeuroLip, an event-based framework that captures fine-grained lip dynamics under a strict yet practical cross-scene protocol: training is performed under a single controlled condition, while recognition must generalize to unseen viewing and lighting conditions. NeuroLip features a 1) Temporal-aware Voxel Encoding module with adaptive event weighting, 2) Structure-aware Spatial Enhancer that amplifies discriminative behavioral patterns by suppressing noise while preserving vertically structured motion information, and 3) Polarity Consistency Regularization mechanism to retain motion-direction cues encoded in event polarities. To facilitate systematic evaluation, we introduce DVSpeaker, a comprehensive event-based lip-motion dataset comprising 50 subjects recorded under four distinct viewpoint and illumination scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeuroLip achieves near-perfect matched-scene accuracy and robust cross-scene generalization, attaining over 71% accuracy on unseen viewpoints and nearly 76% under low-light conditions, outperforming representative existing methods by at least 8.54%. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/JiuZeongit/NeuroLip.

item.title: RefereeBench: Are Video MLLMs Ready to be Multi-Sport Referees
item.author: Yichen Xu, Yuanhang Liu, Chuhan Wang, Zihan Zhao, jinghan luo, Jianzhe Ma, Wenxuan Wang, Qin Jin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: RefereeBench是一个用于评估多模态大语言模型作为自动体育裁判的大规模基准测试，包含11项运动、925个视频和6475个问答对，评估了5项核心裁判能力。

背景: 虽然多模态大语言模型在通用视频理解方面表现出色，但它们在支持专业化、基于规则的决策制定方面的能力仍探索不足。

目的: 介绍RefereeBench，这是第一个用于评估多模态大语言模型作为自动体育裁判的大规模基准测试。

方法: RefereeBench包含11项运动、925个视频和6475个问答对，评估了5项核心裁判能力：犯规存在性、犯规和罚球分类、犯规和罚球推理、实体感知和时间定位。基准测试完全由人工标注，确保基于真实裁判逻辑和多模态证据的高质量标注。

主要发现: 最先进的模型如Doubao-Seed-1.8和Gemini-3-Pro仅达到约60%的准确率，而最强的开源模型Qwen3-VL仅达到47%。分析显示，模型虽然经常能识别事件和涉及实体，但在规则应用和时间定位方面存在困难，并且经常在正常片段中过度犯规。

结论: 当前模型距离成为可靠的体育裁判还有很大差距，未来的多模态大语言模型需要更好地整合领域知识和多模态理解，以推进可信的AI辅助裁判和更广泛的多模态决策制定。

翻译: 虽然多模态大语言模型在通用视频理解方面表现出色，但它们在支持专业化、基于规则的决策制定方面的能力仍探索不足。本文介绍了RefereeBench，这是第一个用于评估多模态大语言模型作为自动体育裁判的大规模基准测试。该基准测试涵盖11项运动，包含925个精选视频和6475个问答对，评估了5项核心裁判能力：犯规存在性、犯规和罚球分类、犯规和罚球推理、实体感知和时间定位。该基准测试完全由人工标注，确保基于真实裁判逻辑和多模态证据的高质量标注。对最先进的多模态大语言模型的广泛评估显示，即使是像Doubao-Seed-1.8和Gemini-3-Pro这样的最强模型，也仅达到约60%的准确率，而最强的开源模型Qwen3-VL仅达到47%。这些结果表明，当前模型距离成为可靠的体育裁判还有很大差距。进一步分析显示，虽然模型经常能识别事件和涉及实体，但在规则应用和时间定位方面存在困难，并且经常在正常片段中过度犯规。我们的基准测试突出了未来多模态大语言模型更好地整合领域知识和多模态理解的需求，以推进可信的AI辅助裁判和更广泛的多模态决策制定。

Abstract

While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at generic video understanding, their ability to support specialized, rule-grounded decision-making remains insufficiently explored. In this paper, we introduce RefereeBench, the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating MLLMs as automatic sports referees. Spanning 11 sports with 925 curated videos and 6,475 QA pairs, RefereeBench evaluates five core officiating abilities: foul existence, foul and penalty classification, foul and penalty reasoning, entity perception, and temporal grounding. The benchmark is fully human-annotated to ensure high-quality annotations grounded in authentic officiating logic and multimodal evidence. Extensive evaluations of state-of-the-art MLLMs show that even the strongest models, such as Doubao-Seed-1.8 and Gemini-3-Pro, achieve only around 60% accuracy, while the strongest open-source model, Qwen3-VL, reaches only 47%. These results indicate that current models remain far from being reliable sports referees. Further analysis shows that while models can often identify incidents and involved entities, they struggle with rule application and temporal grounding, and frequently over-call fouls on normal clips. Our benchmark highlights the need for future MLLMs that better integrate domain knowledge and multimodal understanding, advancing trustworthy AI-assisted officiating and broader multimodal decision-making.

item.title: PLAF: Pixel-wise Language-Aligned Feature Extraction for Efficient 3D Scene Understanding
item.author: Junjie Wen, Junlin He, Fei Ma, Jinqiang Cui
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PLAF是一个像素级语言对齐特征提取框架，旨在实现高效的开放词汇3D场景理解。

背景: 现有的语义表示难以同时满足语言对齐、像素级空间精确性和可扩展性要求，且将像素级语义密集传播到3D空间会导致大量冗余，造成存储和查询效率低下。

目的: 提出PLAF框架，在2D域内实现密集且准确的语义对齐，同时保持开放词汇的表达能力；并设计高效的语义存储和查询方案，以减少2D和3D域中的冗余。

方法: 构建像素级语言对齐特征提取框架（PLAF），并在此基础上设计高效的语义存储和查询方案。

主要发现: 实验结果表明PLAF为准确且高效的开放词汇3D场景理解提供了强大的语义基础。

结论: PLAF通过解决语义表示的冗余问题，实现了高效的开放词汇3D场景理解。

翻译: PLAF是一个像素级语言对齐特征提取框架，旨在实现高效的开放词汇3D场景理解。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有方法在将像素级语言对齐特征提升到3D场景时，存在存储开销大、冗余高且查询效率低的问题。这在现实和研究中很重要，因为准确的开集词汇3D场景理解需要精细的语义和精确的几何对应关系，而传统的图像级或补丁级特征太粗糙，难以满足需求。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法难以同时满足像素级语义对齐和高效存储的需求，因此借鉴了2D基础模型（如DINOv2）和类无关掩码提取器（如SAM）来获取高质量特征。他们设计了一个两阶段框架：首先利用掩码引导聚合特征以获得像素级语言对齐；其次，为了解决存储冗余，他们借鉴了高效空间语义表示中的索引设计思路，将密集特征替换为紧凑的掩码索引和特征池，从而实现高效的三维映射。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用掩码引导的像素级对齐和紧凑的索引存储方案，在 2D 中实现高精度的语言对齐，同时大幅减少 3D 场景中的语义冗余，从而实现高效的开放词汇 3D 理解。整体实现流程分为两步：首先，通过视觉基础模型提取特征，并结合类无关掩码提取器生成掩码，将像素级特征聚合为区域一致的描述符；其次，将图像存储为索引掩码图和掩码特征表，并将这些掩码级描述符回投影到 3D 空间并融合多视图观测，最终构建引用少量语义描述符池的紧凑 3D 表示。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了PLAF框架，通过结合视觉基础模型和类无关掩码提取器，在2D中实现了像素级语言对齐，同时保持开放词汇表达能力。此外，引入了高效的语义存储和查询方案，利用掩码索引和引用设计，显著减少了多视图图像和3D空间中的冗余。相比之前工作，它解决了现有方法在像素级语义对齐上的不足，避免了存储每个像素的高维特征，而是使用紧凑的掩码级表示，从而实现了更精确且可扩展的3D场景理解。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文提出了PLAF框架，通过像素级语言对齐特征提取实现了高效的2D语义对齐，并设计了掩码索引的存储方案，显著减少了3D场景理解的冗余。

Abstract

Accurate open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding requires semantic representations that are both language-aligned and spatially precise at the pixel level, while remaining scalable when lifted to 3D space. However, existing representations struggle to jointly satisfy these requirements, and densely propagating pixel-wise semantics to 3D often results in substantial redundancy, leading to inefficient storage and querying in large-scale scenes. To address these challenges, we present \emph{PLAF}, a Pixel-wise Language-Aligned Feature extraction framework that enables dense and accurate semantic alignment in 2D without sacrificing open-vocabulary expressiveness. Building upon this representation, we further design an efficient semantic storage and querying scheme that significantly reduces redundancy across both 2D and 3D domains. Experimental results show that \emph{PLAF} provides a strong semantic foundation for accurate and efficient open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding. The codes are publicly available at https://github.com/RockWenJJ/PLAF.

item.title: Similarity-Based Bike Station Expansion via Hybrid Denoising Autoencoders
item.author: Oluwaleke Yusuf, M. Tsaqif Wismadi, Adil Rasheed
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究提出了一种基于现有站点数据驱动的框架，利用混合去噪自编码器学习压缩的潜在表示，并通过贪婪分配和空间约束选择扩展候选站点，旨在解决城市共享单车系统在数据受限环境下的站点扩展问题。

背景: 传统的站点分配方法依赖于显式的需求建模，可能无法捕捉区分成功站点的城市特征。本研究旨在利用现有站点的模式来指导扩展决策，特别是在数据受限的环境中。

目的: 开发一种数据驱动的框架，利用现有站点的运营指标来学习潜在表示，并基于潜在空间相似性选择扩展候选站点，以实现无需显式需求建模的证据驱动的扩展规划。

方法: 采用混合去噪自编码器（HDAE）从多源网格级特征（社会人口、建成环境和交通网络）中学习压缩的潜在表示，并使用监督分类头对嵌入空间结构进行正则化。扩展候选站点通过基于潜在空间相似性的贪婪分配和空间约束进行选择。

主要发现: 在特隆赫姆共享单车网络上的评估表明，HDAE嵌入比原始特征产生更空间连贯的聚类和分配模式。跨相似方法和距离指标的敏感性分析证实了其稳健性。基于共识的程序在多个参数化中得出32个高置信度的扩展区域。

结论: 表示学习能够捕捉原始特征无法发现的复杂模式，从而实现无需显式需求建模的证据驱动的扩展规划。共识程序通过要求跨参数化的同意来加强建议，而框架的可配置性允许规划者纳入运营知识。该方法适用于任何现有理想实例指导新候选选择的选址分配问题。

翻译: Urban bike-sharing systems require strategic station expansion to meet growing demand. Traditional allocation approaches rely on explicit demand modelling that may not capture the urban characteristics distinguishing successful stations. This study addresses the need to exploit patterns from existing stations to inform expansion decisions, particularly in data-constrained environments. We present a data-driven framework leveraging existing stations deemed desirable by operational metrics. A hybrid denoising autoencoder (HDAE) learns compressed latent representations from multi-source grid-level features (socio-demographic, built environment, and transport network), with a supervised classification head regularising the embedding space structure. Expansion candidates are selected via greedy allocation with spatial constraints based on latent-space similarity to existing stations. Evaluation on Trondheim's bike-sharing network demonstrates that HDAE embeddings yield more spatially coherent clusters and allocation patterns than raw features. Sensitivity analyses across similarity methods and distance metrics confirm robustness. A consensus-based procedure across multiple parametrisations distils 32 high-confidence extension zones where all parametrisations agree. The results demonstrate how representation learning captures complex patterns that raw features miss, enabling evidence-based expansion planning without explicit demand modelling. The consensus procedure strengthens recommendations by requiring agreement across parametrisations, while framework configurability allows planners to incorporate operational knowledge. The methodology generalises to any location-allocation problem where existing desirable instances inform the selection of new candidates.

Abstract

Urban bike-sharing systems require strategic station expansion to meet growing demand. Traditional allocation approaches rely on explicit demand modelling that may not capture the urban characteristics distinguishing successful stations. This study addresses the need to exploit patterns from existing stations to inform expansion decisions, particularly in data-constrained environments. We present a data-driven framework leveraging existing stations deemed desirable by operational metrics. A hybrid denoising autoencoder (HDAE) learns compressed latent representations from multi-source grid-level features (socio-demographic, built environment, and transport network), with a supervised classification head regularising the embedding space structure. Expansion candidates are selected via greedy allocation with spatial constraints based on latent-space similarity to existing stations. Evaluation on Trondheim's bike-sharing network demonstrates that HDAE embeddings yield more spatially coherent clusters and allocation patterns than raw features. Sensitivity analyses across similarity methods and distance metrics confirm robustness. A consensus-based procedure across multiple parametrisations distils 32 high-confidence extension zones where all parametrisations agree. The results demonstrate how representation learning captures complex patterns that raw features miss, enabling evidence-based expansion planning without explicit demand modelling. The consensus procedure strengthens recommendations by requiring agreement across parametrisations, while framework configurability allows planners to incorporate operational knowledge. The methodology generalises to any location-allocation problem where existing desirable instances inform the selection of new candidates.

item.title: Fed3D: Federated 3D Object Detection
item.author: Suyan Dai, Chenxi Liu, Fazeng Li, Peican Lin
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Fed3D的新型联邦3D目标检测框架，旨在在保护隐私的前提下实现分布式3D目标检测学习。

背景: 3D目标检测模型在自动驾驶、机器人操作和增强现实等场景中扮演重要角色。然而，现有的方法在多机器人感知网络中部署时面临严重的隐私问题，且由于3D数据异质性和有限的通信带宽，在3D目标检测场景中应用传统联邦学习方法极具挑战性。

目的: 本文首次尝试提出一种新的联邦3D目标检测框架Fed3D，以在保护隐私的同时实现3D目标检测的分布式学习。

方法: 针对局部机器人中不规则输入的3D目标和机器人间各类别分布差异导致的局部异质性和全局异质性，提出了局部-全局类别感知损失，以平衡不同3D类别的梯度反向传播速率。为了减少每轮通信成本，开发了联邦3D提示模块，仅学习并通信具有少量可学习参数的提示。

主要发现: 在联邦3D目标检测上的多项实验表明，与最先进的算法相比，Fed3D模型在提供有限的本地训练数据时，显著提高了性能且通信成本更低。

结论: Fed3D模型在保护隐私的同时，能够有效解决3D数据异质性问题，降低通信成本，并在性能上优于现有算法。

翻译: 本文提出了一种名为Fed3D的新型联邦3D目标检测框架，旨在在保护隐私的前提下实现分布式3D目标检测学习。3D目标检测模型在自动驾驶、机器人操作和增强现实等场景中扮演重要角色。然而，现有的方法在多机器人感知网络中部署时面临严重的隐私问题，且由于3D数据异质性和有限的通信带宽，在3D目标检测场景中应用传统联邦学习方法极具挑战性。本文首次尝试提出一种新的联邦3D目标检测框架Fed3D，以在保护隐私的同时实现3D目标检测的分布式学习。针对局部机器人中不规则输入的3D目标和机器人间各类别分布差异导致的局部异质性和全局异质性，提出了局部-全局类别感知损失，以平衡不同3D类别的梯度反向传播速率。为了减少每轮通信成本，开发了联邦3D提示模块，仅学习并通信具有少量可学习参数的提示。在联邦3D目标检测上的多项实验表明，与最先进的算法相比，Fed3D模型在提供有限的本地训练数据时，显著提高了性能且通信成本更低。Fed3D模型在保护隐私的同时，能够有效解决3D数据异质性问题，降低通信成本，并在性能上优于现有算法。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决在多机器人感知网络中，如何在不共享本地数据的情况下，高效训练 3D 物体检测模型的问题。具体包括应对 3D 数据的异质性和有限的通信带宽挑战。在现实应用中，自动驾驶、机器人和增强现实等场景需要 3D 检测技术，但直接收集数据会侵犯隐私。在研究中，3D 数据通常是不规则且稀疏的，直接套用现有的 2D 联邦学习方法会导致模型性能下降，且难以适应边缘设备有限的通信带宽。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对多机器人网络中隐私保护与通信受限的挑战，借鉴了联邦学习中的FedAvg等基础方法以及3D检测中的PiMAE网络结构。他们设计了局部-全局类别感知损失来平衡数据不平衡，并引入了联邦3D提示模块来减少通信开销。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法旨在解决多机器人网络中 3D 目标检测的隐私和数据异构性问题。它通过引入一种“本地-全局类别感知损失”来平衡不同类别梯度的反向传播，并利用“联邦 3D 提示模块”仅传输少量参数，从而在保护隐私的同时降低通信成本。整体流程包括：服务器初始化全局提示池；每轮通信中，服务器选择部分机器人，机器人利用本地数据和全局提示进行训练，并更新本地提示池；机器人将本地提示池上传至服务器；服务器聚合所有本地提示池得到全局提示池，并分发回机器人，循环直至模型收敛。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文提出了首个联邦 3D 对象检测框架 Fed3D。其关键创新点包括：一是引入局部-全局类别感知损失，通过平衡不同类别梯度的反向传播速率来解决 3D 数据的异质性问题；二是开发联邦 3D 提示模块，仅传输少量参数以降低通信成本。相比之前的工作，它首次将联邦学习应用于 3D 场景，解决了传统 3D 检测方法无法处理多机器人隐私保护和通信带宽限制的问题。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为Fed3D的联邦3D目标检测框架，通过引入局部-全局类别感知损失来解决数据异质性问题，并利用提示学习模块降低通信成本以保护隐私。

Abstract

3D object detection models trained in one server plays an important role in autonomous driving, robotics manipulation, and augmented reality scenarios. However, most existing methods face severe privacy concern when deployed on a multi-robot perception network to explore large-scale 3D scene. Meanwhile, it is highly challenging to employ conventional federated learning methods on 3D object detection scenes, due to the 3D data heterogeneity and limited communication bandwidth. In this paper, we take the first attempt to propose a novel Federated 3D object detection framework (i.e., Fed3D), to enable distributed learning for 3D object detection with privacy preservation. Specifically, considering the irregular input 3D object in local robot and various category distribution between robots could cause local heterogeneity and global heterogeneity, respectively. We then propose a local-global class-aware loss for the 3D data heterogeneity issue, which could balance gradient back-propagation rate of different 3D categories from local and global aspects. To reduce communication cost on each round, we develop a federated 3D prompt module, which could only learn and communicate the prompts with few learnable parameters. To the end, several extensive experiments on federated 3D object detection show that our Fed3D model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms with lower communication cost when providing the limited local training data.

item.title: Qwen3.5-Omni Technical Report
item.author: Qwen Team
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Qwen3.5-Omni 是 Qwen-Omni 模型家族的最新进展，是一个参数规模达数百亿、支持 256k 上下文长度的多模态模型。

背景: Qwen3.5-Omni 是在 Qwen-Omni 模型家族基础上的重大进化，旨在提升多模态能力。

目的: 构建一个强大的多模态模型，支持文本、视觉和音频的全面理解与交互，并解决流式语音合成中的不稳定和不自然问题。

方法: 采用了混合注意力混合专家框架，利用包含异构文本-视觉对和超过 1 亿小时音频-视觉内容的大规模数据集进行训练。此外，引入了 ARIA 模块来动态对齐文本和语音单元。

主要发现: Qwen3.5-Omni-plus 在 215 个音频和音频-视觉理解、推理及交互子任务中达到 SOTA 结果；支持 10 种语言的理解和生成；具备音频-视觉 Vibe Coding 新能力；在流式语音合成稳定性上显著提升。

结论: 该模型在多模态任务中表现卓越，超越了 Gemini-3.1 Pro 在关键音频任务上的表现，并实现了高精度的音频-视觉定位和结构化字幕生成。

翻译: 在这项工作中，我们介绍了 Qwen3.5-Omni，这是 Qwen-Omni 模型家族的最新进展。代表了对前身的重大进化，Qwen3.5-Omni 规模扩展到数百亿参数并支持 256k 上下文长度。通过利用包含异构文本-视觉对和超过 1 亿小时音频-视觉内容的大规模数据集，该模型展示了强大的多模态能力。Qwen3.5-Omni-plus 在 215 个音频和音频-视觉理解、推理及交互子任务及基准测试中达到 SOTA 结果，在关键音频任务上超越了 Gemini-3.1 Pro，并在全面的音频-视觉理解上与其持平。在架构上，Qwen3.5-Omni 在 Thinker 和 Talker 中采用了混合注意力混合专家框架，以实现高效的长序列推理。该模型支持复杂的交互，包括超过 10 小时的音频理解和 400 秒的 720P 视频（1 FPS）。为了解决流式语音合成中固有的不稳定和不自然问题，这通常是由文本和语音分词器之间的编码效率差异引起的，我们引入了 ARIA。ARIA 动态对齐文本和语音单元，显著增强了对话语音的稳定性和韵律，同时最小化了对延迟的影响。此外，Qwen3.5-Omni 扩展了语言边界，支持 10 种语言的理解和具有类人情感细微差别的语音生成。最后，Qwen3.5-Omni 展现了卓越的音频-视觉定位能力，生成具有精确时间同步和自动场景分割的脚本级结构化字幕。值得注意的是，我们在多模态模型中观察到了一种新能力的出现：直接根据音频-视觉指令执行编码，我们称之为音频-视觉 Vibe Coding。

Abstract

In this work, we present Qwen3.5-Omni, the latest advancement in the Qwen-Omni model family. Representing a significant evolution over its predecessor, Qwen3.5-Omni scales to hundreds of billions of parameters and supports a 256k context length. By leveraging a massive dataset comprising heterogeneous text-vision pairs and over 100 million hours of audio-visual content, the model demonstrates robust omni-modality capabilities. Qwen3.5-Omni-plus achieves SOTA results across 215 audio and audio-visual understanding, reasoning, and interaction subtasks and benchmarks, surpassing Gemini-3.1 Pro in key audio tasks and matching it in comprehensive audio-visual understanding. Architecturally, Qwen3.5-Omni employs a Hybrid Attention Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework for both Thinker and Talker, enabling efficient long-sequence inference. The model facilitates sophisticated interaction, supporting over 10 hours of audio understanding and 400 seconds of 720P video (at 1 FPS). To address the inherent instability and unnaturalness in streaming speech synthesis, often caused by encoding efficiency discrepancies between text and speech tokenizers, we introduce ARIA. ARIA dynamically aligns text and speech units, significantly enhancing the stability and prosody of conversational speech with minimal latency impact. Furthermore, Qwen3.5-Omni expands linguistic boundaries, supporting multilingual understanding and speech generation across 10 languages with human-like emotional nuance. Finally, Qwen3.5-Omni exhibits superior audio-visual grounding capabilities, generating script-level structured captions with precise temporal synchronization and automated scene segmentation. Remarkably, we observed the emergence of a new capability in omnimodal models: directly performing coding based on audio-visual instructions, which we call Audio-Visual Vibe Coding.

item.title: Breaking the Training Barrier of Billion-Parameter Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
item.author: Yuanchang Zhou, Hongyu Wang, Yiming Du, Yan Wang, Mingzhen Li, Siyu Hu, Xiangyu Zhang, Weijian Liu, Chen Wang, Zhuoqiang Guo, Long Wang, Jingde Bu, Yutong Lu, Guangming Tan, Weile Jia
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为MatRIS-MoE的混合专家模型和Janus分布式训练框架，用于加速训练具有十亿参数的通用机器学习原子势模型。

背景: 通用机器学习原子势模型在训练时需要计算二阶导数，缺乏相应的并行训练框架；且随着模型参数规模增长至十亿级，计算和通信开销急剧增加，训练面临巨大挑战。

目的: 解决通用机器学习原子势模型训练中的计算和通信开销问题，实现十亿参数模型的快速训练。

方法: 构建了基于不变架构的十亿参数混合专家模型MatRIS-MoE，并开发了具有硬件感知优化的高维分布式训练框架Janus。

主要发现: 该代码在两个百亿亿次级超级计算机上运行，在单精度下达到超过90%的并行效率，峰值性能为1.2/1.0 EFLOPS（24%/35.5%的理论峰值），将十亿参数通用机器学习原子势模型的训练时间从数周缩短至数小时。

结论: 这项工作在百亿亿次级计算规模下确立了AI for Science基础模型的新高水位线，并为快速科学发现提供了必要的基础设施。

翻译: 本文介绍了一种名为MatRIS-MoE的混合专家模型和Janus分布式训练框架，用于加速训练具有十亿参数的通用机器学习原子势模型。

Abstract

Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials (uMLIPs), pre-trained on massively diverse datasets encompassing inorganic materials and organic molecules across the entire periodic table, serve as foundational models for quantum-accurate physical simulations. However, uMLIP training requires second-order derivatives, which lack corresponding parallel training frameworks; moreover, scaling to the billion-parameter regime causes explosive growth in computation and communication overhead, making its training a tremendous challenge. We introduce MatRIS-MoE, a billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model built upon invariant architecture, and {Janus}, a pioneering high-dimensional distributed training framework for uMLIPs with hardware-aware optimizations. Deployed across two Exascale supercomputers, our code attains a peak performance of 1.2/1.0 EFLOPS (24\%/{35.5\%} of theoretical peak) in single precision at over 90\% parallel efficiency, compressing the training of billion-parameter uMLIPs from weeks to hours. This work establishes a new high-water mark for AI-for-Science (AI4S) foundation models at Exascale and provides essential infrastructure for rapid scientific discovery.

item.title: SSFT: A Lightweight Spectral-Spatial Fusion Transformer for Generic Hyperspectral Classification
item.author: Alexander Musiat, Nikolas Ebert, Oliver Wasenmüller
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种轻量级的光谱-空间融合Transformer（SSFT），通过分解光谱和空间路径并利用交叉注意力进行集成，在多个数据集上实现了最先进的性能，且参数量极低。

背景: 高光谱成像虽然能通过丰富的光谱特征实现材料识别，但面临高维性、光谱冗余、有限标记数据和强域偏移等挑战。此外，除了地球观测外，高光谱数据的标记通常稀缺且不平衡。

目的: 为了在多样化的获取条件下实现通用高光谱分类，提出紧凑的模型。

方法: 提出轻量级光谱-空间融合Transformer（SSFT），将表示学习分解为光谱和空间路径，并通过交叉注意力将它们集成以捕获互补的波长依赖性和结构信息。

主要发现: SSFT在HSI-Benchmark上实现了最先进的整体性能，排名第一，且使用的参数量不到之前领先方法的2%。在SpectralEarth基准测试中，尽管模型紧凑，SSFT仍保持竞争力。消融研究显示光谱和空间路径都至关重要，其中空间建模贡献最大，且SSFT在没有数据增强的情况下仍保持鲁棒性。

结论: SSFT是一种高效且鲁棒的高光谱分类方法，能够在参数量极少的情况下实现高性能。

翻译: Hyperspectral imaging enables fine-grained recognition of materials by capturing rich spectral signatures, but learning robust classifiers is challenging due to high dimensionality, spectral redundancy, limited labeled data, and strong domain shifts. Beyond earth observation, labeled HSI data is often scarce and imbalanced, motivating compact models for generic hyperspectral classification across diverse acquisition regimes. We propose the lightweight Spectral-Spatial Fusion Transformer (SSFT), which factorizes representation learning into spectral and spatial pathways and integrates them via cross-attention to capture complementary wavelength-dependent and structural information. We evaluate our SSFT on the challenging HSI-Benchmark, a heterogeneous multi-dataset benchmark covering earth observation, fruit condition assessment, and fine-grained material recognition. SSFT achieves state-of-the-art overall performance, ranking first while using less than 2% of the parameters of the previous leading method. We further evaluate transfer to the substantially larger SpectralEarth benchmark under the official protocol, where SSFT remains competitive despite its compact size. Ablation studies show that both spectral and spatial pathways are crucial, with spatial modeling contributing most, and that SSFT remains robust without data augmentation.

Abstract

Hyperspectral imaging enables fine-grained recognition of materials by capturing rich spectral signatures, but learning robust classifiers is challenging due to high dimensionality, spectral redundancy, limited labeled data, and strong domain shifts. Beyond earth observation, labeled HSI data is often scarce and imbalanced, motivating compact models for generic hyperspectral classification across diverse acquisition regimes. We propose the lightweight Spectral-Spatial Fusion Transformer (SSFT), which factorizes representation learning into spectral and spatial pathways and integrates them via cross-attention to capture complementary wavelength-dependent and structural information. We evaluate our SSFT on the challenging HSI-Benchmark, a heterogeneous multi-dataset benchmark covering earth observation, fruit condition assessment, and fine-grained material recognition. SSFT achieves state-of-the-art overall performance, ranking first while using less than 2% of the parameters of the previous leading method. We further evaluate transfer to the substantially larger SpectralEarth benchmark under the official protocol, where SSFT remains competitive despite its compact size. Ablation studies show that both spectral and spatial pathways are crucial, with spatial modeling contributing most, and that SSFT remains robust without data augmentation.

item.title: Beyond Text Prompts: Precise Concept Erasure through Text-Image Collaboration
item.author: Jun Li, Lizhi Xiong, Ziqiang Li, Weiwei Jiang, Zhangjie Fu, Yong Li, Guo-Sen Xie
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TICoE 是一种文本-图像协作擦除框架，通过连续凸概念流形和分层视觉表示学习实现精确且忠实的目标概念移除，同时保持无关语义和视觉内容，并在多个基准测试中超越先前方法，实现更安全、更可控的文本到图像生成。

背景: 文本到图像生成模型虽然具有高保真度和多样性，但由于大规模训练数据集中嵌入的隐含偏见，可能会意外产生不安全或不受欢迎的内容。

目的: 提出 TICoE 框架，以解决现有概念擦除方法（无论是仅文本还是图像辅助）面临的权衡问题，即文本方法往往无法完全抑制概念，而简单的图像引导方法有过度擦除无关内容的风险。

方法: TICoE 采用文本-图像协作擦除框架，利用连续凸概念流形和分层视觉表示学习来实现精确且忠实的目标概念移除。

主要发现: TICoE 在多个基准测试中超越了先前方法，在概念移除精度和内容保真度方面表现更佳，并引入了一种以保真度为导向的评估策略来衡量擦除后的可用性。

结论: TICoE 能够精确移除目标概念同时保留无关语义和视觉内容，实现了更安全、更可控的文本到图像生成。

翻译: Text-to-image generative models have achieved impressive fidelity and diversity, but can inadvertently produce unsafe or undesirable content due to implicit biases embedded in large-scale training datasets. Existing concept erasure methods, whether text-only or image-assisted, face trade-offs: textual approaches often fail to fully suppress concepts, while naive image-guided methods risk over-erasing unrelated content. We propose TICoE, a text-image Collaborative Erasing framework that achieves precise and faithful concept removal through a continuous convex concept manifold and hierarchical visual representation learning. TICoE precisely removes target concepts while preserving unrelated semantic and visual content. To objectively assess the quality of erasure, we further introduce a fidelity-oriented evaluation strategy that measures post-erasure usability. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that TICoE surpasses prior methods in concept removal precision and content fidelity, enabling safer, more controllable text-to-image generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenAscent-L/TICoE.git

Abstract

Text-to-image generative models have achieved impressive fidelity and diversity, but can inadvertently produce unsafe or undesirable content due to implicit biases embedded in large-scale training datasets. Existing concept erasure methods, whether text-only or image-assisted, face trade-offs: textual approaches often fail to fully suppress concepts, while naive image-guided methods risk over-erasing unrelated content. We propose TICoE, a text-image Collaborative Erasing framework that achieves precise and faithful concept removal through a continuous convex concept manifold and hierarchical visual representation learning. TICoE precisely removes target concepts while preserving unrelated semantic and visual content. To objectively assess the quality of erasure, we further introduce a fidelity-oriented evaluation strategy that measures post-erasure usability. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that TICoE surpasses prior methods in concept removal precision and content fidelity, enabling safer, more controllable text-to-image generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/OpenAscent-L/TICoE.git

item.title: Hierarchical Codec Diffusion for Video-to-Speech Generation
item.author: Jiaxin Ye, Gaoxiang Cong, Chenhui Wang, Xin-Cheng Wen, Zhaoyang Li, Boyuan Cao, Hongming Shan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: HiCoDiT是一种基于RVQ编解码器的分层Codec Diffusion Transformer，用于从无声视频中合成语音。

背景: 现有的视频转语音方法忽略了语音的层级结构，阻碍了视觉和语音特征在特定层级上的直接对齐。

目的: 利用RVQ编解码器的层级结构，提出HiCoDiT以实现更强的视听对齐。

方法: HiCoDiT使用低层和高层块生成不同层级的离散语音令牌。低层块以唇部同步运动和面部身份为条件以捕获说话人感知内容，高层块使用面部表情来调节韵律动态。此外，提出了双尺度自适应实例层归一化，通过通道归一化捕获全局声音风格，通过时间归一化捕获局部韵律动态。

主要发现: 实验表明，HiCoDiT在保真度和表现力方面优于基线模型。

结论: 离散建模在视频转语音中具有潜力。

翻译: Video-to-Speech (VTS) 生成旨在从无声视频中合成语音。然而，现有的 VTS 方法忽略了语音的层级结构，该结构从粗粒度的说话人感知语义到细粒度的韵律细节。这种疏忽阻碍了在属性匹配期间视觉和语音特征在特定层级上的直接对齐。在本文中，利用基于残差向量量化 (RVQ) 的编解码器的层级结构，我们提出了 HiCoDiT，一种新颖的分层 Codec Diffusion Transformer，它利用离散语音令牌的固有层级结构来实现强大的视听对齐。具体来说，由于低层令牌编码粗粒度的说话人感知语义，而高层令牌捕获细粒度的韵律，HiCoDiT 采用低层和高层块来生成不同层级的令牌。低层块以唇部同步运动和面部身份为条件以捕获说话人感知内容，而高层块使用面部表情来调节韵律动态。最后，为了实现更有效的粗到细条件化，我们提出了双尺度自适应实例层归一化，它通过通道归一化捕获全局声音风格，并通过时间归一化捕获局部韵律动态。广泛的实验表明，HiCoDiT 在保真度和表现力方面优于基线模型，突出了离散建模在 VTS 中的潜力。代码和语音演示均可从 https://github.com/Jiaxin-Ye/HiCoDiT 获取。

Abstract

Video-to-Speech (VTS) generation aims to synthesize speech from a silent video without auditory signals. However, existing VTS methods disregard the hierarchical nature of speech, which spans coarse speaker-aware semantics to fine-grained prosodic details. This oversight hinders direct alignment between visual and speech features at specific hierarchical levels during property matching. In this paper, leveraging the hierarchical structure of Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ)-based codec, we propose HiCoDiT, a novel Hierarchical Codec Diffusion Transformer that exploits the inherent hierarchy of discrete speech tokens to achieve strong audio-visual alignment. Specifically, since lower-level tokens encode coarse speaker-aware semantics and higher-level tokens capture fine-grained prosody, HiCoDiT employs low-level and high-level blocks to generate tokens at different levels. The low-level blocks condition on lip-synchronized motion and facial identity to capture speaker-aware content, while the high-level blocks use facial expression to modulate prosodic dynamics. Finally, to enable more effective coarse-to-fine conditioning, we propose a dual-scale adaptive instance layer normalization that jointly captures global vocal style through channel-wise normalization and local prosody dynamics through temporal-wise normalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HiCoDiT outperforms baselines in fidelity and expressiveness, highlighting the potential of discrete modelling for VTS. The code and speech demo are both available at https://github.com/Jiaxin-Ye/HiCoDiT.

item.title: Federated Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for Interference Mitigation at the Wireless Edge
item.author: Evar Jones, Daniel J. Jakubisin, Sanmay Das
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于参数高效微调的低秩适应方法，用于解决分布式基站中的干扰抑制问题，通过联邦学习在保持模型性能的同时减少通信开销。

背景: 密集无线部署面临来自不同基站的同频干扰，集中式基于深度神经网络的方法虽然性能良好，但在分布式基站间部署和适应需要传输完整模型更新，导致通信成本随网络密度增加而急剧上升。

目的: 将参数高效微调技术应用于时序卷积神经网络架构以抑制干扰，通过联邦学习在分布式基站间共享知识，同时减少通信负担。

方法: 将低秩适应方法适配到时序卷积神经网络架构，在膨胀卷积层上放置低秩适配器，冻结骨干网络以保留共享信号提取能力，并通过联邦平均协议进行联邦学习。

主要发现: 轻量级适配器仅占骨干网络参数的5.1%，相比联邦完整模型更新，每轮通信减少高达20倍；在非独立同分布干扰环境中，本地LoRA相比冻结骨干网络平均改善误码率12.8%，联邦LoRA性能相当；在数据稀缺节点上，联邦LoRA优于本地适应，且避免了全模型联邦平均在异质条件下的灾难性退化。

结论: 提出的Fed-LoRA方法在保持高性能的同时显著降低了通信成本，特别是在数据稀缺节点上优于本地适应，且避免了全模型联邦平均的退化问题。

翻译: 密集无线部署面临来自不同基站的同频干扰，这些干扰源随基站而异。虽然基于集中式深度神经网络的方法在干扰缓解方面表现出色，但通过联邦学习在分布式基站间部署和适应这些模型需要每轮传输完整的模型更新，导致成本随网络密度扩展而表现不佳。参数高效微调通过仅训练和通信一小部分参数来减轻这一负担。虽然传统上应用于大型基础模型，我们将低秩适应方法适配到时序卷积神经网络架构以抑制干扰，在膨胀卷积层上放置低秩适配器。这种放置使LoRA能够学习局部的、干扰特定的时序模式，而冻结的骨干网络保留了共享的信号提取能力。这些轻量级适配器（占骨干网络参数的5.1%）通过FedAvg进行联邦学习，相比联邦完整模型更新，每轮通信减少高达20倍。我们在具有非独立同分布干扰环境的模拟分布式基站上评估了各种PEFT策略。结果显示，本地LoRA相比冻结骨干网络平均改善误码率12.8%，而联邦LoRA达到相当的性能（12.6%）。联邦LoRA在数据稀缺节点上优于本地适应，因为联邦知识转移弥补了样本的有限，同时避免了全模型联邦平均在异质条件下的灾难性退化。

Abstract

Dense wireless deployments face co-channel interference from heterogeneous sources that vary across base stations (gNBs in 5G). While centralized DNN-based approaches to interference mitigation have shown strong performance, deploying and adapting these models across distributed gNBs via federated learning (FL) requires transmitting full model updates each round, resulting in a cost that scales poorly with network density. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reduces this burden by training and communicating only a small fraction of parameters. While traditionally applied to large foundation models, we adapt Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to temporal convolutional neural network architectures for interference suppression, placing low-rank adapters on the dilated convolutional layers. This placement enables LoRA to learn local interference-specific temporal patterns, while the frozen backbone retains the shared signal extraction capability. These lightweight adapters (5.1\% of backbone parameters) are federated via FedAvg, reducing per-round communication by up to 20$\times$ compared to federating full model updates. We evaluate various PEFT strategies across simulated distributed gNBs with non-IID interference environments. Results show that local LoRA achieves 12.8\% average BER improvement over the frozen backbone, while Fed-LoRA achieves comparable performance (12.6\%). Fed-LoRA outperforms local adaptation on data-starved nodes where federated knowledge transfer compensates for limited samples, all while avoiding the catastrophic degradation observed with full-model FedAvg under heterogeneous conditions.

item.title: SENSE: Stereo OpEN Vocabulary SEmantic Segmentation
item.author: Thomas Campagnolo, Ezio Malis, Philippe Martinet, Gaétan Bahl
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为SENSE的新方法，用于开放词汇语义分割，通过结合立体视觉和视觉语言模型来提高分割精度。

背景: 现有的开放词汇语义分割方法通常依赖单视图图像，在空间精度上存在困难，特别是在遮挡和物体边界附近。

目的: 提出SENSE，这是首个立体开放词汇语义分割工作，利用立体视觉和视觉语言模型来增强开放词汇语义分割。

方法: 通过引入立体图像对，利用几何线索来提高空间推理和分割精度，在PhraseStereo数据集上训练。

主要发现: 在PhraseStereo数据集上，相比基线方法平均精度提高了2.9%，相比最佳竞争方法提高了0.76%；在Cityscapes上相对基线工作提高了3.5% mIoU，在KITTI上提高了18%。

结论: 通过联合推理语义和几何，SENSE支持从自然语言进行准确场景理解，对自主机器人和智能交通系统至关重要。

翻译: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation enables models to segment objects or image regions beyond fixed class sets, offering flexibility in dynamic environments. However, existing methods often rely on single-view images and struggle with spatial precision, especially under occlusions and near object boundaries. We propose SENSE, the first work on Stereo OpEN Vocabulary SEmantic Segmentation, which leverages stereo vision and vision-language models to enhance open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. By incorporating stereo image pairs, we introduce geometric cues that improve spatial reasoning and segmentation accuracy. Trained on the PhraseStereo dataset, our approach achieves strong performance in phrase-grounded tasks and demonstrates generalization in zero-shot settings. On PhraseStereo, we show a +2.9% improvement in Average Precision over the baseline method and +0.76% over the best competing method. SENSE also provides a relative improvement of +3.5% mIoU on Cityscapes and +18% on KITTI compared to the baseline work. By jointly reasoning over semantics and geometry, SENSE supports accurate scene understanding from natural language, essential for autonomous robots and Intelligent Transportation Systems.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决现有开放词汇语义分割方法仅依赖单视图图像，导致在遮挡和物体边界附近空间精度不足的问题。引入立体视觉能提供几何线索，提升空间推理能力，这对自主机器人和智能交通系统理解自然语言描述的场景至关重要，能实现更精准的场景理解。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法依赖单视图图像，缺乏空间粒度，忽略了立体视觉中的几何线索。因此设计了 SENSE，利用立体视觉和视觉-语言模型增强开放词汇语义分割。设计上借鉴了 CLIPSeg 框架，并利用了 CLIP 的特征。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法利用立体视觉和视觉语言模型，通过引入几何线索来增强开放词汇语义分割，从而提高空间推理和分割精度，特别是在遮挡和物体边界附近。实现流程上，首先使用冻结的 CLIP 视觉编码器处理立体图像对以提取中间特征；接着，通过 SIEF 模块自适应地融合左右视图的特征；随后，利用基于 Transformer 的解码器处理融合后的特征并结合文本提示；最后，通过 SDAF 模块利用视差图作为注意力先验来细化分割预测。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了首个基于立体视觉的开放词汇语义分割方法，关键创新点在于引入了几何线索以提升空间推理能力，并设计了SIEF和SDAF两个模块来融合立体特征和利用视差图细化分割。相比之前主要依赖单视图图像的工作，SENSE在解码器内部整合了几何信息，从而提高了对遮挡和边界处的分割精度。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了SENSE，一种利用立体视觉和视觉语言模型进行开放词汇语义分割的新方法。它通过融合立体图像对和几何线索，提高了空间推理和分割精度，特别是在遮挡和物体边界附近。在PhraseStereo数据集上训练，该方法展示了在短语引导任务和零样本设置中的强大性能。

Abstract

Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation enables models to segment objects or image regions beyond fixed class sets, offering flexibility in dynamic environments. However, existing methods often rely on single-view images and struggle with spatial precision, especially under occlusions and near object boundaries. We propose SENSE, the first work on Stereo OpEN Vocabulary SEmantic Segmentation, which leverages stereo vision and vision-language models to enhance open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. By incorporating stereo image pairs, we introduce geometric cues that improve spatial reasoning and segmentation accuracy. Trained on the PhraseStereo dataset, our approach achieves strong performance in phrase-grounded tasks and demonstrates generalization in zero-shot settings. On PhraseStereo, we show a +2.9% improvement in Average Precision over the baseline method and +0.76% over the best competing method. SENSE also provides a relative improvement of +3.5% mIoU on Cityscapes and +18% on KITTI compared to the baseline work. By jointly reasoning over semantics and geometry, SENSE supports accurate scene understanding from natural language, essential for autonomous robots and Intelligent Transportation Systems.

item.title: TwinTrack: Post-hoc Multi-Rater Calibration for Medical Image Segmentation
item.author: Tristan Kirscher, Alexandra Ertl, Klaus Maier-Hein, Xavier Coubez, Philippe Meyer, Sylvain Faisan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 TwinTrack 的框架，用于解决胰腺导管腺癌在增强 CT 扫描中的分割问题，该框架通过后处理校准方法，将深度学习模型的概率输出调整为专家标注的平均响应，从而更好地处理专家间的不一致性和不确定性。

背景: 胰腺导管腺癌在增强 CT 扫描中的分割具有固有的模糊性，专家之间的不一致反映了真实的不确定性而非标注噪声。标准深度学习方法假设单一真值，产生的概率输出校准不佳且难以解释。

目的: 提出 TwinTrack 框架，通过后处理校准将集成分割概率调整为经验平均人类响应，使概率可直接解释为专家分配肿瘤标签的预期比例，明确建模专家间的不一致。

方法: TwinTrack 框架采用后处理校准程序，仅需要一个小型的多标注者校准集，将深度学习模型的概率输出校准为经验平均人类响应。

主要发现: 在 MICCAI 2025 CURVAS-PDACVI 多标注者基准测试中，该方法在一致性指标上始终优于标准方法。

结论: 该方法简单且仅需少量校准数据，能够有效改善分割概率的校准效果。

翻译: 本文提出了一种名为 TwinTrack 的框架，用于解决胰腺导管腺癌在增强 CT 扫描中的分割问题，该框架通过后处理校准方法，将深度学习模型的概率输出调整为专家标注的平均响应，从而更好地处理专家间的不一致性和不确定性。

Abstract

Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) segmentation on contrast-enhanced CT is inherently ambiguous: inter-rater disagreement among experts reflects genuine uncertainty rather than annotation noise. Standard deep learning approaches assume a single ground truth, producing probabilistic outputs that can be poorly calibrated and difficult to interpret under such ambiguity. We present TwinTrack, a framework that addresses this gap through post-hoc calibration of ensemble segmentation probabilities to the empirical mean human response (MHR) -the fraction of expert annotators labeling a voxel as tumor. Calibrated probabilities are thus directly interpretable as the expected proportion of annotators assigning the tumor label, explicitly modeling inter-rater disagreement. The proposed post-hoc calibration procedure is simple and requires only a small multi-rater calibration set. It consistently improves calibration metrics over standard approaches when evaluated on the MICCAI 2025 CURVAS-PDACVI multi-rater benchmark.

item.title: SCHK-HTC: Sibling Contrastive Learning with Hierarchical Knowledge-Aware Prompt Tuning for Hierarchical Text Classification
item.author: Ke Xiong, Qian Wu, Wangjie Gan, Yuke Li, Xuhong Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SCHK-HTC的方法，用于解决少样本层次文本分类任务中语义相似兄弟类难以区分的问题。

背景: 少样本层次文本分类是一项具有挑战性的任务，涉及在数据稀缺条件下将文本映射到预定义的树状标签层次结构。现有方法利用标签层次结构中的结构约束来保持父子预测的一致性，但面临一个关键瓶颈，即由于缺乏足够的领域知识，难以区分语义相似的兄弟类。

目的: 为了增强模型对深层兄弟类之间细微差别的感知能力，而不仅仅是强制执行层次规则。

方法: 提出了一种新颖的框架，包含两个核心组件：层次知识提取模块和兄弟对比学习机制。该设计指导模型在每个层次级别编码判别性特征，从而提高混淆类的可分性。

主要发现: 该方法在三个基准数据集上取得了优越的性能，在大多数情况下超过了现有的最先进方法。

结论: 代码已公开，该方法在少样本层次文本分类任务中表现优异。

翻译: Few-shot Hierarchical Text Classification (few-shot HTC) is a challenging task that involves mapping texts to a predefined tree-structured label hierarchy under data-scarce conditions. While current approaches utilize structural constraints from the label hierarchy to maintain parent-child prediction consistency, they face a critical bottleneck, the difficulty in distinguishing semantically similar sibling classes due to insufficient domain knowledge. We introduce an innovative method named Sibling Contrastive Learning with Hierarchical Knowledge-aware Prompt Tuning for few-shot HTC tasks (SCHK-HTC). Our work enhances the model's perception of subtle differences between sibling classes at deeper levels, rather than just enforcing hierarchical rules. Specifically, we propose a novel framework featuring two core components: a hierarchical knowledge extraction module and a sibling contrastive learning mechanism. This design guides model to encode discriminative features at each hierarchy level, thus improving the separability of confusable classes. Our approach achieves superior performance across three benchmark datasets, surpassing existing state-of-the-art methods in most cases. Our code is available at https://github.com/happywinder/SCHK-HTC.

Abstract

Few-shot Hierarchical Text Classification (few-shot HTC) is a challenging task that involves mapping texts to a predefined tree-structured label hierarchy under data-scarce conditions. While current approaches utilize structural constraints from the label hierarchy to maintain parent-child prediction consistency, they face a critical bottleneck, the difficulty in distinguishing semantically similar sibling classes due to insufficient domain knowledge. We introduce an innovative method named Sibling Contrastive Learning with Hierarchical Knowledge-aware Prompt Tuning for few-shot HTC tasks (SCHK-HTC). Our work enhances the model's perception of subtle differences between sibling classes at deeper levels, rather than just enforcing hierarchical rules. Specifically, we propose a novel framework featuring two core components: a hierarchical knowledge extraction module and a sibling contrastive learning mechanism. This design guides model to encode discriminative features at each hierarchy level, thus improving the separability of confusable classes. Our approach achieves superior performance across three benchmark datasets, surpassing existing state-of-the-art methods in most cases. Our code is available at https://github.com/happywinder/SCHK-HTC.

item.title: Where does output diversity collapse in post-training?
item.author: Constantinos Karouzos, Xingwei Tan, Nikolaos Aletras
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了后训练语言模型输出多样性坍塌的问题，发现其主要由训练数据组成决定，而非生成格式或特定后训练方法。

背景: 后训练语言模型产生的输出多样性低于其基础模型，这种坍塌破坏了依赖多样化样本的推理时扩展方法，并可能使模型在创造性和价值敏感任务上的输出趋于同质化。

目的: 通过追踪 Olmo 3 的三个并行后训练谱系，分离训练数据组成、生成格式和模型权重在多样性坍塌中的作用，以确定坍塌的成因。

方法: 对 Olmo 3 的三个谱系（Think、Instruct 和 RL-Zero）在 15 个任务和四种文本多样性指标下进行追踪，分析数据组成、生成格式和模型权重的影响，并将多样性损失分解为质量控制组件和残差组件。

主要发现: 1. 坍塌位置与数据组成共变；2. Think 谱系在监督微调阶段失去最多语义多样性；3. DPO 在 Instruct 中的效果大于 Think；4. 抑制推理中的思维链会降低 Think 模型在困难任务上的准确性，但不会改变答案级多样性；5. 多样性损失分解显示，Think 模型在保留正确答案多样性方面优于 Instruct；6. 坍塌是由训练数据嵌入模型权重中，而非由生成格式施加。

结论: 多样性坍塌是在训练期间由数据组成决定的，无法仅通过推理时方法解决。

翻译: 后训练语言模型产生的输出多样性低于其基础模型。这种输出多样性坍塌破坏了依赖多样化样本的推理时扩展方法，并存在使模型在创造性和价值敏感任务上的输出趋于同质化的风险。先前的工作将坍塌归因于特定的后训练方法，但没有分离训练数据组成与方法的作用，也没有分离生成格式与模型权重的作用。我们通过追踪 Olmo 3 的三个并行后训练谱系（Think、Instruct 和 RL-Zero）在 15 个任务和四种文本多样性指标下的输出多样性，发现坍塌位置与数据组成共变：Think 谱系在监督微调阶段失去最多语义多样性，且 DPO 在 Instruct 中的效果大于在 Think 中的效果。在推理时抑制 Think 模型中的思维链推理会降低其在困难任务上的准确性，但不会改变答案级多样性，表明坍塌是由训练数据嵌入模型权重中，而非由生成格式施加。将六个可验证任务上的多样性损失分解为质量控制组件（移除不正确输出）和残差组件（正确输出之间的真正缩小）显示，这种分割取决于任务，且尽管 Think 模型在整体上坍塌更多，但仍比 Instruct 保留更多正确答案多样性。我们的结果表明，多样性坍塌是在训练期间由数据组成决定的，无法仅通过推理时方法解决。

Abstract

Post-trained language models produce less varied outputs than their base counterparts. This output diversity collapse undermines inference-time scaling methods that rely on varied samples, and risks homogenizing model outputs on creative and value-laden tasks. Prior work attributes collapse to specific post-training methods, without separating the role of training data composition from the method, or the generation format from the model weights. We trace output diversity through three parallel post-training lineages of Olmo 3, Think (chain-of-thought distillation), Instruct (broad multi-source data), and RL-Zero, across 15 tasks and four text diversity metrics. We find that the location of collapse co-varies with data composition: the Think lineage loses most semantic diversity at supervised fine-tuning, and the effect of DPO is larger in Instruct than in Think. Suppressing chain-of-thought reasoning at inference in Think models drops accuracy on hard tasks, yet leaves answer-level diversity unchanged, showing that the collapse is embedded in the model weights by training data, not imposed by the generation format. Decomposing diversity loss on six verifiable tasks into a quality-control component (removal of incorrect outputs) and a residual component (genuine narrowing among correct outputs) reveals that the split is task-dependent, and Think models retain more correct-answer diversity than Instruct despite collapsing more in aggregate. Our results indicate that diversity collapse is determined during training by data composition and cannot be addressed at inference time alone.

item.title: Cut Your Losses! Learning to Prune Paths Early for Efficient Parallel Reasoning
item.author: Jiaxi Bi, Tongxu Luo, Wenyu Du, Zhengyang Tang, Benyou Wang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为STOP的路径修剪方法，旨在通过系统分类和优化，提升大推理模型在并行推理中的效率和准确性。

背景: 并行推理虽然能增强大推理模型，但早期错误会导致大量无效路径，造成高昂的计算成本。现有的路径修剪研究缺乏标准化框架。

目的: 提出一种系统化的路径修剪分类法，并引入STOP方法以提升并行推理的效率和效果。

方法: 提出了首个系统化的路径修剪分类法，按信号源（内部/外部）和可学习性（可学习/不可学习）对方法进行分类，并提出了STOP（Super TOken for Pruning）方法。

主要发现: STOP方法在1.5B到20B参数范围的LRMs上表现出优于现有基线的有效性和效率；在固定计算预算下，STOP能显著提升GPT-OSS-20B在AIME25上的准确率（从84%提升至近90%）；STOP具有良好的可扩展性。

结论: STOP方法验证了可学习内部信号修剪方法的潜力，作者将研究发现提炼为形式化的经验指南，以促进其在现实世界中的最佳部署。

翻译: 并行推理增强了大推理模型（LRMs），但由于早期错误导致无效路径而造成高昂成本。为了缓解这一问题，前缀级别的路径修剪至关重要，然而现有研究仍缺乏标准化框架。在这项工作中，我们提出了首个系统化的路径修剪分类法，按信号源（内部与外部）和可学习性（可学习与非可学习）对方法进行分类。这一分类揭示了可学习内部方法的未开发潜力，从而促使我们提出了STOP（Super TOken for Pruning）。在1.5B到20B参数范围的LRMs上的广泛评估表明，STOP在有效性和效率方面均优于现有基线。此外，我们在变化的计算预算下严格验证了STOP的可扩展性——例如，在固定计算预算下，将GPT-OSS-20B在AIME25上的准确率从84%提升至近90%。最后，我们将我们的发现提炼为形式化的经验指南，以促进最优的现实世界部署。代码、数据和模型可在 https://bijiaxihh.github.io/STOP 获取。

Abstract

Parallel reasoning enhances Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) but incurs prohibitive costs due to futile paths caused by early errors. To mitigate this, path pruning at the prefix level is essential, yet existing research remains fragmented without a standardized framework. In this work, we propose the first systematic taxonomy of path pruning, categorizing methods by their signal source (internal vs. external) and learnability (learnable vs. non-learnable). This classification reveals the unexplored potential of learnable internal methods, motivating our proposal of STOP (Super TOken for Pruning). Extensive evaluations across LRMs ranging from 1.5B to 20B parameters demonstrate that STOP achieves superior effectiveness and efficiency compared to existing baselines. Furthermore, we rigorously validate the scalability of STOP under varying compute budgets - for instance, boosting GPT-OSS-20B accuracy on AIME25 from 84% to nearly 90% under fixed compute budgets. Finally, we distill our findings into formalized empirical guidelines to facilitate optimal real-world deployment. Code, data and models are available at https://bijiaxihh.github.io/STOP

item.title: Elucidating the SNR-t Bias of Diffusion Probabilistic Models
item.author: Meng Yu, Lei Sun, Jianhao Zeng, Xiangxiang Chu, Kun Zhan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Diffusion Probabilistic Models在生成任务中表现优异，但存在SNR-timestep偏差问题，导致生成质量下降。本文提出了一种差分校正方法来缓解这一问题。

背景: Diffusion Probabilistic Models在广泛生成任务中表现出色，但存在SNR-timestep偏差，即去噪样本的信噪比与其对应时间步的不匹配。

目的: 提供证据和分析以证实SNR-timestep偏差现象，并提出一种简单有效的差分校正方法来缓解该偏差。

方法: 将样本分解为不同频率成分，并对每个成分单独应用差分校正。

主要发现: 该方法显著改善了多种扩散模型（包括IDDPM、ADM、DDIM等）在各种分辨率数据集上的生成质量，且计算开销可忽略不计。

结论: 提出的差分校正方法能有效缓解SNR-timestep偏差，提高生成质量。

翻译: 扩散概率模型在广泛的生成任务中表现出色。然而，我们观察到这些模型经常受到信噪比-时间步偏差的影响。这种偏差指的是去噪样本的信噪比与其对应时间步之间的错位。具体而言，在训练期间，样本的信噪比与其时间步严格耦合。然而，这种对应关系在推理期间被破坏，导致误差累积并损害生成质量。我们提供了全面的实证证据和理论分析来证实这一现象，并提出了一种简单而有效的差分校正方法来缓解SNR-t偏差。认识到扩散模型通常在反向去噪过程中先重建低频成分，然后再关注高频细节，我们将样本分解为各种频率成分，并对每个成分单独应用差分校正。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法在各种分辨率数据集上显著提高了多种扩散模型（IDDPM、ADM、DDIM、A-DPM、EA-DPM、EDM、PFGM++和FLUX）的生成质量，且计算开销可忽略不计。代码位于 https://github.com/AMAP-ML/DCW。

Abstract

Diffusion Probabilistic Models have demonstrated remarkable performance across a wide range of generative tasks. However, we have observed that these models often suffer from a Signal-to-Noise Ratio-timestep (SNR-t) bias. This bias refers to the misalignment between the SNR of the denoising sample and its corresponding timestep during the inference phase. Specifically, during training, the SNR of a sample is strictly coupled with its timestep. However, this correspondence is disrupted during inference, leading to error accumulation and impairing the generation quality. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence and theoretical analysis to substantiate this phenomenon and propose a simple yet effective differential correction method to mitigate the SNR-t bias. Recognizing that diffusion models typically reconstruct low-frequency components before focusing on high-frequency details during the reverse denoising process, we decompose samples into various frequency components and apply differential correction to each component individually.
