By reformulating classical self-supervised pretext tasks, such as rotation prediction, color matching, and cross-view correspondence, as image-instruction-response triplets, we introduce supervision that cannot be solved without relying on visual evidence. Our approach requires no human annotations, no architectural modifications, and no additional training stages. Across multiple models, training regimes, and benchmarks, injecting only a small fraction (3-10%) of such visually grounded instructions consistently improves performance on vision-centric evaluations. Our findings highlight instruction tuning with visually grounded SSL tasks as a powerful lever for improving visual reasoning in MLLMs through simple adjustments to the training data distribution. Code available at: https://github.com/sirkosophia/V-GIFT

item.title: GeoLink: A 3D-Aware Framework Towards Better Generalization in Cross-View Geo-Localization
item.author: Hongyang Zhang, Yinhao Liu, Haitao Zhang, Zhongyi Wen, Zhenyu Kuang, Shuxian Liang, Xiansheng Hua
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: GeoLink提出了一种3D感知的语义一致性框架，用于解决跨视图地理定位中的泛化问题。

背景: 现有方法主要依赖2D对应关系，容易受到跨视图冗余共享信息的干扰，导致表示的可迁移性较差。

目的: 为了解决跨视图地理定位中因视角变化引起的严重语义不一致以及域偏移下的泛化能力不足的问题。

方法: 利用VGGT从多视角无人机图像离线重建场景点云，提供稳定的结构先验。在此基础上，通过几何感知语义细化模块和统一视图关系蒸馏模块来改进2D表示学习。

主要发现: GeoLink在多个基准测试中持续优于最先进的方法，并在未见域和多样化天气环境下实现了优越的泛化能力。

结论: GeoLink通过将3D结构关系转移到2D特征中，在保持2D推理流程的同时，提高了跨视图对齐能力。

翻译: Generalizable cross-view geo-localization aims to match the same location across views in unseen regions and conditions without GPS supervision. Its core difficulty lies in severe semantic inconsistency caused by viewpoint variation and poor generalization under domain shift. Existing methods mainly rely on 2D correspondence, but they are easily distracted by redundant shared information across views, leading to less transferable representations. To address this, we propose GeoLink, a 3D-aware semantic-consistent framework for Generalizable cross-view geo-localization. Specifically, we offline reconstruct scene point clouds from multi-view drone images using VGGT, providing stable structural priors. Based on these 3D anchors, we improve 2D representation learning in two complementary ways. A Geometric-aware Semantic Refinement module mitigates potentially redundant and view-biased dependencies in 2D features under 3D guidance. In addition, a Unified View Relation Distillation module transfers 3D structural relations to 2D features, improving cross-view alignment while preserving a 2D-only inference pipeline. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that GeoLink consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods and achieves superior generalization across unseen domains and diverse weather environments.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决通用跨视角地理定位中因视角变化导致的严重语义不一致以及在领域偏移下泛化能力差的问题。现有方法主要依赖2D视觉对应，容易被冗余信息干扰。这个问题很重要，因为自动驾驶和机器人导航等实际应用需要在无GPS环境下工作，如果模型无法泛化到未见过的区域，其实际应用价值将受限。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法仅依赖2D图像对应，容易受视角变化和冗余信息干扰，导致泛化能力差。他们借鉴了人类利用3D环境进行多视角理解的思想，认为3D结构比2D视觉线索更稳定。因此设计了GeoLink框架，利用VGGT模型离线重建场景点云作为稳定的结构锚点。他们借鉴了Point-NN进行点云编码，并引入了MoE（混合专家）范式来处理稀疏点云。最后，利用这些3D锚点来指导2D特征学习，抑制冗余信息并转移结构关系。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用场景级的3D结构作为稳定的锚点，以解决跨视图地理定位中的语义不一致和域偏移问题。整体实现流程包括：首先，利用重建模型从多视角无人机图像中离线生成场景点云；其次，利用这些3D点云作为“锚点”指导2D特征学习；最后，通过几何感知语义细化模块和统一视图关系蒸馏模块，将3D结构信息转化为2D特征，从而提升跨域泛化能力。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了GeoLink框架，利用离线重建的场景点云作为稳定的3D结构先验。其关键创新点包括：1. 几何感知语义细化模块，在3D指导下抑制2D特征中的冗余和视角偏差；2. 统一视图关系蒸馏模块，将3D结构关系转移到2D特征中。相比之前主要依赖2D视觉对应关系且易受冗余信息干扰的方法，GeoLink引入了显式的3D结构引导，利用点云作为锚点来规范2D学习，从而提高泛化能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了 GeoLink 框架，利用从无人机图像重建的 3D 场景点云作为稳定的结构锚点，通过几何感知语义细化和统一视图关系蒸馏模块来改进 2D 表示学习，从而提升跨视图地理定位在未见域和多样化天气环境下的泛化能力。

Abstract

Generalizable cross-view geo-localization aims to match the same location across views in unseen regions and conditions without GPS supervision. Its core difficulty lies in severe semantic inconsistency caused by viewpoint variation and poor generalization under domain shift. Existing methods mainly rely on 2D correspondence, but they are easily distracted by redundant shared information across views, leading to less transferable representations. To address this, we propose GeoLink, a 3D-aware semantic-consistent framework for Generalizable cross-view geo-localization. Specifically, we offline reconstruct scene point clouds from multi-view drone images using VGGT, providing stable structural priors. Based on these 3D anchors, we improve 2D representation learning in two complementary ways. A Geometric-aware Semantic Refinement module mitigates potentially redundant and view-biased dependencies in 2D features under 3D guidance. In addition, a Unified View Relation Distillation module transfers 3D structural relations to 2D features, improving cross-view alignment while preserving a 2D-only inference pipeline. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that GeoLink consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods and achieves superior generalization across unseen domains and diverse weather environments.

item.title: KV Packet: Recomputation-Free Context-Independent KV Caching for LLMs
item.author: Chuangtao Chen, Grace Li Zhang, Xunzhao Yin, Cheng Zhuo, Bing Li, Ulf Schlichtmann
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 KV Packet 的重计算免费缓存重用框架，通过将缓存的文档视为不可变的轻量级可训练软令牌适配器，以解决标准 KV 缓存依赖上下文的问题。

背景: 大型语言模型严重依赖键值缓存以最小化推理延迟，但标准 KV 缓存具有上下文依赖性，在新的上下文中重用缓存的文档需要重新计算键值状态以考虑注意力分布的偏移。

目的: 为了解决现有解决方案如 CacheBlend、EPIC 和 SAM-KV 在选择性重计算部分令牌时仍产生不可忽视的计算开销和增加的首令牌延迟的问题，本文提出了一种无需重计算的缓存重用框架。

方法: KV Packet 将缓存的文档视为不可变的轻量级可训练软令牌适配器，并通过自监督蒸馏训练这些适配器以桥接上下文不连续性。

主要发现: 在 Llama-3.1 和 Qwen2.5 上的实验表明，KV Packet 方法实现了接近零的计算开销和比基于重计算的基线更低的 TTFT 延迟，同时保持了与完整重计算基线相当的 F1 分数。

结论: KV Packet 方法在保持性能的同时显著降低了计算成本和首令牌延迟，优于现有的重计算方法。

翻译: 大型语言模型严重依赖键值缓存以最小化推理延迟。然而，标准 KV 缓存具有上下文依赖性：在新的上下文中重用缓存的文档需要重新计算键值状态以考虑注意力分布的偏移。现有的解决方案如 CacheBlend、EPIC 和 SAM-KV 通过选择性重计算一部分令牌来缓解这一问题；然而，它们仍然产生不可忽视的计算开销和增加的首令牌延迟。在本文中，我们提出了 KV Packet，一种重计算免费的缓存重用框架，它将缓存的文档视为不可变的轻量级可训练软令牌适配器，并通过自监督蒸馏训练这些适配器以桥接上下文不连续性。在 Llama-3.1 和 Qwen2.5 上的实验表明，所提出的 KV Packet 方法实现了接近零的计算开销和比基于重计算的基线更低的 TTFT 延迟，同时保持了与完整重计算基线相当的 F1 分数。

Abstract

Large Language Models (LLMs) rely heavily on Key-Value (KV) caching to minimize inference latency. However, standard KV caches are context-dependent: reusing a cached document in a new context requires recomputing KV states to account for shifts in attention distribution. Existing solutions such as CacheBlend, EPIC, and SAM-KV mitigate this issue by selectively recomputing a subset of tokens; however, they still incur non-negligible computational overhead (FLOPs) and increased Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) latency. In this paper, we propose KV Packet, a recomputation-free cache reuse framework that treats cached documents as immutable ``packets'' wrapped in light-weight trainable soft-token adapters, which are trained via self-supervised distillation to bridge context discontinuities. Experiments on Llama-3.1 and Qwen2.5 demonstrate that the proposed KV Packet method achieves near-zero FLOPs and lower TTFT than recomputation-based baselines, while retaining F1 scores comparable to those of the full recomputation baseline.

item.title: Training-Free Test-Time Contrastive Learning for Large Language Models
item.author: Kaiwen Zheng, Kai Zhou, Jinwu Hu, Te Gu, Mingkai Peng, Fei Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TF-TTCL 是一种无需训练的测试时对比学习框架，通过从自身推理经验中提炼监督信息，使冻结的 LLM 能够在线提升性能。

背景: 现有测试时适应（TTA）方法依赖基于梯度的更新，需要白盒访问和大量开销；而无需训练的替代方案要么是静态的，要么依赖外部引导。

目的: 提出 TF-TTCL 框架，旨在让冻结的 LLM 能够通过从自身推理经验中提炼监督信息来在线提升性能。

方法: TF-TTCL 通过三个核心模块实现动态的“探索-反思-引导”循环：1) 语义查询增强通过多智能体角色扮演生成不同的推理轨迹；2) 对比经验蒸馏捕捉优秀与较差轨迹间的语义差距，将其提炼为显式文本规则；3) 上下文规则检索在推理过程中激活这些存储的规则，动态引导冻结的 LLM 走向稳健的推理模式并避免已观察到的错误。

主要发现: 在封闭式推理任务和开放式评估任务上，TF-TTCL 在在线评估中始终优于强大的零样本基线和代表性的 TTA 方法。

结论: TF-TTCL 框架能够有效提升冻结 LLM 的在线推理能力，无需训练和外部引导。

翻译: 大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出强大的推理能力，但在分布偏移下性能往往会下降。现有的测试时适应（TTA）方法依赖于基于梯度的更新，这需要白盒访问和大量开销，而无需训练的替代方案要么是静态的，要么依赖外部引导。在本文中，我们提出了训练无关的测试时对比学习 TF-TTCL，这是一个无需训练的适应框架，它使冻结的 LLM 能够通过从自身推理经验中提炼监督信息来在线提升性能。具体来说，TF-TTCL 通过三个核心模块实现动态的“探索-反思-引导”循环：1) 语义查询增强首先通过多智能体角色扮演生成不同的推理轨迹；2) 对比经验蒸馏然后捕捉优秀与较差轨迹间的语义差距，将其提炼为显式文本规则；3) 上下文规则检索最后在推理过程中激活这些存储的规则，动态引导冻结的 LLM 走向稳健的推理模式并避免已观察到的错误。在封闭式推理任务和开放式评估任务上的广泛实验表明，TF-TTCL 在在线评估中始终优于强大的零样本基线和代表性的 TTA 方法。代码可在 https://github.com/KevinSCUTer/TF-TTCL 获取。

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong reasoning capabilities, but their performance often degrades under distribution shift. Existing test-time adaptation (TTA) methods rely on gradient-based updates that require white-box access and need substantial overhead, while training-free alternatives are either static or depend on external guidance. In this paper, we propose Training-Free Test-Time Contrastive Learning TF-TTCL, a training-free adaptation framework that enables a frozen LLM to improve online by distilling supervision from its own inference experiences. Specifically, TF-TTCL implements a dynamic "Explore-Reflect-Steer" loop through three core modules: 1) Semantic Query Augmentation first diversifies problem views via multi-agent role-playing to generate different reasoning trajectories; 2) Contrastive Experience Distillation then captures the semantic gap between superior and inferior trajectories, distilling them into explicit textual rules; and 3) Contextual Rule Retrieval finally activates these stored rules during inference to dynamically steer the frozen LLM toward robust reasoning patterns while avoiding observed errors. Extensive experiments on closed-ended reasoning tasks and open-ended evaluation tasks demonstrate that TF-TTCL consistently outperforms strong zero-shot baselines and representative TTA methods under online evaluation. Code is available at https://github.com/KevinSCUTer/TF-TTCL.

item.title: C2: Scalable Rubric-Augmented Reward Modeling from Binary Preferences
item.author: Akira Kawabata, Saku Sugawara
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出 Cooperative yet Critical reward modeling (C2) 框架，通过奖励模型与仅基于二元偏好训练的评分标准生成器之间的批判性合作，显著提升奖励模型的判断可靠性。

背景: 现有的 rubric-augmented verification 方法虽然能提供更可靠的判断，但需要昂贵的评分标准标注，限制了可扩展性。此外，低质量的评分标准会主动误导奖励模型。

目的: 受合作通信原则启发，旨在通过让奖励模型与评分标准生成器进行批判性合作，在不依赖外部评分标准标注的情况下，提高奖励模型判断的可信度和可扩展性。

方法: C2 框架通过合成有益和误导性的评分标准对来训练合作评分标准生成器和批判性验证器。奖励模型仅在推理时采纳其认为有益的评分标准。

主要发现: C2 在 RM-Bench 上提升了高达 6.5 分，在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上提升了 6.0 点长度控制胜率。8B 奖励模型在不使用外部标注的情况下，达到了使用 4 倍更大模型评分标准时的性能。

结论: 在 rubric-augmented verification 中激发 deliberate cooperation 能以可扩展的方式使奖励模型更加可信。

翻译: Rubric-augmented verification guides reward models with explicit evaluation criteria, yielding more reliable judgments than single-model verification. However, most existing methods require costly rubric annotations, limiting scalability. Moreover, we find that rubric generation is vulnerable to a failure of cooperation; low-quality rubrics actively mislead reward models rather than help. Inspired by the principle of cooperative communication, we propose Cooperative yet Critical reward modeling (C2), a framework that significantly improves reward model judgments by having the reward model critically collaborate with a rubric generator trained solely from binary preferences. In C2, we synthesize helpful and misleading rubric pairs by measuring how each rubric shifts the reward model toward or away from the correct preference. Using these contrastive pairs, we train a cooperative rubric generator to propose helpful rubrics, and a critical verifier to assess rubric validity before making its judgment, following only rubrics it deems helpful at inference time. C2 outperforms reasoning reward models trained on the same binary preferences, with gains of up to 6.5 points on RM-Bench and 6.0 points length-controlled win rate on AlpacaEval 2.0. Without external rubric annotations, C2 enables an 8B reward model to match performance achieved with rubrics from a 4$imes$ larger model. Overall, our work demonstrates that eliciting deliberate cooperation in rubric-augmented verification makes reward models more trustworthy in a scalable way.

Abstract

Rubric-augmented verification guides reward models with explicit evaluation criteria, yielding more reliable judgments than single-model verification. However, most existing methods require costly rubric annotations, limiting scalability. Moreover, we find that rubric generation is vulnerable to a failure of cooperation; low-quality rubrics actively mislead reward models rather than help. Inspired by the principle of cooperative communication, we propose Cooperative yet Critical reward modeling (C2), a framework that significantly improves reward model judgments by having the reward model critically collaborate with a rubric generator trained solely from binary preferences. In C2, we synthesize helpful and misleading rubric pairs by measuring how each rubric shifts the reward model toward or away from the correct preference. Using these contrastive pairs, we train a cooperative rubric generator to propose helpful rubrics, and a critical verifier to assess rubric validity before making its judgment, following only rubrics it deems helpful at inference time. C2 outperforms reasoning reward models trained on the same binary preferences, with gains of up to 6.5 points on RM-Bench and 6.0 points length-controlled win rate on AlpacaEval 2.0. Without external rubric annotations, C2 enables an 8B reward model to match performance achieved with rubrics from a 4$\times$ larger model. Overall, our work demonstrates that eliciting deliberate cooperation in rubric-augmented verification makes reward models more trustworthy in a scalable way.

item.title: OneHOI: Unifying Human-Object Interaction Generation and Editing
item.author: Jiun Tian Hoe, Weipeng Hu, Xudong Jiang, Yap-Peng Tan, Chee Seng Chan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: OneHOI是一个统一的扩散变换框架，将人类与物体交互的生成和编辑整合到一个条件去噪过程中。

背景: 现有方法分为两个不相关的家族：HOI生成无法整合混合条件，而HOI编辑难以解耦姿态与物理接触并扩展到多个交互。

目的: 介绍OneHOI，一个统一的扩散变换框架，将HOI生成和编辑整合到由共享结构化交互表示驱动的单一条件去噪过程中。

方法: Relational Diffusion Transformer (R-DiT)通过角色和实例感知的HOI标记、基于布局的空间动作定位、结构化HOI注意力以及HOI RoPE来建模动词介导的关系。

主要发现: OneHOI支持布局引导、无布局、任意遮罩和混合条件控制，在HOI生成和编辑方面均取得了最先进的结果。

结论: OneHOI在HOI生成和编辑任务中实现了最先进的结果。

翻译: OneHOI是一个统一的扩散变换框架，将人类与物体交互的生成和编辑整合到一个条件去噪过程中。现有方法分为两个不相关的家族：HOI生成无法整合混合条件，而HOI编辑难以解耦姿态与物理接触并扩展到多个交互。我们介绍OneHOI，一个统一的扩散变换框架，将HOI生成和编辑整合到由共享结构化交互表示驱动的单一条件去噪过程中。核心是Relational Diffusion Transformer (R-DiT)，通过角色和实例感知的HOI标记、基于布局的空间动作定位、结构化HOI注意力和HOI RoPE来建模动词介导的关系。在HOI-Edit-44K上与模态dropout联合训练，以及HOI和物体中心数据集，OneHOI支持布局引导、无布局、任意遮罩和混合条件控制，在HOI生成和编辑方面均取得了最先进的结果。代码可在https://jiuntian.github.io/OneHOI/获取。

Abstract

Human-Object Interaction (HOI) modelling captures how humans act upon and relate to objects, typically expressed as <person, action, object> triplets. Existing approaches split into two disjoint families: HOI generation synthesises scenes from structured triplets and layout, but fails to integrate mixed conditions like HOI and object-only entities; and HOI editing modifies interactions via text, yet struggles to decouple pose from physical contact and scale to multiple interactions. We introduce OneHOI, a unified diffusion transformer framework that consolidates HOI generation and editing into a single conditional denoising process driven by shared structured interaction representations. At its core, the Relational Diffusion Transformer (R-DiT) models verb-mediated relations through role- and instance-aware HOI tokens, layout-based spatial Action Grounding, a Structured HOI Attention to enforce interaction topology, and HOI RoPE to disentangle multi-HOI scenes. Trained jointly with modality dropout on our HOI-Edit-44K, along with HOI and object-centric datasets, OneHOI supports layout-guided, layout-free, arbitrary-mask, and mixed-condition control, achieving state-of-the-art results across both HOI generation and editing. Code is available at https://jiuntian.github.io/OneHOI/.

item.title: HiVLA: A Visual-Grounded-Centric Hierarchical Embodied Manipulation System
item.author: Tianshuo Yang, Guanyu Chen, Yutian Chen, Zhixuan Liang, Yitian Liu, Zanxin Chen, Chunpu Xu, Haotian Liang, Jiangmiao Pang, Yao Mu, Ping Luo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: HiVLA是一个视觉-语言-动作模型，通过分层框架解耦高层语义规划和低层运动控制，以保持VLM的推理能力并提升机器人操作性能。

背景: 端到端视觉-语言-动作模型在窄控制数据上微调时，往往损害了其从基础视觉-语言模型继承的深刻推理能力。

目的: 解决高层语义规划与低层运动控制之间的权衡问题，同时保持VLM的零样本推理能力并独立提升各组件性能。

方法: 提出HiVLA框架，包含高层VLM规划器（执行任务分解和视觉定位）和低层DiT动作专家（配备级联交叉注意力机制），以融合全局上下文、高分辨率物体中心裁剪和技能语义。

主要发现: 在仿真和现实世界的广泛实验中，HiVLA显著优于最先进的端到端基线，特别是在长 horizon 技能组合和杂乱场景中小物体的精细操作方面表现优异。

结论: 解耦架构成功保留了VLM的零样本推理能力，并允许独立改进两个组件，从而显著提升了机器人操作性能。

翻译: 虽然端到端视觉-语言-动作模型为机器人操作提供了有前景的范式，但在窄控制数据上微调它们往往会损害其从基础视觉-语言模型继承的深刻推理能力。为了解决这一基本权衡，我们提出了HiVLA，一个以视觉为中心的分层框架，明确解耦高层语义规划和低层运动控制。在高层部分，VLM规划器首先执行任务分解和视觉定位以生成结构化计划，包括子任务指令和精确的目标边界框。然后，为了将此计划转化为物理动作，我们在低层部分引入了配备新颖级联交叉注意力机制的流匹配扩散变换器动作专家。这种设计依次融合全局上下文、高分辨率物体中心裁剪和技能语义，使DiT能够纯粹专注于稳健执行。我们的解耦架构保留了VLM的零样本推理能力，同时允许两个组件的独立改进。在仿真和现实世界中的广泛实验表明，HiVLA显著优于最先进的端到端基线，特别是在长 horizon 技能组合和杂乱场景中小物体的精细操作方面表现优异。

Abstract

While end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, fine-tuning them on narrow control data often compromises the profound reasoning capabilities inherited from their base Vision-Language Models (VLMs). To resolve this fundamental trade-off, we propose HiVLA, a visual-grounded-centric hierarchical framework that explicitly decouples high-level semantic planning from low-level motor control. In high-level part, a VLM planner first performs task decomposition and visual grounding to generate structured plans, comprising a subtask instruction and a precise target bounding box. Then, to translate this plan into physical actions, we introduce a flow-matching Diffusion Transformer (DiT) action expert in low-level part equipped with a novel cascaded cross-attention mechanism. This design sequentially fuses global context, high-resolution object-centric crops and skill semantics, enabling the DiT to focus purely on robust execution. Our decoupled architecture preserves the VLM's zero-shot reasoning while allowing independent improvement of both components. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that HiVLA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art end-to-end baselines, particularly excelling in long-horizon skill composition and the fine-grained manipulation of small objects in cluttered scenes.

item.title: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
item.author: Lin-Zhuo Chen, Jian Gao, Yihang Chen, Ka Leong Cheng, Yipengjing Sun, Liangxiao Hu, Nan Xue, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Yao Yao, Yinghao Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: LingBot-Map是一种基于几何上下文变换器架构的前馈3D基础模型，旨在从视频流中恢复3D信息，如相机位姿和点云。

背景: 受同时定位与建图（SLAM）原理的启发，Streaming 3D reconstruction需要从视频流中恢复3D信息，这要求具备几何精度、时间一致性和计算效率。

目的: 介绍LingBot-Map，一种用于从流式数据重建场景的前馈3D基础模型。

方法: 构建在几何上下文变换器（GCT）架构之上，设计了特定的注意力机制，整合了锚点上下文、位姿参考窗口和轨迹记忆，以解决坐标定位、密集几何线索和长距离漂移校正问题。

主要发现: 在518 x 378分辨率输入下，长序列超过10,000帧时，推理速度稳定且高效，约为20 FPS；在多种基准测试中，相比现有的流式和基于迭代优化的方法，性能更优。

结论: LingBot-Map在保持流式状态紧凑的同时保留了丰富的几何上下文，实现了稳定高效的推理，并在性能上优于现有方法。

翻译: 流式3D重建旨在从视频流中恢复3D信息，如相机位姿和点云，这需要几何精度、时间一致性和计算效率。受同时定位与建图（SLAM）原理的启发，我们介绍了LingBot-Map，这是一种用于从流式数据重建场景的前馈3D基础模型，构建于几何上下文变换器（GCT）架构之上。LingBot-Map的一个显著特征是其精心设计的注意力机制，它整合了锚点上下文、位姿参考窗口和轨迹记忆，分别解决坐标定位、密集几何线索和长距离漂移校正问题。这种设计使流式状态保持紧凑，同时保留丰富的几何上下文，能够在长序列超过10,000帧的情况下，在518 x 378分辨率输入下实现稳定且高效的推理，速度约为20 FPS。在各种基准测试中的广泛评估表明，我们的方法比现有的流式和基于迭代优化的方法取得了更优越的性能。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决流式 3D 重建中，如何在保持长序列时间一致性的同时，实现高效且紧凑的推理状态管理的问题。现有的方法要么容易遗忘关键信息，要么计算和内存消耗随序列长度线性增长，导致在长视频或复杂场景中表现不佳。在现实中，这非常重要。人类通过稀疏记忆高效导航，而机器需要从连续视觉输入中实时重建场景（如无人机、自动驾驶）。现有的离线模型无法实时运行，而现有的流式方法在长序列中容易产生轨迹漂移或计算负担过重，限制了其实际应用价值。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者借鉴了经典 SLAM 系统的见解，认为稳健的实时重建需要维护三种互补的空间上下文：用于坐标定标的参考帧、用于局部几何估计的窗口以及用于全局漂移修正的地图。他们基于 VGGT 等现有 3D 基础模型，设计了一种几何上下文注意力机制，用端到端学习的注意力替换了手工设计的优化，以实现高效且一致的流式重建。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用几何上下文注意力机制，将流式上下文分解为三种互补类型：锚点上下文用于固定坐标和尺度，局部位姿参考窗口用于密集局部几何估计，以及轨迹记忆用于全局漂移校正。这种设计在保持紧凑状态的同时保留了丰富的几何上下文。整体实现流程是逐帧处理视频流，首先通过视觉骨干网络编码图像，然后利用几何上下文注意力机制处理。该方法将前几张图像作为锚点固定尺度，保留最近几张图像的完整信息用于局部对齐，并将更早的历史信息压缩为紧凑标记用于全局一致性校正，最后通过任务特定头部预测相机位姿和深度图。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文提出了 LingBot-Map 模型及其核心的几何上下文注意力机制（GCA）。该机制将流式状态分为锚点上下文、姿态参考窗口和轨迹记忆三种互补类型，在保持紧凑状态的同时保留丰富几何信息。相比现有方法，它通过端到端学习实现了对上下文的选择性管理，无需手工启发式或测试时训练，从而在长序列中实现了更高效且稳定的实时推理。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了名为 LingBot-Map 的流式 3D 重建模型，通过设计一种几何上下文注意力机制，在长序列视频中实现了高效且一致的重建。

Abstract

Streaming 3D reconstruction aims to recover 3D information, such as camera poses and point clouds, from a video stream, which necessitates geometric accuracy, temporal consistency, and computational efficiency. Motivated by the principles of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), we introduce LingBot-Map, a feed-forward 3D foundation model for reconstructing scenes from streaming data, built upon a geometric context transformer (GCT) architecture. A defining aspect of LingBot-Map lies in its carefully designed attention mechanism, which integrates an anchor context, a pose-reference window, and a trajectory memory to address coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction, respectively. This design keeps the streaming state compact while retaining rich geometric context, enabling stable efficient inference at around 20 FPS on 518 x 378 resolution inputs over long sequences exceeding 10,000 frames. Extensive evaluations across a variety of benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance compared to both existing streaming and iterative optimization-based approaches.

item.title: One Token per Highly Selective Frame: Towards Extreme Compression for Long Video Understanding
item.author: Zheyu Zhang, Ziqi Pang, Shixing Chen, Xiang Hao, Vimal Bhat, Yu-Xiong Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为XComp的极端视频压缩模型，旨在解决长视频理解中因帧数过多导致的上下文长度限制问题。

背景: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在处理长视频时面临挑战，因为每一帧通常会产生数十或数百个token，而大型语言模型（LLM）的有限上下文长度迫使VLM稀疏地感知帧并丢失时间信息。

目的: 探索极端视频token压缩，最终实现每帧一个token，并提高token效率。

方法: 提出了可学习的渐进式模块（LP-Comp）进行token级压缩，以及基于内部注意力分数的帧级压缩（QC-Comp）。此外，通过将长视频分割成短片段并使用局部注意力来缓解LLM注意力中的位置偏差。

主要发现: XComp模型能够消化2倍到4倍的更多帧，且性能得到提升；通过结合token级和帧级压缩，实现了更大的压缩比；在LVBench上准确率从42.9%提升至46.2%；仅需2.5%的监督微调数据即可实现数据高效的监督压缩微调。

结论: XComp模型在长视频理解任务中取得了显著成果，通过极端压缩实现了更密集的帧采样，并在多个基准测试中提升了性能。

翻译: 本文提出了一种名为XComp的极端视频压缩模型，旨在解决长视频理解中因帧数过多导致的上下文长度限制问题。视觉语言模型（VLM）在处理长视频时面临挑战，因为每一帧通常会产生数十或数百个token，而大型语言模型（LLM）的有限上下文长度迫使VLM稀疏地感知帧并丢失时间信息。本文探索极端视频token压缩，最终实现每帧一个token，并提高token效率。方法包括提出可学习的渐进式模块（LP-Comp）进行token级压缩，以及基于内部注意力分数的帧级压缩（QC-Comp）。此外，通过将长视频分割成短片段并使用局部注意力来缓解LLM注意力中的位置偏差。XComp模型能够消化2倍到4倍的更多帧，且性能得到提升；通过结合token级和帧级压缩，实现了更大的压缩比；在LVBench上准确率从42.9%提升至46.2%；仅需2.5%的监督微调数据即可实现数据高效的监督压缩微调。

Abstract

Long video understanding is inherently challenging for vision-language models (VLMs) because of the extensive number of frames. With each video frame typically expanding into tens or hundreds of tokens, the limited context length of large language models (LLMs) forces the VLMs to perceive the frames sparsely and lose temporal information. To address this, we explore extreme video token compression towards one token per frame at the final LLM layer. Our key insight is that heuristic-based compression, widely adopted by previous methods, is prone to information loss, and this necessitates supervising LLM layers into learnable and progressive modules for token-level compression (LP-Comp). Such compression enables our VLM to digest 2x-4x more frames with improved performance. To further increase the token efficiency, we investigate frame-level compression, which selects the frames most relevant to the queries via the internal attention scores of the LLM layers, named question-conditioned compression (QC-Comp). As a notable distinction from previous studies, we mitigate the position bias of LLM attention in long contexts, i.e., the over-concentration on the beginning and end of a sequence, by splitting long videos into short segments and employing local attention. Collectively, our combined token-level and frame-level leads to an extreme compression model for long video understanding, named XComp, achieving a significantly larger compression ratio and enabling denser frame sampling. Our XComp is finetuned from VideoChat-Flash with a data-efficient supervised compression tuning stage that only requires 2.5% of the supervised fine-tuning data, yet boosts the accuracy from 42.9% to 46.2% on LVBench and enhances multiple other long video benchmarks.

item.title: How to Fine-Tune a Reasoning Model? A Teacher-Student Cooperation Framework to Synthesize Student-Consistent SFT Data
item.author: Zixian Huang, Kaichen Yang, Xu Huang, Feiyang Hao, Qiming Ge, Bowen Li, He Du, Kai Chen, Qipeng Guo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 TESSY 的框架，通过交替使用教师和学生模型生成数据，以解决风格不一致问题并提升学生模型的推理能力。

背景: 使用更强的模型生成的合成数据进行监督微调（SFT）是常用的模型增强策略，但对于像 Qwen3-8B 这样的新兴推理模型，这种方法往往无法提升推理能力，甚至会导致性能大幅下降。

目的: 识别教师生成数据与学生模型分布之间的显著风格差异，并提出一种方法来弥合这一差距。

方法: 提出了 Teacher-Student Cooperation Data Synthesis 框架（TESSY），该框架交替使用教师和学生模型来生成风格和非风格标记，从而产生既继承教师先进推理能力又保持与学生模型风格一致性的合成序列。

主要发现: 在代码生成任务中，使用 GPT-OSS-120B 作为教师模型生成的数据进行微调 Qwen3-8B 会导致性能下降（LiveCodeBench-Pro 下降 3.25%，OJBench 下降 10.02%），而 TESSY 框架则实现了性能提升（LiveCodeBench-Pro 提升 11.25%，OJBench 提升 6.68%）。

结论: TESSY 框架能够有效解决风格不一致问题，在保持学生模型风格一致性的同时，显著提升了其推理能力。

翻译: A widely adopted strategy for model enhancement is to use synthetic data generated by a stronger model for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, for emerging reasoning models like Qwen3-8B, this approach often fails to improve reasoning capabilities and can even lead to a substantial drop in performance. In this work, we identify substantial stylistic divergence between teacher generated data and the distribution of student as a major factor impacting SFT. To bridge this gap, we propose a Teacher-Student Cooperation Data Synthesis framework (TESSY), which interleaves teacher and student models to alternately generate style and non-style tokens. Consequently, TESSY produces synthetic sequences that inherit the advanced reasoning capabilities of the teacher while maintaining stylistic consistency with the distribution of the student. In experiments on code generation using GPT-OSS-120B as the teacher, fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on teacher-generated data leads to performance drops of 3.25% on LiveCodeBench-Pro and 10.02% on OJBench, whereas TESSY achieves improvements of 11.25% and 6.68%.

Abstract

A widely adopted strategy for model enhancement is to use synthetic data generated by a stronger model for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, for emerging reasoning models like Qwen3-8B, this approach often fails to improve reasoning capabilities and can even lead to a substantial drop in performance. In this work, we identify substantial stylistic divergence between teacher generated data and the distribution of student as a major factor impacting SFT. To bridge this gap, we propose a Teacher-Student Cooperation Data Synthesis framework (TESSY), which interleaves teacher and student models to alternately generate style and non-style tokens. Consequently, TESSY produces synthetic sequences that inherit the advanced reasoning capabilities of the teacher while maintaining stylistic consistency with the distribution of the student. In experiments on code generation using GPT-OSS-120B as the teacher, fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on teacher-generated data leads to performance drops of 3.25% on LiveCodeBench-Pro and 10.02% on OJBench, whereas TESSY achieves improvements of 11.25% and 6.68%.

item.title: Dive into Claude Code: The Design Space of Today's and Future AI Agent Systems
item.author: Jiacheng Liu, Xiaohan Zhao, Xinyi Shang, Zhiqiang Shen
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Claude Code是一个代理编码工具，通过分析其TypeScript源代码并与OpenClaw对比，识别了五个核心人类价值观和十三项设计原则，并详细描述了其架构，包括权限系统、上下文管理、扩展机制等。

背景: Claude Code是一个能够运行Shell命令、编辑文件和调用外部服务的代理编码工具。

目的: 通过分析公开的TypeScript源代码，并与OpenClaw进行对比，来描述Claude Code的综合架构，并识别其背后的设计哲学和需求。

方法: 通过分析公开的TypeScript源代码，并与OpenClaw（一个独立的开放源AI代理系统）进行对比分析。

主要发现: 识别了五个核心人类价值观和设计哲学：人类决策权威、安全与安全、可靠执行、能力放大和上下文适应性；系统核心是一个简单的while循环；包含权限系统（七种模式）、基于ML的分类器、五层上下文压缩管道、四种扩展机制（MCP、插件、技能、钩子）、子代理委托机制和工作树隔离、以及面向会话的存储；与OpenClaw的对比显示，相同的重复设计问题在不同部署背景下会产生不同的架构答案。

结论: 系统架构由五个核心人类价值观和十三项设计原则驱动；核心是一个简单的循环；大部分代码位于循环周围的系统中；与OpenClaw的对比表明部署背景的变化会导致不同的架构答案；最后识别了未来代理系统的六个开放设计方向。

翻译: Claude Code是一个代理编码工具，可以代表用户运行Shell命令、编辑文件和调用外部服务。本研究通过分析公开可用的TypeScript源代码，并进一步与OpenClaw（一个独立的开放源AI代理系统）进行比较，后者从不同的部署背景下回答了许多相同的设计问题，来描述其综合架构。我们的分析确定了五个人类价值观、哲学和需求，它们推动了架构（人类决策权威、安全与安全、可靠执行、能力放大和上下文适应性），并将它们追溯到十三项设计原则以实现具体的实现选择。系统的核心是一个简单的while循环，调用模型、运行工具并重复。然而，大部分代码存在于这个循环周围的系统中：一个具有七种模式的权限系统和基于ML的分类器、用于上下文管理的五层压缩管道、四种扩展机制（MCP、插件、技能和钩子）、具有工作树隔离的子代理委托机制以及面向会话的存储。与OpenClaw（一个多通道个人助理网关）的比较显示，相同的重复设计问题在部署背景改变时会产生不同的架构答案：从每个动作的安全分类到边界级别的访问控制，从单个CLI循环到网关控制平面内的嵌入式运行时，以及从上下文窗口扩展到网关范围的能力注册。最后，我们确定了未来代理系统的六个开放设计方向，基于最近的实证、架构和政策文献。

Abstract

Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that can run shell commands, edit files, and call external services on behalf of the user. This study describes its comprehensive architecture by analyzing the publicly available TypeScript source code and further comparing it with OpenClaw, an independent open-source AI agent system that answers many of the same design questions from a different deployment context. Our analysis identifies five human values, philosophies, and needs that motivate the architecture (human decision authority, safety and security, reliable execution, capability amplification, and contextual adaptability) and traces them through thirteen design principles to specific implementation choices. The core of the system is a simple while-loop that calls the model, runs tools, and repeats. Most of the code, however, lives in the systems around this loop: a permission system with seven modes and an ML-based classifier, a five-layer compaction pipeline for context management, four extensibility mechanisms (MCP, plugins, skills, and hooks), a subagent delegation mechanism with worktree isolation, and append-oriented session storage. A comparison with OpenClaw, a multi-channel personal assistant gateway, shows that the same recurring design questions produce different architectural answers when the deployment context changes: from per-action safety classification to perimeter-level access control, from a single CLI loop to an embedded runtime within a gateway control plane, and from context-window extensions to gateway-wide capability registration. We finally identify six open design directions for future agent systems, grounded in recent empirical, architectural, and policy literature.

item.title: Anomaly Detection in IEC-61850 GOOSE Networks: Evaluating Unsupervised and Temporal Learning for Real-Time Intrusion Detection
item.author: Joseph Moore
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文评估了无监督时间建模在IEC-61850 GOOSE协议网络入侵检测中的有效性，比较了五种模型在检测性能、实时性要求和跨环境泛化能力方面的表现。

背景: IEC-61850 GOOSE协议是现代数字变电站中关键通信的基础，但缺乏原生安全机制，易受重放、冒充和数据注入攻击。由于严格的延迟限制（小于4毫秒）和标记攻击数据有限，入侵检测面临挑战。

目的: 评估无监督时间建模是否能为GOOSE网络提供有效且可部署的异常检测。

方法: 在ERENO IEC-61850数据集上比较了五种模型：监督随机森林、前馈自编码器以及三种循环序列自编码器（RNN、LSTM和GRU）。使用保留的验证分区选择异常阈值以避免测试集泄漏。

主要发现: 监督随机森林检测性能最高（F1=0.9516），但每次预测耗时21.8ms，无法满足实时约束。四种无监督模型均满足4ms要求，其中GRU在准确率与延迟的权衡上表现最佳（F1=0.8737，耗时1.118ms）。所有模型在独立数据集上因分布偏移而性能下降，但循环模型相比监督基线仍保持较高的相对性能。

结论: 无监督时间模型是实时GOOSE入侵检测的实用选择，特别是在缺乏标记训练数据或需要在多样化变电站进行大规模部署的环境中。

翻译: IEC-61850 GOOSE协议是现代数字变电站中关键通信的基础，但缺乏原生安全机制，易受重放、冒充和数据注入攻击。由于严格的延迟限制（小于4毫秒）和标记攻击数据有限，入侵检测面临挑战。本文评估了无监督时间建模是否能为GOOSE网络提供有效且可部署的异常检测。在ERENO IEC-61850数据集上比较了五种模型：监督随机森林、前馈自编码器以及三种循环序列自编码器（RNN、LSTM和GRU）。监督随机森林检测性能最高（F1=0.9516），但每次预测耗时21.8ms，无法满足实时约束。四种无监督模型均满足4ms要求，其中GRU在准确率与延迟的权衡上表现最佳（F1=0.8737，耗时1.118ms）。所有模型在独立数据集上因分布偏移而性能下降，但循环模型相比监督基线仍保持较高的相对性能。无监督时间模型是实时GOOSE入侵检测的实用选择，特别是在缺乏标记训练数据或需要在多样化变电站进行大规模部署的环境中。

Abstract

The IEC-61850 GOOSE protocol underpins time-critical communication in modern digital substations but lacks native security mechanisms, leaving it vulnerable to replay, masquerade, and data injection attacks. Intrusion detection in this setting is challenging due to strict latency constraints (sub-4ms) and limited availability of labeled attack data. This paper evaluates whether unsupervised temporal modeling can provide effective and deployable anomaly detection for GOOSE networks. Five models are compared on the ERENO IEC-61850 dataset: a supervised Random Forest baseline, a feedforward Autoencoder, and three recurrent sequence autoencoders (RNN, LSTM, and GRU). The supervised Random Forest achieves the highest detection performance (F1=0.9516) but fails to meet real-time constraints at 21.8ms per prediction. All four unsupervised models satisfy the 4ms requirement, with the GRU achieving the best accuracy to latency tradeoff among them (F1=0.8737 at 1.118ms). A cross-environment evaluation on an independent dataset shows that all models degrade under distribution shift. However, recurrent models retain substantially higher relative performance than the supervised baseline, suggesting that temporal sequence modeling generalizes better than fitting labeled attack distributions. Anomaly thresholds for the unsupervised models are selected on a held out validation partition to avoid test set leakage. These results support unsupervised temporal models as a practical choice for real-time GOOSE intrusion detection, particularly in environments where labeled training data may be unavailable or where large-scale deployment across diverse substations is required.

item.title: Graph-Based Fraud Detection with Dual-Path Graph Filtering
item.author: Wei He, Wensheng Gan, Philip S. Yu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于图的双路径图过滤模型（DPF-GFD），用于解决欺诈检测中的关系伪装、高异质性和类别不平衡问题。

背景: 图神经网络（GNNs）在处理图数据时具有优势，但欺诈图固有的关系伪装、高异质性和类别不平衡导致大多数GNNs在欺诈检测任务中表现不佳。

目的: 为了解决欺诈检测中的关系伪装、高异质性和类别不平衡挑战，提出了一种基于图的双路径图过滤模型（DPF-GFD）。

方法: DPF-GFD首先应用基于Beta小波的算子对原始图进行操作以捕获关键结构模式；然后从基于距离的节点表示构建相似性图，并应用改进的低通滤波器；最后通过监督表示学习融合原始图和相似性图的嵌入，并使用集成树模型评估未标记节点的欺诈风险。

主要发现: DPF-GFD引入了频率互补的双路径过滤范式，明确解耦了结构异常建模和特征相似性建模，在高度异质性和不平衡的欺诈图中能够生成更具判别性和稳定的节点表示。

结论: 在四个真实世界金融欺诈检测数据集上的综合实验证明了所提出方法的有效性。

翻译: 在图数据上的欺诈检测可以被看作是一个需要区分不同类型节点的艰巨任务。由于图神经网络（GNNs）通过消息传递操作自然适合处理以图形式编码的信息，基于GNN模型的方法在欺诈检测领域日益受到关注。然而，欺诈图固有的关系伪装、高异质性和类别不平衡导致大多数GNNs在欺诈检测任务中表现不佳。为了解决这些挑战，本文提出了一种基于图的双路径图过滤模型（DPF-GFD）。DPF-GFD首先应用基于Beta小波的算子对原始图进行操作以捕获关键结构模式。然后，它从基于距离的节点表示构建相似性图，并应用改进的低通滤波器。原始图和相似性图的嵌入通过监督表示学习融合以获得节点特征，最后由集成树模型用于评估未标记节点的欺诈风险。与现有的单图平滑方法不同，DPF-GFD引入了针对欺诈检测定制的频率互补双路径过滤范式，明确解耦了结构异常建模和特征相似性建模。这种设计能够在高度异质性和不平衡的欺诈图中生成更具判别性和稳定的节点表示。在四个真实世界金融欺诈检测数据集上的综合实验证明了所提出方法的有效性。

Abstract

Fraud detection on graph data can be viewed as a demanding task that requires distinguishing between different types of nodes. Because graph neural networks (GNNs) are naturally suited for processing information encoded in graph form through their message-passing operations, methods based on GNN models have increasingly attracted attention in the fraud detection domain. However, fraud graphs inherently exhibit relation camouflage, high heterophily, and class imbalance, causing most GNNs to underperform in fraud detection tasks. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a Graph-Based Fraud Detection Model with Dual-Path Graph Filtering (DPF-GFD). DPF-GFD first applies a beta wavelet-based operator to the original graph to capture key structural patterns. It then constructs a similarity graph from distance-based node representations and applies an improved low-pass filter. The embeddings from the original and similarity graphs are fused through supervised representation learning to obtain node features, which are finally used by an ensemble tree model to assess the fraud risk of unlabeled nodes. Unlike existing single-graph smoothing approaches, DPF-GFD introduces a frequency-complementary dual-path filtering paradigm tailored for fraud detection, explicitly decoupling structural anomaly modeling and feature similarity modeling. This design enables more discriminative and stable node representations in highly heterophilous and imbalanced fraud graphs. Comprehensive experiments on four real-world financial fraud detection datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

item.title: Metric-Aware Principal Component Analysis (MAPCA):A Unified Framework for Scale-Invariant Representation Learning
item.author: Michael Leznik
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了基于广义特征问题的尺度不变表示学习统一框架 Metric-Aware Principal Component Analysis (MAPCA)。

背景: 现有的表示学习方法缺乏统一的几何视角，且难以在标准 PCA 和输出白化之间进行连续控制。

目的: 提出 MAPCA 框架，通过引入度量矩阵 M 来统一多种自监督学习目标，并阐明输入白化和输出白化的区别。

方法: MAPCA 通过求解最大化 Tr(W^T Sigma W) 且满足 W^T M W = I 的广义特征问题实现。文中定义了标准 beta 族度量 M(beta) = Sigma^beta，以及对角度量 M = D = diag(Sigma)。

主要发现: 1. beta 族度量提供了从标准 PCA (beta=0) 到输出白化 (beta=1) 的连续谱偏差控制，且条件数单调递减；2. 对角度量 M = D 恢复了不变 PCA (IPCA)；3. W-MSE 对应于 M = Sigma^{-1} (beta = -1)，位于谱压缩范围之外且与 Barlow Twins 方向相反；4. 尺度不变性要求度量矩阵在缩放下变换为 M_tilde = CMC，IPCA 满足此条件，而一般 beta 族在中间值不满足。

结论: MAPCA 提供了几何语言来统一多种自监督学习目标，揭示了输入白化和输出白化在谱方向上的本质区别，且证明了尺度不变性仅由 IPCA 精确满足。

翻译: 我们介绍了基于广义特征问题的尺度不变表示学习统一框架 Metric-Aware Principal Component Analysis (MAPCA)，该框架通过求解最大化 Tr(W^T Sigma W) 且满足 W^T M W = I 的广义特征问题实现，其中 M 是对称正定度量矩阵。M 的选择决定了表示的几何性质。标准的 beta 族度量 M(beta) = Sigma^beta，其中 beta 在 [0,1] 之间，提供了在标准 PCA (beta=0) 和输出白化 (beta=1) 之间的连续谱偏差控制，其条件数 kappa(beta) = (lambda_1/lambda_p)^(1-beta) 单调递减至各向同性。对角度量 M = D = diag(Sigma) 恢复了不变 PCA (IPCA)，这是一种植根于 Frisch (1928) 对角回归的方法，作为更广泛框架中的一个独特成员。我们证明了当缩放 C 发生时，尺度不变性成立当且仅当度量变换为 M_tilde = CMC，IPCA 满足此条件，而一般的 beta 族在中间值不满足。除了其经典解释外，MAPCA 还提供了一种统一多种自监督学习目标的几何语言。Barlow Twins 和 ZCA 白化对应于 beta=1 (输出白化)；VICReg 的方差项对应于对角度量。一个关键发现是，尽管 W-MSE 被描述为一种基于白化的方法，但它对应于 M = Sigma^{-1} (beta = -1)，完全位于谱压缩范围之外，且与 Barlow Twins 方向相反。这种输入白化和输出白化之间的区别在损失函数层面是不可见的，只有在 MAPCA 框架内才能精确体现。

Abstract

We introduce Metric-Aware Principal Component Analysis (MAPCA), a unified framework for scale-invariant representation learning based on the generalised eigenproblem max Tr(W^T Sigma W) subject to W^T M W = I, where M is a symmetric positive definite metric matrix. The choice of M determines the representation geometry. The canonical beta-family M(beta) = Sigma^beta, beta in [0,1], provides continuous spectral bias control between standard PCA (beta=0) and output whitening (beta=1), with condition number kappa(beta) = (lambda_1/lambda_p)^(1-beta) decreasing monotonically to isotropy. The diagonal metric M = D = diag(Sigma) recovers Invariant PCA (IPCA), a method rooted in Frisch (1928) diagonal regression, as a distinct member of the broader framework. We prove that scale invariance holds if and only if the metric transforms as M_tilde = CMC under rescaling C, a condition satisfied exactly by IPCA but not by the general beta-family at intermediate values. Beyond its classical interpretation, MAPCA provides a geometric language that unifies several self-supervised learning objectives. Barlow Twins and ZCA whitening correspond to beta=1 (output whitening); VICReg's variance term corresponds to the diagonal metric. A key finding is that W-MSE, despite being described as a whitening-based method, corresponds to M = Sigma^{-1} (beta = -1), outside the spectral compression range entirely and in the opposite spectral direction to Barlow Twins. This distinction between input and output whitening is invisible at the level of loss functions and becomes precise only within the MAPCA framework.

item.title: A deep learning framework for glomeruli segmentation with boundary attention
item.author: Behnaz Elhaminia, Catherine King, Jiaqi Lv, Lorraine Harper, Paul Moss, Owen Cain, Dimitrios Chanouzas, Shan E Ahmed Raza
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种新的肾小球检测与分割模型，旨在解决传统深度学习方法在分割相邻肾小球时边界不精确的问题。

背景: 准确检测和分割肾组织中的肾小球对于诊断应用至关重要。传统深度学习方法主要依赖语义分割，但往往难以精确描绘相邻肾小球的边界。

目的: 提出一种强调边界分离的新型肾小球检测与分割模型，以解决相邻肾小球难以精确描绘的问题。

方法: 利用病理学基础模型，提出了一种基于U-Net的架构，其中包含一个专门的注意力解码器，用于突出关键区域并改进实例级分割。

主要发现: 实验评估表明，该方法在Dice系数和交并比方面均超越了最先进的方法，显示出在肾小球描绘方面的优越性能。

结论: 所提出的方法在肾小球描绘方面优于现有的最先进方法。

翻译: 准确检测和分割肾组织中的肾小球对于诊断应用至关重要。传统深度学习方法主要依赖语义分割，这往往无法精确描绘相邻肾小球。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种新的肾小球检测与分割模型，强调边界分离。利用病理学基础模型，所提出的基于U-Net的架构包含一个专门的注意力解码器，用于突出关键区域并改进实例级分割。实验评估表明，该方法在Dice系数和交并比方面均超越了最先进的方法，显示出在肾小球描绘方面的优越性能。

Abstract

Accurate detection and segmentation of glomeruli in kidney tissue are essential for diagnostic applications. Traditional deep learning methods primarily rely on semantic segmentation, which often fails to precisely delineate adjacent glomeruli. To address this challenge, we propose a novel glomerulus detection and segmentation model that emphasises boundary separation. Leveraging pathology foundation models, the proposed U-Net-based architecture incorporates a specialised attention decoder designed to highlight critical regions and improve instancelevel segmentation. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that our approach surpasses state-of-the-art methods in both Dice score and Intersection over Union, indicating superior performance in glomerular delineation.

item.title: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds
item.author: Team HY-World, Chenjie Cao, Xuhui Zuo, Zhenwei Wang, Yisu Zhang, Junta Wu, Zhenyang Liu, Yuning Gong, Yang Liu, Bo Yuan, Chao Zhang, Coopers Li, Dongyuan Guo, Fan Yang, Haiyu Zhang, Hang Cao, Jianchen Zhu, Jiaxin Lin, Jie Xiao, Jihong Zhang, Junlin Yu, Lei Wang, Lifu Wang, Lilin Wang, Linus, Minghui Chen, Peng He, Penghao Zhao, Qi Chen, Rui Chen, Rui Shao, Sicong Liu, Wangchen Qin, Xiaochuan Niu, Xiang Yuan, Yi Sun, Yifei Tang, Yifu Sun, Yihang Lian, Yonghao Tan, Yuhong Liu, Yuyang Yin, Zhiyuan Min, Tengfei Wang, Chunchao Guo
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: HY-World 2.0 是一个多模态世界模型框架，在 HY-World 1.0 的基础上进行了改进，支持多种输入模态并生成 3D 世界表示。

背景: 该框架是对先前项目 HY-World 1.0 的升级和改进。

目的: 为了适应多样化的输入模态，包括文本提示、单视图图像、多视图图像和视频，并生成高保真、可导航的 3D 高斯泼溅场景。

方法: 采用四阶段方法：1) 使用 HY-Pano 2.0 进行全景生成；2) 使用 WorldNav 进行轨迹规划；3) 使用 WorldStereo 2.0 进行世界扩展；4) 使用 WorldMirror 进行世界合成。此外，还引入了 WorldLens 渲染平台。

主要发现: 在多个基准测试中，HY-World 2.0 在开源方法中达到了最先进的性能，结果与闭源模型 Marble 相当。

结论: 作者发布了所有模型权重、代码和技术细节，以促进可复现性并支持 3D 世界模型的进一步研究。

翻译: 我们介绍了 HY-World 2.0，这是一个多模态世界模型框架，推进了我们之前的项目 HY-World 1.0。HY-World 2.0 适应多样化的输入模态，包括文本提示、单视图图像、多视图图像和视频，并产生 3D 世界表示。使用文本或单视图图像输入时，模型执行世界生成，合成高保真、可导航的 3D 高斯泼溅场景。这是通过四个阶段的方法实现的：a) 使用 HY-Pano 2.0 进行全景生成，b) 使用 WorldNav 进行轨迹规划，c) 使用 WorldStereo 2.0 进行世界扩展，以及 d) 使用 WorldMirror 进行世界合成。具体来说，我们引入了关键创新来增强全景保真度，实现 3D 场景理解和规划，并升级了我们的基于关键帧的视图生成模型 WorldStereo，具有一致的内存。我们还通过完善模型架构和学习策略升级了 WorldMirror，这是一个用于通用 3D 预测的前馈模型，使其能够从多视图图像或视频中进行世界重建。此外，我们引入了 WorldLens，一个高性能的 3DGS 渲染平台，具有灵活的引擎无关架构、自动 IBL 照明、高效的碰撞检测和训练渲染协同设计，支持角色交互的 3D 世界探索。广泛的实验表明，HY-World 2.0 在几个基准测试中达到了开源方法中的最先进性能，结果与闭源模型 Marble 相当。我们发布了所有模型权重、代码和技术细节，以促进可复现性并支持 3D 世界模型的进一步研究。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决现有3D世界模型在生成和重建任务上分离的问题。生成式方法擅长从文本或单图合成场景，但难以保证重建精度；而重建式方法能精确还原结构，却缺乏生成未见区域的先验。这个问题很重要，因为机器人仿真、游戏开发等应用需要既能生成逼真场景又能精确还原物理世界的统一模型，HY-World 2.0正是首个开源的此类统一框架。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到现有3D世界建模方法通常只专注于生成或重建，导致两者存在差距。因此，他们设计了一个统一框架，将“生成”和“重建”结合到离线3D世界模型中。该方法采用四阶段流程：全景生成、轨迹规划、世界扩展和世界合成。作者借鉴了之前的HY-World 1.0和HY-World 1.5项目，并使用了来自先驱[72]的闭源模型作为对比基准，同时采用了来自先驱[67, 10, 23, 50]的场景解析技术。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法是第一个开源的多模态世界模型框架，旨在弥合“想象生成”与“物理重建”之间的差距。它接受文本、单视图图像、多视图图像和视频等多种输入，同时支持从稀疏输入生成高保真 3D 世界，以及从密集输入恢复精确的 3D 结构。整体实现流程分为四个阶段：首先通过全景生成将输入转化为高保真全景图；接着进行轨迹规划以确定探索路径；随后利用记忆机制进行世界扩展，生成多视角视图；最后通过世界合成和 3D 高斯泼溅技术构建最终的 3D 世界。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一个统一生成与重建的多模态世界模型框架，包含全景生成、轨迹规划、世界扩展和世界合成四个阶段。相比之前的工作，它填补了开源社区在统一生成与重建方面的空白，通过升级 HY-Pano 2.0、WorldNav、WorldStereo 2.0 和 WorldMirror 2.0 等组件，显著提升了全景保真度、场景理解能力和重建精度。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了HY-World 2.0，这是一个开源的多模态世界模型框架，首次统一了3D世界的生成与重建任务，支持从文本或单视图图像生成高保真场景，也能从多视图输入恢复精确结构。

Abstract

We introduce HY-World 2.0, a multi-modal world model framework that advances our prior project HY-World 1.0. HY-World 2.0 accommodates diverse input modalities, including text prompts, single-view images, multi-view images, and videos, and produces 3D world representations. With text or single-view image inputs, the model performs world generation, synthesizing high-fidelity, navigable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes. This is achieved through a four-stage method: a) Panorama Generation with HY-Pano 2.0, b) Trajectory Planning with WorldNav, c) World Expansion with WorldStereo 2.0, and d) World Composition with WorldMirror 2.0. Specifically, we introduce key innovations to enhance panorama fidelity, enable 3D scene understanding and planning, and upgrade WorldStereo, our keyframe-based view generation model with consistent memory. We also upgrade WorldMirror, a feed-forward model for universal 3D prediction, by refining model architecture and learning strategy, enabling world reconstruction from multi-view images or videos. Also, we introduce WorldLens, a high-performance 3DGS rendering platform featuring a flexible engine-agnostic architecture, automatic IBL lighting, efficient collision detection, and training-rendering co-design, enabling interactive exploration of 3D worlds with character support. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HY-World 2.0 achieves state-of-the-art performance on several benchmarks among open-source approaches, delivering results comparable to the closed-source model Marble. We release all model weights, code, and technical details to facilitate reproducibility and support further research on 3D world models.

item.title: Geometrically Consistent Multi-View Scene Generation from Freehand Sketches
item.author: Ahmed Bourouis, Savas Ozkan, Andrea Maracani, Yi-Zhe Song, Mete Ozay
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种从单张自由手绘草图生成几何一致多视图场景的新方法，通过引入并行相机感知注意力适配器和稀疏对应监督损失，在无需参考图像或迭代优化的情况下实现了高效且高质量的场景重建。

背景: 自由手绘草图是最几何贫乏的输入之一，它们通过抽象线条传达场景意图，同时引入了与任何一致3D解释相冲突的空间扭曲。现有的多视图方法需要照片或文本，而草图到3D的方法需要多个视图或昂贵的逐场景优化。

目的: 解决从单张自由手绘草图生成几何一致多视图场景的问题，应对缺乏训练数据、从扭曲2D输入进行几何推理以及跨视图一致性这三个叠加挑战。

方法: 1. 构建了一个包含约9000个草图到多视图样本的精选数据集，通过自动化生成和过滤管道完成；2. 引入了并行相机感知注意力适配器，将几何归纳偏置注入视频Transformer；3. 提出了基于运动恢复结构重建的稀疏对应监督损失。

主要发现: 该方法在单次去噪过程中合成所有视图，无需参考图像、迭代细化或逐场景优化。相比最先进的两阶段基线，在真实感上提高了60%以上，在几何一致性上提高了23%，并提供了高达3.7倍的推理速度提升。

结论: 该方法显著优于现有的两阶段基线，实现了从单张草图快速生成高质量、几何一致的多视图场景。

翻译: 本文提出了一种从单张自由手绘草图生成几何一致多视图场景的新方法，通过引入并行相机感知注意力适配器和稀疏对应监督损失，在无需参考图像或迭代优化的情况下实现了高效且高质量的场景重建。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决从单张手绘草图生成几何一致多视图场景的问题。手绘草图是几何信息最贫乏的输入，包含非线性扭曲和噪声，往往与3D解释冲突。现有方法要么需要照片或文本，要么需要多个视图或昂贵的优化。这个问题在研究中很重要，因为这是首个尝试从单张手绘场景草图生成几何一致多视图输出的方法，填补了空白。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对从单张手绘草图生成几何一致多视图这一新问题，识别出缺乏数据、几何推理和跨视图一致性三大挑战。他们设计了一个包含数据集构建、相机感知注意力适配器（CA3）和稀疏对应监督损失（CSL）的框架。该方法借鉴了Wan 2.1视频扩散Transformer作为骨干网络，使用了PRoPE进行几何编码，并利用SfM提取的对应关系进行监督。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用几何归纳偏置和监督信号，使生成模型能够从单张扭曲的手绘草图推断出连贯的3D场景结构，并在单次去噪过程中直接生成所有视图。整体实现流程包括：首先通过自动化流程构建包含约9000个样本的数据集；然后将视频扩散变换器与轻量级的相机感知注意力适配器结合，并利用稀疏对应监督损失进行训练；最后输入草图，模型在单个去噪步骤中直接生成所有视图，无需参考图像或逐场景优化。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点包括：一是构建了一个包含约9000个样本的草图到多视图数据集；二是提出了并行相机感知注意力适配器（CA3），将几何归纳偏置注入到视频扩散模型中；三是引入了基于结构运动（SfM）的稀疏对应监督损失（CSL）。相比之前的工作，该方法能够仅凭单张手绘草图生成几何一致的多视图场景，无需参考照片、迭代优化或逐场景优化，且显著提升了真实感和几何一致性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 这篇论文提出了一种从单张手绘草图生成几何一致多视图场景的新方法。通过构建包含约 9k 样本的数据集，并引入相机感知注意力适配器和稀疏对应监督损失，模型能够在单次去噪过程中生成高质量且几何一致的多视图图像。

Abstract

We tackle a new problem: generating geometrically consistent multi-view scenes from a single freehand sketch. Freehand sketches are the most geometrically impoverished input one could offer a multi-view generator. They convey scene intent through abstract strokes while introducing spatial distortions that actively conflict with any consistent 3D interpretation. No prior method attempts this; existing multi-view approaches require photographs or text, while sketch-to-3D methods need multiple views or costly per-scene optimisation. We address three compounding challenges; absent training data, the need for geometric reasoning from distorted 2D input, and cross-view consistency, through three mutually reinforcing contributions: (i) a curated dataset of $\sim$9k sketch-to-multiview samples, constructed via an automated generation and filtering pipeline; (ii) Parallel Camera-Aware Attention Adapters (CA3) that inject geometric inductive biases into the video transformer; and (iii) a Sparse Correspondence Supervision Loss (CSL) derived from Structure-from-Motion reconstructions. Our framework synthesizes all views in a single denoising process without requiring reference images, iterative refinement, or per-scene optimization. Our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art two-stage baselines, improving realism (FID) by over 60% and geometric consistency (Corr-Acc) by 23%, while providing up to a 3.7$\times$ inference speedup.

item.title: Digital Guardians: The Past and The Future of Cyber-Physical Resilience
item.author: Saurabh Bagchi, Hyunseung Kim, Tarek Abdelzaher, Homa Alemzadeh, Somali Chaterji, Glen Chou, Yuying Duan, Fanxin Kong, Michael Lemmon, Yin Li, Mengyu Liu, Wenhao Luo, Meiyi Ma, Sibin Mohan, Ayan Mukhopadhyay, Melkior Ornik, Dimitra Panagou, Kristin Yvonne Rozier, Ivan Ruchkin, Huajie Shao, Sze Zheng Yong, Majid Zamani, Xugui Zhou
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该综述文章通过五个相互关联的主题，全面探讨了网络物理系统的韧性，旨在为在日益复杂和对抗性环境中实现具有韧性的网络物理系统提供系统性路线图。

背景: 网络物理系统的韧性是指系统在面临安全攻击、环境干扰或软硬件故障等不利“扰动”时，维持安全和关键功能的基本能力。

目的: 提供关于网络物理系统韧性的全面综述，通过五个相互关联的主题构建该领域，并展示代表性应用领域以提供实现韧性的系统性路线图。

方法: 文章通过五个相互关联的主题来构建该领域，包括：1. 系统级属性（硬件、软件和人类用户之间的相互作用）；2. 针对数据稀缺环境的学习型网络物理系统的挑战及解决方案；3. 韧性的主动措施（验证、测试和冗余）；4. 恢复机制（超越传统故障模型，设计“足够好”的恢复策略）；5. 人类在其中的中心作用（干预级别、信任校准和可解释AI）。

主要发现: 韧性是一个从硬件、软件和人类用户相互作用中涌现的系统级属性；学习型网络物理系统常面临数据稀缺、数据不平衡或噪声问题，需要合成数据生成和基础模型适应等创新解决方案；恢复机制应优先考虑安全关键功能；人类在网络物理系统韧性中扮演中心角色，需要信任校准和可解释AI来支持人机协作。

结论: 通过整合这五个相互关联的主题，该综述为在日益复杂和对抗性环境中实现具有韧性的网络物理系统提供了系统性路线图。

翻译: Resilience in cyber-physical systems (CPS) is the fundamental ability to maintain safety and critical functionality despite adverse 'perturbations,' which includes security attacks, environmental disruptions, and hardware or software failures. This survey provides a comprehensive review of CPS resilience, framing the field through five interconnected themes that are required in an integrated whole to achieve real-world resilience. The article first posits that resilience is a system-wide property emerging from interactions between hardware, software, and human users. Second, it addresses the challenges of learning-enabled CPS, which often operate in data-scarce environments characterized by imbalanced or noisy data, requiring innovative solutions like synthetic data generation and foundation model adaptation. Third, the survey examines proactive measures for resilience, which include distinctive aspects of verification, testing, and redundancy. Fourth, it explores recovery mechanisms, moving beyond traditional fault models to design 'just good enough' recovery strategies that prioritize safety-critical functions during perturbations. Finally, it highlights the central role of the human, focusing on the different levels of human intervention, the necessity of trust calibration, and the requirement for explainable AI to support human-CPS teaming. These themes are illustrated through representative application domains, primarily Connected and Autonomous Transportation Systems (CATS) and Medical CPS (MCPS). By integrating the five interconnected themes, this survey provides a systematic roadmap for achieving the resilient CPS in increasingly complex and adversarial environments.

Abstract

Resilience in cyber-physical systems (CPS) is the fundamental ability to maintain safety and critical functionality despite adverse "perturbations," which includes security attacks, environmental disruptions, and hardware or software failures. This survey provides a comprehensive review of CPS resilience, framing the field through five interconnected themes that are required in an integrated whole to achieve real-world resilience. The article first posits that resilience is a system-wide property emerging from interactions between hardware, software, and human users. Second, it addresses the challenges of learning-enabled CPS, which often operate in data-scarce environments characterized by imbalanced or noisy data, requiring innovative solutions like synthetic data generation and foundation model adaptation. Third, the survey examines proactive measures for resilience, which include distinctive aspects of verification, testing, and redundancy. Fourth, it explores recovery mechanisms, moving beyond traditional fault models to design "just good enough" recovery strategies that prioritize safety-critical functions during perturbations. Finally, it highlights the central role of the human, focusing on the different levels of human intervention, the necessity of trust calibration, and the requirement for explainable AI to support human-CPS teaming. These themes are illustrated through representative application domains, primarily Connected and Autonomous Transportation Systems (CATS) and Medical CPS (MCPS). By integrating the five interconnected themes, this survey provides a systematic roadmap for achieving the resilient CPS in increasingly complex and adversarial environments.

item.title: APEX-MEM: Agentic Semi-Structured Memory with Temporal Reasoning for Long-Term Conversational AI
item.author: Pratyay Banerjee, Masud Moshtaghi, Shivashankar Subramanian, Amita Misra, Ankit Chadha
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: APEX-MEM是一个结合了三种关键创新的对话记忆系统，旨在解决大语言模型在长期对话记忆方面的挑战。

背景: 大语言模型在长期对话记忆方面仍面临困难，简单的扩大上下文窗口或应用朴素检索往往会引入噪声并导致响应不稳定。

目的: 提出APEX-MEM系统，以实现更可靠、更稳定的长期对话记忆，并提高对话推理的时间连贯性。

方法: APEX-MEM系统包含三个关键创新：1) 使用领域无关本体构建对话的属性图；2) 仅追加存储以保留信息的完整时间演变；3) 多工具检索代理，在查询时理解和解决冲突或演变的信息。

主要发现: 在LOCOMO的问答任务上达到88.88%的准确率，在LongMemEval上达到86.2%，优于现有的会话感知方法。

结论: 结构化的属性图能够实现更时间连贯的长期对话推理，证明了APEX-MEM的有效性。

翻译: Large language models still struggle with reliable long-term conversational memory: simply enlarging context windows or applying naive retrieval often introduces noise and destabilizes responses. We present APEX-MEM, a conversational memory system that combines three key innovations: (1) a property graph which uses domain-agnostic ontology to structure conversations as temporally grounded events in an entity-centric framework, (2) append-only storage that preserves the full temporal evolution of information, and (3) a multi-tool retrieval agent that understands and resolves conflicting or evolving information at query time, producing a compact and contextually relevant memory summary. This retrieval-time resolution preserves the full interaction history while suppressing irrelevant details. APEX-MEM achieves 88.88% accuracy on LOCOMO's Question Answering task and 86.2% on LongMemEval, outperforming state-of-the-art session-aware approaches and demonstrating that structured property graphs enable more temporally coherent long-term conversational reasoning.

Abstract

Large language models still struggle with reliable long-term conversational memory: simply enlarging context windows or applying naive retrieval often introduces noise and destabilizes responses. We present APEX-MEM, a conversational memory system that combines three key innovations: (1) a property graph which uses domain-agnostic ontology to structure conversations as temporally grounded events in an entity-centric framework, (2) append-only storage that preserves the full temporal evolution of information, and (3) a multi-tool retrieval agent that understands and resolves conflicting or evolving information at query time, producing a compact and contextually relevant memory summary. This retrieval-time resolution preserves the full interaction history while suppressing irrelevant details. APEX-MEM achieves 88.88% accuracy on LOCOMO's Question Answering task and 86.2% on LongMemEval, outperforming state-of-the-art session-aware approaches and demonstrating that structured property graphs enable more temporally coherent long-term conversational reasoning.

item.title: BIEVR-LIO: Robust LiDAR-Inertial Odometry through Bump-Image-Enhanced Voxel Maps
item.author: Patrick Pfreundschuh, Turcan Tuna, Cedric Le Gentil, Roland Siegwart, Cesar Cadena, Helen Oleynikova
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: BIEVR-LIO是一种利用几何细微变化提高移动机器人激光-惯性里程计鲁棒性的新方法。

背景: 移动机器人进入更具挑战性的环境，这些环境通常包含很少的信息来约束点云配准，导致激光-惯性里程计（LIO）精度下降甚至发散。

目的: 利用可用几何的细微变化来提高鲁棒性。

方法: 提出了一种高分辨率地图表示，将表面存储为紧凑的体素方向高度图像；提出了一种地图引导的点采样策略，以专注于几何信息丰富的区域。

主要发现: 在多个传感器、平台和环境中的实验表明，在约束良好的场景中具有最先进的性能，并在基线方法发散的挑战性场景中有显著改进。此外，BIEVR-LIO捕获的细粒度几何可用于机器人运动等下游任务。

结论: BIEVR-LIO在具有挑战性的环境中显著提高了鲁棒性，并减少了计算成本。

翻译: 摘要：可靠的里程计对于移动机器人至关重要，因为它们越来越多地进入更具挑战性的环境，这些环境通常包含很少的信息来约束点云配准，导致激光-惯性里程计（LIO）精度下降甚至发散。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了BIEVR-LIO，这是一种专门设计用于利用可用几何的细微变化以提高鲁棒性的新方法。我们提出了一种高分辨率地图表示，将表面存储为紧凑的体素方向高度图像。这种表示可以直接用于配准，而无需计算中间几何原语，同时仍支持高效更新。由于信息丰富的几何通常在环境中稀疏分布，我们进一步提出了一种地图引导的点采样策略，以将配准集中在几何信息丰富的区域，从而在不信息丰富的环境中提高鲁棒性，并减少与全局高分辨率采样相比的计算成本。在多个传感器、平台和环境中的实验表明，在约束良好的场景中具有最先进的性能，并在基线方法发散的挑战性场景中有显著改进。此外，我们证明了BIEVR-LIO捕获的细粒度几何可用于机器人运动等下游任务。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是在几何上信息不足的环境中，LiDAR-惯性里程计（LIO）精度下降甚至发散的问题。在直隧道或平坦地形等缺乏显著几何特征的地方，现有方法往往无法利用微小的几何细节来保持稳定。这个问题很重要，因为机器人正进入更具挑战性的环境，LIO的鲁棒性对于可靠导航至关重要。该研究在现有基线失效的场景中实现了最先进的性能，并支持步态规划等下游任务。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到在几何信息贫乏的环境中，现有系统因缺乏分辨率而无法利用微妙的几何变化，因此设计了一种新的地图表示（BIEVR），将局部表面几何存储为2D高度图像以保留细节，并提出地图感知的点采样策略来关注信息丰富的区域。在借鉴方面，他们参考了CURL-SLAM的高度图像投影和注册范式，但CURL-SLAM使用谐波拟合（计算昂贵且平滑），而作者显式存储高分辨率图像，实现高效更新和常数时间查找，同时保留锐利不连续性。他们也借鉴了基于Hessian的采样概念，但使用轻量级度量来避免计算成本。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用体素方向高度图像来紧凑地存储微小的几何细节，并结合地图感知的采样策略来关注信息丰富的区域，从而在几何信息贫乏的环境中提高鲁棒性。整体实现流程包括：首先利用IMU积分对激光点云进行去畸变并获取初始位姿；接着采用地图感知的采样策略选取关键点；随后直接在BIEVR表示上进行扫描到地图的配准；最后优化速度、重力和IMU偏差，并利用所有扫描点高效更新地图。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点包括提出了一种高分辨率的体素地图表示，将表面存储为体素方向高度图像，以及一种地图引导的双分辨率点采样策略。相比之前的工作，BIEVR 显式地跟踪相对于主导平面的偏差，保留了细微的几何梯度，而不是假设平面或高斯近似；同时，它利用地图引导的采样来关注几何信息丰富的区域，从而在无需额外传感器或密集数据的情况下提高鲁棒性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为BIEVR-LIO的激光惯性里程计方法，通过利用高分辨率体素方向高度图像地图表示和地图感知的点采样策略，显著提升了系统在几何信息稀疏环境下的鲁棒性。

Abstract

Reliable odometry is essential for mobile robots as they increasingly enter more challenging environments, which often contain little information to constrain point cloud registration, resulting in degraded LiDAR-Inertial Odometry (LIO) accuracy or even divergence. To address this, we present BIEVR-LIO, a novel approach designed specifically to exploit subtle variations in the available geometry for improved robustness. We propose a high-resolution map representation that stores surfaces as compact voxel-wise oriented height images. This representation can directly be used for registration without the calculation of intermediate geometric primitives while still supporting efficient updates. Since informative geometry is often sparsely distributed in the environment, we further propose a map-informed point sampling strategy to focus registration on geometrically informative regions, improving robustness in uninformative environments while reducing computational cost compared to global high-resolution sampling. Experiments across multiple sensors, platforms, and environments demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in well-constrained scenes and substantial improvements in challenging scenarios where baseline methods diverge. Additionally, we demonstrate that the fine-grained geometry captured by BIEVR-LIO can be used for downstream tasks such as elevation mapping for robot locomotion.

item.title: Three-Phase Transformer
item.author: Mohammad R. Abu Ayyash
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Three-Phase Transformer (3PT) 是一种基于解码器架构的 Transformer 模型，通过残差流结构先验来提升性能。

背景: 3PT 在标准的 SwiGLU + RMSNorm + RoPE + GQA 架构上运行。

目的: 通过引入残差流结构先验来改进解码器架构。

方法: 将隐藏向量划分为 N 个等大小的循环通道，每个通道由相位感知操作维护，包括通道 RMSNorm、在注意力机制和前馈网络之间进行 2D Givens 旋转以及将 GQA 头与分区对齐的头部计数约束。此外，通过注入固定的 Gabriel 喇叭剖面 r(p) = 1/(p+1) 来注入一个垂直于通道的一维直流子空间。

主要发现: 在 WikiText-103 数据集上，3PT 在仅增加 1,536 个参数的情况下，实现了比仅使用 RoPE 的基线模型低 7.20% 的困惑度。3PT 在步数收敛速度上比基线快 1.93 倍，在墙钟时间上快 1.64 倍。N 值表现为一个参数共享旋钮而非唯一最优值；在 5.5M 参数时，N=1 胜出；在 123M 参数时，N=3 和 N=1 在统计上不可区分。

结论: 3PT 的负载机制是通道划分的残差流、每块旋转、每相位归一化和喇叭直流注入。该架构在几何上实现了无需显式强制执行的自稳定，与 RoPE、注意力和前馈网络具有正交组合性。

翻译: 我们提出了三阶段变压器，这是一种针对标准 SwiGLU + RMSNorm + RoPE + GQA 骨干网络的解码器架构的残差流结构先验。隐藏向量被划分为 N 个等大小的循环通道，每个通道由相位感知操作维护：通道 RMSNorm、在注意力和前馈网络之间进行 2D Givens 旋转，该旋转将每个通道旋转 theta + i*(2*pi/N)，以及将 GQA 头与分区对齐的头部计数约束。该架构是在打乱和重新定位之间的自稳定平衡，而不是一个附加的模块。该分区切出了一条垂直于通道的一维直流子空间，我们向其中注入了一个固定的 Gabriel 喇叭剖面 r(p) = 1/(p+1)，作为一个与 RoPE 的相对位置旋转正交组合的绝对位置侧通道。标准的 N=3 借用了平衡三相交流电的隐喻，其中三个相隔 120 度的正弦波相加为零，且没有反相关对。在 123M 参数的 WikiText-103 上，3PT 在仅增加 1,536 个参数（总参数的 0.00124%）的情况下，比匹配的 RoPE-Only 基线实现了 -7.20% 的困惑度（-2.62% 每字节比特），并且收敛速度提高了 1.93 倍（墙钟时间 1.64 倍）。N 表现为参数共享旋钮而非唯一最优值：在 5.5M 时，对 {1,2,3,4,6,8,12} 的 N 扫描几乎是单调的，N=1 获胜；在 123M 时，三次种子扫描发现 N=3 和 N=1 在统计上不可区分。负载机制是通道划分的残差流、每块旋转、每相位归一化和喇叭直流注入。我们表征了（a）无需显式强制执行的自稳定几何，这是神经网络守恒定律框架的一个新实例；（b）在 12 层时的旋转角度漂移的 U 形深度剖面；（c）与 RoPE、注意力和前馈网络的正交组合。

Abstract

We present Three-Phase Transformer (3PT), a residual-stream structural prior for decoder-only Transformers on a standard SwiGLU + RMSNorm + RoPE + GQA backbone. The hidden vector is partitioned into N equally-sized cyclic channels, each maintained by phase-respecting ops: a per-channel RMSNorm, a 2D Givens rotation between attention and FFN that rotates each channel by theta + i*(2*pi/N), and a head-count constraint aligning GQA heads with the partition. The architecture is a self-stabilizing equilibrium between scrambling and re-imposition, not a bolted-on module. The partition carves out a one-dimensional DC subspace orthogonal to the channels, into which we inject a fixed Gabriel's horn profile r(p) = 1/(p+1) as an absolute-position side-channel composing orthogonally with RoPE's relative-position rotation. The canonical N=3 borrows its metaphor from balanced three-phase AC, where three sinusoids 120 degrees apart sum to zero with no anti-correlated pair. At 123M parameters on WikiText-103, 3PT achieves -7.20% perplexity (-2.62% bits-per-byte) over a matched RoPE-Only baseline at +1,536 parameters (0.00124% of total), with 1.93x step-count convergence speedup (1.64x wall-clock). N behaves as a parameter-sharing knob rather than a unique optimum: at 5.5M an N-sweep over {1,2,3,4,6,8,12} is near-monotone with N=1 winning; at 123M a three-seed sweep finds N=3 and N=1 statistically indistinguishable. The load-bearing mechanism is the channel-partitioned residual stream, per-block rotation, per-phase normalization, and horn DC injection. We characterize (a) self-stabilization of the geometry without explicit enforcement, a novel instance of the conservation-law framework for neural networks; (b) a U-shaped depth profile of rotation-angle drift at 12 layers; (c) orthogonal composition with RoPE, attention, and FFN.

item.title: Batch Effects In Brain Foundation Model Embeddings
item.author: Ye Tao, Bradley T. Baker, Yu Wu, Anand D. Sarwate, Sandeep Panta, Sergey Plis, Vince D. Calhoun
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究系统评估了两个神经影像基础模型在多站点fMRI数据集上的表现，发现基础模型嵌入中包含大量批次相关变异，并探讨了 harmonization 对此的影响，指出 BrainLM 倾向于捕捉细粒度区域活动，而 SwiFT 倾向于表示区域间交互。

背景: 基础模型在大型高维生物医学应用中显示出强大潜力，但其在捕捉相关神经生物学特征方面的能力仍被探索不足。

目的: 系统评估两个神经影像基础模型在多站点fMRI数据集上的嵌入表现，并研究 harmonization 如何影响这些嵌入。

方法: 使用综合评估框架，在多站点fMRI数据集上评估来自 BrainLM 和 SwiFT 两个神经影像基础模型的嵌入。

主要发现: 基础模型嵌入编码了大量的批次相关变异，往往在异质数据集中主导诊断相关信息；BrainLM 倾向于捕捉细粒度区域活动，而 SwiFT 倾向于表示区域间交互。

结论: 强调了在基础模型中考虑批次效应的重要性，并激励未来研究将生物学有意义的信号与采集相关变异分离开来。

翻译: Foundation models show strong potential for large-scale, high-dimensional biomedical applications, yet their ability to capture relevant neurobiological characteristics remains underexplored. We systematically evaluate embeddings from two neuroimaging foundation models, BrainLM and SwiFT, across multi-site fMRI datasets using a comprehensive evaluation framework. Our results show that foundation model embeddings encode substantial batch-related variability, often dominating diagnosis-related information across heterogeneous datasets. We further investigate how harmonization, applied to reduce batch effects, influences these embeddings. In addition, we find that BrainLM prefers to capture fine-grained regional activity, whereas SwiFT tends to represent interactions between regions, consistent with their respective model architectures. Our study highlights the importance of accounting for batch effects in foundation models and motivates future work on disentangling biologically meaningful signals from acquisition-related variability.

Abstract

Foundation models show strong potential for large-scale, high-dimensional biomedical applications, yet their ability to capture relevant neurobiological characteristics remains underexplored. We systematically evaluate embeddings from two neuroimaging foundation models, BrainLM and SwiFT, across multi-site fMRI datasets using a comprehensive evaluation framework. Our results show that foundation model embeddings encode substantial batch-related variability, often dominating diagnosis-related information across heterogeneous datasets. We further investigate how harmonization, applied to reduce batch effects, influences these embeddings. In addition, we find that BrainLM prefers to capture fine-grained regional activity, whereas SwiFT tends to represent interactions between regions, consistent with their respective model architectures. Our study highlights the importance of accounting for batch effects in foundation models and motivates future work on disentangling biologically meaningful signals from acquisition-related variability.

item.title: Co-distilled attention guided masked image modeling with noisy teacher for self-supervised learning on medical images
item.author: Jue Jiang, Aneesh Rangnekar, Harini Veeraraghavan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为DAGMaN的框架，用于在医学图像的自监督学习中解决掩码图像建模中的信息泄露和注意力头多样性降低的问题。

背景: 掩码图像建模是提取未标注数据有用特征表示的有效自监督学习方法，但随机掩码方法在医学图像中因邻近补丁的上下文相似性导致信息泄露和自监督学习简化。此外，层级移动窗口（Swin）Transformer虽然有效，但无法使用高级掩码方法，因为它缺乏全局[CLS]令牌。

目的: 引入注意力引导的掩码机制，在共蒸馏学习框架内选择性掩码语义共现和判别性补丁，以减少信息泄露并增加自监督学习预训练的难度。同时，为了解决注意力引导掩码不可避免地降低注意力头多样性从而影响下游任务性能的问题，首次将噪声教师整合到共蒸馏框架中。

方法: 提出了DAGMaN框架，该框架在共蒸馏学习框架内结合了注意力引导的掩码机制和噪声教师，以在执行注意力引导掩码的同时保持高注意力头多样性。

主要发现: 在包括全样本和少样本肺结节分类、免疫治疗结果预测、肿瘤分割和无监督器官聚类在内的多个任务中展示了DAGMaN的能力。

结论: DAGMaN框架能够有效减少信息泄露，增加预训练难度，并保持高注意力头多样性，从而提升下游任务性能。

翻译: Masked image modeling (MIM) is a highly effective self-supervised learning (SSL) approach to extract useful feature representations from unannotated data. Predominantly used random masking methods make SSL less effective for medical images due to the contextual similarity of neighboring patches, leading to information leakage and SSL simplification. Hierarchical shifted window (Swin) transformer, a highly effective approach for medical images cannot use advanced masking methods as it lacks a global [CLS] token. Hence, we introduced an attention guided masking mechanism for Swin within a co-distillation learning framework to selectively mask semantically co-occurring and discriminative patches, to reduce information leakage and increase the difficulty of SSL pretraining. However, attention guided masking inevitably reduces the diversity of attention heads, which negatively impacts downstream task performance. To address this, we for the first time, integrate a noisy teacher into the co-distillation framework (termed DAGMaN) that performs attentive masking while preserving high attention head diversity. We demonstrate the capability of DAGMaN on multiple tasks including full- and few-shot lung nodule classification, immunotherapy outcome prediction, tumor segmentation, and unsupervised organs clustering.

Abstract

Masked image modeling (MIM) is a highly effective self-supervised learning (SSL) approach to extract useful feature representations from unannotated data. Predominantly used random masking methods make SSL less effective for medical images due to the contextual similarity of neighboring patches, leading to information leakage and SSL simplification. Hierarchical shifted window (Swin) transformer, a highly effective approach for medical images cannot use advanced masking methods as it lacks a global [CLS] token. Hence, we introduced an attention guided masking mechanism for Swin within a co-distillation learning framework to selectively mask semantically co-occurring and discriminative patches, to reduce information leakage and increase the difficulty of SSL pretraining. However, attention guided masking inevitably reduces the diversity of attention heads, which negatively impacts downstream task performance. To address this, we for the first time, integrate a noisy teacher into the co-distillation framework (termed DAGMaN) that performs attentive masking while preserving high attention head diversity. We demonstrate the capability of DAGMaN on multiple tasks including full- and few-shot lung nodule classification, immunotherapy outcome prediction, tumor segmentation, and unsupervised organs clustering.

item.title: Perspective on Bias in Biomedical AI: Preventing Downstream Healthcare Disparities
item.author: Michal Rosen-Zvi, Yoav Kan-Tor, Michael Danziger, Agata Ferretti, Javier Aula-Blasco, Julia Falcao, Ron Shamir, Mordechai Muszkat
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了生物医学领域早期阶段的数据收集和研究优先级中存在的偏见问题，并提出了通过社区关注三个基础原则来改善生物医学AI公平性和鲁棒性的方法。

背景: 医疗保健差异往往归因于筛查、诊断和治疗的不平等获取，但本文指出这种不平等在数据收集和研究优先级阶段就已经存在，特别是在分子层面的研究中。

目的: 为了改善生物医学AI的公平性和鲁棒性，促进更有效地服务于弱势群体的生物医学创新，并改善健康结果。

方法: 对2015年至2024年间发表的4719篇PubMed索引的组学出版物进行了自动化分析，并对大型数据集如CellxGene和GEO进行了分析。

主要发现: 只有一小部分研究报告了祖先或种族信息，且报告情况略有改善；大型数据集中存在显著的群体偏见，欧洲血统数据占主导地位；生物医学基础模型可能会延续或放大这些早期阶段的偏见。

结论: 通过社区关注三个基础原则：来源、开放性和评估透明度，可以改善生物医学AI的公平性和鲁棒性。

翻译: 摘要：健康差异在社会经济界限之间持续存在，通常归因于筛查、诊断和治疗的不平等获取。然而，这种观点强调，在数据收集和研究优先级阶段，特别是在研究重点和数据收集处于分子层面的情况下，关键偏见可能在临床实施之前很久就已经出现。大量研究专注于收集组学数据，但与这些数据集相关的人口统计学信息通常不在研究中报告，即使报告了，也显示出很大的偏见。对2015年至2024年间发表的4719篇PubMed索引的组学出版物进行的自动化分析显示，只有一小部分报告了祖先或种族信息，且报告情况略有改善。对用于模型训练的大型数据集（如CellxGene和GEO）的分析显示，存在显著的群体偏见，欧洲血统数据占主导地位。随着生物医学基础模型成为生物医学发现的核心，它们面临的风险是延续或放大这些早期阶段的偏见，导致监管干预无法完全逆转的级联不平等。我们提出了社区对三个基础原则的关注：来源、开放性和评估透明度，以提高生物医学AI的公平性和鲁棒性。这种方法旨在促进更有效地服务于弱势群体的生物医学创新并改善健康结果。

Abstract

Healthcare disparities persist across socioeconomic boundaries, often attributed to unequal access to screening, diagnostics, and therapeutics. However, this perspective highlights that critical biases can emerge much earlier, during data collection and research prioritization, long before clinical implementation in cases where the focus of the studies and the data that is collected is at the molecular level. A vast number of studies focus on collecting omics data but the demographic information associated with these datasets is often not reported in the studies, and when it is reported, it shows big biases. An automated analysis of 4719 PubMed-indexed omics publications from 2015 to 2024 reveals that only a small fraction report ancestry or ethnicity information, with ancestry reporting improving slightly. Analysis of large-scale datasets commonly used for model training, such as CellxGene and GEO, reveals substantial population bias where European-ancestry data dominates. As biomedical foundation models become central to biomedical discovery with a paradigm in which base models are pretrained on large datasets and reusing them time and again for many different downstream tasks, they risk perpetuating or amplifying these early-stage biases, leading to cascading inequities that regulatory interventions cannot fully reverse. We propose a community-wide focus on three foundational principles: Provenance, Openness, and Evaluation Transparency to improve equity and robustness in biomedical AI. This approach aims to foster biomedical innovation that more effectively serves underserved populations and improves health outcomes.

item.title: TRACER: Trace-Based Adaptive Cost-Efficient Routing for LLM Classification
item.author: Adam Rida
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TRACER是一个开源系统，通过在LLM的生产日志上训练轻量级ML代理来吸收未来流量，并在代理与LLM一致度超过阈值时激活。

背景: LLM分类端点的每次调用都会产生保留在生产日志中的标记输入输出对，这些对构成了一个免费且不断增长的训练集。

目的: 解决何时代理足够可靠以部署、它处理与推迟什么内容，以及随着数据积累边界如何演变的问题。

方法: TRACER系统在LLM的生产轨迹上训练ML代理，并通过一致性门控制部署：仅当代理与LLM的一致性超过用户指定的阈值α时才激活代理。

主要发现: 在77类意图基准测试中，TRACER根据质量目标α实现了83-100%的代理覆盖率；在150类基准测试中，代理完全替代了教师模型；在自然语言推理任务中，一致性门正确拒绝了部署。

结论: TRACER系统是开源的，能够有效地利用生产日志数据来优化LLM的推理成本和可靠性。

翻译: 每次调用LLM分类端点都会产生保留在生产日志中的标记输入输出对。这些对构成了一个免费、不断增长的训练集：在其上训练的轻量级代理可以在接近零边际推理成本的情况下吸收未来流量的很大一部分。开放的问题是代理何时足够可靠以部署，它处理与推迟什么，以及随着数据积累边界如何演变。我们介绍了TRACER（基于轨迹的自适应高效路由），这是一个开源系统，在LLM的生产轨迹上训练ML代理，并通过一致性门控制部署：仅当代理与LLM的一致性超过用户指定的阈值α时才激活代理。为了使路由边界透明，TRACER生成可解释性工件，描述代理处理哪些输入区域，它在哪里达到平台期，以及为什么它推迟。在77类意图基准测试中，使用Sonnet 4.6教师模型，TRACER根据质量目标α实现了83-100%的代理覆盖率；在150类基准测试中，代理完全替代了教师模型。在自然语言推理任务中，一致性门正确拒绝了部署，因为嵌入表示无法支持可靠的分离。该系统作为开源软件提供。

Abstract

Every call to an LLM classification endpoint produces a labeled input-output pair already retained in production logs. These pairs constitute a free, growing training set: a lightweight surrogate trained on them can absorb a significant portion of future traffic at near-zero marginal inference cost. The open questions are when the surrogate is reliable enough to deploy, what it handles versus defers, and how that boundary evolves as data accumulates. We introduce TRACER (Trace-based Adaptive Cost-Efficient Routing), an open-source system that trains ML surrogates on an LLM's own production traces and governs deployment through a parity gate: the surrogate is activated only when its agreement with the LLM exceeds a user-specified threshold α. To make the routing boundary transparent, TRACER generates interpretability artifacts describing which input regions the surrogate handles, where it plateaus, and why it defers. On a 77-class intent benchmark with a Sonnet 4.6 teacher, TRACER achieves 83-100% surrogate coverage depending on the quality target α; on a 150-class benchmark, the surrogate fully replaces the teacher. On a natural language inference task, the parity gate correctly refuses deployment because the embedding representation cannot support reliable separation. The system is available as open-source software.

item.title: Revisiting Token Compression for Accelerating ViT-based Sparse Multi-View 3D Object Detectors
item.author: Mingqian Ji, Shanshan Zhang, Jian Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: SEPatch3D是一种新的框架，通过动态调整补丁大小来加速基于Vision Transformer的稀疏多视图3D目标检测器，同时保持检测精度。

背景: 基于Vision Transformer的稀疏多视图3D目标检测器虽然精度高，但存在高推理延迟问题。现有的token压缩策略如token剪枝、合并和补丁大小放大往往丢弃有用的背景线索、破坏上下文一致性并丢失细粒度语义。

目的: 克服现有token压缩策略的局限性，提出一种新的框架来加速模型，同时保持检测精度。

方法: SEPatch3D框架包含三个主要组件：1) 空间时间感知补丁大小选择(SPSS)，将小补丁分配给包含附近物体的场景以保留细节，将大补丁分配给以背景为主的场景以降低计算成本；2) 信息补丁选择(IPS)，选择用于特征细化的信息补丁；3) 跨粒度特征增强(CGFE)，将细粒度细节注入选定的粗补丁中。

主要发现: 在nuScenes和Argoverse 2验证集上的实验表明，SEPatch3D比StreamPETR基线快57%，比最先进的ToC3D-faster效率高20%，同时保持了相当的检测精度。

结论: SEPatch3D通过动态调整补丁大小和特征增强，有效地加速了3D目标检测器，同时保持了检测精度。

翻译: 基于Vision Transformer的稀疏多视图3D目标检测器虽然取得了显著的精度，但由于繁重的token处理，仍然遭受高推理延迟的困扰。为了加速这些模型，token压缩已被广泛探索。然而，我们对现有策略（如token剪枝、合并和补丁大小放大）的重新审视发现，它们往往会丢弃有用的背景线索，破坏上下文一致性，并丢失细粒度语义，从而对3D检测产生负面影响。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了SEPatch3D，这是一个新颖的框架，它可以在粗补丁内保留关键语义信息的同时动态调整补丁大小。具体来说，我们设计了空间时间感知补丁大小选择(SPSS)，将小补丁分配给包含附近物体的场景以保留细节，将大补丁分配给以背景为主的场景以降低计算成本。为了进一步缓解潜在的细节丢失，信息补丁选择(IPS)选择信息补丁进行特征细化，跨粒度特征增强(CGFE)将细粒度细节注入选定的粗补丁中，丰富了语义特征。在nuScenes和Argoverse 2验证集上的实验表明，SEPatch3D比StreamPETR基线快57%，比最先进的ToC3D-faster效率高20%，同时保持了相当的检测精度。代码可在https://github.com/Mingqj/SEPatch3D获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决基于ViT的稀疏多视图3D目标检测器推理速度慢的问题。现有的压缩方法往往会导致背景信息丢失或细粒度语义缺失，从而影响检测精度。这个问题很重要，因为3D目标检测是自动驾驶的关键，加速模型能实现实时推理，平衡效率与性能。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到基于ViT的稀疏3D检测器存在推理延迟高的问题，并发现现有的Token压缩策略（如剪枝、合并、增大补丁）会丢失背景线索或破坏语义一致性。因此，他们设计了一种动态调整补丁大小的方法，根据时空线索分配大小补丁以减少计算量，并利用跨粒度特征增强来保留关键信息。他们借鉴了Token压缩技术（如DynamicViT、ToMe）和稀疏3D检测方法（如StreamPETR），特别是ToC3D，但指出ToC3D可能丢弃背景区域，而他们的方法通过动态调整粒度和增强信息区域来改进这一点。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想：该方法通过动态调整补丁大小来加速模型，同时保留关键语义信息。它根据物体位置选择大补丁以减少背景计算，选择小补丁以保留细节，并增强选定的补丁以防止信息丢失。整体流程：首先，利用时空感知补丁大小选择机制根据历史查询动态调整补丁大小；接着，通过信息丰富的补丁选择和跨粒度特征增强来优化选定的粗粒度补丁；最后，将增强后的补丁输入 ViT 块进行特征提取和检测。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了SEPatch3D框架，其关键创新点在于根据时空分布动态调整Patch大小，并利用信息选择和跨粒度特征增强模块来保留关键细节。相比之前的工作，该方法不同于容易丢失背景信息的Token剪枝或破坏语义一致性的Token合并，也不同于可能丢弃背景的ToC3D，它通过自适应调整Patch粒度来更好地平衡检测精度与推理效率。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了SEPatch3D框架，通过动态调整补丁大小和跨粒度特征增强，在保持检测精度的同时显著加速了基于ViT的稀疏多视图3D目标检测器。

Abstract

Vision Transformer (ViT)-based sparse multi-view 3D object detectors have achieved remarkable accuracy but still suffer from high inference latency due to heavy token processing. To accelerate these models, token compression has been widely explored. However, our revisit of existing strategies, such as token pruning, merging, and patch size enlargement, reveals that they often discard informative background cues, disrupt contextual consistency, and lose fine-grained semantics, negatively affecting 3D detection. To overcome these limitations, we propose SEPatch3D, a novel framework that dynamically adjusts patch sizes while preserving critical semantic information within coarse patches. Specifically, we design Spatiotemporal-aware Patch Size Selection (SPSS) that assigns small patches to scenes containing nearby objects to preserve fine details and large patches to background-dominated scenes to reduce computation cost. To further mitigate potential detail loss, Informative Patch Selection (IPS) selects the informative patches for feature refinement, and Cross-Granularity Feature Enhancement (CGFE) injects fine-grained details into selected coarse patches, enriching semantic features. Experiments on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 validation sets show that SEPatch3D achieves up to \textbf{57\%} faster inference than the StreamPETR baseline and \textbf{20\%} higher efficiency than the state-of-the-art ToC3D-faster, while preserving comparable detection accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/Mingqj/SEPatch3D.

item.title: Don't Retrieve, Navigate: Distilling Enterprise Knowledge into Navigable Agent Skills for QA and RAG
item.author: Yiqun Sun, Pengfei Wei, Lawrence B. Hsieh
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Corpus2Skill通过离线将文档语料库提炼为分层技能目录，并在服务时让LLM代理导航该目录，从而增强其回溯和组合分散证据的能力。

背景: 现有的检索增强生成（RAG）将大语言模型（LLM）视为搜索结果的被动消费者，模型无法看到语料库的组织方式或尚未检索到的内容，限制了其回溯或组合分散证据的能力。

目的: 提出Corpus2Skill，旨在通过构建分层技能目录，让LLM代理在服务时能够导航语料库，从而提升其推理和证据整合能力。

方法: Corpus2Skill包含离线编译管道和服务时代理导航。离线管道通过迭代聚类文档、生成LLM编写的摘要，并将结果物化为可导航的技能文件树。服务时，代理获得语料库的全景视图，通过逐步细化的摘要钻取主题分支，并通过ID检索完整文档。

主要发现: 在WixQA企业客户支持基准测试中，Corpus2Skill在所有质量指标上均优于密集检索、RAPTOR和代理RAG基线。

结论: Corpus2Skill通过显式可见的层次结构，使代理能够推理查找位置、从非生产性路径回溯以及跨分支组合证据，从而显著提升了RAG系统的性能。

翻译: 检索增强生成（RAG）将大语言模型（LLM）的响应建立在外部证据基础上，但将其视为搜索结果的被动消费者：它从未看到语料库是如何组织的，也从未看到它尚未检索到的内容，限制了其回溯或组合分散证据的能力。我们提出了Corpus2Skill，它在离线阶段将文档语料库提炼为分层技能目录，并在服务时让LLM代理导航它。编译管道迭代地聚类文档，在每个级别生成LLM编写的摘要，并将结果物化为可导航的技能文件树。在服务时，代理获得语料库的全景视图，通过逐步细化的摘要钻取主题分支，并通过ID检索完整文档。由于层次结构是显式可见的，代理可以推理在哪里查找，从非生产性路径回溯，并跨分支组合证据。在WixQA（一个企业客户支持RAG基准）上，Corpus2Skill在所有质量指标上均优于密集检索、RAPTOR和代理RAG基线。

Abstract

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds LLM responses in external evidence but treats the model as a passive consumer of search results: it never sees how the corpus is organized or what it has not yet retrieved, limiting its ability to backtrack or combine scattered evidence. We present Corpus2Skill, which distills a document corpus into a hierarchical skill directory offline and lets an LLM agent navigate it at serve time. The compilation pipeline iteratively clusters documents, generates LLM-written summaries at each level, and materializes the result as a tree of navigable skill files. At serve time, the agent receives a bird's-eye view of the corpus, drills into topic branches via progressively finer summaries, and retrieves full documents by ID. Because the hierarchy is explicitly visible, the agent can reason about where to look, backtrack from unproductive paths, and combine evidence across branches. On WixQA, an enterprise customer-support benchmark for RAG, Corpus2Skill outperforms dense retrieval, RAPTOR, and agentic RAG baselines across all quality metrics.

item.title: Behavior-Aware Dual-Channel Preference Learning for Heterogeneous Sequential Recommendation
item.author: Jing Xiao, Dongqi Wu, Liwei Pan, Yawen Luo, Weike Pan, Zhong Ming
item.description:
来源: arxiv
