item.author: Jonathan Coles, Stefano Schuppli, Lukas Drescher, Fawzi Roberto Mohamed, Elia Palme, Henrique Mendonça, Miguel Gila, Mark Klein, Maxime Martinasso, Joost VandeVondele, Torsten Hoefler, Thomas Schulthess, Josh Romero, Igor Gorodetsky, Ryan Hankins, Isa Wazirzada, Martin Jaggi, Antoine Bosselut, Imanol Schlag, Antoni-Joan Solergibert i Llaquet, Alejandro Hernández Cano, Theofilos Ioannis Manitaras, Nicholas John Browning
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文详细介绍了在阿尔卑斯超级计算机上训练名为Apertus的完全开源多语言基础模型的过程，这是一项学术界的开创性成就。

背景: 全球各国政府都在追求主权人工智能能力，但训练这些模型所需的资本成本和工程复杂性主要限制了私营部门，公共机构之间存在巨大差距。

目的: 记录训练Apertus模型的工程历程，并讨论如何将超级计算机转变为具有韧性的软件定义机器学习平台。

方法: 利用NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper超级芯片在欧洲最大的开放科学系统之一上进行了大规模预训练，并克服了存储瓶颈、稳定大规模互连等基础设施挑战。

主要发现: 成功部署了70B参数规模的预训练活动，并总结了将超级计算机转化为机器学习平台的经验教训。

结论: 初始发布为持续、迭代的操作能力奠定了基础，特别是针对微调基础模型，这超出了单次模型训练的范围。

翻译: 大型语言模型（LLMs）作为科学和社会的变革性技术迅速兴起，促使各国政府追求确保数据合规和文化表现的主权人工智能能力。然而，训练这些模型所需的资本成本和工程复杂性在很大程度上限制了此类能力仅限于私营部门，给公共机构留下了巨大的空白。本文详细介绍了在阿尔卑斯超级计算机上训练Apertus——一个完全开源的多语言基础模型——背后的工程历程。这是学术界在70B参数规模上的首创成就，我们成功在一个欧洲最大的开放科学系统上进行了大规模预训练活动，该系统由NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper超级芯片驱动。我们详细介绍了为训练AI模型准备HPC基础设施所遇到的挑战，从克服存储瓶颈到稳定大规模互连，以及在将超级计算机转变为具有韧性的软件定义机器学习平台过程中学到的教训。最后，我们讨论了模型的后续训练要求和机器学习平台的演变，概述了这一初始发布如何为持续、迭代的操作能力奠定了基础，特别是针对微调基础模型，这超出了单次模型训练的范围。

Abstract

Large Language Models (LLMs) have surged as a transformative technology for science and society, prompting governments worldwide to pursue sovereign AI capabilities that ensure data compliance and cultural representation. However, the associated capital costs and engineering complexity required to train these models have largely restricted such capabilities to the private sector, leaving a significant gap for public institutions. This paper details the engineering journey behind training Apertus, a fully open multilingual foundation model, on the Alps supercomputer. Representing a first-of-its-kind achievement for academia at the 70B parameter scale, we successfully deployed a massive pre-training campaign on one of Europe's largest systems for open science, powered by NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper Superchips. We detail the challenges encountered in readying HPC infrastructure for training AI models, from overcoming storage bottlenecks to stabilizing large-scale interconnects, and the lessons learned in transforming a supercomputer into a resilient software-defined Machine Learning Platform. Finally, we discuss the post-training requirements and evolution of our Machine Learning platform, outlining how this initial release lays the groundwork for a sustained, iterative operational capability, in particular for fine tuning foundation models, that extends well beyond a single model training run.

item.title: An Engineering Journey Training Large Language Models at Scale on Alps: The Apertus Experience
item.author: Jonathan Coles, Stefano Schuppli, Lukas Drescher, Fawzi Roberto Mohamed, Elia Palme, Henrique Mendonça, Miguel Gila, Mark Klein, Maxime Martinasso, Joost VandeVondele, Torsten Hoefler, Thomas Schulthess, Josh Romero, Igor Gorodetsky, Ryan Hankins, Isa Wazirzada, Martin Jaggi, Antoine Bosselut, Imanol Schlag, Antoni-Joan Solergibert i Llaquet, Alejandro Hernández Cano, Theofilos Ioannis Manitaras, Nicholas John Browning
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文详细介绍了在阿尔卑斯超级计算机上训练名为Apertus的完全开源多语言基础模型的工程历程。

背景: 大型语言模型作为变革性技术在全球范围内受到关注，各国政府致力于确保数据合规和文化代表性的主权AI能力。然而，训练这些模型所需的资本成本和工程复杂性主要限制了此类能力仅限于私营部门，导致公共机构存在巨大缺口。

目的: 本文旨在记录在阿尔卑斯超级计算机上训练Apertus模型的工程过程，并分享将超级计算机转化为具有韧性的软件定义机器学习平台的经验教训。

方法: 研究团队在阿尔卑斯超级计算机上成功部署了大规模预训练活动，该系统是欧洲最大的开放科学系统之一，由NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper超级芯片提供动力。研究详细阐述了为AI模型训练准备HPC基础设施所面临的挑战，包括克服存储瓶颈和稳定大规模互连，以及将超级计算机转化为具有韧性的软件定义机器学习平台的方法。

主要发现: 这是学术界在70B参数规模上实现的首创性成就。研究团队克服了存储瓶颈和大规模互连稳定等挑战，成功将超级计算机转化为具有韧性的软件定义机器学习平台。

结论: 初始发布为持续、迭代的操作能力奠定了基础，特别是为微调基础模型提供了支持，这种能力远超单次模型训练运行。

翻译: 大型语言模型作为科学和社会的变革性技术激增，促使世界各国政府追求确保数据合规和文化表现的主权AI能力。然而，训练这些模型所需的资本成本和工程复杂性在很大程度上限制了此类能力仅限于私营部门，给公共机构留下了巨大的缺口。本文详细介绍了在阿尔卑斯超级计算机上训练Apertus的完全开源多语言基础模型的工程历程。这是学术界在70B参数规模上实现的首创性成就，我们成功在一个为开放科学服务的欧洲最大系统之一上部署了由NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper超级芯片提供动力的大规模预训练活动。我们详细阐述了为AI模型训练准备HPC基础设施所面临的挑战，从克服存储瓶颈到稳定大规模互连，以及在将超级计算机转化为具有韧性的软件定义机器学习平台过程中吸取的教训。最后，我们讨论了后训练要求和机器学习平台的演变，概述了这一初始发布如何为持续、迭代的操作能力奠定了基础，特别是为微调基础模型，这种能力远超单次模型训练运行。

Abstract

Large Language Models (LLMs) have surged as a transformative technology for science and society, prompting governments worldwide to pursue sovereign AI capabilities that ensure data compliance and cultural representation. However, the associated capital costs and engineering complexity required to train these models have largely restricted such capabilities to the private sector, leaving a significant gap for public institutions. This paper details the engineering journey behind training Apertus, a fully open multilingual foundation model, on the Alps supercomputer. Representing a first-of-its-kind achievement for academia at the 70B parameter scale, we successfully deployed a massive pre-training campaign on one of Europe's largest systems for open science, powered by NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper Superchips. We detail the challenges encountered in readying HPC infrastructure for training AI models, from overcoming storage bottlenecks to stabilizing large-scale interconnects, and the lessons learned in transforming a supercomputer into a resilient software-defined Machine Learning Platform. Finally, we discuss the post-training requirements and evolution of our Machine Learning platform, outlining how this initial release lays the groundwork for a sustained, iterative operational capability, in particular for fine tuning foundation models, that extends well beyond a single model training run.

item.title: Sparse Contrastive Learning for Content-Based Cold Item Recommendation
item.author: Gregor Meehan, Johan Pauwels
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对冷启动问题，提出了一种仅基于内容的建模方法，通过训练内容编码器将物品映射到潜在空间，并使用稀疏广义采样软最大损失函数来提高物品相关性估计的准确性。

背景: 现有的协同过滤冷启动方法通常通过将辅助物品内容映射到协同过滤模型的嵌入空间来解决，但这种方法受到协同过滤信号与内容特征之间基本信息差距的限制。

目的: 提出一种避免这种限制的纯内容建模方法，即不与协同过滤用户或物品嵌入对齐，而是通过物品间相似性来预测冷启动问题。

方法: 训练内容编码器将物品投影到潜在空间，其中相似性与用户偏好相关；定义训练目标为采样软最大损失的稀疏广义形式，使用α-entmax族激活函数来零化不具信息量的负样本的梯度。

主要发现: 通过知识蒸馏扩展的SEMCo训练 regime在排名准确性上优于现有的冷启动方法和标准采样软最大方法。

结论: 纯内容建模在物品结果公平性方面具有优势。

翻译: Item cold-start is a pervasive challenge for collaborative filtering (CF) recommender systems. Existing methods often train cold-start models by mapping auxiliary item content, such as images or text descriptions, into the embedding space of a CF model. However, such approaches can be limited by the fundamental information gap between CF signals and content features. In this work, we propose to avoid this limitation with purely content-based modeling of cold items, i.e. without alignment with CF user or item embeddings. We instead frame cold-start prediction in terms of item-item similarity, training a content encoder to project into a latent space where similarity correlates with user preferences. We define our training objective as a sparse generalization of sampled softmax loss with the α-entmax family of activation functions, which allows for sharper estimation of item relevance by zeroing gradients for uninformative negatives. We then describe how this Sampled Entmax for Cold-start (SEMCo) training regime can be extended via knowledge distillation, and show that it outperforms existing cold-start methods and standard sampled softmax in ranking accuracy. We also discuss the advantages of purely content-based modeling, particularly in terms of equity of item outcomes.

Abstract

Item cold-start is a pervasive challenge for collaborative filtering (CF) recommender systems. Existing methods often train cold-start models by mapping auxiliary item content, such as images or text descriptions, into the embedding space of a CF model. However, such approaches can be limited by the fundamental information gap between CF signals and content features. In this work, we propose to avoid this limitation with purely content-based modeling of cold items, i.e. without alignment with CF user or item embeddings. We instead frame cold-start prediction in terms of item-item similarity, training a content encoder to project into a latent space where similarity correlates with user preferences. We define our training objective as a sparse generalization of sampled softmax loss with the $α$-entmax family of activation functions, which allows for sharper estimation of item relevance by zeroing gradients for uninformative negatives. We then describe how this Sampled Entmax for Cold-start (SEMCo) training regime can be extended via knowledge distillation, and show that it outperforms existing cold-start methods and standard sampled softmax in ranking accuracy. We also discuss the advantages of purely content-based modeling, particularly in terms of equity of item outcomes.

item.title: XRZero-G0: Pushing the Frontier of Dexterous Robotic Manipulation with Interfaces, Quality and Ratios
item.author: Junming Wang, Teng Pu, Wingmun Fung, Jindong Wang, Shanchang Wang, Yuan Deng, Shuyuan Wang, Ziwei Liu, Kunhao Pan, Ping Yang, Peng Zhai, Yuxin Liang, Xiaofan Li, Jiabi Sun, Renchao Xu, Xiaotian Tian, Pengfei Yan, Guoqiang Ye, Liang Li, Qian Wang, Ruyi Gan, Hao Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为XRZero-G0的软硬件协同设计系统，旨在解决机器人操作中高质量动作对齐演示数据获取的瓶颈问题，通过人机协作和闭环流程提升数据收集效率与质量。

背景: 虽然无机器人人类演示（如UMI范式）为传统遥操作提供了可扩展的替代方案，但当前系统受限于硬件人体工程学不佳、开环工作流程以及缺乏系统性的数据混合策略。

目的: 为了解决这些局限性，提出XRZero-G0系统，该系统集成了人体工程学、虚拟现实接口、闭环数据收集与质量控制流程，以提升数据收集效率、可靠性和透明度。

方法: 系统采用人体工程学设计的虚拟现实接口，配备顶视摄像头和双专用夹爪；提出非本体感觉数据的闭环收集、检查、训练和评估流程；研究了无机器人数据的经验缩放行为和最优混合比例。

主要发现: 实验表明，结合少量真实机器人数据与大规模无机器人数据（如10:1比例）可达到与仅使用真实机器人数据集相当的性能，同时将获取成本降低了二十倍；构建了2000小时的无机器人数据集，实现了零样本跨具身迁移。

结论: XRZero-G0系统证明了构建大规模无机器人数据集并实现零样本跨具身迁移的可行性，为通用现实世界操作提供了一种高度可扩展的方法。

翻译: 获取高质量、动作对齐的演示数据仍然是扩展灵巧机器人操作基础模型的根本瓶颈。虽然无机器人人类演示（如UMI范式）为传统遥操作提供了可扩展的替代方案，但当前系统受限于次优的硬件人体工程学、开环工作流程以及缺乏系统性的数据混合策略。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了XRZero-G0，一个用于具身数据收集和政策学习的软硬件协同设计系统。该系统具有配备顶视摄像头和双专用夹爪的人体工程学虚拟现实接口，可直接提高收集效率。为了确保数据集的可靠性，我们提出了非本体感觉数据的闭环收集、检查、训练和评估流程。该工作流程实现了85%的数据有效性率，并建立了透明的质量控制机制。此外，我们研究了无机器人数据的经验缩放行为和最优混合比例。大量实验表明，结合少量真实机器人数据与大规模无机器人数据（例如10:1的比例）可达到与仅使用真实机器人数据集相当的性能，同时将获取成本降低了二十倍。利用XRZero-G0，我们构建了一个2000小时的无机器人数据集，能够实现向目标物理机器人的零样本跨具身迁移，证明了通用现实世界操作的高度可扩展方法。

Abstract

The acquisition of high-quality, action-aligned demonstration data remains a fundamental bottleneck in scaling foundation models for dexterous robot manipulation. Although robot-free human demonstrations (e.g., the UMI paradigm) offer a scalable alternative to traditional teleoperation, current systems are constrained by sub-optimal hardware ergonomics, open-loop workflows, and a lack of systematic data-mixing strategies. To address these limitations, we present XRZero-G0, a hardware-software co-designed system for embodied data collection and policy learning. The system features an ergonomic, virtual reality interface equipped with a top-view camera and dual specialized grippers to directly improve collection efficiency. To ensure dataset reliability, we propose a closed-loop collection, inspection, training, and evaluation pipeline for non-proprioceptive data. This workflow achieves an 85% data validity rate and establishes a transparent mechanism for quality control. Furthermore, we investigate the empirical scaling behaviors and optimal mixing ratios of robot-free data. Extensive experiments indicate that combining a minimal volume of real-robot data with large-scale robot-free data (e.g., a 10:1 ratio) achieves performance comparable to exclusively real-robot datasets, while reducing acquisition costs by a factor of twenty. Utilizing XRZero-G0, we construct a 2,000-hour robot-free dataset that enables zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer to a target physical robot, demonstrating a highly scalable methodology for generalized real-world manipulation.Our project repository: https://github.com/X-Square-Robot/XRZero-G0

item.title: Lightning OPD: Efficient Post-Training for Large Reasoning Models with Offline On-Policy Distillation
item.author: Yecheng Wu, Song Han, Hai Cai
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Lightning OPD的离线策略蒸馏框架，旨在解决标准在线策略蒸馏需要实时教师模型推理服务器导致的巨大基础设施开销问题。

背景: 标准在线策略蒸馏(OPD)需要在整个训练过程中保持一个实时的教师推理服务器，这带来了巨大的基础设施开销。

目的: 研究是否可以在离线环境下执行策略蒸馏，并理解标准离线策略蒸馏性能下降的原因。

方法: 提出Lightning OPD框架，通过在监督微调(SFT)回放上预先计算教师对数概率来强制执行教师一致性，从而完全消除了对实时教师服务器的需求。

主要发现: 发现违反教师一致性会引入不可减少的梯度偏差，导致离线和在线策略蒸馏都收敛到次优的固定点。在教师一致性的条件下，Lightning OPD与标准OPD共享相同的最佳点，具有有界的梯度差异和隐式正则化效应。

结论: Lightning OPD在数学推理和代码生成任务上实现了最先进的性能，效率显著提高。从SFT初始化的Qwen3-8B-Base模型出发，Lightning OPD仅用30个GPU小时就在AIME 2024上达到了69.9%的准确率，相比标准OPD实现了4.0倍的速度提升。

翻译: On-policy distillation (OPD) 已成为大型语言模型的高效后训练范式。然而，标准 OPD 需要在整个训练过程中保持一个实时的教师推理服务器，从而导致巨大的基础设施开销。在这项工作中，我们研究了是否可以在离线环境下执行 on-policy distillation。一种自然的方法是在 SFT 回放上预先计算教师对数概率，并在训练期间重用它们。然而，在实践中，这种离线变体无法可靠地匹配标准 OPD 的性能。为了理解这种差异，我们确定了一个以前被忽视的条件，即任何 OPD 管道的关键条件，我们称之为教师一致性。该条件要求在监督微调和 OPD 中使用相同的教师模型。我们表明，违反教师一致性会引入不可减少的梯度偏差，导致离线和在线 OPD 都收敛到次优的固定点，无论训练持续时间如何。基于这一见解，我们提出了 Lightning OPD，这是一个离线 on-policy distillation 框架，它通过在 SFT 回放上预先计算教师对数概率来强制执行教师一致性。这种设计完全消除了对实时教师服务器的需求。我们进一步表明，在教师一致性的条件下，Lightning OPD 与标准 OPD 共享相同的最佳点，具有有界的梯度差异和有助于防止策略漂移的隐式正则化效应。在数学推理和代码生成方面的广泛实验表明，Lightning OPD 实现了最先进的性能，效率显著提高。从 SFT 初始化的 Qwen3-8B-Base 模型出发，Lightning OPD 仅在 30 个 GPU 小时内就在 AIME 2024 上达到了 69.9% 的成绩，相比标准 OPD 实现了 4.0 倍的速度提升，并大大降低了 LLM 后训练学术研究的门槛。

Abstract

On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an efficient post-training paradigm for large language models. However, standard OPD requires a live teacher inference server throughout training, resulting in substantial infrastructure overhead. In this work, we investigate whether on-policy distillation can be performed offline. A natural approach is to precompute teacher log-probabilities once over SFT rollouts and reuse them during training. In practice, however, this offline variant fails to reliably match the performance of standard OPD. To understand this discrepancy, we identify a previously overlooked condition that is critical for any OPD pipeline, which we term teacher consistency. This condition requires that the same teacher model be used for both supervised fine-tuning and OPD. We show that violating teacher consistency introduces an irreducible gradient bias, causing both offline and online OPD to converge to a suboptimal fixed point regardless of training duration. Building on this insight, we propose Lightning OPD, an offline on-policy distillation framework that enforces teacher consistency by precomputing teacher log-probabilities over SFT rollouts. This design eliminates the need for a live teacher server entirely. We further show that, under teacher consistency, Lightning OPD shares the same optimum as standard OPD, with bounded gradient discrepancy and an implicit regularization effect that helps prevent policy drift. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation demonstrate that Lightning OPD achieves state-of-the-art performance with significantly improved efficiency. Starting from an SFT-initialized Qwen3-8B-Base model, Lightning OPD reaches 69.9% on AIME 2024 in just 30 GPU hours, achieving a 4.0x speedup over standard OPD and substantially lowering the barrier to entry for academic research on LLM post-training.

item.title: Toward Autonomous Long-Horizon Engineering for ML Research
item.author: Guoxin Chen, Jie Chen, Lei Chen, Jiale Zhao, Fanzhe Meng, Wayne Xin Zhao, Ruihua Song, Cheng Chen, Ji-Rong Wen, Kai Jia
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AiScientist系统通过分层编排和持久的文件工作空间，实现了长时间跨度的机器学习研究工程自动化，在两个基准测试中显著优于最佳基线。

背景: 自主AI研究进展迅速，但长时间跨度的机器学习研究工程仍面临困难，因为智能体必须在数小时或数天内保持连贯的进展，涵盖任务理解、环境设置、实现、实验和调试等多个阶段。

目的: 为了解决长时间跨度的机器学习研究工程难题，提出了一种名为AiScientist的系统，旨在实现自主的长周期研究工程。

方法: AiScientist结合了分层编排和权限范围的文件总线工作空间。顶层编排器通过简洁的摘要和工作空间地图维持阶段级控制，而专用智能体则反复基于持久化的工件（如分析、计划、代码和实验证据）进行重新定位，而非主要依赖对话式交接。

主要发现: 在两个互补的基准测试中，AiScientist在PaperBench上平均比最佳匹配基线提高了10.54分，并在MLE-Bench Lite上达到了81.82%的Any Medal%。消融研究显示，文件总线协议是性能的关键驱动因素，移除后分别导致PaperBench下降6.41分和MLE-Bench Lite下降31.82%。

结论: 长时间跨度的机器学习研究工程是一个协调专门工作在持久项目状态上的系统问题，而不仅仅是一个纯粹的局部推理问题。

翻译: 自主AI研究进展迅速，但长时间跨度的机器学习研究工程仍然困难：智能体必须在数小时或数天内在任务理解、环境设置、实现、实验和调试等方面保持连贯的进展。我们介绍了AiScientist，一个基于简单原则构建的用于机器学习研究自主长周期工程的系统：强大的长周期性能需要结构化编排和持久的状态连续性。为此，AiScientist结合了分层编排和权限范围的文件总线工作空间：顶层编排器通过简洁的摘要和工作空间地图维持阶段级控制，而专用智能体则反复基于持久化的工件（如分析、计划、代码和实验证据）进行重新定位，而不是主要依赖对话式交接，从而对厚重的状态实现薄控制。在两个互补的基准测试中，AiScientist在PaperBench上平均比最佳匹配基线提高了10.54分，并在MLE-Bench Lite上达到了81.82%的Any Medal%。消融研究进一步表明，文件总线协议是性能的关键驱动因素，移除后分别导致PaperBench下降6.41分和MLE-Bench Lite下降31.82%。这些结果表明，长时间跨度的机器学习研究工程是一个协调专门工作在持久项目状态上的系统问题，而不仅仅是一个纯粹的局部推理问题。

Abstract

Autonomous AI research has advanced rapidly, but long-horizon ML research engineering remains difficult: agents must sustain coherent progress across task comprehension, environment setup, implementation, experimentation, and debugging over hours or days. We introduce AiScientist, a system for autonomous long-horizon engineering for ML research built on a simple principle: strong long-horizon performance requires both structured orchestration and durable state continuity. To this end, AiScientist combines hierarchical orchestration with a permission-scoped File-as-Bus workspace: a top-level Orchestrator maintains stage-level control through concise summaries and a workspace map, while specialized agents repeatedly re-ground on durable artifacts such as analyses, plans, code, and experimental evidence rather than relying primarily on conversational handoffs, yielding thin control over thick state. Across two complementary benchmarks, AiScientist improves PaperBench score by 10.54 points on average over the best matched baseline and achieves 81.82 Any Medal% on MLE-Bench Lite. Ablation studies further show that File-as-Bus protocol is a key driver of performance, reducing PaperBench by 6.41 points and MLE-Bench Lite by 31.82 points when removed. These results suggest that long-horizon ML research engineering is a systems problem of coordinating specialized work over durable project state, rather than a purely local reasoning problem.

item.title: Generative Refinement Networks for Visual Synthesis
item.author: Jian Han, Jinlai Liu, Jiahuan Wang, Bingyue Peng, Zehuan Yuan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

summary: 本文介绍了生成式细化网络（GRN），这是一种下一代视觉合成范式，旨在解决扩散模型计算效率低的问题，并利用自回归模型固有的复杂性感知能力。

background: 扩散模型在视觉生成领域占据主导地位，但计算效率低下，无论复杂程度如何都投入相同的计算努力。相比之下，自回归模型具有固有的复杂性感知能力，但往往受到有损离散标记化和误差累积的阻碍。

purpose: 引入生成式细化网络（GRN）来解决扩散模型计算效率低的问题，并克服自回归模型在离散标记化和误差累积方面的局限性。

method: GRN通过理论上近乎无损的分层二值量化（HBQ）解决离散标记化瓶颈，实现与连续模型相当的重构质量。在此基础上，GRN利用全局细化机制升级自回归生成，像人类艺术家绘画一样逐步完善和纠正艺术品。此外，GRN集成了基于熵引导的采样策略，实现复杂度感知的自适应步长生成。

main_findings: 在ImageNet基准测试中，GRN建立了新的图像重构（0.56 rFID）和类别条件图像生成（1.81 gFID）记录。在更具有挑战性的文本到图像和文本到视频生成中，GRN也表现出优越的性能。

conclusion: GRN通过引入分层二值量化和全局细化机制，成功解决了扩散模型计算效率低的问题，并克服了自回归模型的局限性，在图像重构和生成任务上取得了新的记录，并在文本到图像和文本到视频生成中表现出优越性能。

translation: While diffusion models dominate the field of visual generation, they are computationally inefficient, applying a uniform computational effort regardless of different complexity. In contrast, autoregressive (AR) models are inherently complexity-aware, as evidenced by their variable likelihoods, but are often hindered by lossy discrete tokenization and error accumulation. In this work, we introduce Generative Refinement Networks (GRN), a next-generation visual synthesis paradigm to address these issues. At its core, GRN addresses the discrete tokenization bottleneck through a theoretically near-lossless Hierarchical Binary Quantization (HBQ), achieving a reconstruction quality comparable to continuous counterparts. Built upon HBQ's latent space, GRN fundamentally upgrades AR generation with a global refinement mechanism that progressively perfects and corrects artworks -- like a human artist painting. Besides, GRN integrates an entropy-guided sampling strategy, enabling complexity-aware, adaptive-step generation without compromising visual quality. On the ImageNet benchmark, GRN establishes new records in image reconstruction (0.56 rFID) and class-conditional image generation (1.81 gFID). We also scale GRN to more challenging text-to-image and text-to-video generation, delivering superior performance on an equivalent scale. We release all models and code to foster further research on GRN.

Abstract

While diffusion models dominate the field of visual generation, they are computationally inefficient, applying a uniform computational effort regardless of different complexity. In contrast, autoregressive (AR) models are inherently complexity-aware, as evidenced by their variable likelihoods, but are often hindered by lossy discrete tokenization and error accumulation. In this work, we introduce Generative Refinement Networks (GRN), a next-generation visual synthesis paradigm to address these issues. At its core, GRN addresses the discrete tokenization bottleneck through a theoretically near-lossless Hierarchical Binary Quantization (HBQ), achieving a reconstruction quality comparable to continuous counterparts. Built upon HBQ's latent space, GRN fundamentally upgrades AR generation with a global refinement mechanism that progressively perfects and corrects artworks -- like a human artist painting. Besides, GRN integrates an entropy-guided sampling strategy, enabling complexity-aware, adaptive-step generation without compromising visual quality. On the ImageNet benchmark, GRN establishes new records in image reconstruction (0.56 rFID) and class-conditional image generation (1.81 gFID). We also scale GRN to more challenging text-to-image and text-to-video generation, delivering superior performance on an equivalent scale. We release all models and code to foster further research on GRN.

item.title: Learning Probabilistic Responsibility Allocations for Multi-Agent Interactions
item.author: Isaac Remy, Caleb Chang, Karen Leung
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种学习概率责任分配模型的方法，用于捕捉多智能体交互中的多模态不确定性，并通过可微分优化层将责任分配映射到可控的诱导控制上。

背景: 人类在交互环境中的行为不仅受个人目标影响，还受与他人共享约束（如安全性）的影响。理解人们如何分配责任，即为了迁就他人而偏离期望策略的程度，有助于设计符合社会规范和值得信赖的自主系统。

目的: 介绍一种学习概率责任分配模型的方法，以捕捉多智能体交互中固有的多模态不确定性。

方法: 利用条件变分自编码器的潜在空间，结合多智能体轨迹预测技术，学习在场景和智能体上下文条件下责任分配的分布。通过引入可微分优化层，将责任分配映射到可用的诱导控制上，从而在缺乏真实责任标签的情况下保持模型的可处理性。

主要发现: 在INTERACTION驾驶数据集上评估表明，该方法不仅实现了强大的预测性能，还通过责任视角提供了对多智能体交互模式的可解释见解。

结论: 该方法能够有效捕捉多智能体交互中的不确定性，并为设计社会合规和值得信赖的自主系统提供有价值的见解。

翻译: 在交互设置中，人类行为不仅受个人目标影响，还受与他人共享约束（如安全性）的影响。理解人们如何分配责任，即为了迁就他人而偏离期望策略的程度，可以指导社会合规和值得信赖的自主系统的设计。在这项工作中，我们介绍了一种学习概率责任分配模型的方法，以捕捉多智能体交互中固有的多模态不确定性。具体而言，我们的方法利用条件变分自编码器的潜在空间，结合多智能体轨迹预测技术，学习在场景和智能体上下文条件下责任分配的分布。虽然真实责任标签不可用，但通过引入可微分优化层，将责任分配映射到可用的诱导控制上，使模型保持可处理性。我们在INTERACTION驾驶数据集上评估了该方法，结果表明它不仅实现了强大的预测性能，还通过责任视角提供了对多智能体交互模式的可解释见解。

Abstract

Human behavior in interactive settings is shaped not only by individual objectives but also by shared constraints with others, such as safety. Understanding how people allocate responsibility, i.e., how much one deviates from their desired policy to accommodate others, can inform the design of socially compliant and trustworthy autonomous systems. In this work, we introduce a method for learning a probabilistic responsibility allocation model that captures the multimodal uncertainty inherent in multi-agent interactions. Specifically, our approach leverages the latent space of a conditional variational autoencoder, combined with techniques from multi-agent trajectory forecasting, to learn a distribution over responsibility allocations conditioned on scene and agent context. Although ground-truth responsibility labels are unavailable, the model remains tractable by incorporating a differentiable optimization layer that maps responsibility allocations to induced controls, which are available. We evaluate our method on the INTERACTION driving dataset and demonstrate that it not only achieves strong predictive performance but also provides interpretable insights, through the lens of responsibility, into patterns of multi-agent interaction.

item.title: Multi-modal panoramic 3D outdoor datasets for place categorization
item.author: Hojung Jung, Yuki Oto, Oscar M. Mozos, Yumi Iwashita, Ryo Kurazume
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了两个多模态全景3D户外数据集，用于语义地点分类，包含森林、海岸、住宅区、城市区域和室内/室外停车场六类。

背景: 为了研究多模态全景3D户外场景的语义地点分类问题。

目的: 构建两个多模态全景3D户外数据集，并比较语义地点分类方法的最佳结果。

方法: 使用FARO激光扫描仪获取静态全景扫描数据（密集点云），使用Velodyne激光扫描仪在行驶车辆上获取实时全景扫描数据（稀疏点云）。

主要发现: 在语义地点分类任务中，密集点云方法的最佳结果为96.42%，稀疏点云方法的最佳结果为89.67%。

结论: 两个数据集已公开，可用于多模态全景3D户外场景的语义地点分类研究。

翻译: 我们提出了两个多模态全景3D户外数据集，用于语义地点分类，包含森林、海岸、住宅区、城市区域和室内/室外停车场六类。第一个数据集由650个静态全景扫描组成，使用FARO激光扫描仪获取，包含密集的3D彩色和反射率点云（900万个点）和同步彩色图像。第二个数据集由34200个实时全景扫描组成，使用Velodyne激光扫描仪在行驶车辆上获取，包含稀疏的3D反射率点云（7万个点）。数据集在日本福冈市获取，并在[1]、[2]中公开。此外，我们比较了几种语义地点分类方法，最佳结果为96.42%（密集）和89.67%（稀疏）。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决户外环境下的三维地点分类问题，旨在填补现有3D数据集主要针对室内、且户外数据集分辨率低或用途不同的空白。这个问题很重要，因为让机器人知道“我在哪里”能改善人机沟通，支持基于上下文的决策，并使其能在陌生环境中正确执行任务。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者认为机器人需要通过场所分类来理解环境，从而做出决策。他们发现现有的2D图像数据集缺乏3D信息，而现有的3D研究多集中在室内环境，户外数据集（如KITTI）分辨率低且用途不同。因此，他们设计了两个多模态全景3D户外数据集，分别针对静态高分辨率和动态低分辨率场景。他们借鉴了2D图像理解（如ImageNet）和室内3D数据集的研究思路，旨在填补户外3D场所分类数据的空白。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是提出两个多模态全景3D户外数据集，用于地点分类。通过激光扫描仪和相机获取包含距离、反射率和颜色的3D点云信息，以解决现有3D数据集多关注室内且缺乏户外数据的问题。实现流程包括使用高分辨率或低分辨率传感器系统采集360度全景扫描，同步激光与图像数据，将场景标记为森林、城区等六个类别，并利用标准特征描述符进行分类实验。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了两个多模态全景3D户外数据集，分别用于静态和动态环境，结合了激光雷达与相机数据。相比之前的工作，它填补了户外3D地点分类数据集的空白，因为现有的3D研究多集中在室内，且KITTI等数据集主要用于SLAM而非地点分类。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文提出了两个公开的多模态全景 3D 户外数据集，旨在为移动机器人和自动驾驶汽车的地点分类提供基准测试。

Abstract

We present two multi-modal panoramic 3D outdoor (MPO) datasets for semantic place categorization with six categories: forest, coast, residential area, urban area and indoor/outdoor parking lot. The first dataset consists of 650 static panoramic scans of dense (9,000,000 points) 3D color and reflectance point clouds obtained using a FARO laser scanner with synchronized color images. The second dataset consists of 34,200 real-time panoramic scans of sparse (70,000 points) 3D reflectance point clouds obtained using a Velodyne laser scanner while driving a car. The datasets were obtained in the city of Fukuoka, Japan and are publicly available in [1], [2]. In addition, we compare several approaches for semantic place categorization with best results of 96.42% (dense) and 89.67% (sparse).

item.title: Exploration and Exploitation Errors Are Measurable for Language Model Agents
item.author: Jaden Park, Jungtaek Kim, Jongwon Jeong, Robert D. Nowak, Kangwook Lee, Yong Jae Lee
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文设计了一种可控制的环境来评估语言模型代理在探索和利用方面的能力，发现即使最先进的模型也面临挑战，且推理模型表现更好，通过最小化的 harness 工程可以显著改进。

背景: 语言模型代理在复杂的开放决策任务中应用日益广泛，但系统地区分和量化探索与利用行为具有挑战性。

目的: 设计可控制的环境以评估语言模型代理的探索和利用能力，并开发一种指标来量化探索和利用错误。

方法: 设计了受实际具身AI场景启发的可控制环境，每个环境包含部分可观察的2D网格地图和未知任务的DAG。地图生成可编程调整以强调探索或利用的难度。

主要发现: 评估了多种前沿语言模型代理，发现它们在任务上表现挣扎，不同模型表现出不同的失败模式。推理模型更有效地解决问题，且通过最小化的 harness 工程可以显著改进探索和利用。

结论: 通过最小化的 harness 工程可以显著改进探索和利用能力，推理模型在解决此类任务上更有效。

翻译: 语言模型代理在从AI编码到物理AI的复杂开放决策任务中应用日益广泛。在这些设置中，核心要求是能够有效地探索问题空间和利用获取的知识。然而，在没有访问代理内部策略的情况下，从观察到的行动中系统地区分和量化探索与利用仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这个问题，我们设计了受实际具身AI场景启发的可控制环境。每个环境由部分可观察的2D网格地图和未知任务的DAG组成。地图生成可以编程调整以强调探索或利用的难度。为了实现策略无关的评估，我们设计了一个指标来量化代理行动中的探索和利用错误。我们评估了多种前沿语言模型代理，发现即使在我们的任务上，最先进的模型也面临困难，不同模型表现出不同的失败模式。我们进一步观察到，推理模型更有效地解决问题，并且显示通过最小化的 harness 工程可以显著改进探索和利用。我们在此处发布我们的代码。

Abstract

Language Model (LM) agents are increasingly used in complex open-ended decision-making tasks, from AI coding to physical AI. A core requirement in these settings is the ability to both explore the problem space and exploit acquired knowledge effectively. However, systematically distinguishing and quantifying exploration and exploitation from observed actions without access to the agent's internal policy remains challenging. To address this, we design controllable environments inspired by practical embodied AI scenarios. Each environment consists of a partially observable 2D grid map and an unknown task Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). The map generation can be programmatically adjusted to emphasize exploration or exploitation difficulty. To enable policy-agnostic evaluation, we design a metric to quantify exploration and exploitation errors from agent's actions. We evaluate a variety of frontier LM agents and find that even state-of-the-art models struggle on our task, with different models exhibiting distinct failure modes. We further observe that reasoning models solve the task more effectively and show both exploration and exploitation can be significantly improved through minimal harness engineering. We release our code \href{https://github.com/jjj-madison/measurable-explore-exploit}{here}.

item.title: GeoLink: A 3D-Aware Framework Towards Better Generalization in Cross-View Geo-Localization
item.author: Hongyang Zhang, Yinhao Liu, Haitao Zhang, Zhongyi Wen, Shuxian Liang, Xiansheng Hua
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: GeoLink是一个3D感知的语义一致框架，用于解决跨视角地理定位中的语义不一致和泛化问题。

背景: 现有方法主要依赖2D对应关系，容易受到跨视角冗余共享信息的干扰，导致表示的可迁移性较差。

目的: 提出GeoLink框架，旨在解决跨视角地理定位中因视角变化引起的严重语义不一致以及在域偏移下的泛化能力不足的问题。

方法: 利用VGGT从多视角无人机图像中离线重建场景点云，提供稳定的结构先验。基于这些3D锚点，通过几何感知语义细化模块和统一视角关系蒸馏模块来改进2D表示学习。

主要发现: 在多个基准测试中，GeoLink始终优于最先进的方法，并在未见域和多样化天气环境中实现了优越的泛化能力。

结论: GeoLink通过3D感知和语义一致性框架，有效缓解了2D特征中的冗余和视角偏差依赖，并成功将3D结构关系转移到2D特征中，提高了跨视角对齐能力。

翻译: 通用跨视角地理定位旨在在没有GPS监督的情况下，在未见区域和条件下匹配不同视角下的同一位置。其核心困难在于由视角变化引起的严重语义不一致以及在域偏移下的泛化能力差。现有方法主要依赖2D对应关系，但它们容易受到跨视角冗余共享信息的干扰，导致可迁移性较差。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了GeoLink，这是一个用于通用跨视角地理定位的3D感知语义一致框架。具体来说，我们使用VGGT从多视角无人机图像中离线重建场景点云，提供稳定的结构先验。基于这些3D锚点，我们从两个互补的角度改进了2D表示学习。几何感知语义细化模块在3D指导下减轻了2D特征中潜在的冗余和视角偏差依赖。此外，统一视角关系蒸馏模块将3D结构关系转移到2D特征中，提高了跨视角对齐能力，同时保持了仅2D的推理管道。在多个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，GeoLink始终优于最先进的方法，并在未见域和多样化天气环境中实现了优越的泛化能力。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要解决跨视图地理定位中，因视角变化导致语义不一致以及模型在未见区域泛化能力差的问题。这在现实中非常重要，因为自动驾驶和机器人导航等应用需要在未知环境中工作，仅依赖训练区域会导致性能下降。该研究通过引入3D结构作为稳定锚点，显著提升了模型在不同场景和天气下的鲁棒性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到现有方法主要依赖 2D 特征对齐，易受视角变化和冗余信息干扰，导致泛化能力差。他们借鉴人类利用 3D 环境进行多视图理解的方式，提出利用 3D 结构作为稳定的“锚点”来指导 2D 表示学习。具体设计上，作者通过 VGGT 模型从无人机图像离线重建场景点云，利用几何感知语义细化模块和统一视图关系蒸馏模块，将 3D 空间中的结构关系知识转移到 2D 特征中。作者借鉴了 3D 重建技术、MoE 范式和对比学习思想，同时也参考了 BEV 投影和生成模型，但认为它们忽视了场景理解，因此选择使用点云作为训练时的结构锚点。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想：利用场景级3D结构作为稳定的结构锚点，指导2D特征学习，以解决跨视图语义不一致和域偏移问题。整体流程：首先通过VGGT模型从无人机图像离线重建场景点云；接着利用这些3D锚点通过几何感知语义细化模块和统一视图关系蒸馏模块来改进2D特征学习，从而提升泛化能力。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文提出了GeoLink框架，利用3D结构作为稳定的锚点。关键创新点包括：使用VGGT模型离线重建场景点云，以及两个互补模块：几何感知语义细化模块抑制2D特征中的冗余信息，统一视图关系蒸馏模块将3D结构关系转移到2D特征。相比之前主要依赖2D特征对齐的工作，GeoLink引入3D表示来提供更稳定的结构上下文，从而减少冗余共享信息（如天空、植被）的干扰，提高泛化能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 论文提出了GeoLink框架，利用离线重建的3D场景点云作为结构锚点，通过几何感知语义细化和统一视图关系蒸馏模块来改进2D特征学习，从而在未见区域和条件下实现更好的泛化。

Abstract

Generalizable cross-view geo-localization aims to match the same location across views in unseen regions and conditions without GPS supervision. Its core difficulty lies in severe semantic inconsistency caused by viewpoint variation and poor generalization under domain shift. Existing methods mainly rely on 2D correspondence, but they are easily distracted by redundant shared information across views, leading to less transferable representations. To address this, we propose GeoLink, a 3D-aware semantic-consistent framework for Generalizable cross-view geo-localization. Specifically, we offline reconstruct scene point clouds from multi-view drone images using VGGT, providing stable structural priors. Based on these 3D anchors, we improve 2D representation learning in two complementary ways. A Geometric-aware Semantic Refinement module mitigates potentially redundant and view-biased dependencies in 2D features under 3D guidance. In addition, a Unified View Relation Distillation module transfers 3D structural relations to 2D features, improving cross-view alignment while preserving a 2D-only inference pipeline. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that GeoLink consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods and achieves superior generalization across unseen domains and diverse weather environments.

item.title: Towards Patient-Specific Deformable Registration in Laparoscopic Surgery
item.author: Alberto Neri, Veronica Penza, Nazim Haouchine, Leonardo S. Mattos
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种针对普外科手术中患者特异性非刚性点云配准方法，通过结合Transformer架构、重叠估计和物理算法，显著提升了手术中的模型配准精度。

背景: 普外科手术中，由于术前和术中的器官表面存在变形和噪声等不匹配，将患者特异性3D模型集成到手术中面临挑战，影响了手术安全性。

目的: 提出一种患者特异性的非刚性点云配准方法，以解决术前和术中器官表面不匹配的问题，提高模型配准的可靠性。

方法: 结合Transformer编码器-解码器架构、重叠估计和专门的匹配模块来预测密集对应关系，随后使用基于物理的算法进行配准，并采用了一种新颖的数据生成策略来优化个体患者的结果。

主要发现: 在合成数据和真实数据上的实验结果表明，该方法显著优于传统的无差别方法，在合成数据上实现了45%的匹配分数和92%的内点比。

结论: 该方法具有改善手术护理的潜力，能够显著提高手术中的模型配准精度。

翻译: 不安全的手术护理是一个严重的健康问题，通常与外科医生的经验、技能和情境意识的局限性有关。将患者特异性的3D模型集成到手术现场可以增强可视化，提供实时的解剖学指导，并减少术中并发症。然而，由于术前和术中的器官表面之间存在变形和噪声等不匹配，在普外科中可靠地注册这些模型仍然具有挑战性。为了克服这些挑战，我们介绍了一种首创的患者特异性非刚性点云配准方法，该方法利用了一种新颖的数据生成策略来优化个体患者的结果。我们的方法结合了Transformer编码器-解码器架构、重叠估计和专门的匹配模块来预测密集对应关系，随后使用基于物理的算法进行配准。在合成数据和真实数据上的实验结果表明，我们的患者特异性方法显著优于传统的无差别方法，在合成数据上实现了45%的匹配分数和92%的内点比，突出了其改善手术护理的潜力。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 论文主要想解决腹腔镜手术中，将术前3D模型与术中器官表面进行可靠配准的挑战。由于术中器官会发生变形、噪声和部分遮挡，传统的通用配准方法难以应对。这个问题在现实中很重要，因为将患者特异性模型叠加到手术视野可以增强可视化，提供实时解剖学引导，从而减少术中并发症。此外，传统的通用方法可能不适用于误差极低且对每个患者结果至关重要的手术环境。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对通用方法在手术中误差容限低、患者个体差异大的问题，设计了基于患者特异性的非刚性点云配准方法。他们借鉴了Lepard的Transformer架构和LiverMatch的匹配模块，并结合了基于物理的算法以及实时数据生成策略，以优化每个患者的配准结果。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是提出一种患者特定的非刚性点云配准方法，利用术前信息来调整配准过程，以优化个体患者的结果。整体实现流程包括五个主要模块：首先使用 KPConv 提取关键点和特征；接着通过 Transformer 编码器利用自注意力机制增强特征表示；随后预测两个点云的重叠区域；通过解码器将特征扩展为密集表示；最后利用匹配模块确定对应关系，并结合物理算法进行非刚性配准。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文提出了首个患者特定的非刚性点云配准方法，利用术前信息来调整每个个体的配准过程。其关键创新在于引入了一种新颖的实时数据生成策略，包括动态患者特定的变形生成和创新的可见裁剪逻辑。相比之前采用通用策略（在大型数据集上训练以泛化到新病例）的工作，该方法针对手术环境中的低误差要求进行了优化，并利用术前信息来调整每个个体的配准过程。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种针对腹腔镜手术的个性化非刚性点云配准方法。该方法利用深度学习模型和物理模型来预测点云对应关系，从而实现术前和术中器官模型的精确对齐。实验表明，该方法在合成和真实数据上均显著优于传统的通用方法。

Abstract

Unsafe surgical care is a critical health concern, often linked to limitations in surgeon experience, skills, and situational awareness. Integrating patient-specific 3D models into the surgical field can enhance visualization, provide real-time anatomical guidance, and reduce intraoperative complications. However, reliably registering these models in general surgery remains challenging due to mismatches between preoperative and intraoperative organ surfaces, such as deformations and noise. To overcome these challenges, we introduce the first patient-specific non-rigid point cloud registration method, which leverages a novel data generation strategy to optimize outcomes for individual patients. Our approach combines a Transformer encoder-decoder architecture with overlap estimation and a dedicated matching module to predict dense correspondences, followed by a physics-based algorithm for registration. Experimental results on both synthetic and real data demonstrate that our patient-specific method significantly outperforms traditional agnostic approaches, achieving 45% Matching Score with 92% Inlier Ratio on synthetic data, highlighting its potential to improve surgical care.

item.title: InfiniteScienceGym: An Unbounded, Procedurally-Generated Benchmark for Scientific Analysis
item.author: Oliver Bentham, Vivek Srikumar
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 作者提出了InfiniteScienceGym，一个程序化生成的科学基准测试，用于评估大型语言模型从实证数据中推理的能力。

背景: 现有的科学基准测试存在出版偏差、已知知识偏差、标签噪声和存储需求大的问题。

目的: 构建一个程序化生成的科学基准测试，以评估模型在受控环境下的证据推理、放弃回答和工具辅助分析的能力。

方法: 从种子开始，模拟器确定性地生成包含真实目录结构、文件和表格数据的自包含仓库，特权问答生成器生成可回答和不可回答的问题及确切真相。

主要发现: 评估了专有和开放权重模型，发现它们整体准确率均不超过45%，识别不可回答的问题仍是主要弱点，且更强的模型倾向于更有效地使用工具，而不仅仅是消耗更多标记。

结论: InfiniteScienceGym补充了真实科学基准测试，针对难以用已发布数据集单独评估的盲点和失败模式。

翻译: 大型语言模型正逐渐成为科学助手，但评估它们从实证数据中推理的能力仍然具有挑战性。基于已发表研究和人类注释的基准测试继承了出版偏差、已知知识偏差、标签噪声和巨大的存储需求。我们提出了InfiniteScienceGym，这是一个与科学仓库配对的程序化生成的基准测试，以及一个可验证的问答任务。从种子开始，模拟器确定性地生成一个自包含的仓库，具有真实的目录结构、文件和表格数据，特权问答生成器生成可回答和不可回答的问题，并具有确切的真相。这使得在受控环境中评估基于证据的推理、放弃回答和工具辅助分析成为可能，而无需分发大型静态语料库。InfiniteScienceGym通过针对难以仅使用已发布数据集评估的盲点和失败模式，补充了真实科学基准测试。评估了专有和开放权重模型后，我们发现它们整体准确率均不超过45%，识别不可回答的问题仍是主要弱点，且更强的模型倾向于更有效地使用工具，而不仅仅是消耗更多标记。

Abstract

Large language models are emerging as scientific assistants, but evaluating their ability to reason from empirical data remains challenging. Benchmarks derived from published studies and human annotations inherit publication bias, known-knowledge bias, label noise, and substantial storage requirements. We present InfiniteScienceGym, a procedurally generated benchmark of scientific repositories paired with a verifiable question-answering task. From a seed, the simulator deterministically generates a self-contained repository with realistic directory structure, files, and tabular data, and a privileged QA generator produces both answerable and unanswerable questions with exact ground truth. This makes it possible to evaluate evidence-grounded reasoning, abstention, and tool-mediated analysis in a controlled setting without distributing a large static corpus. InfiniteScienceGym complements real scientific benchmarks by targeting blind spots and failure modes that are hard to evaluate using published datasets alone. Evaluating both proprietary and open-weight models, we find that none achieve more than 45% accuracy overall, that recognizing unanswerable questions remains a major weakness, and that stronger models tend to use tools more effectively rather than simply consuming more tokens.

item.title: Identifiability of Potentially Degenerate Gaussian Mixture Models With Piecewise Affine Mixing
item.author: Danru Xu, Sébastien Lachapelle, Sara Magliacane
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究潜在变量服从可能退化的高斯混合分布且仅通过分段仿射混合函数观测到的因果表示学习问题，提供了从高维观测中识别潜在变量的理论结果，并提出了基于稀疏性和高斯性的两阶段估计方法。

背景: 研究潜在变量服从可能退化的高斯混合分布且仅通过分段仿射混合函数观测到的因果表示学习问题，该问题在高维观测中识别潜在变量具有挑战性。

目的: 研究潜在变量服从可能退化的高斯混合分布且仅通过分段仿射混合函数观测到的因果表示学习问题，提供一系列逐步增强的可识别性结果，并基于理论结果提出估计潜在变量的两阶段方法。

方法: 利用稀疏正则化实现可识别性，提出一种两阶段方法通过在学习的表示中强制稀疏性和高斯性来估计潜在变量。

主要发现: 在潜在变量服从可能退化的高斯混合分布且仅通过分段仿射混合函数观测到的因果表示学习问题中，提供了从高维观测中识别潜在变量的理论结果，并提出了基于稀疏性和高斯性的两阶段估计方法。

结论: 在合成数据和图像数据上的实验突出了该方法在恢复真实潜在变量方面的有效性。

翻译: 摘要：因果表示学习旨在从高维观测中识别潜在变量，即使变量之间相互依赖。我们研究潜在变量服从可能退化的高斯混合分布且仅通过分段仿射混合函数观测到的这一问题的可识别性结果。由于潜在退化的可能性，概率密度函数定义不明确，我们为这一具有挑战性的设置提供了一系列逐步增强的可识别性结果。为了实现直到排列和缩放的可识别性，我们利用了学习表示上的稀疏正则化。基于我们的理论结果，我们提出了一种两阶段方法，通过在学习的表示中强制稀疏性和高斯性来估计潜在变量。在合成数据和图像数据上的实验突出了该方法在恢复真实潜在变量方面的有效性。

Abstract

Causal representation learning (CRL) aims to identify the underlying latent variables from high-dimensional observations, even when variables are dependent with each other. We study this problem for latent variables that follow a potentially degenerate Gaussian mixture distribution and that are only observed through the transformation via a piecewise affine mixing function. We provide a series of progressively stronger identifiability results for this challenging setting in which the probability density functions are ill-defined because of the potential degeneracy. For identifiability up to permutation and scaling, we leverage a sparsity regularization on the learned representation. Based on our theoretical results, we propose a two-stage method to estimate the latent variables by enforcing sparsity and Gaussianity in the learned representations. Experiments on synthetic and image data highlight our method's effectiveness in recovering the ground-truth latent variables.

item.title: Deep Spatially-Regularized and Superpixel-Based Diffusion Learning for Unsupervised Hyperspectral Image Clustering
item.author: Vutichart Buranasiri, James M. Murphy
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种无监督框架，结合了掩码深度表示学习和基于扩散的聚类，扩展了S2DL算法，命名为DS2DL。

背景: 现有方法存在局限性，需要更忠实反映数据流形内在几何特性的扩散距离和扩散图构建。

目的: 提高高光谱图像聚类的标签准确性和聚类质量。

方法: 1. 使用带有Vision Transformer骨干的无监督掩码自编码器(UMAE)学习去噪潜在表示；2. 使用熵率超像素(ERS)算法分割图像；3. 在压缩的潜在空间内构建空间正则化扩散图；4. 利用扩散距离和扩散图构建。

主要发现: 在Botswana和KSC数据集上的实验证明了DS2DL算法的有效性。

结论: DS2DL算法通过更忠实的扩散距离和扩散图构建，能够更好地反映数据流形的内在几何特性，从而提升聚类性能。

翻译: 摘要：提出了一种结合掩码深度表示学习和基于扩散的聚类的无监督高光谱图像(HSI)聚类框架，扩展了空间正则化超像素基于扩散学习(S2DL)算法。首先，通过带有Vision Transformer骨干的无监督掩码自编码器(UMAE)模型学习原始HSI的去噪潜在表示。UMAE考虑了空间上下文和长距离光谱相关性，并通过利用仅一小部分训练像素的高效预训练过程实现了掩码。在下一阶段，使用熵率超像素(ERS)算法将图像分割成超像素，并使用压缩潜在空间内的欧氏距离和扩散距离构建空间正则化扩散图，而不是HSI空间。提出的算法Deep Spatially-Regularized Superpixel-based Diffusion Learning (DS2DL)利用了更忠实的扩散距离和随后的扩散图构建，更好地反映了底层数据流形的内在几何特性，提高了标签准确性和聚类质量。在Botswana和KSC数据集上的实验证明了DS2DL的有效性。

Abstract

An unsupervised framework for hyperspectral image (HSI) clustering is proposed that incorporates masked deep representation learning with diffusion-based clustering, extending the Spatially-Regularized Superpixel-based Diffusion Learning ($S^2DL$) algorithm. Initially, a denoised latent representation of the original HSI is learned via an unsupervised masked autoencoder (UMAE) model with a Vision Transformer backbone. The UMAE takes spatial context and long-range spectral correlations into account and incorporates an efficient pretraining process via masking that utilizes only a small subset of training pixels. In the next stage, the entropy rate superpixel (ERS) algorithm is used to segment the image into superpixels, and a spatially regularized diffusion graph is constructed using Euclidean and diffusion distances within the compressed latent space instead of the HSI space. The proposed algorithm, Deep Spatially-Regularized Superpixel-based Diffusion Learning ($DS^2DL$), leverages more faithful diffusion distances and subsequent diffusion graph construction that better reflect the intrinsic geometry of the underlying data manifold, improving labeling accuracy and clustering quality. Experiments on Botswana and KSC datasets demonstrate the efficacy of $DS^2DL$.

item.title: Threat Modeling and Attack Surface Analysis of IoT-Enabled Controlled Environment Agriculture Systems
item.author: Andrii Vakhnovskyi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了首个针对物联网赋能的受控环境农业系统的综合威胁模型，并分析了AI驱动的农业系统特有的攻击类别及物理影响。

背景: 美国将农业列为关键基础设施，但农业运营缺乏强制性的网络安全要求，且受控环境农业系统尚未发布正式的威胁模型。

目的: 构建首个针对物联网赋能的受控环境农业系统的综合威胁模型，并识别AI驱动农业特有的攻击类别。

方法: 应用STRIDE分析、MITRE ATT&CK映射以及IEC 62443区域和管道分解方法，对部署在美国8个气候区的30多家商业设施中的生产平台进行分析。

主要发现: 识别出跨越15种通信协议的123种独特威胁，其中10种在设计上缺乏认证或加密；发现了五种AI驱动农业特有的攻击类别；量化了作物损失时间；商业供应商中仅有一项CVE、零漏洞赏金计划和零IEC 62443认证。

结论: 提出了纵深防御的对策框架，并建议将安全等级2作为最低基线。

翻译: 美国将农业列为关键基础设施，但农业运营缺乏强制性的网络安全要求，且受控环境农业系统尚未发布正式的威胁模型。本文提出了首个针对物联网赋能的受控环境农业系统的综合威胁模型，并分析了AI驱动的农业系统特有的攻击类别及物理影响。

Abstract

The United States designates Food and Agriculture as one of sixteen critical infrastructure sectors, yet no mandatory cybersecurity requirements exist for agricultural operations and no formal threat model has been published for Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA) systems. This paper presents the first comprehensive threat model for IoT-enabled CEA, applying STRIDE analysis, MITRE ATT&CK for ICS mapping, and IEC 62443 zone-and-conduit decomposition to a production platform deployed across 30+ commercial facilities in 8 U.S. climate zones. We enumerate 123 unique threats across 25 data-flow-diagram elements spanning 15 communication protocols, 10 of which operate with zero authentication or encryption by design. We identify five novel attack classes unique to AI-driven CEA: stealth destabilization of neural-network-tuned PID controllers, baseline drift poisoning of anomaly detectors, cross-facility propagation via federated transfer learning, adversarial agronomic schedules that exploit crop biology rather than computational models, and reward poisoning of reinforcement-learning energy optimizers. Physical impact analysis quantifies crop loss timelines from minutes (aeroponics) to days, including worker safety hazards from CO2 injection manipulation. A survey of 10 commercial CEA vendors reveals only one CVE ever issued, zero bug bounty programs, and zero IEC 62443 certifications. We propose a defense-in-depth countermeasure framework and recommend Security Level 2 as a minimum baseline.

item.title: Topological Complexity and Phase Space Stability: A Persistent Homology Approach to Cryptocurrency Risk
item.author: Gabriel Santana, Jemirson Ramirez
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于拓扑数据分析（TDA）的金融风险量化框架，通过分析重构相空间的结构不稳定性来评估风险，并提出了基于拓扑持久范数的杠杆校准启发式方法。

背景: 传统的金融风险度量方法主要基于回报分布的二阶矩或尾部风险启发式方法（如VaR/CVaR），无法考虑市场动态的内在几何结构。

目的: 引入一个严谨的数学框架，利用拓扑数据分析（TDA）来量化风险，作为重构相空间的结构不稳定性。

方法: 应用Takens延迟嵌入定理对加密货币对数回报进行处理，生成底层吸引子的点云表示；分析Vietoris-Rips复形的滤过以计算持久同调群；定义拓扑持久范数；提出基于一维循环持久性的杠杆校准启发式方法。

主要发现: 该方法提供了一种坐标无关、稳定性不变的风险评估度量标准，对高频噪声具有鲁棒性。

结论: 该方法能够有效捕捉市场动态的内在几何结构，为风险评估提供了一种新的数学工具。

翻译: 摘要：金融中传统的风险度量方法主要基于回报分布的二阶矩或尾部风险启发式方法（如VaR/CVaR），无法考虑市场动态的内在几何结构。本文引入了一个严谨的数学框架，利用拓扑数据分析（TDA）将风险量化为重构相空间的结构不稳定性。通过将Takens延迟嵌入定理应用于加密货币对数回报，我们生成了底层吸引子的点云表示。我们分析了Vietoris-Rips复形的滤过演变以计算持久同调群。我们定义了一个“拓扑持久范数”来表征市场状态，并提出了一种基于一维循环持久性的杠杆校准启发式方法。这种方法为风险评估提供了一种坐标无关、稳定性不变的度量标准，对高频噪声具有鲁棒性。

Abstract

Traditional risk measures in finance, predominantly based on the second moment of return distributions or tail risk heuristics (VaR/CVaR), fail to account for the intrinsic geometric structure of market dynamics. This paper introduces a rigorous mathematical framework utilizing Topological Data Analysis (TDA) to quantify risk as the structural instability of the reconstructed phase space. By applying Takens' Delay Embedding Theorem to cryptocurrency log-returns, we generate a point cloud representation of the underlying attractor. We analyze the evolution of the filtration of Vietoris-Rips complexes to compute persistent homology groups $H_k$. We define a "Topological Persistence Norm" to characterize market regimes and propose a leverage calibration heuristic based on the persistence of 1-dimensional cycles. This approach provides a coordinate-free, stability-invariant metric for risk assessment that is robust to high-frequency noise.

item.title: Why MLLMs Struggle to Determine Object Orientations
item.author: Anju Gopinath, Nikhil Krishnaswamy, Bruce Draper
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了多模态大语言模型在处理2D物体方向推理任务时的失败原因，发现视觉编码器并非主要原因，但模型未能有效利用编码器中分散的方向信息。

背景: 先前的研究表明，多模态大语言模型在处理需要推理图像中2D物体方向的任务时存在困难，Tong et al.和Nichols et al.假设这些失败源于视觉编码器，因为常用的CLIP和SigLIP等编码器是针对图像-文本语义对齐而非几何推理进行训练的。

目的: 设计一个受控的实证协议来测试视觉编码器是否是导致多模态大语言模型在2D方向任务中失败的原因，具体通过测量编码器表示中是否可以恢复旋转信息来进行验证。

方法: 研究者在LLaVA OneVision和Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型中检查了SigLIP和ViT特征，在LLaVA 1.5和1.6中检查了CLIP表示，使用全图像或旋转前景补丁与自然背景图像，训练线性回归器从编码特征中预测物体方向。

主要发现: 尽管假设方向信息未在编码器嵌入中保留，但研究发现方向信息可以从编码器表示中恢复：简单的线性模型可以准确从嵌入中预测物体方向。这表明多模态大语言模型在2D方向任务中的失败并非源于视觉编码器的局限性。

结论: 虽然拒绝了视觉编码器是导致多模态大语言模型在2D方向任务中失败原因的假设，但发现方向信息虽然存在但分散在数万个特征中，这可能是模型未能利用可用方向信息的原因。

翻译: 多模态大语言模型在处理需要推理图像中2D物体方向的任务时存在困难，先前的研究表明这可能是由于视觉编码器的局限性。本文设计了一个受控的实证协议来测试这一假设，通过测量编码器表示中是否可以恢复旋转信息。研究发现，方向信息可以从编码器表示中恢复，简单的线性模型可以准确预测物体方向，这反驳了视觉编码器是失败原因的假设。然而，方向信息虽然存在但分散在数万个特征中，这可能是模型未能利用可用方向信息的原因。

Abstract

Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with tasks that require reasoning about 2D object orientation in images, as documented in prior work. Tong et al. and Nichols et al. hypothesize that these failures originate in the visual encoder, since commonly used encoders such as CLIP and SigLIP are trained for image-text semantic alignment rather than geometric reasoning. We design a controlled empirical protocol to test this claim by measuring whether rotations can be recovered from encoder representations. In particular, we examine SigLIP and ViT features from LLaVA OneVision and Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct models, respectively, using full images, and examine CLIP representations in LLaVA 1.5 and 1.6 using rotated foreground patches against natural background images. Our null hypothesis is that orientation information is not preserved in the encoder embeddings and we test this by training linear regressors to predict object orientation from encoded features. Contrary to the hypothesis, we find that orientation information is recoverable from encoder representations: simple linear models accurately predict object orientations from embeddings. This contradicts the assumption that MLLM orientation failures originate in the visual encoder. Having rejected the accepted hypothesis that MLLMs struggle with 2D orientation tasks because of visual encoder limitations, we still don't know why they fail. Although a full explanation is beyond the scope of this paper, we show that although present, orientation information is spread diffusely across tens of thousands of features. This may or may not be while MLLMs fail to exploit the available orientation information.

item.title: Text-Attributed Knowledge Graph Enrichment with Large Language Models for Medical Concept Representation
item.author: Mohsen Nayebi Kerdabadi, Arya Hadizadeh Moghaddam, Chen Chen, Dongjie Wang, Zijun Yao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CoMed是一个基于大语言模型赋能的图学习框架，用于医学概念表示学习，旨在解决现有资源中跨类型依赖缺失和临床语义缺失的问题。

背景: 在电子健康记录挖掘中，学习高质量的医学概念表示对于下游临床预测至关重要。然而，现有的本体资源存在两个关键挑战：一是临床重要的跨类型依赖关系往往缺失或不完整；二是丰富的临床语义在结构化资源中往往缺失，且难以与知识图谱结构进行整合。

目的: 为了解决上述挑战，提出CoMed框架，利用大语言模型赋能图学习来学习医学概念表示。

方法: CoMed首先通过结合从EHR中挖掘的统计可靠关联和类型约束的大语言模型提示来推断语义关系，构建全局医学代码知识图谱。然后利用大语言模型生成节点描述和边理由，将知识图谱丰富为文本属性图。最后，通过联合训练一个LoRA微调的LLaMA文本编码器与异构图神经网络，将文本语义和图结构融合为统一的概念嵌入。

主要发现: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上的广泛实验表明，CoMed一致地提高了预测性能，并作为标准EHR管道中有效的即插即用概念编码器。

结论: CoMed是一个有效的医学概念表示学习方法，能够有效整合文本语义和图结构，提升临床预测任务的表现。

翻译: 在电子健康记录挖掘中，学习高质量的医学概念表示（如标准化诊断、药物和程序代码）对于下游临床预测至关重要。然而，稳健的概念表示学习受到两个关键挑战的阻碍：（i）临床重要的跨类型依赖关系（例如诊断-药物和药物-程序关系）在现有本体资源中经常缺失或不完整，限制了建模复杂EHR模式的能力；以及（ii）丰富的临床语义经常从结构化资源中缺失，即使作为文本可用，也难以与知识图谱结构整合以进行表示学习。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了CoMed，这是一个用于医学概念表示的大语言模型赋能的图学习框架。CoMed首先通过结合从EHR中挖掘的统计可靠关联和类型约束的大语言模型提示来推断语义关系，在医学代码上构建全局知识图谱。然后，它利用大语言模型生成节点描述和边理由，将知识图谱丰富为文本属性图，为概念及其关系提供语义信号。最后，CoMed联合训练一个LoRA微调的LLaMA文本编码器和一个异构图神经网络，将文本语义和图结构融合为统一的概念嵌入。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上的广泛实验表明，CoMed一致地提高了预测性能，并作为标准EHR管道中有效的即插即用概念编码器。

Abstract

In electronic health record (EHR) mining, learning high-quality representations of medical concepts (e.g., standardized diagnosis, medication, and procedure codes) is fundamental for downstream clinical prediction. However, robust concept representation learning is hindered by two key challenges: (i) clinically important cross-type dependencies (e.g., diagnosis-medication and medication-procedure relations) are often missing or incomplete in existing ontology resources, limiting the ability to model complex EHR patterns; and (ii) rich clinical semantics are often missing from structured resources, and even when available as text, are difficult to integrate with KG structure for representation learning. To address these challenges, we present CoMed, an LLM-empowered graph learning framework for medical concept representation. CoMed first builds a global knowledge graph (KG) over medical codes by combining statistically reliable associations mined from EHRs with type-constrained LLM prompting to infer semantic relations. It then utilizes LLMs to enrich the KG into a text-attributed graph by generating node descriptions and edge rationales, providing semantic signals for both concepts and their relationships. Finally, CoMed jointly trains a LoRA-tuned LLaMA text encoder with a heterogeneous GNN, fusing text semantics and graph structure into unified concept embeddings. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV show that CoMed consistently improves prediction performance and serves as an effective plug-in concept encoder for standard EHR pipelines.

item.title: Selecting Feature Interactions for Generalized Additive Models by Distilling Foundation Models
item.author: Jingyun Jia, Chandan Singh, Rich Caruana, Ben Lengerich
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为TabDistill的方法，利用表格基础模型和后处理蒸馏技术来识别表格数据中有意义特征交互，并将其用于构建可解释的广义加性模型。

背景: 在构建准确且可解释的表格数据模型时，识别有意义的特征交互是一个核心挑战。虽然广义加性模型在建模表格数据方面取得了巨大成功，但它们通常依赖启发式程序来选择交互，这可能导致遗漏高阶或上下文相关的效应。

目的: 为了解决上述挑战，本文旨在利用表格基础模型和后处理蒸馏方法来发现特征交互，从而提高下游广义加性模型的预测性能。

方法: TabDistill方法首先在一个数据集上拟合一个表格基础模型，然后应用一种后处理交互归因方法从该模型中提取显著的特征交互。随后，将这些提取的交互项用作广义加性模型的组成部分。

主要发现: 在各项任务中，TabDistill识别出的交互项导致下游广义加性模型的预测性能得到一致提升。

结论: 结果表明，表格基础模型可以作为发现交互的有效且数据驱动的向导，从而连接高容量模型和可解释的加性框架。

翻译: 识别有意义的特征交互是构建准确且可解释的表格数据模型的核心挑战。广义加性模型在建模表格数据方面取得了巨大成功，但通常依赖启发式程序来选择交互，这可能导致遗漏高阶或上下文相关的效应。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了TabDistill，一种利用表格基础模型和后处理蒸馏方法的方法。我们的关键直觉是，表格基础模型通过大规模表示学习隐式地学习丰富且自适应的特征依赖关系。给定一个数据集，TabDistill首先在一个数据集上拟合一个表格基础模型，然后应用一种后处理交互归因方法从该模型中提取显著的特征交互。我们通过将这些交互项用作广义加性模型中的项来评估这些交互。在各项任务中，我们发现TabDistill识别出的交互项导致下游广义加性模型的预测性能得到一致提升。我们的结果表明，表格基础模型可以作为发现交互的有效且数据驱动的向导，从而连接高容量模型和可解释的加性框架。

Abstract

Identifying meaningful feature interactions is a central challenge in building accurate and interpretable models for tabular data. Generalized additive models (GAMs) have shown great success at modeling tabular data, but often rely on heuristic procedures to select interactions, potentially missing higher-order or context-dependent effects. To meet this challenge, we propose TabDistill, a method that leverages tabular foundation models and post-hoc distillation methods. Our key intuition is that tabular foundation models implicitly learn rich, adaptive feature dependencies through large-scale representation learning. Given a dataset, TabDistill first fits a tabular foundation model to the dataset, and then applies a post-hoc interaction attribution method to extract salient feature interactions from it. We evaluate these interactions by then using them as terms in a GAM. Across tasks, we find that interactions identified by TabDistill lead to consistent improvements in downstream GAMs' predictive performance. Our results suggest that tabular foundation models can serve as effective, data-driven guides for interaction discovery, bridging high-capacity models and interpretable additive frameworks.

item.title: Joint Semantic Coding and Routing for Multi-Hop Semantic Transmission in LEO Satellite Networks
item.author: Hong Zeng, Jiangtao Luo, Yongyi Ran
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于图的联合路由与语义编码方法GraphJSCR，用于解决动态低轨卫星网络中的多跳语义传输问题。

背景: 低轨卫星网络面临拓扑变化、链路变化和队列动态等挑战，导致端到端性能依赖于路由、中继处理和语义负载适应。现有研究通常分别优化路由或语义传输，不适用于局部观测下的动态卫星场景。

目的: 提出GraphJSCR方法，以解决动态低轨卫星网络中多跳语义传输的问题，实现路由与语义编码的联合优化。

方法: 将卫星星座建模为时变有向图，将转发过程表述为部分可观测顺序决策问题。设计了图表示学习模块以编码局部拓扑、链路状态、队列条件、数据包上下文和语义传输状态。基于学习到的表示，决策网络联合确定下一跳选择、中继处理级别和语义传输预算，以平衡端到端语义质量和传输延迟。语义编码器-解码器参考SwinJSCC框架开发。

主要发现: 仿真结果表明，GraphJSCR比基准方法收敛更快，在语义保真度和传输效率之间取得了更好的权衡。

结论: GraphJSCR在动态低轨卫星网络中实现了更快的收敛和更好的性能平衡。

翻译: Low Earth Orbit satellite networks pose significant challenges to multi-hop semantic transmission because rapidly changing topology, link variability, and queue dynamics make end-to-end performance jointly depend on routing, relay processing, and semantic payload adaptation. Existing studies usually optimize routing or semantic transmission separately and are therefore not well suited to dynamic satellite scenarios under local observations. To address this issue, this paper proposes GraphJSCR, a graph-based joint routing and semantic coding method for multi-hop semantic transmission in dynamic Low Earth Orbit satellite networks. The satellite constellation is modeled as a time-varying directed graph, and the forwarding process is formulated as a partially observable sequential decision problem. A graph representation learning module is designed to encode local topology, link status, queue conditions, packet context, and semantic transmission states. Based on the learned representation, the proposed decision network jointly determines next-hop selection, relay processing level, and semantic transmission budget to balance end-to-end semantic quality and transmission delay. The semantic encoder-decoder is developed with reference to the SwinJSCC framework. Simulation results demonstrate that GraphJSCR achieves faster convergence and a better tradeoff between semantic fidelity and transmission efficiency than benchmark methods.

Abstract

Low Earth Orbit satellite networks pose significant challenges to multi-hop semantic transmission because rapidly changing topology, link variability, and queue dynamics make end-to-end performance jointly depend on routing, relay processing, and semantic payload adaptation. Existing studies usually optimize routing or semantic transmission separately and are therefore not well suited to dynamic satellite scenarios under local observations. To address this issue, this paper proposes GraphJSCR, a graph-based joint routing and semantic coding method for multi-hop semantic transmission in dynamic Low Earth Orbit satellite networks. The satellite constellation is modeled as a time-varying directed graph, and the forwarding process is formulated as a partially observable sequential decision problem. A graph representation learning module is designed to encode local topology, link status, queue conditions, packet context, and semantic transmission states. Based on the learned representation, the proposed decision network jointly determines next-hop selection, relay processing level, and semantic transmission budget to balance end-to-end semantic quality and transmission delay. The semantic encoder-decoder is developed with reference to the SwinJSCC framework. Simulation results demonstrate that GraphJSCR achieves faster convergence and a better tradeoff between semantic fidelity and transmission efficiency than benchmark methods.

item.title: Why Multimodal In-Context Learning Lags Behind? Unveiling the Inner Mechanisms and Bottlenecks
item.author: Yu Wang, Sharon Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 研究分析了多模态大语言模型中的上下文学习机制，发现其在零样本设置下表现与纯文本上下文学习相当，但在少样本设置下性能显著下降。研究通过分解任务映射构建和转移过程，揭示了模型在跨模态任务映射建立和转移方面的局限性，并提出了一种简单的推理阶段增强方法来强化任务映射转移。

背景: 尽管上下文学习在大型语言模型中取得了成功，但将其扩展到多模态设置时的内部机制以及与纯文本上下文学习的差异仍知之甚少。

目的: 对多模态大语言模型中的上下文学习进行系统分析，以理解其内部机制以及与纯文本上下文学习的差异。

方法: 使用跨模态的相同任务表述，将多模态上下文学习分解为任务映射构建和任务映射转移，分析模型如何建立跨模态任务映射并将其转移到查询样本中。

主要发现: 当前模型缺乏视觉和文本表示之间的推理级对齐，无法可靠地将学习的任务映射转移到查询上。

结论: 研究结果为多模态上下文学习的机制和局限性提供了新的见解，并为更有效的多模态适应提供了方向。

翻译: In-context learning (ICL) enables models to adapt to new tasks via inference-time demonstrations. Despite its success in large language models, the extension of ICL to multimodal settings remains poorly understood in terms of its internal mechanisms and how it differs from text-only ICL. In this work, we conduct a systematic analysis of ICL in multimodal large language models. Using identical task formulations across modalities, we show that multimodal ICL performs comparably to text-only ICL in zero-shot settings but degrades significantly under few-shot demonstrations. To understand this gap, we decompose multimodal ICL into task mapping construction and task mapping transfer, and analyze how models establish cross-modal task mappings, and transfer them to query samples across layers. Our analysis reveals that current models lack reasoning-level alignment between visual and textual representations, and fail to reliably transfer learned task mappings to queries. Guided by these findings, we further propose a simple inference-stage enhancement method that reinforces task mapping transfer. Our results provide new insights into the mechanisms and limitations of multimodal ICL and suggest directions for more effective multimodal adaptation. Our code is available here.

Abstract

In-context learning (ICL) enables models to adapt to new tasks via inference-time demonstrations. Despite its success in large language models, the extension of ICL to multimodal settings remains poorly understood in terms of its internal mechanisms and how it differs from text-only ICL. In this work, we conduct a systematic analysis of ICL in multimodal large language models. Using identical task formulations across modalities, we show that multimodal ICL performs comparably to text-only ICL in zero-shot settings but degrades significantly under few-shot demonstrations. To understand this gap, we decompose multimodal ICL into task mapping construction and task mapping transfer, and analyze how models establish cross-modal task mappings, and transfer them to query samples across layers. Our analysis reveals that current models lack reasoning-level alignment between visual and textual representations, and fail to reliably transfer learned task mappings to queries. Guided by these findings, we further propose a simple inference-stage enhancement method that reinforces task mapping transfer. Our results provide new insights into the mechanisms and limitations of multimodal ICL and suggest directions for more effective multimodal adaptation. Our code is available \href{https://github.com/deeplearning-wisc/Multimocal-ICL-Analysis-Framework-MGI}{here}.

item.title: MERRIN: A Benchmark for Multimodal Evidence Retrieval and Reasoning in Noisy Web Environments
item.author: Han Wang, David Wan, Hyunji Lee, Thinh Pham, Mikaela Cankosyan, Weiyuan Chen, Elias Stengel-Eskin, Tu Vu, Mohit Bansal
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MERRIN是一个用于评估搜索增强型AI代理的多模态证据检索和推理基准测试，旨在解决搜索查询的未指定和多跳性质以及真实世界网络结果的模态、异质性和冲突性质。

背景: 搜索查询具有未指定的、多跳的性质，而真实世界的网络结果具有多模态、异质性和经常冲突的性质。

目的: 引入MERRIN以评估搜索增强型AI代理的能力，包括识别相关模态、检索多模态证据以及在嘈杂的网络源上进行多跳推理。

方法: MERRIN与先前工作有三个重要区别：使用没有显式模态提示的自然语言查询；纳入视频和音频等未探索的模态；要求在网页搜索期间检索复杂、经常嘈杂或冲突的多模态证据。研究评估了十种模型（包括强闭源模型和开放权重模型）在三种搜索设置下的表现。

主要发现: MERRIN具有很高的挑战性，所有代理的平均准确率为22.3%，表现最好的代理仅达到40.1%。更强的代理如Gemini Deep Research虽然性能更高，但收益微薄，因为过度探索；它们消耗更多资源但准确率较低，主要由于源选择效率低下和对文本模态的过度依赖。

结论: 需要能够在嘈杂的网络环境中跨不同模态进行稳健搜索和推理的搜索代理，MERRIN为此提供了一个有价值的测试床。

翻译: 受搜索查询的未指定和多跳性质以及真实世界网络结果的多模态、异质性和经常冲突的性质的启发，我们介绍了MERRIN（多模态证据检索和推理在嘈杂网络环境中），这是一个用于评估搜索增强型代理的人为标注基准。MERRIN衡量AI代理识别相关模态、检索多模态证据以及在嘈杂网络源上进行多跳推理的能力。它在三个方面与先前工作不同：（1）使用没有显式模态提示的自然语言查询，（2）纳入视频和音频等未探索的模态，（3）要求在网页搜索期间检索复杂、经常嘈杂或冲突的多模态证据。我们在三种搜索设置下（无搜索、原生搜索和代理搜索）评估了十种模型驱动的各种搜索代理。我们的结果表明MERRIN具有很高的挑战性：所有代理的平均准确率为22.3%，表现最好的代理仅达到40.1%。我们进一步观察到，虽然像Gemini Deep Research这样的更强代理实现了更高的性能，但由于过度探索，收益微薄；它们采取更多步骤并使用更多工具，但经常被冲突或部分相关的网络内容分散注意力，导致错误的答案。与人类相比，这些代理消耗更多资源但准确率较低，主要由于源选择效率低下和对文本模态的过度依赖。这些发现强调了需要在嘈杂的网络环境中跨不同模态进行稳健搜索和推理的搜索代理的需求，使MERRIN成为评估此类能力的有价值的测试床。

Abstract

Motivated by the underspecified, multi-hop nature of search queries and the multimodal, heterogeneous, and often conflicting nature of real-world web results, we introduce MERRIN (Multimodal Evidence Retrieval and Reasoning in Noisy Web Environments), a human-annotated benchmark for evaluating search-augmented agents. MERRIN measures AI agents' ability to identify relevant modalities, retrieve multimodal evidence, and perform multi-hop reasoning over noisy web sources. It differs from prior work in three important aspects: (1) using natural language queries without explicit modality cues, (2) incorporating underexplored modalities such as video and audio, and (3) requiring the retrieval of complex, often noisy or conflicting multimodal evidence during web search. We evaluate diverse search agents powered by ten models, including strong closed-source models (e.g., GPT-5.4-mini, Gemini 3/3.1 Flash/Pro) and open-weight models (Qwen3-4B/30B/235B), across three search settings (no search, native search, and agentic search). Our results show that MERRIN is highly challenging: the average accuracy across all agents is 22.3%, with the best-performing agent reaching only 40.1%. We further observe that while stronger agents like Gemini Deep Research achieve higher performance, gains are modest due to over-exploration; they take more steps and use more tools, but are often distracted by conflicting or partially relevant web content, leading to incorrect answers. Compared to humans, these agents consume more resources yet achieve lower accuracy, largely due to inefficient source selection and an overreliance on text modalities. These findings highlight the need for search agents capable of robust search and reasoning across diverse modalities in noisy web environments, making MERRIN a valuable testbed for evaluating such capabilities.

item.title: VibeFlow: Versatile Video Chroma-Lux Editing through Self-Supervised Learning
item.author: Yifan Li, Pei Cheng, Bin Fu, Shuai Yang, Jiaying Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: VibeFlow是一个无需昂贵训练资源且具有零样本泛化能力的自监督视频色光编辑框架。

背景: 视频色光编辑旨在修改光照和颜色同时保持结构和时间一致性，但现有方法通常依赖昂贵的合成配对数据进行监督训练。

目的: 提出VibeFlow框架，旨在通过自监督方式实现鲁棒的结构与色光解耦，消除离散化误差，并降低计算开销。

方法: 引入解耦数据扰动流水线，利用预训练视频生成模型的自适应结构重组；引入残差速度场和结构畸变一致性正则化以修正离散化误差。

主要发现: VibeFlow在视频重光照、重着色、低光增强、昼夜转换和特定对象颜色编辑等多样化应用中表现出色，视觉质量显著提升且计算开销大幅降低。

结论: 该框架无需昂贵训练资源，实现了零样本泛化，在保持视觉质量的同时显著减少了计算开销。

翻译: Video chroma-lux editing, which aims to modify illumination and color while preserving structural and temporal fidelity, remains a significant challenge. Existing methods typically rely on expensive supervised training with synthetic paired data. This paper proposes VibeFlow, a novel self-supervised framework that unleashes the intrinsic physical understanding of pre-trained video generation models. Instead of learning color and light transitions from scratch, we introduce a disentangled data perturbation pipeline that enforces the model to adaptively recombine structure from source videos and color-illumination cues from reference images, enabling robust disentanglement in a self-supervised manner. Furthermore, to rectify discretization errors inherent in flow-based models, we introduce Residual Velocity Fields alongside a Structural Distortion Consistency Regularization, ensuring rigorous structural preservation and temporal coherence. Our framework eliminates the need for costly training resources and generalizes in a zero-shot manner to diverse applications, including video relighting, recoloring, low-light enhancement, day-night translation, and object-specific color editing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VibeFlow achieves impressive visual quality with significantly reduced computational overhead. Our project is publicly available at https://lyf1212.github.io/VibeFlow-webpage.

Abstract

Video chroma-lux editing, which aims to modify illumination and color while preserving structural and temporal fidelity, remains a significant challenge. Existing methods typically rely on expensive supervised training with synthetic paired data. This paper proposes VibeFlow, a novel self-supervised framework that unleashes the intrinsic physical understanding of pre-trained video generation models. Instead of learning color and light transitions from scratch, we introduce a disentangled data perturbation pipeline that enforces the model to adaptively recombine structure from source videos and color-illumination cues from reference images, enabling robust disentanglement in a self-supervised manner. Furthermore, to rectify discretization errors inherent in flow-based models, we introduce Residual Velocity Fields alongside a Structural Distortion Consistency Regularization, ensuring rigorous structural preservation and temporal coherence. Our framework eliminates the need for costly training resources and generalizes in a zero-shot manner to diverse applications, including video relighting, recoloring, low-light enhancement, day-night translation, and object-specific color editing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VibeFlow achieves impressive visual quality with significantly reduced computational overhead. Our project is publicly available at https://lyf1212.github.io/VibeFlow-webpage.

item.title: Joint Representation Learning and Clustering via Gradient-Based Manifold Optimization
item.author: Sida Liu, Yangzi Guo, Mingyuan Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种同时进行降维和聚类的流形学习框架，通过梯度流形优化在流形上搜索最优参数和聚类。

背景: 在高维数据聚类中，由于维度灾难的挑战，联合学习降维和聚类是一个更有前景的方向。

目的: 提出一种流形学习框架，旨在同时学习降维技术的参数和基于所得特征进行聚类。

方法: 该框架通过梯度流形优化在流形上搜索降维参数和最优聚类，并以高斯混合模型为例进行示例。

主要发现: 该算法在模拟数据和MNIST基准图像数据集上的实验结果表明，其性能优于文献中的流行聚类算法。

结论: 提出的算法在无监督训练任务中表现出更好的性能。

翻译: 聚类和降维一直是机器学习和计算机视觉中的关键话题。由于维度灾难，高维数据的聚类长期以来一直是一个挑战。因此，一个更有前景的方向是联合学习降维和聚类。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种流形学习框架，同时学习降维和聚类。该框架能够联合学习降维技术的参数（例如线性投影或神经网络）并基于所得特征对数据进行聚类（例如在高斯混合模型框架下）。该框架通过梯度流形优化在流形上搜索降维参数和最优聚类。该框架以高斯混合模型为例，这是一个简单但高效的例子，其过程类似于无监督线性判别分析（LDA）。我们将提出的方法应用于模拟数据的无监督训练以及基准图像数据集（即MNIST）。实验结果表明，我们的算法比文献中的流行聚类算法具有更好的性能。

Abstract

Clustering and dimensionality reduction have been crucial topics in machine learning and computer vision. Clustering high-dimensional data has been challenging for a long time due to the curse of dimensionality. For that reason, a more promising direction is the joint learning of dimension reduction and clustering. In this work, we propose a Manifold Learning Framework that learns dimensionality reduction and clustering simultaneously. The proposed framework is able to jointly learn the parameters of a dimension reduction technique (e.g. linear projection or a neural network) and cluster the data based on the resulting features (e.g. under a Gaussian Mixture Model framework). The framework searches for the dimension reduction parameters and the optimal clusters by traversing a manifold,using Gradient Manifold Optimization. The obtained The proposed framework is exemplified with a Gaussian Mixture Model as one simple but efficient example, in a process that is somehow similar to unsupervised Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA). We apply the proposed method to the unsupervised training of simulated data as well as a benchmark image dataset (i.e. MNIST). The experimental results indicate that our algorithm has better performance than popular clustering algorithms from the literature.

item.title: Representation over Routing: Overcoming Surrogate Hacking in Multi-Timescale PPO
item.author: Jing Sun
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究针对强化学习中长期信用分配的挑战，提出了一种目标解耦架构，通过在评价器端保留多时间尺度预测以辅助表示学习，在演员端严格隔离短期信号并仅基于长期优势更新策略，从而解决了盲目融合多时间尺度信号导致的算法病理问题。

背景: 受神经生物学中多时间尺度多巴胺编码的启发，近期研究试图在Actor-Critic架构（如PPO）中引入多个折扣因子以平衡短期响应与长期规划，但在复杂延迟奖励任务中盲目融合多时间尺度信号会导致严重的算法病理。

目的: 解决盲目融合多时间尺度信号在复杂延迟奖励任务中引发的算法病理问题，并避免策略崩溃和陷入局部最优。

方法: 提出目标解耦架构，在评价器端保留多时间尺度预测以强制辅助表示学习，在演员端严格隔离短期信号并仅基于长期优势更新策略。

主要发现: 将时间注意力路由机制暴露给策略梯度会导致代理目标欺骗，而采用无梯度的不确定性加权会触发不可逆的短视退化现象，即时间不确定性悖论。

结论: 提出的架构在LunarLander-v2环境中通过多次独立随机种子验证，实现了统计上显著的性能提升，无需超参数调整即可持续超越“环境解决”阈值，最小化方差，完全消除策略崩溃，并摆脱了单时间尺度基线陷入的悬停局部最优。

翻译: 该研究针对强化学习中长期信用分配的挑战，提出了一种目标解耦架构，通过在评价器端保留多时间尺度预测以辅助表示学习，在演员端严格隔离短期信号并仅基于长期优势更新策略，从而解决了盲目融合多时间尺度信号导致的算法病理问题。

Abstract

Temporal credit assignment in reinforcement learning has long been a central challenge. Inspired by the multi-timescale encoding of the dopamine system in neurobiology, recent research has sought to introduce multiple discount factors into Actor-Critic architectures, such as Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), to balance short-term responses with long-term planning. However, this paper reveals that blindly fusing multi-timescale signals in complex delayed-reward tasks can lead to severe algorithmic pathologies. We systematically demonstrate that exposing a temporal attention routing mechanism to policy gradients results in surrogate objective hacking, while adopting gradient-free uncertainty weighting triggers irreversible myopic degeneration, a phenomenon we term the Paradox of Temporal Uncertainty. To address these issues, we propose a Target Decoupling architecture: on the Critic side, we retain multi-timescale predictions to enforce auxiliary representation learning, while on the Actor side, we strictly isolate short-term signals and update the policy based solely on long-term advantages. Rigorous empirical evaluations across multiple independent random seeds in the LunarLander-v2 environment demonstrate that our proposed architecture achieves statistically significant performance improvements. Without relying on hyperparameter hacking, it consistently surpasses the ''Environment Solved'' threshold with minimal variance, completely eliminates policy collapse, and escapes the hovering local optima that trap single-timescale baselines.

item.title: From Alignment to Prediction: A Study of Self-Supervised Learning and Predictive Representation Learning
item.author: Mintu Dutta, Ritesh Vyas, Mohendra Roy
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了自监督学习中的预测性表示学习，提出了一种新的分类方法，并比较了JEPA、BYOL和MAE等模型的表现。

背景: 现有的自监督学习方法主要围绕表示对齐和输入重建，但它们主要局限于从观测数据中学习，缺乏对数据分布的预测性结构。

目的: 研究自监督学习的最新发展，定义预测性表示学习这一新类别，提出分类法，并讨论理论视角和开放挑战。

方法: 提出了预测性表示学习的分类法，将JEPA视为该范式下的典型成员，并实现了BYOL、MAE和I-JEPA进行比较分析。

主要发现: MAE在相似性上达到1.00，但鲁棒性较弱为0.55；BYOL和I-JEPA的准确率分别为0.98和0.95，鲁棒性分别为0.75和0.78。

结论: 预测性表示学习是自监督学习研究的一个有前景的方向。

翻译: Self-supervised learning has emerged as a major technique for the task of learning from unlabeled data, where the current methods mostly revolve around alignment of representations and input reconstruction. Although such approaches have demonstrated excellent performance in practice, their scope remains mostly confined to learning from observed data and does not provide much help in terms of a learning structure that is predictive of the data distribution. In this paper, we study some of the recent developments in the realm of self-supervised learning. We define a new category called Predictive Representation Learning (PRL), which revolves around the latent prediction of unobserved components of data based on the observation. We propose a common taxonomy that classifies PRL along with alignment and reconstruction-based learning approaches. Furthermore, we argue that Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) can be considered as an exemplary member of this new paradigm. We further discuss theoretical perspectives and open challenges, highlighting predictive representation learning as a promising direction for future self-supervised learning research. In this study, we implemented Bootstrap Your Own Latent (BYOL), Masked Autoencoders (MAE), and Image-JEPA (I-JEPA) for comparative analysis. The results indicate that MAE achieves perfect similarity of 1.00, but exhibits relatively weak robustness of 0.55. In contrast, BYOL and I-JEPA attain accuracies of 0.98 and 0.95, with robustness scores of 0.75 and 0.78, respectively.

Abstract

Self-supervised learning has emerged as a major technique for the task of learning from unlabeled data, where the current methods mostly revolve around alignment of representations and input recon struction. Although such approaches have demonstrated excellent performance in practice, their scope remains mostly confined to learning from observed data and does not provide much help in terms of a learning structure that is predictive of the data distribution. In this paper, we study some of the recent developments in the realm of self-supervised learning. We define a new category called Predictive Representation Learning (PRL), which revolves around the latent prediction of unobserved components of data based on the observation. We propose a common taxonomy that classifies PRL along with alignment and reconstruction-based learning approaches. Furthermore, we argue that Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture(JEPA) can be considered as an exemplary member of this new paradigm. We further discuss theoretical perspectives and open challenges, highlighting predictive representation learning as a promising direction for future self-supervised learning research. In this study, we implemented Bootstrap Your Own Latent (BYOL), Masked Autoencoders (MAE), and Image-JEPA (I-JEPA) for comparative analysis. The results indicate that MAE achieves perfect similarity of 1.00, but exhibits relatively weak robustness of 0.55. In contrast, BYOL and I-JEPA attain accuracies of 0.98 and 0.95, with robustness scores of 0.75 and 0.78, respectively.

item.title: RiskWebWorld: A Realistic Interactive Benchmark for GUI Agents in E-commerce Risk Management
item.author: Renqi Chen, Zeyin Tao, Jianming Guo, Jing Wang, Zezhou Xu, Jingzhe Zhu, Qingqing Sun, Tianyi Zhang, Shuai Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: RiskWebWorld是一个用于评估电商风险管理领域GUI代理的高保真交互基准测试，包含1513个任务和Gymnasium兼容的基础设施。

背景: 现有的交互基准主要针对良性、可预测的消费环境，在电商风险管理等高风险调查领域的效果尚未被充分探索。

目的: 构建RiskWebWorld，这是首个用于评估电商风险管理领域GUI代理的高保真交互基准测试。

方法: RiskWebWorld包含来自8个核心领域生产风险控制管道的1513个任务，并捕捉了非合作网站和部分环境劫持的风险操作挑战；构建了Gymnasium兼容的基础设施以支持可扩展评估和代理强化学习。

主要发现: 顶级通用模型的成功率为49.1%，而专门的开放权重GUI模型几乎完全失败；在长周期专业任务中，基础模型规模目前比零样本界面定位更重要；代理强化学习使开源模型提升了16.2%。

结论: RiskWebWorld为开发稳健的数字工作者提供了实用的测试平台。

翻译: RiskWebWorld是一个用于评估电商风险管理领域GUI代理的高保真交互基准测试，包含1513个任务和Gymnasium兼容的基础设施。

Abstract

Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents show strong capabilities for automating web tasks, but existing interactive benchmarks primarily target benign, predictable consumer environments. Their effectiveness in high-stakes, investigative domains such as authentic e-commerce risk management remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present RiskWebWorld, the first highly realistic interactive benchmark for evaluating GUI agents in e-commerce risk management. RiskWebWorld features 1,513 tasks sourced from production risk-control pipelines across 8 core domains, and captures the authentic challenges of risk operations on uncooperative websites, partially environmental hijackments. To support scalable evaluation and agentic reinforcement learning (RL), we further build a Gymnasium-compliant infrastructure that decouples policy planning from environment mechanics. Our evaluation across diverse models reveals a dramatic capability gap: top-tier generalist models achieve 49.1% success, while specialized open-weights GUI models lag at near-total failure. This highlights that foundation model scale currently matters more than zero-shot interface grounding in long-horizon professional tasks. We also demonstrate the viability of our infrastructure through agentic RL, which improves open-source models by 16.2%. These results position RiskWebWorld as a practical testbed for developing robust digital workers.

item.title: Debate to Align: Reliable Entity Alignment through Two-Stage Multi-Agent Debate
item.author: Cunda Wang, Ziying Ma, Po Hu, Weihua Wang, Feilong Bao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AgentEA是一个基于多主体辩论的可靠实体对齐框架，通过优化实体表示偏好和两阶段多角色辩论机制来提高对齐决策的可靠性。

背景: 基于大语言模型的实体对齐方法通常通过知识表示学习获取实体嵌入，并利用嵌入相似度识别对齐不确定的实体集，随后检索候选实体集以支持后续的对齐推理和决策。

目的: 解决候选实体集的可靠性和大语言模型的推理能力对后续对齐决策有效性产生关键影响的问题。

方法: AgentEA首先通过实体表示偏好优化提高嵌入质量，然后引入两阶段多角色辩论机制，包括轻量级辩论验证和深度辩论对齐，以逐步增强对齐决策的可靠性并实现更高效的基于辩论的推理。

主要发现: 在跨语言、稀疏、大规模和异构设置下的公共基准测试中，AgentEA被证明是有效的。

结论: AgentEA通过改进的嵌入质量和两阶段辩论机制，有效地提高了实体对齐决策的可靠性。

翻译: AgentEA是一个基于多主体辩论的可靠实体对齐框架，通过优化实体表示偏好和两阶段多角色辩论机制来提高对齐决策的可靠性。

Abstract

Entity alignment (EA) aims to identify entities referring to the same real-world object across different knowledge graphs (KGs). Recent approaches based on large language models (LLMs) typically obtain entity embeddings through knowledge representation learning and use embedding similarity to identify an alignment-uncertain entity set. For each uncertain entity, a candidate entity set (CES) is then retrieved based on embedding similarity to support subsequent alignment reasoning and decision making. However, the reliability of the CES and the reasoning capability of LLMs critically affect the effectiveness of subsequent alignment decisions. To address this issue, we propose AgentEA, a reliable EA framework based on multi-agent debate. AgentEA first improves embedding quality through entity representation preference optimization, and then introduces a two-stage multi-role debate mechanism consisting of lightweight debate verification and deep debate alignment to progressively enhance the reliability of alignment decisions while enabling more efficient debate-based reasoning. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks under cross-lingual, sparse, large-scale, and heterogeneous settings demonstrate the effectiveness of AgentEA.

item.title: AI Powered Image Analysis for Phishing Detection
item.author: K. Acharya, S. Ale, R. Kadel
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于网页截图的深度学习钓鱼网站检测方法，通过对比ConvNeXt-Tiny和Vision Transformer模型，发现卷积模型在视觉钓鱼检测中表现更优，并强调了决策阈值调整的重要性。

背景: 钓鱼网站现在严重依赖视觉模仿，如复制标志、相似布局和匹配颜色，以避免基于文本和URL的检测系统发现。

目的: 测试ConvNeXt-Tiny和Vision Transformer（ViT-Base）两种视觉模型在处理视觉欺骗性钓鱼页面时的表现，并评估决策阈值调整对实际部署的影响。

方法: 研究框架包括数据集创建、预处理、使用ImageNet权重进行迁移学习，以及在不同决策阈值下进行评估。

主要发现: ConvNeXt-Tiny在优化阈值下表现最佳，F1分数最高，且运行效率优于ViT-Base；通过调整决策阈值可以在检测性能和误报控制之间取得平衡。

结论: 卷积模型在视觉钓鱼检测中具有优势，决策阈值调整对实际部署至关重要；研究将发布 curated 数据集以支持可重复性和进一步研究。
